notes.title: Play the Biggest Update and Claim the Biggest Gift!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="ZJ8eNee4PZU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Commanders![/p][p]
The long-awaited [b]Update 2.0[/b] has arrived! This massive release brings a wave of game-changing features and new ways to experience World of Tanks. Here are the most important ones.[/p][list][*][p][b]Tier XI: Meet the New Top-Tier Titans![/b] We are about to enter a bold new era of tactical power. Tier XI brings 16 new vehicles, each with unique mechanics and a special Upgrade system that replaces Field Modifications.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Garage and UX Improvements.[/b] Get ready for the redesigned Garage, a unified tank factory where your vehicles are assembled, equipped, and always battle-ready.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hundreds of Vehicles Rebalanced and Reforged.[/b] This historic rework reshapes hundreds of vehicles across all nations, refining the progression through Tech Tree branches and making gameplay fairer and funner at every tier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A More Intelligent Matchmaking System.[/b] The new matchmaker will be smarter than ever. Expect significantly improved role-aware team compositions, more battles with tighter tier spreads, and limits on light tanks and tank destroyers on top of SPGs for more balanced battles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Personal Missions 3.0.[/b] The third Personal Missions campaign will test your battlefield prowess in three Operations of skill-based, role-focused missions without nation or class limits. Fair and achievable conditions will steadily bring you closer to the [b]Tier VIII Windhund[/b], the [b]Tier X Dravec[/b], and ultimately the [b]Black Rock[/b], a prestige Tier XI tank with a unique firing mechanic.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visit Our Hub Page for Everything Update 2.0 Has to Offer![/b][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/wargaming/sale/wot_2_0"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/907a26bb075ed565bbb67b367107ccde313efb1e.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Get Your Epic Update 2.0 Gift[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p]Only available until the Mid-October Update[/p][/th][/tr][/table][p]Update 2.0 doesn't just come with game-changing features, it also packs a massive gift for everyone![/p][p]Log in and claim the biggest gift in WoT history, including whole Tech Tree branches with researched, purchased, and ready-for-battle vehicles.[/p][p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/862f4dfa29b84b22030d2b6c5f7cdb4a6475ac41.png[/img][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Seasoned Commanders who joined before 2.0:[/p][/th][th][p]New Commanders who are just getting started:[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][/p][list][*][p]1 complete Tier VI–X Tech Tree branch[/p][/*][*][p]2,500 gold, 15,000 bonds, and 10 million credits[/p][/*][*][p]50 Retraining Orders[/p][/*][*][p]And more![/p][/*][/list][/td][td][p][/p][list][*][p]2 complete Tier VI–X Tech Tree branches[/p][/*][*][p]6 million credits[/p][/*][*][p]Premium vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]High-tier rentals[/p][/*][*][p]And more![/p][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Enter the new era with a boost:[/h3][p][url="https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/update-2-0-gift/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f25322"]    EU    [/url]  [url="https://worldoftanks.com/news/general-news/update-2-0-gift/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f25322"]    NA    [/url]  [url="https://worldoftanks.asia/news/general-news/update-2-0-gift/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f25322"]   ASIA   [/url][/p][h2]
Play on Steam with Your Old Account![/h2][p]World of Tanks gives you total freedom to play on your terms. You can link an existing [url="https://Wargaming.net"]Wargaming.net[/url] account to Steam and continue playing with its game progress. If you previously started fresh on Steam but still have an old Wargaming account, you now have the option to reconnect and pick up where you left off.[/p]

Garage and UX Improvements. Get ready for the redesigned Garage, a unified tank factory where your vehicles are assembled, equipped, and always battle-ready.

Fair and achievable conditions will steadily bring you closer to the Tier VIII Windhund, the Tier X Dravec, and ultimately the Black Rock, a prestige Tier XI tank with a unique firing mechanic.

notes.title: Update 2.0: Vehicle Rebalance and Matchmaker Overhaul
notes.content:
[p]Commanders!  Update 2.0 is the biggest update in World of Tanks history. It brings the biggest vehicle rebalance yet and a completely reworked matchmaking system—two massive changes that reshape how battles are played. Let's take a look at each.[/p][h2]Biggest Vehicle Rebalance Ever[/h2][previewyoutube="rRed4clK3MI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This is more than just a rebalance patch—it's a complete overhaul![/p][list][*][p][b]Hundreds of vehicles across all tiers and nations[/b] have been fine-tuned to offer a smoother, more exciting experience.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Stock vehicles [/b]are stronger from the get-go, while revamped modules make early progression smoother.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Light tanks[/b] now pack more survivability without sacrificing stealth or speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Even some [b]Premium vehicles[/b] are being refreshed, with improved stats and battlefield performance that breathe new life into old favorites.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]FULL DETAILS[/b]
[url="https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/update-2-0-rebalance/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f25322"]EU[/url] [url="https://worldoftanks.com/news/general-news/update-2-0-rebalance/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f25322"]NA[/url] [url="https://worldoftanks.asia/news/general-news/update-2-0-rebalance/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f25322"]ASIA[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Matchmaker 2.0: Reforged for Fairer Battles[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9696974b7ca8fe783c2ac3f184b0c610e0a0ef69.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Matchmaker 2.0 introduces a smarter way to build battles—designed for balance, fairness, and tactical depth.[/p][list][*][p][b]Smarter team composition.[/b] The matchmaker balances not just by vehicle type, but by combat roles for more even sides.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Class limits.[/b] Light tanks, TDs, and SPGs have capped numbers per team to ensure tactical variety and reduce frustration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Closer tiers.[/b] Expect more ±1-tier battles, reducing extreme tier spreads and making matches feel tighter and fairer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fewer duplicate vehicles.[/b] The system now limits how many identical tanks can appear on the same team.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unified queue logic.[/b] Expect faster matches and smarter queue handling, especially during off-peak hours.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]LEARN MORE[/b][/p][p][url="https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/update-2-0-matchmaker/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f25322"]EU[/url] [url="https://worldoftanks.com/news/general-news/update-2-0-matchmaker/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f25322"]NA[/url] [url="https://worldoftanks.asia/news/general-news/update-2-0-matchmaker/" style="button" buttoncolor="#f25322"]ASIA[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Want to explore more about what Update 2.0 brings to the battlefield? Head to our dedicated Hub Page for all the highlights:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/wargaming/sale/wot_2_0" style="button" buttoncolor="#f25322"]HEAD TO THE HUB[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i]Roll Out![/i][/p]

tags.balance_change: Hundreds of vehicles across all tiers and nations have been fine-tuned to offer a smoother, more exciting experience.
Stock vehicles are stronger from the get-go, while revamped modules make early progression smoother.
Light tanks now pack more survivability without sacrificing stealth or speed.
Even some Premium vehicles are being refreshed, with improved stats and battlefield performance that breathe new life into old favorites.

tags.feature: Matchmaker 2.0 introduces a smarter way to build battles—designed for balance, fairness, and tactical depth.
Smarter team composition. The matchmaker balances not just by vehicle type, but by combat roles for more even sides.
Class limits. Light tanks, TDs, and SPGs have capped numbers per team to ensure tactical variety and reduce frustration.
Closer tiers. Expect more   1-tier battles, reducing extreme tier spreads and making matches feel tighter and fairer.
Fewer duplicate vehicles. The system now limits how many identical tanks can appear on the same team.
Unified queue logic. Expect faster matches and smarter queue handling, especially during off-peak hours.

notes.title: Update 2.0: Under the Hatch of Tier XI
notes.content:
Commanders,

notes.title: Raumfalte Unsealed: Discover What's Within!
notes.content:
Commanders!

During the recent clashes in Mirium subspace, we captured quite a few [b]Raumfalte[/b] from the enemy lab. These compact devices use dimensional bubbles to store and transport resources, tanks, and even other [b]nested Raumfalte[/b] devices full of cargo. You can obtain a lot of Raumfalte for yourself, and in various ways, including taking part in [b]Operation Pandora[/b]!

[table]
[tr]
[td][/td]
[td][b]EU (CEST/UTC+2)[/b][/td]
[td][b]NA (ET | CT | PT)[/b][/td]
[td][b]APAC (UTC+8)[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][b]Start[/b][/td]
[td]May 15 at 04:00[/td]
[td]May 16 at 01:30 | 03:30 | 04:30[/td]
[td]May 15 at 06:00[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][b]End[/b][/td]
[td]May 30 at 04:00[/td]
[td]May 31 at 01:30 | 03:30 | 04:30[/td]
[td]May 30 at 06:00[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[previewyoutube=1yEPtaehwH4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How It Works[/h2]
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]"Raumfalte" translates from German as [b]"dimensional fault"[/b]; the inventor of the tech, Dr. Cassada from Argentina, cooperated with the Germans during WWII. Each Raumfalte device contains [b]valuable cargo that may include armored vehicles[/b] and other rare items.[/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/30230f2d6c431acff307c62590fdc7c5742704c9.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][b]With a 20% chance, any Raumfalte will include another device[/b], often of a greater rarity. This may result in a chain of Raumfalte within Raumfalte—or even a cycle, when a device of the rarest kind produces a basic one. Raumfalte Proto are the only starting point for getting the advanced Raumfalte Alpha and Raumfalte Prime.[/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e343adbcf436330a1fd70978dc161016bf25c70c.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h2]What Can Be Inside[/h2]

[*] [b](100%)[/b] 1 Personal Reserve (+50% to XP or +50% to credits or +200% to Crew and Free XP for 1 h)
[*] [b](50%)[/b] 1, 3, or 7 Days of WoT Premium Account
[*] [b](2%)[/b] A Tier VIII or IX Premium vehicle:
[list]
[*] [b]Kpz. 3 GST Turm[/b], a Tier VIII German tank destroyer [b]NEW[/b]
[*] [b]VCS 6X6 TS 90[/b], a Tier IX French wheeled light tank [b]NEW[/b]
[*] [b]Czołg Pancernik[/b], a Tier IX Polish heavy tank [b]NEW[/b]
[*] [b]AMBT[/b]
[*] [b]SDP wz 66 Grom[/b]
[*] [b]Jagdtiger Prototype[/b]
[*] [b]T-44-100[/b]
[*] [b]AAT60[/b]
[*] [b]EMIL 1951[/b]
[*] [b]T77[/b][/list][/list]
[table]
[tr][td]
[b]Every 50th Raumfalte Proto opening is a guaranteed Premium vehicle drop[/b]; the counter is reset any time a vehicle drops.[/td][/tr][/table]
[i]Czołg Pancernik[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/63f3caf2051a33472dab2d9588acca8d9f83d002.jpg[/img]
[h3]Raumfalte Alpha: Possible Cargo[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b](20%)[/b] Another Raumfalte

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/70bd9302499310186e154b3d08c0e3e7eb4ed657.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Neon Dash: Full-Speed Fun!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Get ready for the wildest race in World of Tanks![b] Up to 30 players charge through a neon-lit track filled with obstacles[/b], traps, and chaotic physics. Fire impulse shells to knock out rivals, teleport to safety, and complete missions to earn rewards.

Buckle up—it’s going to be a wild ride.
[previewyoutube=SsO7B1vvFdM;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Event duration:[/b]
[quote=author] [b]EU[/b]: Launch 1: April 18, 2025 at 08:00 CEST (UTC+2) until April 20, 2025 at 22:00 CEST (UTC+2)  
Launch 2: April 25, 2025 at 08:00 CEST (UTC+2) until April 27, 2025 at 22:00 CEST (UTC+2)  
[b]NA[/b]: Launch 1: April 18, 2025 at 14:00 ET | 13:00 CT | 11:00 PT until April 21, 2025 at 05:00 ET | 04:00 CT | 02:00 PT  
Launch 2: April 25, 2025 at 14:00 ET | 13:00 CT | 11:00 PT until April 28, 2025 at 05:00 ET | 04:00 CT | 02:00 PT
[b]ASIA[/b]: Launch 1: April 18, 2025 at 17:00 (UTC+8) until April 20, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC+8)  
Launch 2: April 25, 2025 at 17:00 (UTC+8) until April 27, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC+8)  
[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2eaebbfe4a315acb0688b2018ab214bcf7750fe9.jpg[/img]
[h2]Mode Highlights[/h2]
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td width=25%][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/104b7940978fa6616e40f9ae8b2aff3aaddc06de.png[/img][/td]
[td][h3]30-Player Tank Racing[/h3] Compete in fast-paced battles with up to 30 players. Ram, block, and blast opponents with impulse shells. Use your shield to survive enemy hits. No credits or consumables needed—just pure racing action.[/td][/tr][/table]
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td width=25%][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5685f44126c85c38aa356d73cab73da11b0cf2d8.png[/img][/td]
[td][h3]Trap-Filled Neon Map[/h3] Dodge spinning hazards, avoid pitfalls, and use quick reflexes to reach the next checkpoint. Got knocked out? Press J to teleport back to your last checkpoint.[/td][/tr][/table]
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td width=25%][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/136c1aa9a4ba80f479967576e76ba1cd3f7a03d5.png[/img][/td]
[td][h3]Choose Your Ride[/h3] Pick any tank—each comes with rebalanced stats and special abilities just for this mode. Got destroyed? No worries. Respawn in 3 seconds and get back in the race![/td][/tr][/table]

[h2]Progression and Rewards[/h2]
[b]Complete special missions to advance through Progression stages[/b] and earn in⁠-⁠game goodies, including credits, bonds, Personal Reserves, Free XP, Components, Battle Pass Points, and Random Rewards with surprise items. After completing the main event progression, [b]keep on playing to earn credits and Random Rewards in the infinite post-progression[/b].
[h3]Progression Rewards:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/789834005276ffef8ccd08a3a548d35104b1544b.png[/img]
[h3]Post-Progression Rewards (Repeatable):[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a8d6ad3f2c0de37233f778fb59daa6280e198fdf.png[/img]
[h3]Random rewards:[/h3]
[expand type=details expanded=false]Get one of the following rewards:
[list]
[*]25,000, 50,000, or 200,000 credits
[*]Expirable Reserve (7 days): +50% to credits for 1 hour
[*]Expirable Reserve (7 days): +200% to Free and Crew XP for 1 hour Expirable Reserve (7 days): +50% to Combat XP for 1 hour
[*]1 or 3 days of WoT Premium Account
[*]25 or 50 components
[*]500 or 2,500 Free XP
[/list][/expand] 
[b]Start Your Engines![/b]
With wild traps, teleportation, unlimited respawns, and tuned-up tanks, Neon Dash is not your usual tank mode.

More about the event:

notes.title: Update 1.28.1: Beyond Limits
notes.content:
Commanders!

[b]Update 1.28.1: Beyond Limits[/b] introduces [b]four reworked maps[/b] including the overhauled Airfield and the expanded version of Ensk for high-tier battles, [b]four rebalanced TD branches[/b], the brand-new [b]Neon Dash mode[/b] for Arcade Cabinet, the new [b]commendation system[/b], and [b]expanded WoT Plus benefits[/b]. The new [b]Onslaught[/b] season begins, and [b]Frontline[/b] is to return in two weeks.

[previewyoutube=hoz91bDpzMk;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote]World of Tanks servers for Update 1.28.1 will be available from:  
[b]EU:[/b] April 16, 2025, at 08:30 CEST (UTC+2)  
[b]NA:[/b] April 15, 2025, at 06:00 PT | 08:00 CT | 09:00 ET  
[b]ASIA:[/b] April 15, 2025, at 07:00 (UTC+8)[/quote][h2]Improved Maps[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3a1661ad60f62e1c5430cebf76fa8b14f16bbf6f.jpg[/img]
Hit the enlarged (1,000×1,000 meter) and refurbished [b]Ensk Region[/b] in battles where the top vehicle tier is VIII, IX, or X. Play on thoroughly reworked [b]Airfield[/b] which now features a huge cave and a crusader castle, and check out the upgrades to [b]Paris[/b] and the tweaks to [b]Mines[/b].
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/1-28-1-map-rebalance/ style=button]MORE DETAILS[/url] 
[h2]Rebalanced Vehicles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fbda09576a46989aaaad2730e2a857f1f572eb22.png[/img]
Try out the rebalanced TDs from four branches topped off by the [b]T110E4[/b], the [b]Object 268[/b], the [b]Jagdpanzer E 100[/b] (with the Jageroo itself unaffected), and the [b]Ho-Ri 3[/b] (the latter the only one nerfed a bit). As usual, the number of modules has been decreased, module upgrade paths have been streamlined, and stock configurations have been enhanced for the reviewed vehicles.
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/1-28-1-vehicle-rebalance/ style=button]COMPLETE SCOPE[/url] 
[h2]Arcade Cabinet: Neon Dash Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c282c2ca78f01b53f0b3c5f3564540a4f09bb1f6.jpg[/img]
From [b]April 18 to 20[/b] and from [b]April 25 to 27[/b], race through a futuristic course filled with stationary and moving obstacles in vehicles of any tier! Mess with up to 29 opponents by shooting energy impulses, and using Shield and Dash. Neon Dash offers special missions and a mode Progression that can be completed twice.
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/arcade-neon-dash-2025/ style=button]FULL RUN[/url]

[h2]Commendation System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/20a6292afc60f5e47145f30becfad8091fe8320c.jpg[/img]
The brand-new [b]Commendation system[/b] is a way to give a thumbs-up to a teammate—for a heroic feat, a funny moment, nice behavior, or anything in between. You can receive some in return: Friendship sure can bloom on the battlefield!
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/content/guide/general/commendation_system/ style=button]INSTRUCTIONS[/url] 
[h2]Onslaught Returns[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/26437a04f2175f7a530750c3c1226db65874d6e3.jpg[/img]
Compete in the [b]Season of the Jade Manticore[/b] on new and improved maps, using modified Role Skills. As this season is the final one in the Year of the Manticore, you will be able to pick yearly rewards that may include the [b]Stinger[/b] tank.
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/onslaught-season-of-the-manticore-3/ style=button]WHOLE BRIEF[/url] 
[h2]Frontline Is Coming Back[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2b4f8526dc2102c7dbfe770f7e2442797ad778c0.jpg[/img]
[b]From April 28[/b], play 30v30 on Frontline’s colossal maps along various dynamic battle scenarios, going up in rank and using Combat Reserves.
[h2]WoT Plus[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4bf996c9b8b8563b9f00abab6ae27bd6894e9f28.jpg[/img]
The already impressive list of WoT Plus benefits has been expanded: the Assistant will provide recommendations on crew perks in addition to advice on equipment load-outs.
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/wot-plus-6-april-2025/ style=button]WOT PLUS GUIDE[/url] 

[b]UPDATE 1.28.1 - FULL DETAILS[/b] 
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/wot-1-28-1/ style=button]EU[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.com/news/general-news/wot-1-28-1/ style=button]NA[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/news/general-news/wot-1-28-1/ style=button]ASIA[/url]

notes.title: Onslaught 2024-2025 Finale: Season of the Jade Manticore
notes.content:
The final episode of Onslaught in the Year of the Manticore is coming. Take your ultimate chance to dominate the battlefield, climb the ranks, and secure the most valuable [b]Annual Reward[/b], [b]which includes the Tier X Stinger heavy tank with its unique 3D style[/b]. 

Alongside the return of familiar challenges, this season brings [b]new maps, several balance updates, and fresh seasonal customizations[/b]. Read up for details!

[list]
[*] [b]New Rental Vehicles[/b]: Command the [b]Bat.-Châtillon 25 t, Type 71, and Object 268[/b].

[*] [b]Balance Changes[/b]: Several Role Skills have received balance adjustments. 
[/list]
[h3]Map Rotation: [/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Steppes and Safe Haven[/b] maps are added. 
[*] [b]Siegfried Line[/b] has been significantly reworked.

The [b]Tier X Stinger heavy tank [/b]remains the ultimate prize for commanders who collect enough Onslaught Colors. This stunning replica of the T57 Heavy Tank features a [b]striking progressive 3D style [/b]and comes with a special crew that adds to its exclusivity.
[quote=author]At the end of the Year of the Manticore, you will unlock [b]up to four different versions[/b] of the Stinger's 3D style—[b]Silver, Gold, Champion, or Legend[/b]—based on how many Colors you have collected. All lower-tier styles will also be unlocked accordingly. Once you've unlocked them, you can freely switch between them at any time, even after every battle.[/quote]

This season introduces the [b]fresh "Hybrid Beast (Jade)" progressive 2D style[/b] to showcase your achievements in battle. Earn it alongside other unique customization items ([b]camouflage patterns, badges, Dog Tag elements, and more[/b]) throughout your finishing Onslaught journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cf44fd016fb77182c197e1080f0cd73816a36491.jpg[/img] 

[h2]Weekly Missions [/h2]
Weekly missions are now a core part of Onslaught. Each week, a [b]new set of five missions unlocks[/b], and you have until the season's end to complete all 30 in sequence. Take on weekly missions to earn valuable rewards, including: 
[list]
[*] Days of WoT Premium Account
[*] Bonds and credits 
[*] A special Token to choose any improved equipment  
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/67a79db65983b5ad8daf851a9485e500b81ee0de.png[/img]

[i]This is your last chance to prove your mastery in the Year of the Manticore. Seize the battlefield, rise through the ranks, and claim your rewards![/i]

notes.title: Account Update: Steam and WGC Access Expanded
notes.content:
Commanders!

We appreciate our Steam community and are excited to introduce an update that expands how you access World of Tanks. [b]Starting from March 6[/b], World of Tanks gives you total freedom to play on your terms. Thanks to major improvements in our account infrastructure, you can [b]link an existing Wargaming.net account to Steam[/b] and continue playing with its game progress.

If you previously started fresh on Steam but still have an old Wargaming account, you now have the option to reconnect and pick up where you left off.

This update is part of our ongoing effort to enhance flexibility and unify the player experience between Steam and the Wargaming Game Center (WGC). No matter which platform you prefer, you'll enjoy the same content, progress, and features.

[h2]Earn a Premium Vehicle[/h2]
To celebrate this update, all players—including our valued Steam commanders—can take on a simple mission and earn [b]the brand-new FCM 2C, a Tier III Premium heavy tank, and the "Steamroller" 2D style![/b]
[h3]FCM 2C Mission[/h3]

[h2]Special Recognition for Steam Veterans[/h2]
We appreciate the long-standing support of our dedicated Steam players! If you've been playing World of Tanks via Steam before 03.03.2025, you'll receive an exclusive:
[list]
[*] [b]"Steam Veteran" badge[/b]
[*] [b]3 "eSTEAMed Player" projection decals[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7184be1614622905244f9fa4a56d2686908e4555.jpg[/img]Use them to proudly showcase your veteran status on the battlefield!

[h2]How to Link Your Wargaming Account to Steam[/h2]
If you have an existing Wargaming account that you'd like to link to Steam and regain access to your previous progress, follow these steps:
[list]
[*] Launch World of Tanks on Steam
[*] Log in using your Wargaming account credentials when prompted
[*] Confirm the connection and start playing
[*] That's it! You can now access your Wargaming account via Steam anytime
[/list]
For more details, check out our [url=https://wargaming.net/support/products/wot/article/34043/]Player Support Page[/url].

[hr][/hr]
This update makes playing World of Tanks on Steam more accessible and flexible. No matter if you're claiming rewards, reconnecting an old account, or continuing your battles, we're glad to have you as part of our community.

[i]Roll Out![/i]

notes.title: Update 1.28: Polished Steel
notes.content:
Commanders!

Update 1.28: Polished Steel introduces the [b]new Quick Service feature[/b], which lets you fully equip your vehicles using preset configurations in a few clicks from a single window. Explore the [b]latest crew quality-of-life improvements[/b] and test the[b] updated Equipment Assistant feature in the WoT Plus subscription[/b], offering new insights. And that’s not all—read on for more details! 

[previewyoutube=y0gBgjrLCEk;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote]World of Tanks servers for Update 1.28 will be available from:  
[b]EU:[/b] March 5, 2025, at 10:30 CET (UTC+1)  
[b]NA:[/b] March 4, 2025, at 05:00 PT | 07:00 CT | 08:00 ET  
[b]ASIA:[/b] March 4, 2025, at 08:00 (UTC+8)[/quote]  
[h2]Quick Service[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/06817ee50d00d20f4726075bf4ed4fab76e27e9f.jpg[/img]
Make your vehicle battle-ready in just a few clicks! Perfect for new or unfamiliar tanks, this feature simplifies equipment, ammo, consumable, and even style selection. Choose from popular or optimized equipment setups, assign experienced or rookie crew, and adjust your ammo and consumables with ease!  

[h2]Crew Improvements[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d734f8b91a4351003d521a42e051e1903f795dde.jpg[/img]
Welcome quality-of-life upgrades for your crew! [b]Enhanced Practicality and Reliable Placement perks[/b] offer greater performance, while the [b]Auto-Return Crew setting[/b] automatically assigns crew to vehicles before battles. The [b]Mentoring License[/b] lets you transfer experience between crew members—and with the update, you already get three of them! Finally, [b]improved filter memory[/b] keeps your preferences in Barracks even after logging off.  

[h2]Battle Pass Season XVI[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e2a2c79bd09917f8538a482bf244f5a5129b91f7.jpg[/img]
The first of three consecutive Battle Pass Seasons is just around the corner! Prepare to earn Tokens to exchange for exclusive vehicles (including two brand-new ones) and a bunch of other rewards.  

Battle Pass Season XVI introduces:  
[list]  
[*] [b]Vault Shop[/b] with a wide selection of valuable items.  
[*] [b]Chips[/b], a new currency, to purchase items from the Vault Shop.  
[*] [b]The Elite Circuit[/b], offering extra rewards after completing the main Chapters.  
[*] [b]Vouchers[/b] to exchange for credits, Free XP, and components for Experimental Equipment.  
[/list] 
[h2]Maneuvers Event Returns![/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/398a6d4bc8b03061dfeceac1e9865b3e764f1874.jpg[/img]
Starting [b]March 10[/b], the clans-exclusive Maneuvers event is back in World of Tanks! Get ready for heated 7v7 Encounter Battles in Tier X vehicles, following the familiar rules. Once again, you’ll have the chance to[b] earn a powerful Tier X reward vehicle[/b], including the recently introduced ST-62 Version 2. This time, Maneuvers bring new 2D styles and some other fresh additions to the reward pool, alongside a selection of popular prizes from previous events.

[h2]Play Your Way: Steam for Everyone[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/370e9ce742ddb9f10c53f6b34feccb438637cd79.jpg[/img]  
Starting [b]from March 6[/b], World of Tanks gives you total freedom to play on your terms. Whether you're a long-time player or just getting started, you can now seamlessly switch between platforms—play on Steam or through the Wargaming Game Center (WGC) with the same account. Your progress and all in-game belongings stay with you wherever you play.  

Already playing via Steam? Great news! If you’ve been playing World of Tanks on Steam before, you’ll receive an exclusive veteran reward:
[list]
[*] The [b]“Steam Veteran” badge[/b]  
[*] 3 [b]“eSTEAMed Player” projection decals[/b]  
[/list]
For those with an old WGC-associated account, you can now take advantage of the Steam experience too!  

As our special reward to mark this occasion, all players—whether on Steam or the Wargaming Game Center—will have the opportunity to earn the [b]FCM 2C Tier III Premium French heavy tank and the new "Steamroller" 2D style[/b] by completing a special mission. Visit the dedicated news page for all the details!  

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/partnerevents/preview/748263387705639042 style=button]FIND OUT MORE[/url] 

[h2]WoT Plus: Smarter Equipment Assistant[/h2]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a8fe4da4ae08fd6eaf051b922194b10d963530a8.jpg[/img]
Update 1.28 upgrades the [b]WoT Plus Equipment Assistant[/b], making it more practical and adaptable to different playstyles. Now this feature includes:  
[list]  
[*] [b]Onslaught Support[/b]: Recommendations for Onslaught battles.  
[*] [b]Loadout Options[/b]: Popular setups from all players and Legendary setups from top Commanders (WTR > 8,000).  
[*] [b]Experimental Gear[/b]: Now includes suggestions for Experimental Equipment.  
[/list]  

[b]UPDATE 1.28 - FULL DETAILS[/b]  [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/wot-1-28/ style=button]EU[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.com/news/general-news/wot-1-28/ style=button]NA[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/news/general-news/wot-1-28/ style=button]ASIA[/url]

notes.title: Battle Pass Season XVI: Who Dares Wins
notes.content:
[b]Commanders![/b]  

Get ready to embark on a thrilling jungle adventure! [b]Battle Pass Season XVI: Who Dares Wins[/b] brings new features, core vehicles, and tons of rewards!  


[table]  
[tr]  
[td]  
[h3]BATTLE PASS SEASON XVI[/h3]  

[b]EU[/b]: March 5, 2025, until June 4, 2025  
[b]NA[/b]: March 4, 2025, until June 3, 2025  
[b]ASIA[/b]: March 3, 2025, until June 2, 2025  
[/td]  
[/tr]  
[/table]  

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]  
[h3]Battle Pass Vault[/h3]  
[table noborder=1]  
[tr]  
[td width=30%][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/665bb3fb31f60ed6cdae2ffbb9852948c1bfe443.png[/img][/td]  
[td]The [b]Battle Pass Vault[/b] is a new analogue of the reworked Battle Pass Shop. It accepts only [b]Chips[/b]—a rare and valuable currency earned as rewards from specific Chapter stages. Exchange them for Premium tanks, customization items, crew members, and other valuable items. [/td]  
[/tr]  
[/table]
[h3]New BP Currency (Chips)[/h3]  
[table noborder=1]  
[tr]  
[td width=30%][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3bbff62e6befd8952624619644175c87e1b172bd.png[/img][/td]  
[td]Earn [b]Chips[/b] in specific Battle Pass stages and exchange them in the [b]Battle Pass Vault[/b] for premium rewards, including tanks, crew members, and customization items. Chips are exclusive to the current Season, so be sure to use them before they reset![/td]  
[/tr]  
[/table]
[h3]New Reward Entity (Vouchers)[/h3]  
[table noborder=1]  
[tr]  
[td width=30%][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1acd8ff16f7549dfb3b14391e628f389c01bc3c2.png[/img][/td]  
[td]Introducing [b]Vouchers[/b], a brand-new reward mechanic! These can be exchanged for random bonuses, including [b]credits, Free XP, or Experimental Equipment components[/b]. The outcome remains a surprise until you use a Voucher![/td]  
[/tr]  
[/table]
[h3]Elite Circuit[/h3]  
[table noborder=1]  
[tr]  
[td width=30%][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b67d62575ddb639f1a6417beb3965dcc9402301b.png[/img][/td]  
[td]Once you've completed the three main Chapters, unlock the [b]Elite Circuit[/b]—a 5-Stage post-progression challenge offering [b]bonds, Chips, and Vouchers[/b]. The Elite Circuit is cyclical, so you can keep earning rewards until the end of the Season![/td]  
[/tr]  
[/table]
[h3]More Vehicles for Tokens[/h3]  
[table noborder=1]  
[tr]  
[td width=30%][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/62a3b20fb2a475627969cd56257bd865f40ae81a.png[/img][/td]  
[td]This year, the selection of Tier IX reward vehicles expands from 11 to 13! Two brand-new tanks join the roster: the [b]Object 265T[/b] (Soviet heavy) and the [b]ERAC 105 Proto[/b] (French light). Plus, [b]Lorraine 50t[/b] and [b]KPZ 07 HK[/b] receive balance improvements![/td]  
[/tr]  
[/table]  

[h2]Core Vehicles in Brand-New 3D Styles[/h2]  
Prepare to command these beasts, upgraded for jungle warfare with stunning 3D styles:  
[list]  
[*] [b]E 50 M:[/b] A fast and versatile all-rounder.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9ba6f806e35be708038f0e723330d63809414a7c.png[/img]
[*] [b]NC 70 Błyskawica:[/b] A close-combat specialist. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bf565e8a4b9faa69b0d4019797aee8e97831f991.png[/img]
[*] [b]Type 71:[/b] A formidable heavy for powerful breakthroughs. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/30b6f7bdf2931c60d082f2cd960b6f461fbe6e1e.png[/img]
[/list]  

[h2]Earn Base and Improved Rewards![/h2]  
Advance through [b]50 Stages in each of the three Chapters[/b] to collect massive rewards, including:  
[list]  
[*] Special 3D styles and crew members  
[*] Tokens, bonds, credits, Experimental Equipment  
[*] And much more!  
[/list]
[h3]Base Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8fc2e0879068c7373453b1b872864cdf9105d5b1.png[/img]
[h3]Improved Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c971e5c35b386f81de283b47a6e157d47aff2d26.png[/img]

[h2]New Tier IX Reward Tanks for Tokens[/h2]  
Expand your collection with the latest additions:  
[list]
[*] [b]Object 265T[/b]: A Soviet heavy tank
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e22d4c0e794a9da049ceea27ac465b0bb6009912.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]ERAC 105 Proto[/b]: A French light tank
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9c9aa4d388af0e4164eaa3d29b6953369aec1284.jpg[/img]
 
Plus, [b]Lorraine 50t[/b] and [b]KPZ 07 HK[/b] receive buffs!  

[b]Welcome to the jungle, Commanders![/b]  

[h3]LEARN MORE[/h3]

notes.title: Arcade Cabinet Returns with Big Rewards!
notes.content:
[b]Commanders![/b]
The Arcade Cabinet event is back, bringing intense battles with unique modifiers for a fresh and exciting challenge! Jump into two action-packed modes designed to test your skills and strategy.

[b]Event Schedule:[/b][quote=author][b]EU:[/b] Start: February 28, 2025, at 10:00 CET (UTC+1) / End: March 2, 2025, at 23:00 CET (UTC+1)
[b]NA:[/b] Start: February 28, 2025, at 04:00 ET | 03:00 CT | 01:00 PT / End: March 3, 2025, at 06:00 ET | 05:00 CT | 03:00 PT
[b]APAC:[/b] Start: February 28, 2025, at 13:00 (UTC+8) / End: March 3, 2025, at 04:00 (UTC+8)
[/quote]
[h2]Railgun Mode[/h2] 
A sci-fi-inspired battle experience where precision and speed are key. Enhanced targeting, faster aiming, and improved mobility make every shot count.
[table noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f69f502178aacab3d42ae626b68c35db845231c2.png[/img][/td]
[td width="90%"][b][h3]Battle Modifiers[/h3][/b][/td][/tr][/table][list]
[*] [b]Marksman Gun[/b]: gun dispersion at 100m reduced by 70%
[*] [b]Multiplane Stabilizer[/b]: gun dispersion during movement reduced by 50%
[*] [b]Hull Balancers[/b]: gun dispersion on hull traverse reduced by 50%
[*] [b]Turret Balancers[/b]: dispersion on turret traverse reduced by 50%
[*] [b]Robotic Gun Laying Drive[/b]: aiming time decreased by 50%

notes.title: Arcade Cabinet: Join the Snowballs & Ice Age Fun!
notes.content:
[b]Commanders![/b]

The festive season may be behind us, but the fun in World of Tanks never ends! Jump back into the traditional winter excitement with the familiar [b]Snowballs[/b] and [b]Ice Age[/b] submodes.

Both submodes are [b]available simultaneously in the Arcade Cabinet[/b] via the mode selector across two consecutive launches. Enjoy [b]single-tier, 15v15 battles with Tier VIII or Tier X vehicles[/b] across six snowy maps featuring winter-themed mechanics. 

[table]
[tr]
[td]
[h3]Arcade Cabinet: Snowballs and Ice Age[/h3]

[b]EU[/b]  
[b]First launch:[/b] January 24, 2025 at 10:00 CET (UTC+1)  
[b]Second launch: [/b]January 31, 2025 at 10:00 CET (UTC+1)

[b]NA[/b]  
[b]First launch: [/b]January 24, 2025 at 03:00 PT | 05:00 CT | 06:00 ET  
[b]Second launch: [/b]January 31, 2025 at 03:00 PT | 05:00 CT | 06:00 ET  

[b]ASIA[/b]  
[b]First launch: [/b]January 24, 2025 at 17:00 (UTC+8)  
[b]Second launch:[/b] January 31, 2025 at 17:00 (UTC+8)  
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
Snowballs and Ice Age require snowy locations, so [b]Mannerheim Line, Erlenberg, and Glacier[/b] are in play. Plus, both submodes can take place on special winter versions of [b]Karelia, Prokhorovka, and Malinovka[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/81aaa8d35699f63b4bd6066093657903a23d1115.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4c5c60515027883eea17272af63881cb1cc7e27c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cf2b51ad2bb3d2dbc6611d2bb7c4f95d2237d6f9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Snowballs[/h2]
Inspired by real-life snowball fights, this submode is fast, fun, and unpredictable. Shells become snowballs with curved trajectories, reload times are shorter, and [b]engine power is boosted[/b] for all vehicles. Plus, [b]HE shells deal extra splash damage[/b], adding to the chaos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1213db5be7672882c6c4c1ad7daab65bf4877c7f.png[/img]

[h2]Ice Age[/h2]
In Ice Age, the extra-slippery ground turns battles into epic slo-mo shootouts. Enjoy smooth drifting as rounds fly faster and [b]dispersion during movement and traverse is reduced[/b]. Add boosted engine power and top speeds, and you're in for a wild ride!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8e71161a0b91bce10dbf1170b5f2245c617adb92.png[/img]

[h2]Rules[/h2]
Except for different modifiers, Snowballs and Ice Age have the same set of basic rules:
[expand type=details expanded=false] 
[list]
    [*]Battles are [b]single-tier, fought in either Tier VIII or Tier X vehicles[/b]. Any vehicles of these tiers can be used in the mode.
    [*]You earn XP and credits in battles, and you [b]can use all types of Personal and clan Reserves[/b].
    [*][b]XP multipliers for the first victory of the day work[/b] in the submodes.
    [*]Snowballs and Ice Age battles [b]do not contribute to daily missions or personal missions[/b], but they count toward the mode Progression.
    [*]Snowballs and Ice Age battles [b]do not bring you Battle Pass Points[/b]. Gold and credits are not put into the Gold Reserve and the Credit Reserve.
    [*]Snowballs and Ice Age battles [b]do not yield bonds[/b], except for the event Progression rewards (see below).
    [*]You [b]may play in Platoons[/b] (and are eligible for the bonuses if you do).
[/list]
[/expand]

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3f19a14548042caaef1c6d4ca014d703e4780f19.jpg[/img]

[b]Get ready for frosty fun, Commanders![/b]

[h3]LEARN MORE[/h3]
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/arcade-cabinet-winter-january-2025/ style=button] EU [/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.com/news/general-news/arcade-cabinet-winter-january-2025/ style=button] NA [/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/news/general-news/arcade-cabinet-winter-january-2025/ style=button] ASIA [/url]

notes.title: Update 1.27.1: Double Trouble
notes.content:
Meet [b]Update 1.27.1: Double Trouble[/b], our first big one in 2025! It brings you a new line of twin-barreled British heavies, vehicle rebalance affecting 5 branches, a new Onslaught Season, and more. [b]Watch the Update video and scroll down to learn the details![/b]

[previewyoutube=bpyrrTSwBsM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]EU:[/b] 15.01.2025
[b]NA:[/b] 14.01.2025
[b]ASIA:[/b] 14.01.2025[/quote]
[b]UPDATE 1.27.1 - FULL DETAILS[/b]  [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/wot-1-27-1/ style=button]EU[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.com/wot-1-27-1/ style=button]NA[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/wot-1-27-1/ style=button]ASIA[/url]

[h2]Twin-Barreled British Heavies[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d6d400f35bdcbd0cc42cf067e9d0f825c3e38625.jpg[/img]
Explore a new line of four twin-barreled British heavies with the [b]Selective Fire Modes[/b] mechanic. Make the most of their tactical flexibility: Switch between the precise [b]Single Fire[/b] mode and the devastating [b]Salvo Fire[/b] mode anytime and with ease! All the new tanks have excellent frontal protection, adequate mobility, great gun depression, and fancy exteriors.

[b]EXPLORE NEW TANKS[/b]  [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/1-27-1-british-heavy-tanks/ style=button]EU[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.com/1-27-1-british-heavy-tanks/ style=button]NA[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/1-27-1-british-heavy-tanks/ style=button]ASIA[/url]

[h2]Vehicle Rebalancing[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fbda09576a46989aaaad2730e2a857f1f572eb22.png[/img]
Try out the empowered tanks of the [b]E 100[/b], [b]Type 71[/b], and [b]M-Y-V[/b] lines, and mid-tiers of the [b]Maus[/b] branch. The [b]60TP Lewandowskiego[/b] receives some balancing stat corrections, but it’s still a powerhouse—and the rest of its line got buffed. On top of that, module research in the reviewed branches has been streamlined, and the stock configurations have received a boost.

[b]GET THE DETAILS[/b]  [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/vehicle-rebalances-1-27-1/ style=button]EU[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.com/en/news/general-news/vehicle-rebalances-1-27-1/ style=button]NA[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/en/news/general-news/vehicle-rebalances-1-27-1/ style=button]ASIA[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/26437a04f2175f7a530750c3c1226db65874d6e3.jpg[/img]
Enjoy intense 7v7 action starting [b]January 15[/b]! This launch features [b]rebalanced Role Skills[/b], two new maps, and several improvements—now it is easier to become a Legend, Platoon composition rules are less restrictive, and more!

[b]LEARN MORE[/b]  [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/onslaught-season-of-the-manticore-2/ style=button]EU[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.com/en/news/general-news/onslaught-season-of-the-manticore-2/ style=button]NA[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/en/news/general-news/onslaught-season-of-the-manticore-2/ style=button]ASIA[/url]

notes.title: GSOR the TANK: A Christmas Gift From Jason Statham and Us!
notes.content:
Merry Holiday Ops, Commanders!

It's the most wonderful time of the year. We share it with family and friends, keeping our hearths warm and hearts open, giving and receiving presents, and having as much fun as possible. And it will only get better. [b]Jason Statham, our event Ambassador[/b], has a tough but kind message for you. On top of that, we have teamed up with Jason to prepare a massive holiday present for each tanker: [b]a brand-new special Tier IX vehicle carefully wrapped in a new 2D style![/b]
[previewyoutube=tFAyIkehjz0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How to Receive the Present[/h2]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]EU[/b]: December 20, 2024 at 07:00 CET (UTC+1) through January 1, 2025 at 07:00 CET (UTC+1)
[b]NA[/b]: December 19, 2024 at 08:00 PT | 10:00 CT | 11:00 ET through December 31, 2024 at 08:00 PT | 10:00 CT | 11:00 ET
[b]ASIA[/b]: December 20, 2024 at 00:01 (UTC+8) through December 31, 2024 at 23:59 (UTC+8)
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Claim the [b]GSOR the TANK[/b] in your Garage. A single click on the shining gift box will make it yours!
[h2]GSOR the TANK[/h2]
The newcomer is much like our celebrity Holiday Ops host. This medium tank is tough, British, and packs quite a punch. ("A big steel beast with a hefty gun"—as Mr. Statham himself puts it.) The [b]GSOR the TANK[/b] owes its heavy-handedness to high-pen HESH shells. It also keeps up with the latest trends, sporting 3D attachment slots. Park it in your Garage—but not before you take it out for a spin!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e848f6d3d2c827ad2908903627a6de076a02da4f.jpg[/img]
[h2]"Festive Cheer" 2D Style[/h2]
Nice presents come in good wrapping, and the GSOR the TANK comes in the [b]brand-new "Festive Cheer" 2D style[/b]. And as it is wrapping, you can remove it.
[h2]Holly Jolly Party[/h2]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]EU[/b]: December 16, 2024 through December 21, 2024 starting at 14:00 CET (UTC+1)
[b]NA[/b]: December 16, 2024 through December 21, 2024 starting at 05:00 PT | 07:00 CT | 09:00 ET
[b]ASIA[/b]: December 16, 2024 through December 21, 2024 starting at 21:00 (UTC+8)
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fd8a815f0cdb1d50f0252d279806a9007d25f03c.jpg[/img]
We hope you spotted [b]Dakillzor[/b], [b]Skill4ltu[/b] and [b]Quickybaby[/b] portraying film crew members in the action-packed trailer starring Jason Statham. During Holiday Ops 2025, they want to wish you happy holidays with the rest of our Content Creator commanders. To raise your spirits even higher, you can get their Holly Jolly Crew Skins that fit any regular crew member: Just watch their streams from December 16 through December 21 and claim Drops!
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/World%20of%20Tanks?tl=c2542d6d-cd10-4532-919b-3d19f30a768b style=button][b]WATCH STREAMS WITH DROPS ENABLED[/b][/url] 
[h3]How to Receive Twitch Drops[/h3]
[expand type=details expanded=false]
In order to receive Twitch Drops, you need to have an account [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/3413183219972726056?snr=1_2108_9__2107]linked to your email[/url]. If you haven't completed this process yet, you'll need to do so first to participate in the activity. After that, make sure to link your World of Tanks and Twitch accounts to receive your prize. Check our [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/content/guide/twitch-drops/]official Twitch Drops guide[/url] to learn more.
[/expand]
[i]Enjoy your presents and spread the cheer, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Holiday Ops 2025: Winter Raid Mode
notes.content:
Commanders!

Dive into Winter Raid, the new game mode available during Holiday Ops 2025. [b]Fight in a snow-covered paper world with three teams of five players, and collect more gifts than your opponents.[/b]
The holiday-themed mayhem unfolds over three weekends and three Chapters. Get ready for unique vehicles, icy challenges, and festive rewards.

[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td width=25%][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4e07a72c4c91af110b56fd82be603b4685f4ca47.jpg[/img]
[/td][td width=75%]
[h2]Rules[/h2]
Winter Raid pits three teams of five players against each other. Collect gifts scattered across the map and bring them back to your base to rack up points. Defeat enemies, overcome AI bots, and survive surprise snowstorms to secure rewards. [b]The first team to collect 50 gifts—or the team with the most when the timer runs out—claims victory![/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h2]Schedule[/h2]
[b]Winter Raid is only available during three weekends[/b], each adding a new Chapter and fresh missions. Each Chapter unlocks more exclusive prizes, so log in each weekend to get the most out of this festive mode!

notes.title: Tech Tree Trade-In
notes.content:
Commanders!

The Tech Tree Trade-In option debuts in World of Tanks on [b]October 24[/b] and allows you to [b]obtain a new vehicle branch[/b] (Tiers VI to X) without needing to do any additional research, just trade in one of your existing researched branches! This is the perfect opportunity to get some new vehicles if there's a line sitting in your garage that you just don't use anymore, so read on for more details.

[previewyoutube=kVJgey4F23c;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are the main things you need to know:
[list]
[*]You “de-research” Tiers VI–X of any single completely researched vehicle branch of your choice—to [b]instantly research Tiers VI–X of a single unresearched vehicle branch[/b] from those available for the trade-in. Every owned vehicle of Tiers VI to X from the branch you give away will be replaced by its counterpart from the target branch. 
[*][b]A Tech Tree Trade-In fee applies[/b]. The base price is in gold, but you can add bonds, blueprints, and Free XP to bring the gold expenses down to zero. All the calculations will be shown in the Tech Tree Trade-In interface in the game client before you confirm the trade-in. 
[*][b]The Tech Tree Trade-In operation is irreversible and can only be made once[/b]. Before making your decision, please explore in detail the target branch, the final resource cost of the operation, and the effect it will have on your vehicles, crews, equipment, etc. 
[*][b]Recently introduced branches are not available for trade-in[/b].
[*]You can only make one trade-in. [b]The operation is time-limited and cannot be undone[/b], so choose wisely!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c726e99b0069c52abe18e30c40b73f19a4a2b280.jpg[/img]


For full information on Tech Tree Trade-in, be sure to visit the news article.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/tech-tree-trade-in-2024/ style=button][b]LEARN MORE[/b][/url]

notes.title: Important Server Maintenance: Services Will Be Temporarily Unavailable
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8353f46be081f2fd029139414707241c54d9edc1.jpg[/img]
Commanders!

We want to inform you of an upcoming maintenance period that will [b]impact the accessibility of most World of Tank services, including the game[/b].
[h2]Scheduled Downtime[/h2]
[quote=author][b]EU: From October 22, 2024, at 09:00 CEST through October 22, 2024, at 10:30 CEST (UTC+2)

NA: From October 22, 2024, at 00:00 PT through October 22, 2024, at 01:30 PT (UTC-7)

ASIA: From October 22, 2024, at 15:00 UTC+8 through October 22, 2024, at 16:30 UTC+8

Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours[/b][/quote]
Following the maintenance period, we will require [b]several additional hours to restore the full functionality of all services[/b]. We kindly ask for your patience and understanding while the work is being carried out. Your game account and progress will not be impacted.

[h2]Linked Accounts Across All Regions[/h2]
We are excited to announce a major update aimed at streamlining your gaming experience: the implementation of a linked account system across all regions. If you have multiple regional accounts registered to the same email address, these will now be managed under a single, unified system. This change is purely technical and will not affect your progress, items, or any other account assets.

[h2]Who Is Affected[/h2]
This change will impact only players with multiple accounts in different regions registered to the same email address or those who use the same social network account to access multiple accounts in different regions. This update will let you consolidate them into one.
For further information and updates [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/october-2024-downtime-notification/]read the full article[/url].
[hr][/hr]
We appreciate your patience. Thank you for your continued support of World of Tanks.

[i]Roll Out![/i]

notes.title: Babylon Project: Mechanics of the Halloween Special
notes.content:
Commanders! 

The Babylon Project is the beginning of a new chapter in the Mirium saga. Prove your mettle in the [b]classic mode[/b], where you go deeper into the subspace layers or take on [b]the new Last Stand mode[/b] with incoming waves of enemies to repel.

Complete the event progression to learn more about the rich story behind the events and to [b]collect valuable rewards, including the Nergal[/b], a unique Tier VIII Premium heavy risen out of the deep.

[h2]Game Modes[/h2]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][h3]Classic Mode[/h3][/th]
        [th][h3]Last Stand Mode[/h3][/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][list]
[*] Teams of five dive into the subspace, battling enemies and confronting a boss on the fourth layer.
[*] No need to deliver Mirium; defeat enemies to automatically progress through levels.
[*] Collect Mirium to power up tank abilities.
[*] New bosses on the second and third difficulty levels, with the Obsidian returning for the first.
[*] Tank abilities are determined by your pre-battle consumable loadout.
[/list][/td]
        [td][list]
[*] Defend Magnus against waves of Mirium-infused echo tanks.
[*] Survive five waves, with progressively tougher enemies.
[*] Destroyed allies resurrect before the next wave with 50% HP if the wave is completed.
[*] Use any Tier VIII medium, heavy tank, or TD from your Garage, with infinite ammo and event abilities.
[*] Rental tanks are available if you don’t have a suitable Tier VIII vehicle.
[*] Last Stand unlocks after completing the first difficulty level in Classic Mode.
[/list][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[h2]Progression & Rewards[/h2]
Complete event battles and missions to [b]gather Decryption Keys, unlock shocking secrets, and claim rewards[/b] like the Nergal tank, Crew Books, and Battle Pass Points. Play through Objectives to advance your event progression, or use extra keys to skip and still earn prizes. The deeper you go, the more mysteries you reveal and rewards you’ll collect—keep pushing forward to dominate this Halloween event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/08497c20e1ff76d7419a4f9bc46757bd59ada9a0.png[/img]

[h2]Online Leaderboard[/h2]
Track your progress on [b]the Online Leaderboard for the Last Stand mode[/b] and earn unique rewards like the [b]“Dark Knight” 2D style[/b]. Performance is based on damage dealt and time to victory. The leaderboard updates hourly, and the top 80%, 50%, and 5% of players will receive additional rewards at the end of the event. Even a single standout performance can propel you to the top!

[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/halloween-2024-leaderboard style=button]EU[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.com/halloween-2024-leaderboard style=button]NA[/url] [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/halloween-2024-leaderboard style=button]ASIA[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cd81c37e86ea7fe4733b8d27057059868e4b1cad.jpg[/img]

[h2]Halloween Bundles[/h2]
Speed up your event progression and secure valiant fighters for the Last Stand mode from [b]plenty of exclusive offers[/b] available in the Shop.

Prevail against all odds in the Babylon Project, learn more secrets of Mirium, and earn great rewards.

notes.title: Halloween 2024: Babylon Project
notes.content:
Commanders,

The next chapter of the Mirium saga begins! After the demise of Mirny-13, the research of the enigmatic substance was taken over by the international team of [b]Babylon Project[/b]. It's time to battle echo tanks spawned by Mirium, uncover new secrets, and earn new rewards!
[previewyoutube=mNBpx4TGZYE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]BABYLON PROJECT[/b][/h3]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]EU[/b]: October 17 at 04:00 CEST (UTC+2) till November 2 at 01:00 CET (UTC+1)
[b]NA[/b]: October 16 at 01:30 PT | 03:30 CT | 04:30 ET till November 1 at 01:30 PT | 03:30 CT | 04:30 ET
[b]ASIA[/b]: October 17 at 06:00 UTC+8 till November 2 at 06:00 UTC+8
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h2]What's New[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]All-new "Last Stand" mode[/b]: Team up with four other tankers and defeat five consecutive waves of echo tanks to protect the Babylon facility. Play in any Tier VIII MT, HT, or TD from your Garage, with infinite ammo and event abilities. Receive rewards based on your leaderboard position!
[*][b]Updated classic mode[/b]: Fight echo tanks in three phases of Mirium subspace to confront familiar and new bosses in the fourth phase. Play in special event tanks that now use Mirium to power their abilities. You don't need to deliver Mirium to Magnus to get to the next phase: Just obliterate enough echo tanks, and Mirium dropped by them and picked up by you will get into Magnus automatically!
[*][b]New story, new rewards[/b]: Prepare for some plot twists! To uncover the secrets of Mirium, advance in the event's Progression by reaching Objectives and decrypting Records. Collect Decryption Keys by fighting in the event battles (classic mode) and completing event missions (once per day per each event vehicle). Plus, you get rewards!
[/list][h2]Meet the Nergal[/h2]
Complete the event Progression to receive the main prize—the mighty [b]Nergal[/b]—for free! The unique and bizarre exterior of this formidable [b]Tier VIII Premium heavy[/b] makes it unforgettable: It will haunt your dreams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d74079af287390977379751cbed5404338ba8f23.png[/img]

Learn more details about the event:

[/td]

[url=https://worldoftanks.asia/halloween-2024/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: The Waffenträger: Reckoning
notes.content:
Max von Krieger has resurfaced, wielding his devastating superweapon technology that threatens all. Join the fight to stop his reign of terror, compete for glory, and earn spectacular rewards!
[previewyoutube=MrAVezXv0GM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]THE WAFFENTRÄGER: RECKONING[/b][/h3]
[b]EU[/b]: September 20 at 11:00 CEST through October 4 at 23:59 CEST (UTC+2)*
[b]NA[/b]: September 20 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET through October 4 at 23:00 PT | October 5 at 01:00 CT | 02:00 ET*
[b]APAC[/b]: September 19 at 17:00 UTC+8 through October 4 at 23:59 UTC+8*
[i]*Date and time when event battles end.[/i]

[h3][b]PRIME TIMES (FIRST EVENT DAY)[/b][/h3]
[b]EU1, EU2, EU3[/b]: from 14:00 until 23:59 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]EU4[/b]: from 14:00 until 20:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]USC, SA[/b]: from 07:00 PT | 09:00 CT | 10:00 ET until 23:00 PT | 01:00 CT | 02:00 ET
[b]ASIA1[/b]: from 17:00 until 23:59 UTC+8

[h3][b]PRIME TIMES (ALL OTHER EVENT DAYS)[/b][/h3]
[b]EU1, EU2[/b]: from 12:00 until 23:59 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]EU3[/b]: from 11:00 until 23:59 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]EU4[/b]: from 10:00 until 20:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]USC, SA[/b]: from 11:00 PT | 13:00 CT | 14:00 ET until 23:00 PT | 01:00 CT | 02:00 ET
[b]ASIA1[/b]: from 14:00 until 23:59 UTC+8

[h2]Content Creators Enter the Fight[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/36692511fa09d119e6eef2b2fe99467416bced3c.png[/img]
Popular Content Creators [b]Dakillzor[/b], [b]MouzAcrobat[/b], [b]QuickyBaby[/b], and [b]Skill4ltu[/b] will roam the Waffenträger battlefields as the Agents for Harriers who oppose the Von Kriegers. You will be able to recruit these [b]unique crew members with custom voiceovers[/b]. Each has two sets of voice lines: for the Waffenträger mode and for Random Battles.

[h2]Deploy the Blitzträger auf E 110[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/152e828514adee7beb76eeb246f0b04eb1aad182.jpg[/img]
[b]Max von Krieger[/b]'s fearsome war machine returns with [b]enhanced capabilities[/b]. Jump aboard and utilize its overwhelming firepower to crush your foes. Beware when battling the Blitzträger auf E 110 with your fellow Harriers, though, as [b]Ermelinda[/b] is likely to come to her daddy's aid! She's behind the controls of her specially fitted Leopard 1, called the [b]Eos 1[/b].

[h2]Exclusive Progression Rewards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/89e69c55cde629f6c9111d79c49b08e42b91b885.png[/img]
Complete missions to unlock a wealth of rewards, including [b]keys and crates[/b]. Progress through stages to earn [b]unique 2D styles, decals, Battle Bass Points, and voiceover-equipped crew members[/b].

[h2]Open the Engineer’s Crate[/h2]
Unlock [b]Engineer’s Crates[/b] by completing Waffenträger [b]event missions[/b] in the Blitzträger auf E 110 and defeating the rare Blitzträger auf E 220. Crates may drop in-game items from four categories, including [b]brand-new Premium and reward vehicles[/b] such as the [b]E77[/b], the [b]Leichter Kpz. 70 (K)[/b], and the [b]Project ION[/b]. You can also get Engineer’s Crates for completing certain [b]Progression milestones[/b].

[h2]Meet the New Vehicles[/h2]
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]
[b]E 77[/b]
A compact German Tier IX Premium heavy tank boasting innovative engine, chassis, and transmission designs. Despite its smaller size, the E 77 packs robust armor and a renowned 12.8 cm gun, making it a formidable contender on the battlefield.

[/td]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a59f1f22957324d19546a1bc6099565594f6a147.png[/img]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Leichter Kpz. 70 (K)[/b]
This German Tier VIII Premium light tank has exceptional –10° of gun depression. Its hydropneumatic suspension and compact turret with a precise 90 mm gun allow for firing from cover while staying hidden, making it a challenging adversary.

[/td]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cd983105e912352ad305b67c0392416c64e7fcad.png[/img]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Projekt ION[/b]
This Czechoslovakian Tier VIII Premium heavy tank shares its stats with the Škoda T 56 and looks like Hannelore Ritter’s prototype tank designed to counter Von Krieger’s machines and based on the cutting-edge technology of the Alliance.

[/td]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2c2015f25438d789e52ed0d9469b5d91ab70ba8e.png[/img]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h2]The Ultimate Blitzträger auf E 220 Showdown[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c8bd15fc95246ec05162d8be25fbeb390f7234d0.jpg[/img]
Test your skills against the formidable [b]Blitzträger auf E 220[/b] during special event weekends. Face off against your favorite Contributors and Wargaming employees in these thrilling encounters. Take down the golden BT220 and [b]earn valuable rewards[/b], including Engineer’s Crates.

Don’t miss out on the epic conclusion of the Waffenträger saga. Max von Krieger emerges one last time, supported in his sinister ways by his daughter Ermelinda. Will the Alliance, led by Hannelore, prevail, or will the world fall?

notes.title: Update 1.26: Hailstorm
notes.content:
Commanders! 

Meet Update 1.26: Hailstorm, one of our biggest releases in 2024! This epic update features [b]Czechoslovakian LTs, an updated crew perk system[/b], and much more. [b]Watch the Update video and scroll down for more details![/b]

[previewyoutube=47zsCpxet3A;full][/previewyoutube]

[quote]World of Tanks servers for Update 1.26 will be available from:
[b]EU:[/b] 04.09.2024
[b]NA:[/b] 03.09.2024
[b]ASIA:[/b] 02.09.2024[/quote]
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/wot-1-26/ style=button][b]UPDATE 1.26 - FULL DETAILS[/b][/url]

[h2]Czechoslovakian Light Tanks[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7be9c57f0b6d56294c7d78732856acb8db112e66.jpg[/img]Unleash the power of the new Czechoslovakian light tanks! This new line includes [b]four swift flankers from Tier VII to X, with Tier VIII-X tanks featuring unique autocannons[/b] that fire thousands of rounds per minute. While their relatively low armor penetration requires precise aiming, the efficiency indicator will help you master these dynamic firing mechanics.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/1-26-czech-light-tanks/ style=button][b]DISCOVER NEW TANKS[/b][/url]

[h2]Revamped Perk System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b458e2ce140c5bbb6c055da067fb06653a737c39.jpg[/img]Now, each crew member can learn up to six perks, and the XP earned thereafter will allow you to receive Universal Training Manuals. Additionally, enjoy:
[list]
[*][b]New and Rebalanced Perks:[/b] Both new and old perks have been updated. You now have six personal and three group perks available for each specialization.
[*][b]Bonus Perks:[/b] Each additional role for your crew member will include three bonus perks that develop alongside the main specialization. This will help vehicles with smaller crews perform more effectively in battle.
[*][b]Perk Efficiency:[/b] To ensure a perk is 100% effective, it must be learned by all crew members in that role.
[*][b]One Month of Free Perk Resets:[/b] Enjoy a month of free resets to experiment and optimize your crew. Afterward, each crew member will have one additional free reset with no time limit.
[/list]
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/new-crew-perks-1-26/ style=button][b]GET FULL DETAILS[/b][/url]

[h2]Comprehensive Vehicle Rebalance[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fbda09576a46989aaaad2730e2a857f1f572eb22.png[/img]We're rebalancing [b]three vehicle branches[/b], starting from Tier V, to make your favorite tanks more competitive. Expect updates to the [b]Bat.-Châtillon 25 t, M48 Patton, and K-91 branches[/b], along with revised stock vehicle configurations and improved modules. Five Premium tanks also get performance boosts, enhancing their agility, firepower, and resilience.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/vehicle-rebalances-1-26/ style=button][b]EXPLORE VEHICLE ENHANCEMENTS[/b][/url]

[h2]New Random Events[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d5a66270aa9fd4559aa5ee87976d4a5348232724.jpg[/img]Experience dynamic gameplay with new Random Events! Watch as the central plant in [b]Pilsen[/b] is bombed, a plane crashes on [b]Malinovka's[/b] hill, and a rockslide changes the landscape in [b]Karelia[/b]. These events add thrilling new dimensions to your battles, creating fresh opportunities for strategy and engagement.


[h2]Map Reworking[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/baed604dab29c2a45faf23db68c46b2f2c579aa9.jpg[/img]We've [b]reworked eight Random Maps[/b] to improve gameplay comfort for all vehicle classes. The [b]Mannerheim Line, Oyster Bay, and Outpost[/b] have undergone the most significant changes. From shoreline adjustments and new heavy tank positions to improved LT positioning and safer passage routes, these updates aim to enhance your battle experience. Prepare to discover new strategies on the battlefield!

[h2]Battle Pass Season XV[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7d6f073ad7f6d199cf8a12dc5db649a8109b8e4b.jpg[/img]Battle Pass Season XV kicks off with the release of Update 1.26, offering you your last chance to earn Tokens for the [b]TT-130M and TS-60[/b] or to obtain previous vehicles you may have missed. Inspired by the Waffenträger universe, this Season unveils Max von Krieger's early life and features [b]Waffenträger-themed customization rewards[/b]. Participate in this final Season of the annual Progression to earn stunning 3D styles and tons of other valuable items!

[h2]Onslaught: Season of the Azure Manticore[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4b44aabf8b8210bb9a44f872b768cee6f83eeb5a.jpg[/img]The 2024-2025 Onslaught annual cycle will consist of three consecutive Seasons with a shared Progression system. With the release of Update 1.26, the first Season, the Season of the Azure Manticore, introduces new challenges and the following key updates:
[list]
[*]Revised Rating Points for easier Progression.
[*]Reduced potential damage range [b](from ±25% to ±12%)[/b].
[*]Updated Onslaught modifiers.
[*]Eight new special Tier X vehicles now eligible for battle.
[/list]
Earn exclusive rewards like the Onslaught annual 2D style, tokens for selecting [b]improved and Experimental Equipment, badges, stripes, and the exclusive Stinger[/b], a special reward Tier X tank with a unique crew and a gorgeous 3D style.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/onslaught-season-of-the-manticore-1/ style=button][b]GIVE ME MORE DETAILS[/b][/url]

[h2]Consumables Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/98ad7f0265779f21ddfe593a4993c289966ffc47.jpg[/img]Small Repair and First Aid Kits now function like their large counterparts, repairing all modules and healing all crew members, respectively. [b]Large consumables see reduced cooldown times[/b], enhancing your battle readiness. We've also removed the Removed Speed Governor, 100/105-octane Fuel, and Lend-Lease/Quality Oil, [b]introducing Quality Fuel and Excellent Fuel[/b] for all nations and engine types.

[h2]WoT Plus Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5a0dba18261408ae8104b1e6ce589f7152a4278f.jpg[/img]Improve your battle results with a new valuable bonus! Access a [b]new information system, the Equipment Assistant[/b], which shows the most common equipment on specific vehicles derived from server statistics. notes.title: Introducing: Czechoslovakian Autocannon Light Tanks!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Update 1.26 introduces a brand-new [b]Czechoslovakian light tank line[/b] into the game. These vehicles have great potential for bold and exciting gameplay due to the [b]twin autocannons[/b] that most of them are wielding.
[previewyoutube=3TGfT4JdYuI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Spot and Shoot in Bursts[/h2]
Starting from Tier VIII, all light tanks in the new Czechoslovakian line have [b]twin autocannons[/b] as their main armament. Autocannons have [b]medium calibers[/b] and a [b]rapid rate of fire[/b]: up to 3,000 shots per minute. You can empty the guns' clip in one go, which takes just a few seconds. All of this gives a unique appeal to the gameplay of vehicles from the new branch.
[list]
[*] [b]Aim for vulnerable spots:[/b] Medium caliber means medium armor penetration.
[*] [b]Mind your dispersion:[/b] Due to the physics of rapid-fire guns, dispersion steadily increases during a burst. For your convenience, there’s a [b]shooting efficiency indicator[/b].
[*] [b]Do damage at close range:[/b] Accuracy also decreases as the distance to the target grows.
[*] [b]Choose the ammo type wisely:[/b] Opt for higher pen and lower damage, average pen and average damage, or lower pen and higher damage.
[*] [b]Flank enemies for phenomenal burst damage:[/b] If you load HE rounds and your target is not well-armored, you can literally rip it apart.
[*] [b]Plan your retreat:[/b] Firing autocannons lowers your camo values; luckily, your mobility is enough to escape (especially if you think about your options in advance).
[*] [b]Spot for the team:[/b] The new Czechoslovaks have decent base view ranges, so besides ripping enemies apart, they are good at the common light tanks' specialty: reconnaissance.
[*] [b]Take notice:[/b] Twin-barreled tank mechanics don't apply to twin autocannons, as their extremely high rate of fire negates consecutive/salvo shot mechanics. Plus, your rounds from both guns will be headed to a single point on the enemy vehicle rather than to two separate points.
[/list]
[h2]Meet the New Czechoslovaks[/h2]
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td width="80%"][b]Škoda T 17[/b]: This Tier VII light tank is the only one in the new branch without the signature twin autocannons, but it is sort of a transition vehicle. Its single autoloader gun has a clip of 5 rounds and a very short intra-clip reloading time.[/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/90bdd8181dca65967a9b91e36eb8d478ce8ad101.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td width="80%"][b]Vz. 64 Blesk[/b]: This Tier VIII predator is the first in the line with the twin autocannons and the new and unusual things they drag in—like firing in controlled bursts (minding your increasing dispersion) and the shooting efficiency indicator.[/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c1d508a58c6327c44bd0b25db3098000287f76ca.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td width="80%"][b]LPT-67 Šelma[/b]: Sitting (most likely, prowling) at Tier IX, this light tank has the same gameplay formula as its predecessor. It's a decent scout, an absolute scourge of thin-armored foes, and a menace to those who have at least one medium-sized weak spot.[/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fcb66f8a4c9b4c2b7046451f926315d4a95229c6.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td width="80%"][b]Vz. 71 Tesák[/b]: This tank at the top of the branch wields a pair of powerful 57-mm autocannons and by virtue of its tier, is the most dangerous enemy-shredder in the family. Its introduction will surely make waves in the meta. Try to ride them![/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a8d0b702a07cd7641907fa1432d441beee1feaa5.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Get to know the new autocannon Czechoslovaks better!

notes.title: Crew Perks Update: A Revolutionary New System
notes.content:
Commanders!

Update 1.26 brings about a major revision of the Crew Perk System. It introduces new perks, rebalances existing ones, and provides flexible perk management options.
[previewyoutube=yABtHIGIvjM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Main Changes in the Crew Perk System[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Maximum Six Perks per Crew Member[/b]: Each crew member can now have a maximum of six perks (including zero perks). Directives will not effectively grant you a seventh perk under any circumstances.
[*] [b]Bonus Perks[/b]: Crew members with multiple roles benefit from the "bonus perk" system. This allows the perks of additional qualifications to be trained alongside the main perks without requiring extra XP or increasing training time.
[*] [b]Shared Perk Effectiveness[/b]: In crews where multiple members share the same role, such as two loaders, the effectiveness of their perks is now shared between them. To achieve 100% effectiveness of a perk, both crew members must fully train it.
[*] [b]Rebalanced and New Perks[/b]: Over a dozen new perks have been introduced. Additionally, existing perks, such as "Sound Detection" and "Firefighting", have been rebalanced.
[*] [b]Post-Progression System[/b]: Half of the Crew XP earned by six-perk crews in battles will contribute to a single Post-Progression, rewarding players with a Universal Training Guide after reaching 100,000 XP milestones.
[*] [b]Perk Reset Options[/b]: Resetting a crew member will also affect Zero Perks, allowing you to choose an entirely new perk setup. Two new buttons in the Barracks enable players to simultaneously reset and assign perks for all crew members.
[/list]
[h2]Implementation of Changes: Key Outtakes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players with crew members exceeding the six-perk limit will receive [b]compensation in the form of National Crew Books[/b].
[*] For the first [b]30 days[/b] after Update 1.26, players can [b]reset perks[/b] as many times as they like, for any crew. Afterward, each crew member will have one free reset.
[/list]
Get the details on the changes to the Crew Perk System and their implementation!
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/new-crew-perks-1-26/ style=button][b]LEARN MORE[/b][/url]

[i]Roll Out![/i]

notes.title: Onslaught: Season of the Azure Manticore Is Coming Your Way!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Year of the Manticore, Commanders! 

Prepare for another challenging battle journey as we kick off the 2024-2025 Onslaught annual cycle! It will feature three dynamic seasons with a shared progression system, starting with the [b]Season of the Azure Manticore[/b] with the release of Update 1.26. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4b44aabf8b8210bb9a44f872b768cee6f83eeb5a.jpg[/img]
[h2]Annual Rewards: Introducing the Stinger[/h2] 

The Onslaught 2024-2025 Annual Reward includes the [b]Stinger, a Tier X heavy tank[/b] that is a stunning replica of the T57 Heavy Tank. This unique vehicle [b]features a striking 3D style and comes with a special crew[/b] that adds to its exclusivity. Collect 9 or more Onslaught Colors (special mode’s currency) across the Seasons to earn this exceptional tank, along with other valuable rewards. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/58be482f13fc59dc6a9b94e617f877507e775aa1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/50d8a8dd14e05b6a34810f7a59f7b308ae2581a7.jpg[/img]
In addition to the Annual Reward, you will also be able to earn various seasonal customization rewards, including the [b]fresh "Hybrid Beast" progressive 2D style[/b].

[h2]Changes in the Ranking System: Rebalanced Progression[/h2]
We’ve streamlined the ranking system to make it more balanced and accessible: 
[list]
[*] [b]Iron Rank: [/b]Major adjustments to make progression easier. 
[*] [b]Bronze Rank:[/b] Moderate changes to facilitate smoother advancement. 
[*] [b]Silver Rank: [/b]Minor tweaks to enhance the ease of moving up. 
[/list]
[h2]Lucky Chips Missions[/h2]
Onslaught will feature [b]weekly Lucky Chips missions [/b]that must be completed consecutively and are exclusive to the mode. Each mission brings you some valuables, like [b]days of WoT Premium Account, bonds, or credits[/b]. On top of that, completing a week’s set of five missions gives you a Lucky Chip. Every additional Lucky Chip will automatically bring you a new reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4cafbb591e2921475dcc74910f6578203a7dd9d0.png[/img]

[h2]Updated Modifiers for Battles [/h2]
For the first time in Onslaught (and World of Tanks), we’re rolling out a change to one of the essential gameplay mechanics:
[list]
[*] Range of Potential Damage: [b]Reduced from +/-25% to a more predictable +/-12%[/b].  
[/list]
Given the competitive spirit of Onslaught, this adjustment makes damage outcomes in the mode more predictable and reliable. 

We've also updated several other modifiers and introduced additional changes—find out more details from our portal article. 
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/onslaught-season-of-the-manticore-1/ style=button][b]VIEW DETAILS[/b][/url]
