notes.title: Overwhelming Fire Returns with Even More Rewards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e1f7b793b7ebd195d3fca3c30cc78bb6d47f1df9.jpg[/img]

The Overwhelming Fire mode returns to World of Tanks, Commanders! 

There will be two launches of this unique mode this August. It will feature the eight familiar special vehicles with autocannons, so prepare for an unforgettable experience and great reward earnings!
[quote=author][b]First Launch[/b]
EU: From August 9 at 08:00 through August 11 at 22:00 (UTC)
NA: From August 9 at 14:00 through August 12 at 05:00 (UTC)
ASIA: From August 9 at 05:00 through August 11 at 20:00 (UTC)

[b]Second Launch[/b]
EU: From August 16 at 08:00 through August 18 at 22:00 (UTC)
NA: From August 16 at 14:00 through August 19 at 05:00 (UTC)
ASIA: From August 16 at 05:00 through August 18 at 20:00 (UTC)[/quote]
[h3]What's New?[/h3]
Get ready for dynamic battles with the same eight fast-firing vehicles, now enhanced with a new animated Progression system. Enjoy clearer combat statistics in our revamped post-battle screen.

[b]Extensive Animated Progression With Stage Rewards:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]6 Rewarding Stages:[/b] Each stage offers valuable rewards like credits, bonds, directives, days of WoT Premium Account, and random rewards from a predetermined list.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b41dde39be93c688f06df4f14b34425bed3a2b60.png[/img]
[*] [b]Complete Special Missions:[/b] Earn Progression Points by completing three base missions in Overwhelming Fire to advance through the stages.
[*] [b]Unlimited Post-Progression:[/b] Unlock unlimited stages after the Main Progression, granting credits and some random rewards from a predetermined list.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d5a20b5da0114e4f1351a35d1e07451a490c5314.png[/img]
[b]Dedicated Post-Battle Screen:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Detailed Combat Statistics:[/b] Displaying all your combat statistics, such as destroyed enemies and assisted/blocked damage.
[*] [b]No Cost Gameplay:[/b] You won't receive credits or XP, but you also won't spend anything. The mode's zero economy is clearly explained.
[/list]
[b]Battle Pass Points Earning[/b]
[list]
[*] When you reach certain Stages of the Main Progression, you will earn Battle Pass Points, which will increase with each new Stage. 
[/list]
[h3]Rewards[/h3]
Play in unique vehicles with automatic cannons to earn [b]bonds, directives, days of WoT Premium Account, Personal Reserves, Free XP[/b], and more! Tons of rewards await you both in the Main Progression and during your Post-Progression journey.

[h3]The Vehicles[/h3]
Overwhelming Fire features eight familiar Tier X vehicles, each with unique automatic cannon sub-mechanics.

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6d0f629734dc7fb6f8f25dd7705de8362b14746c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e84459c6995873d91019bd37b1ce618481b92679.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9c878a88a033a4a9ed885e22a820d22045687ea7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0872f6da4ae52d31fc1ca3f092745da3267bcf27.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/dd8de60d9b54d3f6860e17c4dc005ae7bde3a09f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/76242eb62c1bc578451c6d8e0546f8adb2943873.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ca25092b80969881575b85d9bcfba6161939b8d2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8bbe2a54bf0e47ebfff3437433df599d413fd297.jpg[/img]
[/expand]

[h3]Rules[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Only the eight special vehicles created for the mode[/b] can participate in Overwhelming Fire battles. They are all of the same tier.
[*] The matchmaker will [b]limit the maximum number of B-C CS 59s (rocket arty) and EBR 40s on a team[/b] to two of each. The rest of the vehicles can be mixed and matched without limits.
[*] Random Battles rules apply: [b]15v15, with Standard Battles, Assault, and Encounter Battles possible[/b].
[*] Battles can occur on [b]any maps used for Tier X Random Battles[/b] (except Grand Battles maps).
[*] You [b]don't earn credits or XP[/b] in the Overwhelming Fire mode, but you don't spend credits on repairs, ammo, etc.
[*] [b]Credits[/b] earned by completing Stages [b]are not added[/b] to the respective Reserve.
[*] You [b]cannot complete missions[/b] except those created specifically for the mode.
[*] Platoons are available, but [b]Platoon bonuses don't apply[/b].
[/list]
[i]Prepare to unleash rapid-fire chaos in the updated Overwhelming Fire mode, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Onslaught Light: Play With No Ranks in Tier VIII Vehicles!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8031063871672c9b3f32fbc6f53cdfb2536cc201.jpg[/img]

Commanders,

From [b]July 10 to July 24[/b], join the [b]Onslaught Light experimental mode[/b] via the mode selector! Play 7v7 in Tier VIII vehicles by the familiar Onslaught rules in a more relaxed, yet also more lucrative way: You [b]never lose your progress[/b] and can [b]bring along your Tier VIII Premium vehicles[/b].

[h2]How Is Onslaught Light Different?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tier VIII only,[/b] except for SPGs and a few excluded vehicles of other types.
[*] [b]No Ranks or Qualification[/b]: with lower stakes, play for fun (and profit)!
[*] [b]Standalone event[/b]: not part of the Onslaught Year/Season cycles.
[*] [b]Credit and XP gain[/b]: as in Tier VIII Random Battles.
[*] [b]Premium vehicles allowed[/b]: all respective bonuses apply.
[*] [b]Event Progression[/b]: play well, earn Progression points (with no loss), and receive extra rewards![/list][h2]How Is Onslaught Light Similar to the "Heavy" Mode?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]7v7 battles[/b]: more room to shine.
[*] [b]All Onslaught modifiers apply[/b]:
[list]
[*] ↑ vehicle hit points ↑
[*] ↓ consumables cooldown time ↓
[*] ↓ dispersion at 100 m ↓
[*] ↓ time remaining visible ↓
[*] ↓ proximity spotting radius ↓[/list][*] [b]Platoons and Super Platoons[/b]: play with a friend or in a pre-made team of seven commanders.
[*] [b]Fog of War[/b]: no info on the enemy team until their vehicles are spotted.
[*] [b]Pre-battle preparation[/b]: select your vehicle and its configuration during the countdown.
[*] [b]Points of Interest[/b]: capture to use Tactical Skills (Divisional Radar, Artillery Strike).
[*] [b]Role Skills[/b]: these depend on your vehicle type and role. Accumulate Prestige Points in battle to build up their charge level.[/list]Learn more about the Onslaught gameplay rules and mechanics in the game client.
[h2]Excluded Vehicles[/h2]
[b]Onslaught Light is an experimental mode[/b], and some vehicles are unsuitable for this new format due to their combat roles. Plus, some tanks overperform at Tier VIII under the special battle conditions in the Onslaught format and can decide the outcome of battles, so we've excluded them from the mode:

[expand][list][*] BZ-176 
[*] Löwe 
[*] T34 and T34B
[*] FCM 50t
[*] Gonsalo
[*] AAT60[/list][/expand]
Also excluded are all Tier VIII SPGs—as per the general Onslaught rules.
[h2]Event Progression[/h2]
Onslaught Light has a [b]15-Stage event Progression[/b] with nice rewards, including Experimental Equipment and components, bonds, credits, Personal Reserves, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/05c87d5af531c1039472bf4e3e3a3f22e108b772.png[/img]

The Progression rewards also include [b]the unique "Enlightenment" 2D style[/b] and decals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e604d18538e91a37b4a059c779d8d938bd6927b8.jpg[/img]
Earning Progression points is simple: [b]everyone gets some[/b] (except the last player by Prestige Points on the losing team). Also [b]you never lose points[/b].

[expand]
[h4]Progression Points Distribution[/h4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3c75285c02756569f1abd674defd54c45edb6355.png[/img]

[/expand]
You can score even more Progression points by completing [b]daily Battle Missions[/b] in the mode.

[expand]
[h4]Daily Battle Missions[/h4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4a32e98e9e4828b2b262d6544c5e9ae997674a62.png[/img]
Continue doing missions after you max out the mode Progression. Completing each mission will yield you 20 bonds.
[/expand]
[i]Prepare your favorite Tier VIIIs for the fun and lucrative mode, Commanders![/i]

Access this exciting mode via the mode selector and become the unseen threat on the battlefield!
[quote]Available from June 28 through June 30, 2024, and from July 5 through July 7, 2024[/quote]
[h3]What's New?[/h3]
Compared to the previous launch back in 2023, Darkness of the Night has several gameplay and visual changes. Check them out:
[list]
[*]New map: special version of [b]Fjords[/b] shrouded in darkness. It features [b]dimmed lighting and rain[/b]. The precipitation does not affect the gameplay but adds to the mood. It won't impact the performance of your system significantly.
[*][b]Jamming modifier removed[/b] due to feedback. Signal range is no longer cut in half.
[/list]
[h3]Maps[/h3]
Night battles will unfold on the following transformed maps:
[list]
[*][b]NEW! Fjords[/b].
[*]Glacier.
[*]Sand River.
[*]Lakeville. 
[/list]
All maps will feature a pale moon glowing in the sky and a few other light sources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/270e0a142beccc527e9fd11ac74325d6516284ea.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/64fb96ef0bc1619ef9e30f9e3433db2d770623a2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Battle Rules[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can play in [b]any Tier VIII or Tier X vehicle[/b].
[*]Battles are [b]15v15[/b] and [b]single-tiered[/b].
[*][b]Platoons are available[/b], and all Platoon bonuses apply.
[*]You cannot complete missions except those [b]created specifically for the mode[/b].
[*]Credits and XP [b]can be earned[/b].
[*]Battle Pass Points and bonds [b]cannot be earned[/b].
[*]All types of [b]Reserves (Personal and Clan) can be used[/b].
[*]XP multipliers for the [b]first victory of the day do apply[/b].
[*]Credits [b]are added to the Credit Reserve[/b].
[*]Gold is [b]not added to the Gold Reserve[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Battle Modifiers[/h3]
In this mode, players can expect a special set of battle modifiers that will change the familiar game rules.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4831dc3fe72bb2e2bb6b7794adcc646e90a0ff58.png[/img]

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td width="25%"][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/83de4f0ed424d95b466812ec1910a04a2acdfbfb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/43a663a9de3a012257e6989fadfefc1e0faf0d59.png[/img][/url][/td]
[td width="75%"]Darkness of the Night will have a short chain of battle missions during each launch. Complete them to earn [b]up to 800 bonds in total[/b].[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[i]Roll out quietly in your sneakiest vehicles and prevail subtly, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Operation Overlord: Join a New PvE Mode!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d7a17668ff68902876f44386afe668a5642c09bd.jpg[/img]

From [b]June 6 through July 4[/b], experience the historically inspired [b]Operation Overlord PvE mode[/b] and join the iconic Normandy landings. Dedicated to the 80th anniversary of D-Day, the largest amphibious operation in military history, this single-player combat scenario immerses you in the pivotal events of June 6, 1944. 

[quote]Available from June 6, 2024, at 02:00 UTC through July 4, 2024 at 02:00[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/46190338d5a2381ac2d1bceeeefe5cbe3c73ae8d.png[/img]
[h3]Mode Objectives[/h3]
Operation Overlord is a single-player battle scenario inspired by the real historical events of D-Day during World War II. As part of a team of AI-driven allies, you [b]fight against computer-controlled enemies[/b].
[list]
[*]Your first objective is to [b]break through the coastal defenses and minefields[/b]. Secure the beachhead by targeting and destroying coastal bunkers, suppressing enemy positions, and breaching fortified defenses.
[*]Work with your AI-driven allies to ensure mission success.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/47f5179bca3b33c432507f8a4523de2787dd0655.png[/img]
[h3]Difficulty Levels and Missions[/h3]
The mode has two difficulty levels:[b] Regular and Rigorous,[/b] with missions providing different rewards for each level. Both levels are available from the start.
Each difficulty has three missions: The first is available [b]on June 6[/b], while the other two remain locked [b]until June 13, when all three become available[/b]. The second and third missions mirror the first one but with added challenges to enhance your gameplay experience.

[h3]Core Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Each operation is intuitive:[/b] Rush forward, follow navigation markers, and destroy enemies and coastal bunkers on sight. Here are some highlights and unique play mechanics of the mode:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a155029c5e1d436c4eab2e6bd623a61486f5f841.png[/img]
[*] [b]Event Map:[/b] Battles will unfold on the special Overlord map, enriched with many details and interactive objects to replicate the atmosphere of the Normandy landings.
[*] [b]Combat Vehicle: [/b]You will head into battle in the legendary M4A3E8 Sherman.
[/list]
[h3]Unique Features[/h3]
[list]
[*][b] Battleship Support: [/b]Surprise enemies by using your shell tracers to help the USS Frankford target enemy bunkers on the fog-covered beach.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/46786b99afd9be4d19c3545a1e71e27492ada219.png[/img]

[*] [b]Smoke Signals:[/b] Available after disabling enemy anti-aircraft defenses, use these to mark targets like enemy fortifications and vehicles for allied battleships.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/eecdf80b470358d2af4346c3ffc5415533059ba8.png[/img]

[*] [b]Minefields:[/b] The coastline area is littered with mines, so move carefully! You have a unique support vehicle on your side, however. The Sherman Crab will help you and your allies to navigate the buried explosives.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ae4a45e8c046b22d97c76e3354aa30eba4e55a71.png[/img]
[h3]Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/24bf368f7740734de992b29057fa0c5e969287e0.png[/img]
Each difficulty level only has one mission available at the start of the event, with additional missions and extra rewards active from June 13. The reward pool includes:
[list]
[*] Credits
[*] Bonds
[*] Free XP
[*] Battle Pass Points
[/list]
[h3]2D Styles and Camos[/h3]
Rewards also include two stunning all-season 2D styles and two cool camos inspired by the events of D-Day.
Once you complete all missions for Rigorous difficulty, you will also receive the commemorative "Overlord Veteran" medal.

[i]Good luck on the sandy beaches of Normandy, Commanders! Complete historically inspired missions and earn unique styles alongside other rewards![/i]

notes.title: Update 1.25: New Achievement System, PvE Event & More!
notes.content:
Commanders! 

Update 1.25 commemorates the 80th anniversary of D-Day, offering an immersive PvE mode with AI enemies and many other activities to honor this historic event. We‘re also introducing a new Achievement system to help track your progress, and Frontline returns with familiar rules and dynamic 30v30 battles. [b]Watch the Update video and scroll down for more details![/b]

Embark on [b]a single-player PvE adventure[/b] and immerse yourself in the epic events of D-Day. This historically inspired battle scenario will unfold on the Overlord map and beyond [b]from June 6 until July 4[/b]. Relive history, enjoy dynamic gameplay, and unlock valuable rewards through two difficulty levels!

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/pve-normandy-2024/ style=button][b]DISCOVER OPERATION OVERLORD[/b][/url]

[b]Battle Pass Season XIV honors the 80th anniversary of D-Day[/b] with a heartfelt dive into history. Running [b]from June 5 through September 4[/b], the Season consists of three main Chapters. Complete them in any order to earn tons of rewards, including three brand-new Tier VI Premium tanks with Normandy-inspired 3D styles.
At the end of June, prepare to participate in [b]a time-limited extra Chapter dedicated to Tankfest[/b] and collect two recognizable crew members and additional goodies.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/battle-pass-d-day-2024/ style=button][b]GET FULL DETAILS[/b][/url]

Join us for the 80th Anniversary of D-Day! Our event hub will guide you through June, featuring [b]special-themed in-game events and two historical live streams[/b]—one from a D-Day landing craft and another at Tankfest, both with Twitch Drops.
Earn D-Day Tokens and trade them in the D-Day Token Store for awesome rewards!

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/d-day-hub-2024/ style=button][b]EXPLORE D-DAY ACTIVITIES[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7a156b27c03184260e72b35eabfbea9e81a2dd22.jpg[/img]

Initially focusing on vehicles, [b]it categorizes achievements into various sections[/b]: vehicle types, nations, customizations, and more. Climb the Total Vehicle Count achievement ladder to earn exclusive animated Dog Tags and reach new milestones to boost your overall Achievement Score.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/achievement-system-1-25/ style=button][b]FIND OUT MORE[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/83d03c6602e1fb2bbabb60b042af809df885a549.jpg[/img]
Engage in epic 30v30 Frontline battles on huge maps, like the historically inspired Normandy location, and prove your might with the familiar rules of the dynamic battle scenario system. As always, you can [b]earn attractive rewards, including Experimental Equipment[/b], a choice of directives, bonds, and more!

[h2]Onslaught: Claim Your Annual Reward![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1e4025ca17bac6a40811989adb3135835ead0eb7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steel Hunter Returns!
notes.content:
Commanders!

Steel Hunter, the much-loved battle royale mode, is back with us again. [b]From May 20 through June 2[/b], prepare for free-for-all survival on ever-shrinking maps in eight mode-specific vehicles upgraded as the battle goes on. Expect intense rivalry and nice rewards, [b]enhanced visual effects[/b] for multiple abilities, plus brand-new features making survival more social, including [b]Platoon voice chat[/b] and [b]Random Platoons[/b].

Team up with a stranger and become survival mates with them!

[previewyoutube=JlqxLcxpWVg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5f0d0d1d6dd75c24fdf907a3a456529b0a2b1c79.jpg[/img]

[h3]Random Platoons [/h3]
[list]
[*] Activate this option in the Steel Hunter Garage.
[*] You will be assigned a mate with the best suitable skill level (as measured by Steel Hunter performance)*.
[*] If you enjoy your random co-survivor's company, you may offer to convert your Random Platoon to a regular Steel Hunter Platoon. This option is available on the battle results screen. 
[/list]

[h3]Steel Hunter Platoon voice chat** [/h3]
[list]
[*] Use it while in a Random or a regular Steel Hunter Platoon.
[*] If your Steel Hunter Platoon is a regular one, you can also use the voice chat in the Garage.
[/list]

[h3]Chat Wheel [/h3]
[list]
[*] Familiar to you from Random Battles and activated by the "T" key by default, it can improve communication with Platoon mates if you cannot use the voice chat for some reason.
[/list]

[h3]VFX changes to Combat Abilities [/h3]
[list]
[*] Apply to multiple vehicles, upscale the visuals, and help tell whether an Ability is being used by an enemy or your ally. 
[/list]

[i]*In case finding a Platoon partner takes longer than usual, the skill requirements may be eased.
**Voice chat must be enabled in the game settings. It's activated by pressing a key designated in the key bindings menu.[/i]

[h2]Progression Rewards[/h2]
Collect [b]Progression Points[/b] and [b]Steel Seals[/b] in Steel Hunter by playing well and also by completing event-specific daily missions. The Points will advance your [b]Progression[/b], with every [b]Stage[/b] giving various rewards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2ea789e65d9a8b956d6793f43a3109246e4f4de9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Items for Steel Seals[/h2]
Exchange [b]Steel Seals[/b] you receive in the mode into unique vehicle customization items! You can do this [b]in the in-game Store until June 10[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/12485602c423bfa0158ce03b00822c24a0831634.jpg[/img]

[h2]Changes to VFX and Combat Abilites [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Arlequin[/b]: the Airstrike Combat Ability now ignores armor; damage dealt and stun efficiency is maximal in the center of the blast zone and diminishes to its edges.
[*] The drops’ and all vehicles’ visual effects interact with the terrain better.
[*] The respawn visual effects have been enhanced for all vehicles.
[*] The visual effects have been upgraded for several Combat Abilities: Minefield ([b]Varyag[/b]), Trap and Target Tracking ([b]Raven[/b]), Acid Shell ([b]Bái Láng[/b]), Surging Fervor and Electric Discharge ([b]Huragan[/b]); for the latter Ability, your own or your ally’s zone of effect is now visually distinct from those of the enemies.
[/list]

Learn everything about Steel Hunter in the complete guide.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/ style=button][b]LEARN MORE[/b][/url]

[i]Prepare for the big hunt and remember that hunting in packs is now more convenient than ever![/i]

notes.title: Call to the Final Frontier
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/30ba184bf9de6f58b08a971763ad787461fe82d8.png[/img]
[i]To the final frontier, Commanders![/i]
A mysterious alien Object stole the antimatter straight from the warp core of the [i]U.S.S. Enterprise[/i]. Use your vehicle combat skills while competing with other crewmates to recover the antimatter and research the alien Object. Help the iconic flagship resume her five-year mission!
[quote][b]CALL TO THE FINAL FRONTIER
Available from May 2, 2024 at 08:00 UTC through May 13, 2024 at 04:00 UTC[/b]
[/quote]
[previewyoutube=N4CY4YlCg8o;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Recruit Iconic Characters[/h2]
Free Mission Progress rewards include three iconic [i]Star Trek[/i] characters: Captain James T. [b]Kirk[/b], Commander [b]Spock[/b], and comms specialist Nyota [b]Uhura[/b], all with [b]custom voiceovers[/b]. Put them in charge of your vehicles in Random Battles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/55c6da28b5f081718cbade942d9eac2aff7273f3.png[/img]
[h2]Ride Your Rover Into the Mission Area[/h2]
The mysterious alien Object is placing [b]Antimatter Fragments[/b] in strange patterns on the asteroid’s surface. Use a remote-controlled [b]Rover[/b] to collect Fragments before your [i]U.S.S. Enterprise[/i] crewmates beat you to it, guided by [b]Mr. Scott[/b]. Captain Kirk encourages healthy competition and wants to test the vehicles’ performance, so use your Rover’s abilities and power-ups!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/039f2f9a85bef3be4f834f1f73d65115e286a571.png[/img]
[h2]Get Rewarded by Starfleet[/h2]
Free Mission Progress rewards include unique [i]Star Trek[/i]-themed content. Complete daily event missions and earn a 2D style, decals, and inscriptions, as well as three Commanders with unique voiceovers and an [b]Orion Lockbox[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0b6eb0879a3352687ce7ad446993e12b83515a9c.png[/img]
[h2]Get More Orion Lockboxes [/h2]
Some precious items ended up in the hands of Orion merchants who sell them in lockboxes. The possible loot (a merchant word indeed!) includes ten armored vehicles from Earth’s past. Two of them were previously unknown: the [b]AAT60[/b] and the [b]Nemesis[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/effac763689cec07a6dd7c9e4ffb4cce09b26c08.jpg[/img]
[h2]Meet New Armored Vehicles[/h2]
The two newcomers from Orion Lockboxes are both Tier VIII Premium medium tanks with very good gun depression values. The [b]AAT60[/b] combines great gun handling with solid DPM, and can sport the fascinating Emissary 3D style. The [b]Nemesis[/b] has a very sturdy turret and excellent single-shot damage.
[h2]Scan the Emissary 3D Style[/h2]
[i]"Found this one when we were looking for that T95 we lost during field trials. The ground 'round the thing was...strange, wrinkled. Like it had been fried or something. And what a remarkable piece of equipment, this tank. Looks a bit like one of ours, right? But I heard Doc getting all excited about the 'improbable alloy' it's made of—after he managed to chip a bit off the lower plate. Hope his ravings can stir up some of the top brass to get the tank outta our depot and into some fancy top-secret lab. Because I’m telling you, it looks like it can fly—or even more. You know, the little green men that built it—just for fun, inspired by our exotic designs—they might find its remote control and press some buttons."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c9daebe8794e1e1cd1ee8b08f23c44ee6d264efb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/71bb6280a66bf076030a2d326d6e558c2b96366f.jpg[/img]

[i]To the Final Frontier![/i]

[h2]POLISH TD LINE[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/05d968373ffaafd28b474f6f014f0cab594b3941.jpg[/img]
The game’s first branch of Polish tank destroyers includes six researchable vehicles from Tier V to Tier X. Tiers V–VII showcase classic turretless TDs with traditional gameplay. Meanwhile, vehicles of Tiers VIII–X have deep-rifled guns with innovative shell mechanics. This enables them to unleash maximum damage in close combat. Check out the lineup!

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/1-24-1-polish-tank-destroyers/ style=button][b]DISCOVER TD DOMINANCE[/b][/url]

[h2]ALL CREWS ARE NOW 100%![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b2d6e69674f97a887ba725ec1706d56580e87ee1.jpg[/img]
We're constantly enhancing the crew system. Here’s what's new this time:
[list]
[*] All crews now operate at 100% efficiency.
[*] The "major qualification level" has been renamed to "crew efficiency" for clarity.
[*] Perk efficiency penalty when retraining for free or for credits—gradually decreases with experience.
[*] Special retraining bonuses for newcomers.
[*] Option to switch tanker qualification when retraining for credits.[/list]
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/crew-update-april-2024/ style=button][b]GET FULL DETAILS[/b][/url]

[h2]TIER X VEHICLE REBALANCING[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5ec5267ad43ac5f33f98c006a5e3b31a8b264a23.jpg[/img]
Based on your feedback and our statistics, we identified four Tier X vehicles that required fine-tuning. The Pz.Kpfw. VII and AMX 50 Foch B receive performance boosts, while the Super Conqueror and Controcarro 3 Minotauro get slight adjustments to make them less formidable opponents.

To ensure consistency with the vehicles mentioned above, we're also tweaking the performance of surrounding Tier VIII-IX French and Italian TDs in their branches.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/supertest-vehicle-rebalances-march-2024/ style=button][b]DISCOVER CHANGES[/b][/url]

[h2]MAP REBALANCING[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4c404122be92911a0ae7bd6d2c6ce0e5e52092a0.jpg[/img]
We've revamped five Random Battle maps to enhance gameplay comfort. Mountain Pass has undergone more substantial changes. We've also made slight adjustments to various positions on the following maps: Karelia, Mines, El Halluf, and Outpost.

[h2]ONSLAUGHT: FIGHT FOR YOUR ANNUAL REWARD![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1e4025ca17bac6a40811989adb3135835ead0eb7.jpg[/img]
Prepare for the Season of the Jade Pegasus, the culmination of the Year of the Pegasus! Push yourself to the limit on the battlefield to earn a better Annual Reward. It might include the Hurricane Tier X medium tank and a variety of other valuable items. The closing Season of Onslaught 2023-2024 also brings:
[list]
[*] A brand-new piece of Improved Equipment: Innovative Targeting.
[*] Team Training with Onslaught maps.
[*] Fresh customization rewards.[/list]
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/onslaught-season-of-the-jade-pegasus-2024/ style=button][b]DISCOVER ONSLAUGHT UPDATES[/b][/url]

[h2]REFINE YOUR SKILLS WITH POSTMORTEM MODE![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1ade988e1d08fc5ad8f9a15407dd10d5823c83ab.jpg[/img]
Discover the new Postmortem Mode feature to boost your mastery on the battlefield! The feature provides vital insights into enemy positioning, shell trajectory, and penetration mechanics. It includes Last Moment—functionality that unveils crucial details of the shot that destroyed your vehicle. This offers both Detailed and Short versions.

The Postmortem Mode deepens your understanding of gameplay and helps you learn from every battle.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/content/guide/general/guide-postmortem-mode/ style=button][b]POSTMORTEM MODE: DETAILS[/b][/url]

[h2]Revamped Tour of Duty[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/40168adc2e297f4e72f91c425dbc8aad746d7021.jpg[/img]
Our Tour of Duty clan activity is getting a significant makeover. Here's what's new:
[list]
[*] Three daily clan missions with sequential completion.
[*] The final two missions are completed in a Platoon or detachment with clanmates.
[*] Claim rewards for completed missions manually.
[/list]
Rewards for mission completion include Industrial Resources and a fresh clan currency. The ultimate prize of your Tour of Duty journey is the Carro da Combattimento 45 t, an Italian Tier X medium tank, with the "Proserpina" 3D style.

notes.title: Polish Tank Destroyers Are Coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6ecc3304720298c5cb33152a3ed3df3a3529b67e.jpg[/img]
[b]Commanders! [/b] 

Update 1.24.1 introduces a [b]debut lineup of Polish tank destroyers[/b]. The new branch comprises 6 researchable vehicles spanning Tier V to Tier X.

[previewyoutube=oZ5nCwLwJiY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Branch Composition[/h2]
The new branch of Polish tank destroyers consists of six researchable vehicles from Tier V to Tier X. The transition to the new branch will begin with the [b]Tier IV 14TP light tank[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8a66808ffa002a683340766718d4966eac5f7b59.png[/img]

Tiers V–VII will feature classic turretless TDs with traditional gameplay. The first vehicle in the branch is the [b]SDP 40 Zadymka[/b], sitting at Tier V. It is followed by the [b]SDP 44 Burza (Tier VI)[/b] and [b]SDP 57 Gowika (Tier VII)[/b].

However, [b]Tiers VIII–X introduce innovative shell mechanics[/b], enabling vehicles to deal maximum damage in close combat. They are represented by:
[list]
[*] SDP 58 Kilana (Tier VIII)
[*] SDP 60 Gonkiewicza (Tier IX)
[*] NC 70 Błyskawica (Tier X)
[/list]
[h2]Maximize Damage with Star Tray Shells [/h2]
Polish Tier VIII–X TDs are equipped with [b]unusual deep-rifled guns[/b]. These guns enable them to fire star tray shells traveling at incredible velocities: 1,700 m/s for a standard round and 2,000 m/s for a special one. These shells are [b]most effective within 50 meters[/b], delivering maximum damage. However, the damage gradually decreases with distance. Thus, high-tier Polish TDs encourage you to engage in close combat where you can be most effective. 

Learn more about brand-new Polish tank destroyers in a dedicated article on our portal! 

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/1-24-1-polish-tank-destroyers/ style=button][b]LEARN MORE[/b][/url]

notes.title: Open Emerald Boxes for Great Rewards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ecedbcfbcb84134270b1375cb8810d4bddf46f5e.jpg[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]

Join the [b]Green Light Festival from March 14 through March 21[/b] and play in Random Battles and Steel Hunter to earn rewards, including up to 2 Emerald Boxes. 

Each box contains valuable items, such as 1 of 10 Premium vehicles, including 2 brand-new ones, days of Wot Premium Account, and more. 

Get boxes right now and paint the battlefield green!
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Emerald Boxes[/h2]
[b]Available from March 14, 2024 at 04:00 (UTC) through March 21, 2024 at 22:00 (UTC)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a91bca244d9694d21ba712231a1926755d36af44.png[/img]

[h3]What’s Inside?[/h3]
Emerald Boxes are [u]available in bundles of 5, 25, 50, or 150 Boxes[/u] and contain a reward from the list below:
[list]
[*] 1 of 10 Premium vehicles, including 2 brand-new ones—the T 54D and the Alembic (Drop chance: 2%)
[*] From 5,000 to 250,000 of Free XP (Drop chance: 10%)
[*] One of the following: Crew Book or credits (Drop chance: 75%)
[*] One of the following: Days of WoT Premium Account or Personal Reserves (Drop chance: 100%)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/164522df875006e7dc6f03e3a317cf9b4c4b15bd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6f81d7d46880c256ee4bacca7002ba4af384456d.png[/img]
[h3]Get a Guaranteed Premium Vehicle[/h3]
[list]
[*] For every 50 Emerald Boxes you open, you are guaranteed one of the ten Tier VIII–IX Premium vehicles. 
[*] The counter is reset if a vehicle drops before you open your 50th box.
[*] The Emerald Boxes will only drop vehicles that you don’t already have in your Garage.
[*] Once you have all ten vehicles, the next vehicle drop will grant its value in gold instead.
[*] If you don’t open all your Emerald Boxes in time, they will open automatically at the end of the event.
[/list]
[h2]Meet the Mighty and Sturdy T 54D![/h2]
The [b]T 54D[/b] is a Soviet medium tank with a powerful British L7 gun, high armor protection, and solid survivability.

Especially in the early stages of the battle, the T 54D is a supporter rather than an independent actor. But it has high damage potential and accuracy, making it a potent force on the battlefield. 
Maximize your firepower with well-aimed shots at enemy weak spots, engage targets from a distance, and use terrain to maintain the advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/932a5f4ce5ac5f9243ae80d7cf76a2057839e59d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Shine on the Battlefield in the Mysterious Alembic![/h2]
The second newcomer is the amazing [b]Alembic[/b], a special version of the ASTRON Rex 105 mm. 

This small and compact American medium tank features a 5-round autoloader with an impressive 1,600 burst damage. It comes in an eye-catching permanent 3D style, turning the mighty machine into a potent alchemy laboratory on tracks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/72ed6adc3e23254516cd56ecd86b87d6f1d1553e.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Enjoy the festivities and grab Emerald Boxes with awesome vehicles!

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/specials/st-patricks-day-emerald-box-contents-march-2024/ style=button]READ MORE[/url]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/604a5964a75d0685631352d29238f70d1f6a2522.jpg[/img]

Update 1.24 is coming your way, Commanders!

As the inaugural update of 2024, it presents the chance to engage in the revamped Maneuvers clan event. Additionally, this spring will unveil several exciting events and features that are in active development, including Random Events on new maps, the introduction of the first lineup of Polish tank destroyers in the game, and more. Let’s take a closer look.

[h2]Maneuvers Event[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/80ecf09917502125f680f5df1efce162ff220879.jpg[/img]

Starting [b]March 11[/b], World of Tanks will host the [b]Maneuvers clan event[/b]. Its progression system and core rules will be the same as in the previous launch but with several improvements.

One of the main additions is the bond auction. If you participated in the event but didn’t make it to the leaderboard due to insufficient Fame Points, you can join the bond auction to bid for a chance at cool Tier X reward vehicles.

Additionally, we bring:
[list]
[*] [b]Encounter Battles[/b] Instead of Standard Battles: Engage in 7v7 battles using any Tier X vehicles.
[*] [b]First Victory Bonus[/b]: Earn more personal Fame Points for the day's first victory in a new vehicle.
[*] [b]Interface Improvements[/b]: Get back destroyed vehicles directly from the battle room interface.
[/list]

[h2]Roadmap Highlights: Get Ready for an Intense Spring![/h2]
If you missed our upcoming plans announcement, check it out below! Exciting events, features, and improvements across your favorite modes are on the horizon. Get ready to experience:
[list]
[*] [b]Expansion of Random Events[/b] to include Pilsen, Karelia, Cliff, Redshire, Siegfried Line, and Malinovka.
[*] Arrival of two new branches: [b]Polish tank destroyers[/b] designed for close combat and [b]Czechoslovakian light tanks[/b] equipped with autocannons.

notes.title: It's Time for Update 1.23.1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ff91d5e17199075357016f04b21d295846b1455a.jpg[/img]

Attention Commanders! 
Mark your calendars for the unveiling of Update 1.23.1 on January 10! This update brings you six brand-new Japanese heavies featuring double aiming mechanics and hydropneumatic suspension.

On top of that, brace yourselves for the return of the revamped Onslaught mode with the Season of the Crimson Pegasus, kicking off the day the update goes live. Finally, try out a pack of rebalanced low-tier vehicles in Random Battles, and get ready for the fourth Episode of Frontline, which will be released later. Let's dive in!

[previewyoutube=9HzAv74CRrI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Introducing Brand-New Japanese Heavies[/h2]
Six fresh Japanese heavy tanks stand prepared to dominate the battlefield! These versatile brawlers feature well-sloped armor and robust turrets. The higher-tier tanks in this branch come equipped with two gameplay-changing mechanics: double aiming (gun cooling) and hydropneumatic suspension.

Double aiming allows the gun to fire more accurately if you wait a little after the reload. The second aiming circle shows this improved accuracy, which starts working as the gun cools down. Opt for higher DPM with slightly compromised accuracy, or shoot less frequently with pinpoint precision.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/3860212413465830923

[h2]Onslaught: Season Of The Crimson Pegasus[/h2]
Embark on the next chapter of your Onslaught journey with the Season of the Crimson Pegasus! Participate and make progress toward the Annual Reward, which includes an exclusive version of the [b]Tier X Polish CS⁠-⁠63 medium tank[/b]. This special reward comes with a stunning 3D style and custom crew members, along with other enticing rewards.
[list]
[*] New maps: The fresh Season introduces three new maps—Oyster Bay, Studzianki, and Outpost—promising a new tactical experience.
[*] Cool items for bonds: The in-game Store, featuring exclusive items for bonds, is reopening its doors, so don't miss out!
[*] Three new combat modifiers: To elevate the thrill, the Season of the Crimson Pegasus will showcase three new modifiers (on top of the existing two), ensuring even more exciting battles ahead.
[/list]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/3860212413469413323

[h2]Revitalizing Vehicles: A Journey Across Tiers[/h2]
We shift our focus back to vehicle rebalancing, concentrating on 11 low-tier vehicles ranging from Tier II through Tier IV. The fine-tuning of their characteristics aims to improve accessibility and enhance the overall experience for newcomers embarking on their World of Tanks journey.

At the same time, experienced veterans can look forward to new gameplay hallmarks, enriching their experience. Roll out and enjoy!

Stay tuned for the upcoming updates—our focus will shift to rebalancing high-tier vehicles, too!

[h2]Prepare To Fight In Frontline Episode 4[/h2]
The next Frontline Episode is on the horizon, showcasing the dynamic battle scenarios system. In each battle, a randomly selected scenario from three Combat Reserves options will unfold, as follows:
[list]
[*] Standard Battle follows regular rules
[*] Operational Support accelerates Reserves recharge
[*] Twist of Fate offers a choice between two randomly selected Combat Reserves from a diverse pool
[/list]
With all three scenarios randomly available during Episode 4, gear up for an electrifying gameplay experience!

notes.title: Welcome the New Line of Japanese Heavies!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a001c3b44b93eef46d44062e38110f19a3b03e5b.jpg[/img]

Commanders!

A new branch of six Japanese heavy tanks will enter the game in Update 1.23.1. It begins at Tier V with the Mitsu 108, a heavy, which you can research after the Chi-He, a Tier IV medium tank. The branch’s top three tanks feature a brand-new mechanic─double aiming (also known as gun cooling). On top of that, the top two also have hydropneumatic suspension. Let’s take a closer look at the vehicles from the branch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/27f96a4d36370f887d251fb7f823fc84a855bbbe.jpg[/img]

[h2]Mitsu 108 (Tier V)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7d725c2eedf90cb1f4fb212fa3f856fba78b1800.jpg[/img]

Kicking off the new line is a full-fledged heavy that only weighs about half of the O-I Experimental, its counterpart from the Japanese superheavy branch. For its weight and size, the Mitsu 108 is pretty mobile, with a base top forward speed of 35 km/h. While its armor protection isn’t great, it has impressive armament (with a 105 mm top gun) and an excellent maximum gun depression angle of −10°.

[h2]Type 3 Ju-Nu (Tier VI)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bb3cf810f26ce4e959b864676c26dfcb62d00a17.jpg[/img]

The Ju-Nu gives us a lot of hints about where this branch is headed. It keeps the mobility and strong gun depression angle of its predecessor. At the same time, it is less bulky and has a sturdier turret, and it compensates for its smaller damage per shot value with a significantly better DPM from its top 88 mm gun.

[h2]Type 4 Ju-To (Tier VII)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f212b6c4b75e9000235c11c709e6d96229beb9fb.jpg[/img]

The Ju-To is an incremental step in the same direction. Its powerful engine allows it to retain the mobility of the tanks before it in the branch while also having thicker turret armor. (And while its nominal hull armor is less than that of its “elder brother”, its effective armor values are better because of the angles at which the plates are sloped.) The basic formula of the branch—“a well-rounded and mobile heavy able to play hull-down”—is ready, and it’s about time for a special ingredient to be introduced.

[h2]Double Aiming (Gun Cooling) Mechanic[/h2]
The brand-new double aiming mechanic is based on an ingenious tank gun cooling system proposed in post-war Japan. Ventilators paired with heat-dissipating radiators would allow the barrel to cool off faster, mitigating the negative impact of thermal deformation and thus reducing gun dispersion.

In the game, double aiming works as follows. If you delay the shot after your gun has fully loaded, the gun dispersion will decrease. Once the mechanic activates, you will see a second, smaller circle inside your aiming circle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/48efec9da5235ff47e5f2a1483a0bd6be75ce929.jpg[/img]

Double aiming gives additional tactical flexibility to the Tier VIII–X vehicles in the new branch. Depending on the situation on the battlefield, you can engage in terrain-based play at close range while firing on cooldown, sacrifice part of your DPM and snipe enemies from afar, or opt for any in-between approach. The Type 63, a Premium “relative” of the new Japanese heavy branch, also possesses this mechanic.

[h2]Type 57 (Tier VIII)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7dc36c70aca7c6692d7993f7c7a25c4021a044eb.jpg[/img]

Even if you disregard the double aiming mechanic, the stats of the Type 57 are impressive. It has well-sloped hull armor, its turret armor is 300 mm thick at the front (yes, we are speaking nominal values), and its maximum gun depression angle is outstanding (−12°). Plus, suppressing the urge to shoot immediately can bring down the Type 57’s base gun dispersion from a not-so-great (but not terrible) 0.42 m at 100 m to an almost Leopard-like 0.28 m at 100 m.

[h2]Type 68 (Tier IX)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b93f2e2c6b4887ca4b1830dd0e0ae84faf262e77.jpg[/img]

Being a Tier IX vehicle, the Type 68 has better damage per shot, shell penetration, reload time, and specific power than its predecessor. Yet it plays very much in the same way. The main difference between the tanks is that the Type 68 achieves its −12° of maximum gun depression with the help of hydropneumatic suspension. The base value is −8°, and to bend its gun down to the fullest, the Type 68 needs to decrease its speed (like the STB-1).

[h2]Type 71 (Tier X)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fd97fcdf13cfbd35509dbedbc5ea827fac77b49c.jpg[/img]

Sitting comfortably atop the branch (as it will atop a hill) is the Type 71. With a gun cooling system and hydropneumatic suspension, it’s a large 67-ton chunk of innovation with a tough turret and not-so-tough hull. The tank’s specific power (17.5 hp per ton) gives it enough mobility to reach favorable terrain folds in good time. Once in position, the suspension can activate automatically and crank the maximum gun depression level from −7° to −12°. The damage per shot (400 HP) and the base reload time (8.8 seconds) provide a nice foundation for some solid damage per minute. Alternatively, you can occupy a back slope far away from the enemy, forfeit DPM records, and snipe: when the gun cools down, the base dispersion is 0.28 m at 100 m.

[i]Go up this new branch of tactically diverse machines and try them all out in battle, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Introducing Random Events in Update 1.23
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/64a8c3b6b05f1c3aeefaf754f44c2a96cd4141a8.jpg[/img]

Commanders!

While map environment interaction has always been a fundamental aspect of World of Tanks gameplay, the last significant update occurred back in 2018 with the release of Update 1.0. Since then, we’ve explored various options for the future development of World of Tanks battlefields.

Now, the game has entered a new phase of its evolution with the introduction of Random Events. Initially unveiled during Recon Mission 2023, Random Events passed through all stages of development, including prototyping and testing in the Common Test, and will make their debut on the live servers with the release of Update 1.23.

[previewyoutube=X_Jf_Zaut5U;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A Brief Recap of Random Events[/h2]

Let's refresh your memory of what Random Events are.
[list]
[*] [b]Available on four maps[/b]: Himmelsdorf, Ruinberg, Prokhorovka, and Safe Haven.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d217485fbeee6a925c88a21698cc4152bd52bb30.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Occur at specific times, significantly affecting extensive areas of the maps.[/b] This impact creates fresh pathways for vehicles, potentially obstructing existing ones, while also establishing new cover and firing positions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2c60403c616826c13ce82ed00693c37a920e18a3.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Random Events Are Now Truly Random![/b] Each event on any of the four maps has its own specific launch probability, which depends on the current combat situation. To avoid disrupting some familiar combat scenarios, Random Events are not guaranteed to happen and may not even occur during battle. Stay vigilant and always keep the situation on the battlefield under control!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c795da9021ae1724945555453e291dd3f7bb9b3d.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]The Random Event zone will be marked by red smoke.[/b] As you approach its border, a warning notification will appear. Upon entering the zone, the countdown to the event launch begins. Use this time to take up the most strategic position within or outside the zone. Be cautious of collisions with large objects generated during the event, as they may destroy your vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0f8e4776e31ae08fad8a539bf0e3cbb72be29315.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/random-events-new-gen-maps/ style=button][b]LEARN MORE[/b][/url]

Random Events on the four maps are just the beginning. Our efforts involve the gradual redesign of more maps to deliver more dynamic content like this to you, so look out for more developments in the future!

[i]Stay tuned and good luck, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Update 1.22.1. What’s New?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/87d8cadb5f16f32ed873fa133501e56a7fab6933.jpg[/img]

[b]It's time for Update 1.22.1, Commanders![/b] 

We’ve redesigned most of the in-game crew interfaces to make the entire system more useful, informative, and convenient. We’re also introducing the new Elite Levels feature which will highlight your wealth of battle experience.

And don't forget that Halloween is just around the corner! Your exploration of the abnormal activities in the foreboding town of Mirny-13 is coming to its culmination. The final chapter of the Mirny trilogy features three powerful bosses, new and more dangerous AI enemies, and other changes. And, of course, lots of cool and valuable rewards! Get ready to participate in the battle against evil!

[h2]Crew Interface Overhaul[/h2]

We’ve redesigned most of the existing crew interfaces to improve your World of Tanks gaming experience. It will make your interaction with crews easier, more intuitive, and more convenient at all stages. You can now:
[list]
[*] Understand more clearly how the major qualification level affects perks and improves your vehicles.
[*] Use several different types of Crew Books at once and combine them with Free XP for quick crew training.
[*] Move or assign crew members to other vehicles with less effort, and filter your crew member list by various criteria.
[/list]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/6688466724225064320

[h2]The Elite Levels System: A Barometer of Your Experience[/h2]

The Elite Levels are a new index of your experience with your favorite vehicles. This achievement system will help you show the World of Tanks community that you’re an experienced Commander and how well you know your vehicle.

Elite Levels only apply to Elite vehicles at Tier V and above. To increase your Level, play in any regular in-game mode and battle type. Depending on the amount of Combat XP earned, you will receive special Elite Points. After you reach a certain Elite Points limit, your current Level will be updated automatically.

[i]After the release of the update, the calculation of the initial Elite Levels for all Elite vehicles will be based on their lifetime Combat XP earned—you won’t start from zero.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/3747615443048241671

[h2]Mirny-13: Get Ready for the Final Chapter of the Supernatural Trilogy[/h2]

Did you miss exciting adventures in the abandoned town of Mirny-13?

From October 18 through November 2, World of Tanks will host the final chapter of our supernatural Halloween trilogy. You'll finally be able to unravel all the secrets of this sinister place and learn the end of the story.

[previewyoutube=TEtl2ZtT1Qs;full][/previewyoutube]

The event’s mechanics will all be familiar; however, we’ve reworked some Anomalies (special entities that boost your vehicles), added new AI-driven opponents, and improved the remaining ones. Now they are smarter and even more dangerous, which will make the gameplay dynamic and thrilling like never before.

But most importantly, now you can fight three bosses in total, one at each difficulty level. The maximum "three-star" difficulty level will be pretty challenging, so team up with your friends and get ready to fight tooth and nail to reach the end and escape from Mirny-13! And win a host of attractive in-game rewards, including the brand-new Obsidian, a Tier VIII Soviet Premium medium tank! Don't miss out and get ready to battle evil!

notes.title: Elite Levels: Show Off Your Experience Before the Battle Even Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/130808809ce56fe292af0d9871099a5aa1d8999d.jpg[/img]

Every Commander has their favorite vehicles. They may be fully decorated with progressive decals and have the rarest awards, but you still enjoy playing them as much as you did the very first time. So how can you display your immense experience in these vehicles when they’re already at their best? That’s where the Elite Levels system comes in!

This new achievement system indicates your experience in a particular vehicle. It’s simple: the more experience you have earned in a vehicle, the higher its Elite Level. Let’s see how it works.

[h2]Elite Levels: Let the World See Your Wealth of Experience![/h2]

Elite Levels don’t provide you with any combat advantages or any additional rewards. Instead, they highlight your wealth of battle experience and let everyone see how well you know your vehicle. They are your personal point of pride and show how much of the most valuable resource—time—you have invested in your favorite vehicles.

The Elite Levels system will be introduced in Update 1.22.1 and only applies to Elite vehicles at Tier V and above. To achieve Elite status in a vehicle, you need to research all its modules and the subsequent vehicle(s) within its Tech Tree branch. After that, all the Combat XP you have earned in this vehicle will count toward the vehicle’s Elite Level.

[quote=]Don't forget that all Premium and reward vehicles come with Elite status by default.[/quote]
The main purpose of this system is to be visible to other players, so Elite Levels will be shown as a numerical counter:
[list]
[*] In the vehicle’s stats

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f9e58c3020f67855d5ec08067a7e252843948e34.jpg[/img]
[*] In the team panels in battle*

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a7dd78a9dd097ed1fb2cc0c0bc04b79364f80859.jpg[/img]
[*] On the Platoon screen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9d8969088b31a4c9c267b5794e7d39e9bdacd734.jpg[/img]
[/list][i]*You can adjust the width of team panels to display your preferred Elite Levels visualization in battle.[/i]

[h2]Progressing Through the Elite Levels[/h2]

There will be 350 Elite Levels in total. To increase your level, play in any regular in-game mode and battle type, where your Elite vehicles will earn Combat XP. Depending on the amount of Combat XP earned, you will receive special Elite Points. After you earn a certain number of Elite Points, your current level will be updated automatically, and you'll receive a notification in the Garage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1143ab2e72a109bf9d93f3e0053a3b490bf7404d.jpg[/img]
The more battles you play and the more Combat XP you earn, the higher your Elite Level will be. As your level increases, the color and design of the level icon will also change.

You can always check the current Elite Level of any vehicle in the Garage, as well as your progress toward the next level. You can also see your top vehicles with the highest Elite Level values in the Service Record tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0674a45b914dc99128b6acda67eae3f5c9eb81f8.jpg[/img]
[quote=]Your Elite progress is based on all Combat XP previously earned by your vehicles in Random Battles only, minus XP for researching modules to reach Elite status. After Update 1.22.1 goes live, it will only include pure Combat XP earned in battle in any game mode.

Once reached, all Elite Levels are always with you, so you will never lose them.[/quote]
If you don't want other players to see your current Elite Level, enable the Anonymizer in the game settings.

[i]Get ready to climb the Elite Levels and let everyone see how experienced you are, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Onslaught: Season of the Azure Pegasus: Mid-Season Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9579648c5f7bf06374e3bc6ba6348c152030ac83.jpg[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]

We have been keeping a close eye on the latest season of Onslaught. Many of you have already started your journey through our competitive game mode, and there is still plenty of time left to become a Legend! However, we have noticed some minor issues that need adjustments in order to improve the experience for everyone.

The mid-season patch will affect the following features:
[list]
[*] Vehicle Role Skills
[*] Prestige Point System
[*] Earning Rating Points
[*] Rules for Creating Platoons
[/list][h2]Changes to Vehicle Role Skills[/h2]

Role Skills are a crucial aspect of the game mode and greatly influence the vehicles used in battles. Based on our observations, we need to weaken some of the more popular choices and strengthen the less utilized ones in order to create a more diverse range of vehicles and tactics.

The following Role Skills have received an update:

[h3][b]Medium Tanks [/b][/h3]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/02ded91c26dac032d687a331422d43fec59ed9d3.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Fury[/b]

As of now, Assault Medium Tanks appear too effective in situations where they manage to force a close-range battle, leaving virtually no chance for their opponents. Reducing the gun reload bonus at level 3 and shortening the skill's duration should cool them down a bit.
[list]
[*] Gun reload bonus was reduced from 25/30/40% to 25/30/35%.
[*] Skill duration was reduced from 15 s to 12 s.
[/list][b]Assault Medium Tanks[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8c5be061ffd5d8285d5c5b9c056dc14e6989ba63.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Inspiring[/b]

We would like to see more vehicles in the Versatile Medium Tank role in battles given the bonuses they provide to the team.
[list]
[*] Bonus to the crew major qualification level was increased from 15/25/35% to 17.5/30/42.5%.
[/list][b]Versatile Medium Tanks[/b]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0a8a3eed583b69147e2d35258a7a58663711ab14.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Fire Cover[/b]

The role of Sniper Medium Tanks is now particularly popular for capturing Points of Interest, but after, they are in no hurry to return to the team. Reducing the amount of damage they cause from a distance should encourage them to be more active in battles.
[list]
[*] Stun time was reduced from 0/6/10 s to 0/6/8 s.
[*] Damage caused was reduced from 75/150/250 HP to 70/135/225 HP.
[/list][b]Sniper Medium Tanks[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h3][b]Tank Destroyers[/b][/h3]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fd70e37b7ab86b1e65a94f58683bb8d30d165793.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Second Wind[/b]

Support Tank Destroyers have finally received their share of attention, albeit by being included in a list of rental vehicles. Even in the hands of not the most experienced player, however, these vehicles turn out to be quite effective, which is why their Role Skill is more demanding in terms of activation time.
[list]
[*] Duration of the "Acceleration" part was reduced from 8 s to 6 s.
[*] Amount of restored hit points was reduced from 150 HP + 35/65/85% to 75 HP + 35/65/85%.
[/list][b]Support Tank Destroyers[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5396cb750dca502b1171a3ac1484fe3362d96232.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Straight Ahead[/b]

Certain vehicles in the role of Assault Tank Destroyers were weakened in the recent update, which naturally affected the effectiveness of the mode. We strengthened their Role Skill in the following ways:
[list]
[*] Engine power bonus was increased from 25% to 30%.
[*] Bonus to module repair speed was increased from 15% to 30%.
[*] Reload time reduction when receiving a shot was increased from 4 s to 5 s.
[/list][b]Assault Tank Destroyers[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h2]Minor Adjustments to the Prestige Points System[/h2]

We continue to closely monitor your feedback regarding the operation of this system while simultaneously making small adjustments to the logic of its operation. This update aims to increase the value of player damage by reallocating points from categories such as blocked damage and HP loss.
[list]
[*] Changes were made to the system for accruing Prestige Points.
[/list][h2]Changes to Rating Points Distribution[/h2]

This season, a fairly large number of changes were made to the rating system of the mode, such as the appearance of qualifications, changes to the number of Ranks and Divisions, changes to the size of Divisions, and more.

Taking into account the information collected, and based on the results of the first three weeks, we decided to make a set of small changes to the logic for accruing and losing Rating Points.
[list]
[*] Changes were made to the Rating Points system.
[/list][h2]Changes to the Rules for Forming Platoons[/h2]

We are increasingly seeing cases of high-ranking players abusing the Super Platoon system to earn Rating Points, so we are reinstating the cap on the maximum rating difference between players. The change should not affect the majority of players while simultaneously complicating such fraud.
[list]
[*] Maximum rating difference between Super Platoon players is now 1,500 Rating Points.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We are sure these updates will improve the experience for everyone participating in the Season of the Azure Pegasus. You still have plenty of time to climb the Ranks and earn fantastic rewards before Onslaught ends.

[i]Good luck, and roll out![/i]

notes.title: Waffenträger Event Bundles With Free Keys and Starters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/56636197a0d2dca6a26ee2544039b410e8e58896.png[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]

Take the helm of the incredibly powerful [b]Blitzträger auf E 110[/b], or join the Harrier Squad to vanquish this great evil!

No matter which side you choose in the epic [b]Waffenträger: Projekt Hyperion[/b] showdown, our event-themed bundles will have you diving right into the action. Each offer features exclusive decals to commemorate the event, as well as Engineer‘s Starters to activate the reward-filled Engineer's Gate.

Try your luck and claim formidable prizes, including three brand-new vehicles: the [b]KJPZ TIII Jäger[/b], the [b]Object 283[/b], and the [b]Jagdtiger Prototype[/b]. On top of that, the Engineer’s Gate can grant the iconic Waffenträger auf E 100 as a rental tank for Random Battles!

All offers (except for the Introductory Pack) also include [b]free Keys to roll out aboard the Blitzträger auf E 110[/b]. Command one of the most powerful vehicles ever conceived, put the Harriers in their place, and earn even more rewards.

[h2]Waffenträger: Projekt Hyperion Offers[/h2]

[quote=][b]EU[/b]: Available from September 25 at 12:00 (UTC+3) through October 9 at 11:00 (UTC+3)
[b]NA[/b]: Available from September 25 at 12:00 (UTC+3) through October 9 at 11:00 (UTC+3)
[b]ASIA[/b]: Available from September 25 at 17:00 UTC+8 through October 9 at 16:00 UTC+8[/quote]
[h3][b]Ermelinda Large Set[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/81ed364fbc4ba4935c44f1a01a490b80ca034b28.png[/img]
[h3][b]Ermelinda Medium Set[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/171d3171ae87928677903e3f97119da1d0b9de29.png[/img]
[h3][b]Ermelinda Small Set[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ff6e65adcd405ac924f5f21feb07caae23e154e3.png[/img]
[h3][b]Ermelinda Introductory Pack[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f0dfd524aaff6e69ac6849714409bc04bd9e1395.png[/img]
[h2]Gates and Starters[/h2]

You can earn two types of Starters for completing event missions and Progression Stages and for defeating the Blitzträger auf E 220. Starters are necessary for activating both the Engineer's and Harriers' Gates, which are filled with valuable loot.

[b]Harriers‘ Starters[/b] are rewarded for completing event missions and progression milestones while playing in Harrier Squad vehicles. They are used for the Harriers’ Gate with the following reward items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3be44ce582c65e73c4054515cdf6b31c99a64491.jpg[/img]
[b]Engineer’s Starters[/b] are rewarded for completing missions while playing in the Blitzträger auf E 110 and progression milestones, and they are part of the special event bundles. They are used to activate the Engineer’s Gate with the following reward items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a150ae4b1be6ee6aa88d80658a5dac188f5a43e5.jpg[/img]

The most exciting and valuable rewards from the Engineer’s Gate are random Tier VIII and IX Premium and reward vehicles that come with a Garage slot. They include these three brand-new warriors:
[list]
[*] [b]NEW! The KJPZ TIII Jäger[/b], a Tier IX Premium German tank destroyer, is a nimble mobile sniper with great gun handling and accuracy. Similar in appearance and layout to the Waffenträger auf Pz. IV and the Grille 15, already in the game, this TD also shares similar characteristics with them. The Jäger can't boast any significant armor as it focuses on shooting and mobility.
[*] [b]NEW! The Object 283[/b] is a reward Tier IX rear-turreted Soviet medium tank with a high DPM. This tank has an unusual layout for a medium tank with rear turret placement. Despite its similarities to the branch of Soviet sniper medium tanks with the K-91 up top, its characteristics are closer to those of the Object 430. It has a strong front hull and turret armor, as well as impressive thick sides strengthened with screens.
[*] [b]NEW! The Jagdtiger Prototype[/b], a Tier VIII Premium German assault TD, wields a powerful 128 mm gun. This modification of the Jagdtiger is equipped with the 12.8 cm Pak 44/1 L/55 gun. The general concept of the vehicle is the same as that of its more powerful version: unimpeded destruction of enemy vehicles with the help of its excellent gun.

[*] T54 Heavy Tank  
[*] K-2  
[*] CS-52 LIS  
[*] Object 274a  
[*] M-IV-Y  
[*] ShPTK-TVP 100  
[*] Strv 81  
[*] ISU-152K  
[*] FV1066 Senlac  
[/list]You have a 2% chance to get one of these tanks when activating the Engineer's Gate. Most importantly, you will receive vehicles that you do not have in your Garage yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/069e75b397f309fc087a454bc8be8517e260e4a9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f30c50cd916e506f69cc8047b083e870a3f1168b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4405b996fae188adc21fd0ce5544e985ef01692d.png[/img]
On top of that, the Engineer's Gate has a chance of dropping 10 Random Battles in the legendary Waffenträger auf E 100*!

[i]*10 rental battles in the Waffenträger auf E 100 may drop no more than five times per account.[/i]

[h2]The Engineer's Gate: How It Works[/h2]
[list]
[*] When a vehicle drops from the Engineer’s Gate, a slot in the Garage is credited first, and then information about it will be displayed in the in-game Notification Center.
[*] If you receive a vehicle that is already in your Garage, it will be replaced by another vehicle from the above list that you don't already have in your Garage.
[*] If you already have all the vehicles from the list, you will be compensated the cost of the dropped tank in gold.
[*] If you have sold a Premium vehicle from the above list and it can be restored using the in-game Vehicle Restoration tool, it may drop from the Engineer's Gate at the standard drop rate.
[/list][h2]Guaranteed Vehicle Mechanics[/h2]

If you spent 49 Engineer's Starters but still did not receive a Premium vehicle, then with the 50th activation of the Engineer's Gate, you are guaranteed to receive a random Premium tank that you don't have already from the list above, as well as a Garage slot.

If you already have all the vehicles from the list in your Garage, then the guaranteed vehicle mechanics will be disabled.

[h3][b]Vehicle Compensation Costs[/b][/h3]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/217717c28f43da39af7e48f4f1647cee441dddc2.png[/img]
[/expand]
[quote=]After the end of the event on [b]October 9 at 12:00 (UTC+3)[/b], all unused Keys for playing in the Blitzträger auf E 110 will disappear, and the corresponding number of Gates will be activated automatically. All items from them will be automatically credited to your account. All event vehicles will be deducted, and all XP earned in them will be moved to the MS-1. All Collection Items, rewards, and loot from the Gates remain with you permanently. You will be able to play your battles in the rented Waffenträger auf E 100 until [b]October 15 at 07:00 (UTC+3)[/b].

Any bundles that you sent as gifts but that were not accepted by their recipients [b]will be returned to your account[/b].[/quote]
[i]Enjoy Waffenträger: Projekt Hyperion, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Dive Into Epic 6v1 Waffenträger Battles!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2ce8202bc628c5df9a26ad7ddec9accc125ab994.jpg[/img]

[i]Superweapons going hyper. Intense asymmetric combat where you can play in a team of six or as the big bad boss. Secret organizations and treaties. Family drama with some new faces. Refined unique gameplay mechanics. An awesome loot table that includes a very special rental TD with an autoloader for Random Battles plus a dozen Premium and reward vehicles (with the [b]KJPZ TIII Jäger[/b], the [b]Object 283[/b], and the [b]Jagdtiger Prototype[/b] among them).[/i]

[previewyoutube=dd9swSlZ15E;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]WAFFENTRÄGER: PROJEKT HYPERION[/b][/h3]

[b]EU[/b]: September 25 at 11:00 CEST through October 9* at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA[/b]: September 25 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET through October 9* at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET
[b]ASIA[/b]: September 25 at 17:00 UTC+8 through October 9* at 17:00 UTC+8

[i]*Please note: The last day of battles will take place on October 8.[/i]

[h3][b]PRIME TIMES (FIRST EVENT DAY)[/b][/h3]

[b]EU1, EU2, EU3[/b]: from 14:00 until 00:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]EU4[/b]: from 14:00 until 20:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]USC, SA[/b]: from 07:00 PT | 09:00 CT | 10:00 ET until 23:00 PT | 01:00 CT | 02:00 ET
[b]ASIA1[/b]: from 17:00 until 00:00 UTC+8

[h3][b]PRIME TIMES (ALL OTHER EVENT DAYS)[/b][/h3]

[b]EU1, EU2[/b]: from 12:00 until 00:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]EU3[/b]: from 11:00 until 00:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]EU4[/b]: from 10:00 until 20:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]USC, SA[/b]: from 11:00 PT | 13:00 CT | 14:00 ET until 23:00 PT | 01:00 CT | 02:00 ET
[b]ASIA1[/b]: from 14:00 until 00:00 UTC+8

[h2]NEW MECHANICS[/h2]

Both sides of the conflict have been preparing for this showdown. The Blitzträger auf E 110 is now equipped with new Hyperion tech enabling it to do massive damage to multiple enemies. The Alliance has added one more tank type to their roster, which now lists four powerful machines; there are additional abilities allowing them to do splash damage and slowly regenerate HP.

Plasma obtained by the Harriers when a Generator is overloaded now enhances the power of their shots and abilities. There are three Generators on the battlefield at any moment, and each can be overcharged right after you deal with the Sentinel bots protecting it. Players will also meet opponents of comparable skill in battles, and the rental Waffenträger auf E 100 now comes with a fixed four-perk crew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5f2dc73bef2e6c9b0a06fb282c20a43ac20510ac.png[/img]

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/content/guide/general/waffentrager-event/ style=button][b]TO THE FULL GUIDE[/b][/url]

[h2]GATES AND REWARDS[/h2]

During the event, you can obtain lots of valuables from different sources, with Harriers’ and Engineer’s Starters being the most desirable prizes. Each Starter type is used to open their respective Gate.

Harriers’ Gates can hold vehicle customization, credits, days of WoT Premium account, Personal Reserves, and more. Engineer’s Gates contain especially valuable items, such as more battles in the Waffenträger auf E 100, assorted customization elements including the Harriers’ 3D styles, gold, credits, Personal Reserves, Demounting Kits, Crew Books, and Premium vehicles, including new and very rare ones. You can replace the rewards you receive with credits (Harriers’ Gates) or gold (Engineer’s Gates).

Starters of either type are awarded for completing some combat missions and Progression Stages, plus Engineer’s Starters also come as gifts with special in-game Store packages available [b]from September 25 until October 9[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/822d8ff7b9911d6ddfa7b08edc13cd99da241ee5.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3741984674883004701

[h2]REWARD VEHICLES[/h2]

12 Premium and reward vehicles can be obtained from Engineer‘s Gates. That includes the [b]CS⁠-52⁠ LIS[/b], the [b]ShPTK-TVP 100[/b], the [b]M-IV-Y[/b], the [b]Object 274a[/b], the [b]T54 Heavy[/b], the [b]Strv 81[/b], the [b]ISU⁠-⁠152K[/b], the [b]FV1066 Senlac[/b], and the [b]K-2[/b].

There are three more machines that deserve particular attention. The [b]KJPZ TIII Jäger[/b], a Tier IX Premium German TD making its debut, is a nimble mobile sniper with great gun handling and accuracy. The [b]Object 283[/b], already known to the community, is a sleek Tier IX rear-turreted reward Soviet medium tank with a high DPM. Another interesting visitor is the [b]Jagdtiger Prototype[/b], a Tier VIII Premium German assault TD wielding a powerful 128 mm gun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/88d403c596594d0cc3b971ffd3b969a85da32b16.png[/img]

[h2]GOLDEN BLITZTRÄGER AUF E 220 HUNT[/h2]

Playing as a Harrier during the Waffenträger: Projekt Hyperion event, you can encounter a special version of the boss adversary, the [b]Blitzträger auf E 220[/b]. The slightly different name of the vehicle and the special color scheme with a touch of gold signify that you are facing a special opponent: one of your favorite content creators or a Wargaming employee. Defeat a golden Blitzträger, and you (and every Harrier on the team) will get an Engineer’s Starter, plus some bragging rights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9b1c1ee69bbb56ccd97a9aae9a4dda01248dd5bc.png[/img]
[h2]THE PLOT THICKENS[/h2]

Waffenträger: Projekt Hyperion continues the story of intrigue, betrayal, and covert operations. Last year, the Alliance’s plans to acquire the dangerous tech developed by the notorious scientist and engineer Max von Krieger were thwarted by a gifted daughter of his, Ermelinda. This time, the Harriers’ superiors have decided to fight lightning with lightning, enlisting the help of her elder sister, Hannelore. The latter has improved the tactical potential of their vehicles, while Ermelinda has been busy working on the devastating Hyperion device.

Does this arms race boil down to mere sibling rivalry, or could some higher motives possibly be involved on either side? Participate in the event and find out! You can also recruit Hannelore as a tank commander (by completing one of the Progression Stages).

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/6816816781640522922 style=button][b]THE STORY SO FAR[/b][/url]

[h2]GET THE FREE DLC! [/h2]

During the event, all Steam players can claim a [b]special free DLC, Ermelinda’s Gift[/b], containing a day of WoT Premium Account, three thematic decals, and a crew skin of Ermelinda herself. A nice addition to all the rewards you can receive in the event!

The exclusive DLC will be available only [b]until October 9, 2023[/b], so make sure to grab it in time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2572940/World_of_Tanks__Ermelindas_Gift_Pack/

[h2]TAKE PART IN OUR GIVEAWAY AND GET A GUARANTEED PRIZE![/h2]

We are holding a special Community Giveaway, where we ask Steam players to share their victory strategies as the Harriers or the Engineer in the comments of this article. Check them out to learn some useful tips and tricks—or share your own advice and get a [b]guaranteed reward of one Community Token and one Voltage Regulator decal[/b]! 

[h3][b]How to participate in the Giveaway: [/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Click the Rate Up button under this article.
[*] Share your favorite tips on securing a victory as the Harriers or the Engineer in the comments.
[/olist]That’s it! If you complete these steps, you will receive your Community Token and event-themed decal a few days after the Giveaway ends [b]on October 2, 2023[/b].  

[h3][b] The prize: [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/25e8b44f097f37e91d432b9505375557946efb64.png[/img]

[h2]Join the Fray, Commanders![/h2]

[i]From September 25, try it all out: beat the boss and be the boss in event battles, play in the rental Waffenträger in Random Battles, maybe meet a golden Blitzträger, and earn a load of valuable and memorable rewards![/i]
