notes.title: BATTLE PASS 2023: SEASON XI
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d0c9e10ecfeea6e10d73628f7b15c5d8974eac2c.jpg[/img]

Season XI of Battle Pass will be a hot topic this entire summer[b] from May 31 through September 6[/b]. There are new Core Vehicles, each with a flashy progressive style, as well as new heroes whose adventures take them to historical lands by a big warm sea. The loot list has been improved (see the full guide below), with Experimental Equipment among the Base Rewards, gold in the Improved Rewards, and adjusted bond yields. Also, the Collection is available from the start of the Season. Finally, expect a series of Challenges that offer extra prizes, along with an additional [b]time-limited Chapter[/b] (coming around mid-Season) that includes a Premium tank among its rewards!

[previewyoutube=Ay91airiJ50;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Complete Chapters in Any Order[/h2]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ab36745562744117b9d0f1d76abbec8f934aa473.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/48d684e3061dce8bee866e99312d9dfdb2f3d1cc.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/86fcae7c6fcf1390c3971834ba75bc22a9be9c4c.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a34cb7eedc0ab9f9fb1582c2e51ed3f4f54aef26.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[th]          IAN HARMAN[/th]
[th]     COLETTE BUGEAUD[/th]
[th]     STEFAN ADAŠKEVIČ[/th]
[th] ADDITIONAL CHAPTER[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]
The mechanics of progressing through Season XI are well known to those who played in the previous Season. Activate any Chapter, switch to another if you want, and come back later to continue from where you stopped. Try to finish every Chapter to max out the progressive styles, unlock the experienced crew members, and turn your hard-earned Battle Pass Points into additional goodies. You can earn Battle Pass Points in Random Battles (playing in Tier VI–X vehicles), as well as in Onslaught, Frontline, and Steel Hunter: Reborn.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/content/guide/general/battle_pass/ style=button][b]DETAILS[/b][/url]

[h2]Obtain Unique Progressive Styles[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/baa25b701e9e968229211244ee08aa0aa94a0bb4.png[/img]

[b]HANMĀ FOR THE TYPE 5 HEAVY[/b]

[i]"Hello, Dad. I hope you and Mom are doing well and don't miss me much. Things are looking up for me! I think I'll be promoted for the success of Operation Husky, just like you wanted. You should see the beast I command: a captured Japanese tank, as huge and reliable as a sledgehammer. Before our landing, our engineers reworked it so well, even you'd be surprised.

We're on the mainland now, moving north—though not too fast. But we'll get through it! We have no other choice. I've also made two friends: a bold French girl named Colette and a guy with a complicated fate named Stefan. They're great guys, but you might not say so at first glance.
In all other respects, things are the same. As they say, a front line is a front line.
Sincerely, your son Ian.

P.S. When we're done here, I'll bring you a captured Parabellum."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9c0648de78017f6e94fbd2e5abe479c8f877f4c8.png[/img]

[b]ÉGLANTIER FOR THE AMX 50 FOCH B[/b]

[i]"You probably think I became a commander while drinking coffee with croissants? You two have fewer combat missions under your belts than I do. Here, you know-it-all—take a closer look at this tank destroyer. You think I got this war trophy for my 'beaux yeux?' Yes, it looks very much like the French one, but it's a German design! Like the flamethrowers, which, you can be sure, will bring the heat during the first breakthrough. When you understand what makes the compressors work, then you'll be able to call yourself a tankman. But for now, don't take too much on yourselves, guys, and don't tell me who, when, and from where to attack. Je me casse."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/19b7977fbfbf8bb8b78cc04a7be01d0424ed6395.png[/img]

[b]SWORN BROTHER FOR THE T57 HEAVY TANK[/b]

[i]"Do you remember, Yanka, how we volunteered for the Army? You signed up as Andrzej and didn't respond to this name for the first couple of days. I didn't think we'd be sent to the South—it's too far from home. Well, Africa's no resort, but we're not timid—we did it!

Looks to me we'll have a hard time in Italy, too, but who's going to ask us?

My only dream is to come back to my homeland and build a house when this is all over. A small one by the river. To live a normal life—although it seems it'll never be normal again… All right, everything will be fine. We'll take a steam bath, and that grandma will treat us to smalec. Be careful and come back soon, and I'll take care of that famed Duplex Drive system. The landing is serious business, so I'll be working here 'til morning."[/i]

[h2]Gather the Collection and Experience the Story[/h2]

With the Collection available from the start, get into the thick of the highly atmospheric plot of Season XI straight away. Unlock its Elements by reaching certain Stage thresholds and get to know the heroes better. In addition to some juicy details, completing the Collection will grant you three extra Tokens and a special decal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9c50e247f5280ed647984fd205a7ce9dffdb21d4.png[/img]
[h2]Receive Base and Improved Rewards[/h2]

The places our heroes are heading to are famous for their riches. Check out the Season XI loot!

[b]Base Rewards [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e1b4ac14e15f42893e7718f47f2c54707f3ffcba.png[/img]

[b]Improved Rewards[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3956e28dae211665add1b371991b140821f662da.png[/img]

[h2]Earn Experimental Equipment[/h2]

By finishing the Chapters of Season XI, you not only finalize their respective progressive styles and acquire unique and experienced crew members, but you also expand your stock of [b]Experimental Equipment[/b]. You can earn four of each of the types: Fire-Control System, Mobility Improvement System, and Survival Improvement Suite.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/content/guide/general/equipment/ style=button][b]EQUIPMENT GUIDE[/b][/url]

[h2]Items for Tokens[/h2]

Tokens are a special reward currency exclusive to Battle Pass. They accumulate over the course of the year from all the Battle Pass Seasons you take part in throughout 2023. In Season XI, you can earn [b]up to 21 Tokens[/b] as Progression rewards (12 as Base Rewards and nine as Improved Rewards), plus up to [b]three additional Tokens[/b] for gathering Collection Elements. Spend Tokens in the Items for Tokens section of the in-game Store to redeem valuable goodies, such as Bounty Equipment and nine rare Tier IX vehicles. In Season XI, you can accumulate enough Tokens to grab the BZ-58-2 or—if you saved up at least three Tokens from Season X—the KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b384745fc2f88e406567f5307a6f0d4daf09c541.jpg[/img]
[h2]Challenges[/h2]

During Season XI, Challenges will be available via the Tournaments game menu for those who play in Tier IX Battle Pass reward vehicles. That includes the newcomers to the roster: the BZ-58-2 and the KPz 3 Projekt 07 HK. Follow the news, sign up for Challenges, outperform the competition, and earn prizes!

[h2]Get Extra Rewards![/h2]

Once you complete all three main Chapters of Season XI, you'll have access to the [b]Reward section of the in‑game Store[/b]. It's where you can spend Battle Pass Points on bonds and progressive styles, as well as crew members from previous Seasons.

The Reward section of the in-game Store will be available [b]until September 6, 2023[/b].

[h2]Get the Improved Pass[/h2]

You can obtain the Improved Pass for any Season XI Chapter for [b]2,500 gold[/b] on the Battle Pass screen in your Garage. The in-game Store has real-money offers of bundles that include the Improved Pass for all Chapters, as well as value bundles. On top of giving you the full Improved Pass, value bundles allow you to receive 250 gold daily for up to 30 days if you play a single Random Battle that day.

[i]A new journey awaits, Commanders![/i]

Finally, expect a series of Challenges that offer extra prizes, along with an additional time-limited Chapter (coming around mid-Season) that includes a Premium tank among its rewards!

notes.title: Recon Mission 2023: Try Out Random Events and Dynamic Cover
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/db8560c3e05663f1c6f92141c20953cabd5efda7.jpg[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]

Map environment interaction has always been one of the cornerstones of World of Tanks gameplay. Felling trees allows you to hide better from opponents, while sliding down a steep hill slope can help you attack your foes from the rear, and so on. We have always worked hard to keep expanding the bag of environment-related tricks players can use in battle. With Update 9.13, it became possible to fight inside buildings where you were safe from arty shelling. Later, with Update 1.0, the first destructible objects were added to serve as disposable cover.

Now the time has come for every player to try out two new map features first made available to the participants of the Update 1.20.1 Common Test: random events and dynamic cover. From May 15, play in the Recon Mission 2023 mode (accessible via the mode selector) and share your opinions with us in the updated questionnaires!

[previewyoutube=N6DRPLCKN54;full][/previewyoutube]
The addition of random events and dynamic cover makes gameplay richer and more varied while staying true to its basics. Random events give you a fresh selection of interesting opportunities once they happen, each with the potential to tip the scales of battle, and dynamic cover (which can be moved around the battlefield) gives you an open invitation to improvise. With these new features, your tactical awareness and inventiveness are rewarded more than ever. What’s important is that the gameplay enhancements you can experience in Recon Mission 2023 are just what we are ready to release for testing—and it’s only the beginning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7de1b39fd8665690c0360487c3157f9be2b9aa16.jpg[/img]
[h2]Random Events: Part and Parcel of Maps[/h2]

[b]A random event significantly impacts a large area of its map[/b], creating new paths for vehicles and/or blocking existing ones, producing new cover and firing positions. One of the main goals of random events is shaking up the situation on the battlefield. Their locations (shown in the widget below) are most likely familiar to you as spots where fighting may come to a stalemate. Random events can break up deadlocks by offering both sides fresh tactical opportunities.

Random events are designed as integral parts of the locations in which they happen and are related to their setting. For example, Safe Haven features a seaport, and one of the random events there is a large cargo ship crashing into a dock. In Recon Mission 2023, random events are available on four maps: [b]Himmelsdorf, Ruinberg, Prokhorovka, and Safe Haven[/b].

[quote=]Currently, we do not plan to introduce random events on every map, although the list of locations that do feature them may expand in the future. Also, we are currently prioritizing integrating random events into Random Battles because it is the core mode of the game. In the future, we may implement random events in other game modes.[/quote]
[h2]Random Events: Current State and Mechanics[/h2]

While playing in the new Recon Mission 2023 mode, you won’t be able to miss random events. Before an event starts, [b]you will hear a warning sound, at which point the event zone will be marked on the map and the minimap with a red border, and then a countdown will start[/b]. Before it reaches zero, it is advisable to drive your vehicle out of the event zone. The current penalty for not doing this in time is the vehicle’s destruction, but this may change in the future.

Recon Mission 2023 is just one of the stages of ongoing random events development. Moreover, certain features are for testing purposes only and will not carry over to the release. For example, [b]every possible random event (two or three per map) will fire over the course of every battle[/b], each within a designated narrow time frame. This most likely won’t be the case when random events hit Random Battles—they will occur at more random times (or sometimes not even happen at all) and will possibly be triggered by certain gameplay factors.

With random events being very important to their locations (as they change their topography drastically on the go), we will pay special attention to their impact on map balance. We will use the data and feedback from Recon Mission while fine-tuning the existing events and designing new ones.

Random events may be random in their timing, but when one starts, it unfolds according to its unique scenario. For each event, its sequence, the location and size of its danger zones, and the shape of new cover and passages will always be the same. Therefore, you can already learn how every event unfolds to use the tactical advantages it offers in the future.

In Recon Mission, the visual effects for random events are not final, their current quality being sufficient for a gameplay test. When random events become part of Random Battles on certain maps, explosions will be much more impressive, fires will burn brighter, etc.

[quote=]We are aware that random events may be a strain on some lower-end systems. By the time they hit Random Battles, we will address this by optimizing their use of system resources on any hardware and adding their versions for lower-spec systems that will be less demanding on performance but the same in terms of gameplay.[/quote]
[h2]Dynamic Cover[/h2]

Every Recon Mission location will also have [b]dynamic cover[/b]: map objects that can be moved by your vehicle while giving it additional protection. You can use these objects in a broad variety of tactical situations, and it’s important to distinguish between the [b]two types of dynamic cover: indestructible and destructible[/b].
[list]
[*] Indestructible dynamic cover currently consists of railway carriages and wrecks of tanks (either with or without a turret). These objects may be hard to push around with your vehicle, but you don’t have to worry about them being dismantled by enemy shots.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/af8876fba6792dba4cd3a4afe4f1ed9ac58d1e60.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4df2dfbe427b594180934c6e1d11c72c1d3799fc.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/571a8a0f1e0395c34f512eb67c8f3b4f54cf5658.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[*] Destructible dynamic cover includes cargo containers as well as small and large concrete blocks. Each of these object types has an HP pool that can be depleted with several shots. The exact number of shots needed to destroy an opponent’s dynamic cover depends on its remaining HP count and the damage output of your gun.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5c61dcaa993d2d35da105d0e82d4d4aac99e9f7d.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/660befc1141f8c29db013ffbd85d9aede2f48dd1.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/13c3f14fa82c48f18a73ba44bbd7a4c4b2fe745a.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][/list]We plan to add more dynamic cover objects in the future. Currently, there is a limited number of them because we are testing the mechanics and want to make it easier for you to identify the objects that can be moved and destroyed.

[h2]Recon Mission 2023: The Progression[/h2]

Getting into the top 12 by base XP (in your team) in Recon Mission battles contributes to your progression bar. To complete the event Progression, you need to meet these conditions in 50 battles. Among the rewards you receive for reaching certain Progression thresholds are days of WoT Premium Account, Personal Reserves, directives, medals, and a special 2D style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a416c4cfe16a046d733e0a8ba87327f86bb3a44b.jpg[/img]
The Progression will be reset after the first week of Recon Mission (on May 22 at 10:00 CEST (UTC+2)), so you can complete it twice—and get double the rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/190635b91398887447429d31d1b2b8c6a53df847.jpg[/img]
[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7ca6546fd6eb02e7f64bd63b14ce4a9105577b63.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1a1299beb9ccba47a4ae6cf84e28d9de5996e9d1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a7c3bd172d26c1d646f3e51d374a92b9ee09fad7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/af4d5628f4c3bc27591ed96b5a9cf6bb3533b55a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5685d31f574cd5394a493a069ea0520ec413d3ee.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]The Questionnaire[/h2]

You can fill in the general questionnaire after having played 20 Recon Mission battles in which you were among the top 12 players on your team by base XP earned. There are also four map-specific questionnaires that unlock after you play eight battles on the given map (while also being among the top 12 on your team by base XP).

The set of questions you can answer has been reworked and expanded compared to the previous Recon Mission. In these, you are encouraged to give your opinions not only on the implementation of random events and dynamic cover on the available maps but also on the gameplay mechanics of these features, such as their randomness, timing, triggers, penalties for vehicles that fail to leave danger zones in time, and much more.

[i]Play Recon Mission 2023, fill in the questionnaires, and help define the future of the game, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Steam Community Shop Returns!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ec5a321af64deccfc841f537a75b8359777d3104.png[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]

We were happy to see that you’ve enjoyed the concept of the Steam Community Shop and actively participated in our Community events. As we said in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3673284490078328350]launch article[/url], the Community Shop will work in stages, each lasting approximately 2 months. The first stage ended on April 30, 2023, so now it’s time for a new one—with slightly refreshed rewards!

[h3][b]Steam Community Shop: Second Stage[/b][/h3]
[b]From May 5, 2023 through June 30, 2023[/b]

[h2]How Does It Work?[/h2]

Every month, we are launching new Community events, be it Giveaways, rewards for following us on Steam Hub, or anything else. If you participate in these events and complete all the required steps correctly, you will earn a certain number of [b]Community Tokens[/b].

You can then exchange these Tokens in the Community Shop for various rewards that you need most at the moment. These include [b]Personal Reserves, ×5 missions, days of WoT Premium Account, a 2D style, and more[/b]. Some rewards can be purchased for Tokens an unlimited number of times, while others are limited to 1-2 times per account.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ac415cbf91977708afa69d5a081211c7f618012c.jpg[/img]

You can save up your Tokens to purchase better rewards, or spend them as soon as you get them: the choice is yours! However, keep in mind that earned Community Tokens [b]DO NOT transfer[/b] between stages. When a stage ends, all unused Tokens will disappear, so make sure to spend all of your Tokens in time!

[h2]How to Find the Steam Community Shop[/h2] 
[olist]
[*] To find the Steam Community Shop, launch the game and open the DEPOT section. 
[*] Then, find the HOMEFRONT SUPPLIES tab inside your Depot. 
[*] Find the “Steam Community Shop”  option in the HOMEFRONT SUPPLIES tab and click it to view all of the available rewards for purchase.
[/olist][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9dce7ae6155527cf0f94ee3d63a0cba2afdf864a.png[/img]
[h2]New Addition to the Shop: Missions for More Tokens[/h2]

During this stage, you can invest your Tokens into [b]special personal missions[/b] that will reward you with... even more Tokens! We added these missions to the Community Shop to give all players the opportunity to earn more Tokens whenever they want. These missions have quite simple conditions and can be completed by just playing the game. Enjoy!

[h2]Earn Community Tokens Right Now![/h2]

We decided that it is a good tradition to launch a Community Giveaway with a start of a new Community Shop Stage. So, there you go: like this post and write a comment to earn [b]one Community Token[/b] after the Giveaway ends!

To participate and receive a guaranteed prize, you need to complete a couple of easy steps:
[olist]
[*] Press the “Rate Up” button under this article
[*]In the comments, share your thoughts about the addition of missions that earn you more Tokens.
[/olist]That’s it! If you complete these steps, you will receive your Token a couple of days after the Giveaway ends [b]on May 12, 2023[/b]. 

[i]Participate in our events and activities, earn Tokens, and choose your prizes![/i]

notes.title: Play the Latest Changes in Update 1.20.1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/964348838da8a4509fd147e9914fe7dae525c3f8.png[/img]

[b]Spring into the action with Update 1.20.1, Commanders! [/b]

It features the improved crew perk system and a new branch of Japanese tank destroyers. On top of that, this update introduces the Season of the Crimson Griffin in Onslaught. You'll also be able to experience random events and dynamic cover in Recon Mission, which will come later in May. Finally, you can assemble the Collection feature in Battle Pass and also purchase new slots in the Garage with credits. Scroll down for details!

[previewyoutube=M8mETmgz8U4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Recon Mission: Random Events and Dynamic Cover[/h2]

Random events and dynamic cover are parts of the Recon Mission mode, which will kick off in May. Each of these brand-new mechanics offers you a fresh gameplay experience and opens up new tactical opportunities on the battlefield.

[b]Random events[/b] occur at a specific time and in specific areas of four maps: Safe Haven, Ruinberg, Prokhorovka, and Himmelsdorf. They change the environment around you and the combat situation on the battlefield, so try to use this to gain an advantage over your opponents!

[b]Dynamic cover[/b] refers to various movable objects (e.g., shipping containers, concrete blocks, etc.) that you can use to protect yourself against enemy fire. Read the article below to find out more about both mechanics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3cf0987a8ccdb00e32bcee74ebb0b444c5ba2f9b.jpg[/img]

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/1-20-1-CT-1/#recon-mission style=button][b]DETAILS[/b][/url]

[h2]The Improved Crew Perk System[/h2]

We're continuing to work on a comprehensive rework of the crew system in World of Tanks. Now all perks are available immediately once you start training them. The major qualification level now affects almost all perks (excluding Brothers in Arms). The higher it is, the stronger the perk effect.

There will no longer be an XP penalty when you finish a battle with injured crew members. Additionally, we've made crew interfaces clearer. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7a355e36dde4694554074c7b173cfb1d25fd2273.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3717201559848438561

[h2]New Branch: Japanese Tank Destroyers[/h2]

Six menacing Japanese tank destroyers are ready to head into battle! All vehicles boast high-caliber guns that cause good damage per shot. Massive yet maneuverable, these Japanese TDs are designed to support the team from the second line of fire or assist heavy tanks on the front line. Take them for a spin to strike fear—and damage—into your opponents!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ad1c60ed7bbbfeb4f173ff4f150be9f7fae953e3.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3717201559844945774

[h2]New Launch of Onslaught[/h2]

Onslaught, our competitive mode, returns with the Season of the Crimson Griffin and special status rewards! It brings several gameplay improvements, including the following:
[list]
[*] Reworked vehicle Role Skills
[*] Two special combat modifiers
[*] Two additions to the map pool: Airfield and Glacier
[*] And more!
[/list]Prepare your Tier X vehicles or pick one of the rental tanks provided to fight for glory, honor, and status rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cc658fc3e3ecddab1bfcb572b12b105fa2374131.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/6869720192212185151

[h2]Battle Pass Collection[/h2]

Battle Pass Season X features the exciting backstories of the Season's heroes. This story is told through the descriptions of various in-game goodies (e.g., crew members, progressive and 2D styles, and decals) that you collect as Base and Improved Rewards. These items are the Elements of the Collection feature. Simply progress in Battle Pass as usual to complete it!

Assembling the current Season's Collection will earn you extra Battle Pass Tokens (up to three in Season X). If you don't manage to complete the Collection in this current Season, you will be able to do so in the following Seasons by purchasing the missing elements with Battle Pass Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2eb4c8f31a85c3119029565e9620bae0cdef6922.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.20.1: Crew Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3443b9e839f509016c05a27518439772a918ffd7.jpg[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]

After the announcement of previous changes and based on the Common Tests results where we suggested our changes to the crew perk system, we received many questions and comments from you. Many of you shared your feedback about potential issues with the new system. We would like to thank all active players again for taking part in the future of World of Tanks. Your feedback is what helps us work out different ideas and understand which direction development should take.

[h2]In Update 1.20.1, the Crew Perk System Will Remain Unchanged[/h2]

The results of the first Common Tests clearly showed us that the suggested changes to the crew perk system required serious improvements. We took into account the point that this new system will increase the skill gap between newcomers and World of Tanks veterans with experienced crews.

As a result, at this stage, we have decided to keep the current crew perk system without changing familiar mechanics. We won't add new perks or rework existing ones in Update 1.20.1.

[quote=]No action will be required from you with regard to the crew perk system after Update 1.20.1. You won't need to train new perks, adapt to reworked ones, or retrain your crews—in the upcoming update, all current mechanics will remain unchanged. For example, Firefighting will still be available for the crew members of all major qualifications.[/quote]
However, those improvements that will help make the entire system more comfortable and useful [b]will be released in Update 1.20.1[/b]. We will also continue working on updating the crew perk system, taking into account your feedback and data gathered during Common Tests. We will need time to address the issues with more complex aspects of this feature.

For now, here's a summary of the crew improvements that will be released in Update 1.20.1.

[previewyoutube=v0Xn_IGCH7A;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Perk Training and Major Qualification Level[/h2]

There will no longer be skills in the updated system—they will become [b]perks[/b]. In the new system, all perks become active immediately once you start training them, even when trained to 1%. At first, their effect will be minimal, but the more you train a perk, the more its effectiveness increases. The same applies to Brothers in Arms—even if only one crew member has the perk trained, the entire crew will reap the advantages of the bonus.

[quote=]The Mentor perk has become more convenient: Its effect now also works for the Commander.[/quote]
Additionally, the major qualification level now affects almost all perks (excluding Brothers in Arms). The higher it is, the stronger the perk effect.

[h2]Combat Interface for Perks With Situational Effects[/h2]

When updating the crew perk system, we tried to make it not only more comfortable to use but also more informative. To do so, we added separate icons to the combat interface to [b]display perks with a situational effect[/b].

The situational effect triggers and provides a bonus only when the conditions to activate the effect are met in battle. For example, some perks with such an effect are Adrenaline Rush (accelerates gun loading if the vehicle has under 10% of its hit points left) and Jack of All Trades (enables the Commander to replace knocked-out crew members).

Each time the effect activates, the corresponding perk icon will appear on the combat interface. This way, you'll see right away that the perk has triggered. You can enable and disable the display of perk icons in the game settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3ef8a21c10b6363efb52d87cfaca0cd2e22b60af.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/14ecbf89532ac98a82a8bef8f60d528b3b11aab3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/08fcd9b12e6c89f428310bf51b02c5b502986b96.jpg[/img]

[h2]Interface Rework: Clearer and More Informative[/h2]

To make the crew perk system even more informative, we’ve also reworked some in-game interfaces.
[list]
[*] In the characteristics window of any vehicle in your Garage, you'll see how all current perks affect these characteristics. Now you will be able to understand more clearly how particular perks improve your vehicles.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bb9fe471e071c9c4a03f237260a5a60439195ce9.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Perk descriptions and pop-up tooltips in the Garage, as well as descriptions of the directives for crew, have been reworked to become clearer and more informative.
[/list]Finally, an enjoyable bonus: There will no longer be a penalty to the earned Crew XP if you finish a battle with injured crew members.

[quote=]Once again, thank you for participating in the Common Tests and for sharing your feedback. We look forward to better engagement with you through future developments![/quote]
We continue our consistent work on improving the perk and crew system to make them more versatile, useful, and convenient for all players. The listed changes lay a strong foundation for other crew improvements that we will announce in the future. Stay tuned!

notes.title: New Japanese Tech Tree: Tank Destroyers!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b2985d3e17471c4e7c780e7838a891586bc37093.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings, Commanders! We’re introducing six brand-new Japanese tank destroyers for you to pursue![/b]

[previewyoutube=aYRcg6KymzY;full][/previewyoutube]
Branching off from the Tier IV Type 1 Chi-He, this new line of the Japanese Tech Tree extends all the way to Tier X. It includes the first upper-tier Japanese TDs in the game, now available for you to command. But before we take a look at the six mighty vehicles coming your way in Update 1.20.1, let's briefly describe their gameplay concept and key features.

[h2]Japanese Tank Destroyers: Strong All-Rounders[/h2]

The gameplay of these new vehicles can hardly be considered unique. At the same time, however, they are noticeably different from both heavily armored assault TDs and sniping "glass cannons." 

[h3][b]Firepower[/b][/h3]

These Japanese tank destroyers are versatile all-rounders with an optimal balance of frontal armor, decent firepower, and adequate mobility. They feature mighty high-caliber guns with good accuracy and aiming time. Their damage per shot is good—but certainly not as good as that of the best damage dealers. However, they have enough DPM to seriously hurt their opponents at both medium and short distances, providing support to allied heavies.

[quote=]Most TDs in the branch have AP shells that serve as both standard and special ammunition with high armor penetration values, as well as good HE shells.[/quote]
[h3][b]Armor and Dynamics[/b][/h3]

The frontal armor of the Tier VII–IX vehicles is thick enough (in some zones) to withstand some direct fire from same-tier opponents, but it’s not enough to operate as frontline brawlers. The only exception is the Tier X mastodon, whose armor allows you to confidently play on the first line. But even this mighty warrior needs to hide its vulnerable lower glacis plate using terrain irregularities.

The top speed of all the vehicles is average, while the reverse speed is great, relative to their frontal armor. However, keep in mind that you won’t be able to react quickly to changes in battle and switch flanks, so you need to plan your routes ahead.

[quote=][b]Summary[/b]

Most of these new Japanese tank destroyers are strong "midfielders," able to play both aggressively in attack and confidently in defense. They have medium armor, adequate mobility, and decent firepower, which makes them versatile and reliable choices for both novice and experienced Commanders.[/quote]
Now—back to the branch composition.

[h2]The Ho-Ni III and the Type 95 Ji-Ro[/h2]

The first tank in the line is [b]the Ho-Ni III[/b]. If you’ve enjoyed the German Tier V StuG III Ausf. G, playing the Ho-Ni III will feel familiar—but with an even more powerful and accurate gun. This vehicle lacks armor, so you should use ambush tactics to maximize your lifespan and thus contribute to your team’s victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/37c3adc1757b0146414763ef7026e3ce5490d774.png[/img]

Next up: [b]the Tier VI Type 95 Ji-Ro[/b]. Its gameplay is similar to its predecessor's but with a few modifications. The Type 95 Ji-Ro boasts high concealment values and a view range of 350 m. But due to the almost complete lack of armor, it will have to spend most of its lifetime in ambushes. The closest analog of this vehicle is the Soviet SU-100.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ea95ef94df3f32711ad4d251e9e63953d4460911.png[/img]

[h2]Tier VII–IX Vehicles: More Armor and Versatility[/h2]

Starting from Tier VII, the gameplay concept of these Japanese TDs changes—they get sturdy frontal armor and even more respectable damage per shot!

[b]The Chi-To SP[/b] has vulnerable zones in the frontal projection—big Commander’s cupolas, lower glacis plate—but it can already absorb standard shells from same-tier opponents. Try to use the terrain and turn your vehicle’s hull to decrease the impact angle, thus boosting your armor effectiveness and ricochet chances.

The Chi-To SP is maneuverable and can confidently follow heavy tanks carrying either a 75 mm or 105 mm cannon with decent damage per shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2828105e427b182e4bb67eec0706c203acc52cc6.png[/img]

Roll out to the upper tiers in [b]the Tier VIII Ho-Ri 2[/b]! This vehicle embodies the best qualities of Japanese TDs and balances its solid frontal armor with a hefty gun that has 400 HP of damage per shot.

The Ho-Ri 2 has two cupolas, one of which is at a very acute angle towards the enemy in front of you, so it won't be easy to penetrate it. There are several other vulnerable zones in the lower and upper glacis plates, but only the best Tier VIII guns can penetrate them.

[quote=]The Ho-Ri 2 will perform brilliantly as an aggressive support vehicle from the second line of fire. The vehicle’s good reverse speed (15 km/h) makes it easier to roll out, take a shot, and withdraw into cover so that enemies can’t zero in on your weak spots.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d113479da0445df28815af72c7094beed12561df.png[/img]

Another standout support vehicle waits for you in Tier IX. The Ho-Ri 1 is a serious damage dealer armed with a fearsome 149 mm gun with 650 HP of damage per shot—but a rather long (15.5 s) reload time. It has a big lower glacis plate that you’ll need to hide, but your opponents will have serious problems penetrating the upper part of the cabin. With its notable armor penetration values and adequate mobility, the Ho-Ri 1 has what it takes to be a true roving menace on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c758514a381de2f8301e38e4a18c3da856398dde.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ce324f5ca3bb9e5b4b5dfd926d355c05b6cf5230.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/75cdad890891cb9c57d858af7985c8c525259fc8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/211c586b2f2e0d56ee721cf9bf1146f775afe961.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/befaabf5c3aa5237d3a1c390c5b620b100579644.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/798229197deecd4dc82f173f9e5ac09f27b837a8.png[/img]

[h2]The Ho-Ri 3: The Crown Jewel of the New Line[/h2]

All the hallmarks of the Japanese TD line culminate in [b]the Ho-Ri 3[/b]. Its effective frontal armor is up to 300 mm, and its durability is 2,000 HP. The only true weak spot on the front of this mastodon is the lower glacis plate. The average damage per shot is 700 HP, and the standard AP shell has 305 mm of penetration, which is enough to bring down even Tier X tanks with a few shots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d8401355aa6c83d3509bdf24f03e8559d1384b47.png[/img]

Its huge profile and low camouflage values mean that staying at the back is not an option. The vehicle’s top speed is 35 km/h, and this is quite enough to arrive at key positions about the same time as allied heavies and provide them with significant fire support.

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the Commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks, as well as special in-game items.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ac742558a6dd0f6fae06861fc000370e1ad71305.png[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9a9278e5eefeb537701c2669268f11f9190bb1af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7cf4be7a576842f982c471893341c9678a670d36.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6eec9b0becc1bb37ddb62c6b995a457b9088606a.png[/img]
[/expand]
The Ho-Ri 3 can also be used as a mighty breakthrough vehicle, but use caution, since its lower plate is rather large. You should always make the most of the terrain, take advantageous positions, and turn your vehicle’s hull to decrease the impact angle.

[i]Enjoy playing these versatile Japanese tank destroyers, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Introducing: Collections
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0e978206103786daf1806c946f03e4c48aa0e995.jpg[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]

We are introducing a new game feature, called Collections. It will enhance the feeling of accomplishment you get from playing through Battle Pass Seasons, and help you immerse yourself further into their atmosphere and lore. Collections will also provide you with immediate bonus rewards and serve as mementos of your battle feats.

[previewyoutube=s5hw6TRBA00;full][/previewyoutube]
The first Collection will appear during Season X of Battle Pass, and Seasons XI and XII will feature their own Collections as well. You will be able to access the Collection from the Battle Pass screen.

[quote=]The Collection screen will be added in Update 1.20.1, and all Collection Elements and any extra Tokens you have earned by that time will be credited.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e279a4719e3a51cb49a104f8aa3ba0bdb738e1af.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Battle Pass Season X Collection[/h2]

The Season X Collection is based on the characters’ battle diaries, which feature notes, hand-drawn sketches, and photographs. These Collection Elements will help you learn more about the heroes’ backgrounds and their adventures in faraway lands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a3b4dab1708ab62f8a6dff9e1d9be4977cdad09e.png[/img]

Throughout Season X, obtaining certain Stage rewards (both Base and Improved) furthers your Collection progress. These rewards include:
[list]
[*] 2D styles
[*] Completed progressive styles
[*] Decals
[*] Crew members
[*] A medal
[/list]As you advance through the Collection, you are awarded Elements, which are narrative rewards that give more depth to the story of Season X. These include:
[list]
[*] The personal belongings of each hero
[*] Detailed descriptions of each progressive style
[*] Dossiers on the heroes
[*] Secret correspondences and photos
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6265ddcd393fbb820b955b96d56655b7458cdb30.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7fd29a76e08315e32ff5729fd972b18cdc51e4ed.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Season X Collection: Extra Rewards[/h2]

There are [b]13 Elements in the Season X Collection[/b]. Reaching a certain number of Collection Elements will earn you additional rewards:
[list]
[*] 7 Elements: 1 Token
[*] 9 Elements: ×6 Ode to Armor decals (pictured)
[*] 11 Elements: 1 Token
[*] 13 Elements: 1 Token
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/881ba269ebef2b550e34f5b548d73869e4415d85.png[/img]

Thus, completing Season X with an Improved Pass will get you [b]3 additional Tokens[/b], on top of the 21 Tokens from Progression rewards, allowing you to purchase the first of the two new Tier IX reward vehicles, the BZ-58-2 .

Completing Season X will earn you [b]10 Collection Elements[/b], and you can get another 3 Elements with an Improved Pass. If you don't manage to finish your Collection in the current Season, you can still do so in the following Seasons, but please note that extra Tokens are only credited for gathering Collection Elements during their respective Season.

We hope you enjoy the new Collections feature.

[i]May every adventure of yours be worth remembering, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: [UPDATE] Onslaught Continues With the Season of the Crimson Griffin!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9579648c5f7bf06374e3bc6ba6348c152030ac83.jpg[/img]

[quote=]The new start date of Onslaught: Season of the Crimson Griffin is [b]May 3[/b]. It will run until [b]June 11[/b].[/quote]
[quote=]Based on the Common Test results and your feedback, we've determined that the combat modifiers mentioned in this article will create a positive impact on combat dynamics and the effectiveness of role skills, and achieve our goal of enabling you to experiment with more vehicle choices and unconventional tactics.

Therefore, we will be including them in the upcoming Season of the Crimson Griffin, and will continue to monitor and make the necessary adjustments as the season progresses.[/quote]
Spring has sprung, bringing Onslaught back to World of Tanks with even more thrilling battles and unique customization rewards, Commanders!

[previewyoutube=g6tisvnj4M0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]The Season of the Crimson Griffin: General Overview[/h2]

After the debut Season of our new competitive mode, we took a short break to analyze your feedback and think about how to make Onslaught even more exciting. While we continue to develop this mode, we are ready to launch the Season of Crimson Griffin, running from May 3 through June 11.

In this Season, we want to introduce some improvements you've asked us to add to Onslaught. Also, we want to test several new mechanics aimed at making the Onslaught gameplay more diverse and enjoyable. And, of course, we want to provide you with your favorite competitive mode and let you enjoy glorious victories! You’ll also have a chance to get your hands on exclusive customizations that we’ve added to the reward pool.

In the meantime, we will continue to collect statistics and are working on the next Season with qualification battles, which will kick off in the fall of 2023. We’re preparing some cool stuff for you, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png[/img]

[h2]More Diverse Tactics and Dynamic Battles![/h2]

Our aim is to introduce more variety and excitement to the Onslaught gameplay. To achieve this, we’ve reworked vehicle Role Skills. We’ll also be testing two special combat modifiers during the Common Test. But first things first.

[h2]Vehicle Role Skills Reworking[/h2]

We’ve reworked several vehicle Role Skills in Onslaught. All vehicle role skills are now easier to charge. Additionally:
[list]
[*] Skill cooldown time has been greatly reduced
[*] Some skills are now available from the start of each battle
[*] Some skills have changed the principle of work, for example, Inspire affects all allied vehicles on the battlefield
[/list]Considering the increased effectiveness of vehicle Role Skills in battle, in order to maintain the pace of combat, we want to test special combat modifiers that will be added to Onslaught during the Common Test period.

[h2]Combat Modifiers[/h2]

Reworked vehicle Role Skills, as well as combat modifiers tested during the Common Test, will add more variety and excitement to the Onslaught gameplay. They will also allow you to try out more different tactics and maneuvers.

There will be two combat modifiers, as follows:
[list]
[*] The HP pools of all vehicles eligible for Onslaught will be increased by 25%
[*] Consumables cooldown time will be reduced from 90 seconds to 45 seconds
[/list][quote=]During the Common Test, Onslaught will feature two combat modifiers. They increase vehicles' HP pools and reduce the cooldown time of consumables. We will collect data and consider your feedback before deciding whether to make these mechanics permanent. If they are well received, they will be included in the upcoming Onslaught Season. However, if you don't find these modifiers useful, we will not introduce them.
[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png[/img]

[h2]Weekly Combat Missions[/h2]

The Season of the Crimson Griffin brings two lines of rewards. The progression system of the first reward line remains unchanged and includes brand-new customization items that we’ve prepared especially for the Season of the Crimson Griffin. To grab these distinctive status symbols, you need to advance through the Ranked System.

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/805f5c607d840ec0708847dd777edccdebf775b4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/27d6f89eeb447fea12beb515393d380fc9ebb815.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e9fcf25f7b0367f0860f4050f7c2c6835c0915c2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8b7ee31d2ff968448ae8bc13dd772d0419af022a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5d84f0bc30a8430093c60c8bd4d7a7e43eb2005f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/88483572ab79f00b2ff811af8ea7a71ce0eeb19f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4bdf6909e711ba0233a1dccff0f5e3524da41d6e.png[/img]
[/expand]
But in the second reward line, instead of progression for a certain number of victories, you will now have a system with a set of consecutive weekly combat missions.

With the start of the Season, five simple missions become available to you. All missions are completed consecutively, one after another, and for each completed mission, you will receive useful in-game rewards. At the end of the weekly period, your progress is reset, and a new set of the same missions with the same rewards will become available. The list of missions is updated on Monday.

[quote=]After completing a set of five missions, you will receive one Lucky Chip, a special in-game currency. Earn Lucky Chips throughout the Season to grab the most valuable prizes of the second reward line: a brand-new progressive 2D style (also available in the first reward line), a universal Training Guide, days of WoT Premium Account, and other sweet goodies.[/quote]
Your rewards for earned Lucky Chips will be credited automatically. Once you have a certain number of Lucky Chips, you will instantly receive a valuable in-game item.

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9b2419352391dd4e98e7e0fd1a3238c6c850f2be.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/14527c49e863b308c43f37ea8c79d2c03b353db0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/47d4dbe94e00d83f7d65f59b8ea2975bef83a332.png[/img]
[/expand]
[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b1a9db581b1efd9fc3aa93f47c14650ce24d19b7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fd9cdb8c903046e5406908bc1b9d0f98b2a491a8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f453fd2584bc50131a82abce3d2ddcfec6e11c7b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/aea98adb20dcd6d0f0768cf2cc59d3f5fe4c6938.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6468ca19a34eb6f033c2379954d59094fec53c39.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/236b337418035d84e87f273f51392f5206cb8312.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a8948064e8f2683da2bd5e5669eebfff91f912bb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/dd141b9a390d214115fe92821d17ce23fa7cc5cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/91f2975dbc839543a4b68207c668652351012023.png[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]Brand-New Customization Rewards[/h2]

We’ve updated the first reward line, which includes unique status customization items. They are now in stunning crimson tones, echoing the name of this intermediate Season. In addition to the useful in-game goodies you can earn for completing weekly combat missions, you can also get your hands on the following:
[list]
[*] Unique Dog Tag elements, such as Engravings and Backgrounds
[*] Cool Griffin mastery badges for reaching the two elite ranks of Champion and Legend
[*] A striking “The Last of the Griffins” stripe
[*] A cool progressive 2D style: After you play your first battle in the mode, you will immediately receive Level I of this style. As you reach new ranks or significant achievements in a specific battle or series of battles, your style will gain new 2D elements. The maximum Level VII style with the most imposing camo is awarded when you make it to the Legend rank.
[/list][quote=]Starting this Season, you can apply this style to any vehicle in your Garage.[/quote]
[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a7c5877f723d3151e5d2a3f3a2993fdef0c91712.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/312226f543e98e3ba7e71d60f72bc2b3754a0328.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/66b9b6e5daa6dccec0d94ec9079d1225bf83d776.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1dec0e19158b736ebf4cb0bd1ed3b4620e4c3203.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/67d91e32da2c935094f959d30579c2a722a94ede.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3c7ca71e29e485d01adec3fd379398cf44dcb88a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/60ee8d37b4c857e7b4091b5737da53d45acc05cc.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png[/img]

[h2]Map Rebalancing and Two New Battlefields[/h2]

During the Update 1.20.1 Common Tests, we will be adjusting the positioning of Points of Interest on Onslaught’s maps to determine their optimal location. We've also added two new locales to the set of maps available for the Onslaught mode: Glacier and Airfield. 

[quote=]The locations of Points of Interest on all maps may change and will be finalized after the Update 1.20.1 Common Tests.[/quote]
[h2]Super Platoons Limits[/h2]

In the Season of Crimson Griffin, we’ll remove the limits on the difference between the highest and lowest Rating Points value when creating Super Platoons. You can now join your friends in Super Platoons without restrictions, regardless of the ranks and divisions in which you play. For example, if you fight in the Debutant rank, you can join a Super Platoon in the Gold rank.

We’re also aiming to adjust the matchmaker so that Super Platoons get matched against opposing Super Platoons in battle.

[h2]Minimap Pings and Voice Chat[/h2]

Here’s another improvement based on your feedback: We are removing the limits on the number of pings on the minimap to make it easier for players in Super Platoons to coordinate their actions in battle. It will be more convenient for you to interact with the team. Solo Commanders will also receive an increased number of pings on the minimap.

We’ve also made a slight improvement to the voice chat. If you were in voice chat as a solo player at the end of a battle, you will remain in voice chat in the next battle.

[h2]Rental Vehicles and Battle Pass Points[/h2]

You will be awarded rental vehicles (the WZ-111 model 5A, the E 50 Ausf. M, and the T110E4) at the start of the Season. They will remain on your account until the end of the Season and will be removed when it’s over.

These rental vehicles will be available only for the Onslaught mode. It will be impossible to enter Random Battles or other modes using these tanks.

[quote=]You’ll also be able to earn Battle Pass Points when playing Onslaught.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png[/img]

[i]Enjoy the Season of the Crimson Griffin, Commanders! And we’d love to hear your feedback to help us decide which changes Onslaught will feature in the next Season![/i]

notes.title: Update 1.20.1: WoT Plus and Crew System Revision
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/964348838da8a4509fd147e9914fe7dae525c3f8.png[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]

We would like to thank all those who participated in the Common Tests of the update, as your involvement has been instrumental in shaping the game’s future. Conducting public testing of updates before introducing them to the live game is a crucial step in this process, allowing us to collect reactions and gather feedback to create a better game for everyone.

Although Update 1.20.1 has introduced many new features and improvements, we have faced some challenges with two specific aspects of the update. WoT Plus will require some additional minor adjustments, while the Crew system will undergo more extensive changes. We are committed to addressing the issues raised by the community and ensuring that these features meet our high standards. Let’s dive into how we plan to accomplish this.

[h2]Changes to WoT Plus[/h2]

Free demounting of “Improved Equipment,” the equipment type purchasable with bonds, was perceived as a bonus that would give subscribers an advantage. Our intention with WoT Plus is to provide subscribers comfort and convenience, not an upper hand in battles. Therefore, [b]“Improved Equipment” will be excluded[/b] from the list of equipment that can be demounted for free with a WoT Plus subscription.

[h2]Changes to Crew Perks[/h2]

The crew system has been an essential part of World of Tanks since its early days. It allows for fine-tuning a vehicle, boosting its best features, and mitigating shortcomings. These benefits stay with players as they advance through the tech tree, taking crews with them.

New perks and adjusting existing ones were meant to add more flexibility and diversity to the crew perks selection and make it more useful. However, this was negatively perceived as an increase in the disparity among the player base between competitive players, veterans with experienced crews, and new players. We do not intend to raise the number of perks needed to ensure that players can remain competitive during a battle in terms of vehicle performance.

[b]As a result, we have made the decision not to introduce the new perks in their current state or proceed with the rebalancing of existing ones tested during the Common Tests.[/b]

[quote=]Please note, there is no need for a 30-day promotion that allows you to reset crew perks for free or to credit 12 retraining orders to all players.[/quote]
[h2]Quality-of-Life Improvements to the Crew System[/h2]

The revamped Crew System introduces several quality-of-life updates that were well-received by the community due to their usefulness. Additionally, these updates provide us with a solid foundation for future enhancements to crew perks and crew progressions. Thus, Update 1.20.1 will implement the following changes:
[list]
[*] Unifying perks and skills into perks that work from the start and become more effective as the level of major qualification increases. For example, the “Brothers in Arms” perk will start taking effect at 1%, even if only one crew member is trained in it.
[*] Removing experience penalties for injured crew members.
[*] Adding a battle interface for situational perks.
[*] Providing clear descriptions of perks and their effects.
[*] Displaying the effects of all perks in the vehicle characteristics widget.
[/list]We want to extend our appreciation for your continuous support and valuable feedback, which has empowered us to take an exciting next step with World of Tanks in Update 1.20.1. With a host of new features and enhancements, we believe that the game will be even more enjoyable for all players. Stay tuned to the portal for further details on the update's contents and our upcoming roadmap announcement outlining the planned content for later in 2023.

Thank you for being an integral part of the World of Tanks community, and we hope to see you soon on the battlefield!

[i]Roll Out![/i]

notes.title: Arcade Cabinet Is Back With Two Familiar Modes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9f216c80f9cbd432a69d8d690d4420a4f36b25d0.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, Commanders![/b]

Arcade Cabinet is back, offering two tried and tested game modes: Element of Surprise and Railgun. Each will be live for one weekend, followed by a third weekend when both will be available at the same time.

Element of Surprise will increase the randomness of every shot, adding more unpredictability and excitement to your gameplay. In Railgun, you'll experience a significant boost in gun precision, spotting capability, and mobility for your vehicle, making battles more thrilling and fast paced.

Players will also have the opportunity to earn up to 1,200 bonds while Arcade Cabinet is live. So, get ready for a wild ride and mark your calendars for the upcoming weekends!

[h2]How to Find Arcade Cabinet[/h2]

Select Arcade Cabinet from the menu to the right of the “Battle!” button in your Garage. When hovering over the mode button, you’ll see a description of the combat modifiers to be applied in battle. Prepare for something completely different!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9ce7c597b3ec1e7fa5f6dc2cc3df1ecd46bcd35a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Element of Surprise[/h2]

From March 17 at 10:00 CET through March 19 at 23:59 CET

From March 31 at 10:00 CEST through April 2 at 23:59 CEST

The damage spread in the standard rules of World of Tanks is a modest ±30%, which is certainly enough to stir up some powerful emotions. But what if we crank it up (or down) a bit? In Element of Surprise, the damage spread is ±75%, and there’s a much bigger chance of extremely low or extremely high damage values. Prepare for a ride on a swinging rollercoaster with some insane loops! (We are speaking figuratively here, of course.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5e34f8ba6bcee794236654045746e00ca8f683c2.png[/img]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Steppes
[*] Abbey
[*] Ensk
[*] Pearl River
[*] Murovanka
[*] Mines
[*] Highway
[/list][table noborder=1 equalcells=1]

[/tr]
[/table]
[h2]Railgun [/h2]

From March 24 at 10:00 CET through March 26 at 23:59 CEST

 From March 31 at 10:00 CEST through April 2 at 23:59 CEST

This mode lives up to its name, and makes you feel like you’ve landed in a sci-fi novel! The vehicles all keep their looks, but their guns become super-precise, with extremely low dispersion and fast aiming. Dispersion from vehicle movement and traverse is halved, so almost all shots get “snappy.” The proximity spotting distance goes up to 445 meters, meaning enemies won't be able to hide from you (or you from them). With a solid chance of hitting any opponent in plain sight, your tactical options become fantastic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/18e90ef4e23cd200957ed4475fbc6660f86d426c.png[/img]

[h2]The Rules[/h2]

Although Element of Surprise and Railgun have different battle modifiers, their key rules are the same:
[list]
[*] Battles are single-tiered and fought in either Tier VIII or Tier X vehicles.
[*] You’ll receive XP and credits for battles, and you can use all types of regular reserves (both Personal and Clan).
[*] XP multipliers for the first victory of the day work in the modes, and credits are put into the vault.
[*] Element of Surprise and Railgun battles do not contribute to daily missions or Personal Missions, but they do count towards the mode progression.
[*] Element of Surprise and Railgun battles do not give you bonds, except for the event progression rewards—see below.
[*] You may play in Platoons if you wish (you’ll be eligible for the bonuses if you do).
[/list][h2]The Rewards[/h2]

While each of the modes is active, you can complete a short chain of battle missions and earn some bonds (up to 1,200 in total).

notes.title: Shamrock Days Are Coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8a2bd348555462c74ca65bcdf532fe259d65ffdf.jpg[/img]

[u]Shamrock Days are now available for players and everyone can enjoy the Emerald Boxes and Hidden Treasures. We apologize for the delay, and we will keep monitoring the event closely to make sure everything goes as smoothly as possible from now.[/u]

[b]Commanders,[/b]

During Shamrock Days ([b]from March 16 through March 22[/b]), World of Tanks will celebrate St. Patrick’s Day in a threefold way: with the Hidden Treasures web event, special battle missions, and the Green Light in-game event. During the latter, Emerald Boxes will be available from the in-game Store, giving you a chance to obtain rare vehicles. Every 50th opening guarantees you one.

[previewyoutube=_vEoK1d0etQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]From March 16 to March 20[/b], the ×5 bonus to XP for the first win of the day will be active, and lots of discounts will be offered on researchable and Premium vehicles, equipment, consumables, customization elements, and conversion to Free XP.

[b]Happy Hours[/b] will be in effect every day from March 16 to March 20, from 18:00 to 22:00 CET (UTC+1), granting an additional bonus (+200% to Crew XP on the first and the third day or +50% to XP on the second and the fourth day).

[h2]Hidden Treasures[/h2]

[expand type=details]
Hidden Treasures will run [b]from March 16 through March 22[/b]. To participate, just log in to the event page with your World of Tanks credentials and play a treasure hunt game. Every day, flip five tiles on a 25-tile field to receive a [b]special bonus code[/b]. You'll receive different prizes depending on the tiles you flip. However, you are guaranteed a day of WoT Premium Account on the first day of the event, a Training Guide on the second, and a new 2D style on the third.

[b]How to activate the bonus code:[/b] 
[olist] 
[*] Launch the game from Steam and open the Wargaming.net Game Center. 
[*] Click your account’s avatar in the upper-left corner. 
[*] Choose the “Activate Wargaming Code” option. 
[*] Enter the bonus code in the required field. 
[*] Log in to the game and enjoy! 
[/olist] [quote=][b]NOTE:[/b] To activate the bonus code, you must have an email address attached to your account. To do this, complete the following steps: 

[b]In the game[/b] 
[olist]  
[*] Click your username in the upper-left corner. 
[*] Click the “Add Email” button under your username. 
[*] Add and confirm your email address. 
[/olist] [b]In the Wargaming.net Game Center[/b] 
[olist] 
[*] Click your username in the upper-left corner. 
[*] Click the “Complete Account” button under your username. 
[*] Add and confirm your email address. 
[/olist][/quote][/expand]
[h2]Battle Missions[/h2]
[list]
[*] The repeatable[b] Good Luck missions[/b], available during Happy Hours (every day from March 16 to March 20, from 18:00 to 22:00 CET (UTC+1) every day of the event), will reward you with extra XP or Crew XP.
[*] [b]The Four-Leaf Clover missions[/b] can be completed up to 7 times per day and will be available all day long from March 16 through March 22. The WoT-branded stamps you earn from these missions can be exchanged for styles, decals, emblems, Personal Reserves, consumables, and more in the Homefront Supplies section of the Depot.
[/list][h2]Green Light and Emerald Boxes[/h2]

During the [b]Green Light event[/b] (from March 16 at 05:30 CET through March 22 at 05:30 CET (UTC+1)), you can purchase Emerald Boxes from the in-game Store, with a daily limit of 500 boxes. These boxes come in bundles with 5, 15, 50, or 75 boxes and an equal number of battle missions for ×5 XP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c35d64b8818841b313b9804580acb5112c664de9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3397eeee2c9eeb5b6adefd4bc786121a1226a944.png[/img]

Each Emerald Box may contain:
[list]
[*] [b]One of 9 rare Premium vehicles[/b] (Probability: 2%)
[*] [b]One of 10 rare 2D styles[/b] (Probability: 10%)
[*] [b]A Crew Book or a male crew member[/b] with Brothers in Arms as a zero perk (Probability: 25%)
[*] One of the following: [b]Days of WoT Premium Account, Personal Reserves, credits[/b], or a [b]battle mission for ×5 XP[/b] (Probability: 100%)
[/list][expand type=details]

notes.title: Steam Community Shop: Choose Your Rewards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ec5a321af64deccfc841f537a75b8359777d3104.png[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]  
 
Our Steam Community unites tens of thousands of passionate tankers from all over the world. We are proud to see it grow and evolve every day, with new people joining, new discussion threads created, new artwork shared, and new guides published. We always try our best to keep this amazing Community entertained, even outside the game, through various Steam events and activities, and we never stop thinking of how we can make them even better and more rewarding.
 
We are excited to share our first big step in reimagining our Community activities on Steam: the introduction of [b]Community Tokens and the Steam Community Shop[/b]! 
 
[h3][b]Steam Community Shop: First Stage[/b][/h3] 
[b]March 6, 2023 through April 30, 2023[/b] 
 
[h2]What are Community Events?[/h2] 
 
First of all, let’s clarify which events and activities we’re talking about. World of Tanks Steam regularly launches various giveaways and perk events that require you to perform certain actions on the World of Tanks Steam Hub in order to receive a reward (e.g., “Like” and leave a comment).  
 
You can see examples of past Community events below (keep in mind that these events have already ended and you can no longer participate in them):  
 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3673284490063097927
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3635002625424278970
Usually, you can expect at least [b]one subscription event[/b], [b]one tag suggestion event[/b], and [b]one giveaway event[/b] per month. Some months, there may be even more, and in the future, we plan to add additional event types.  
 
Now that you understand what kind of events we are redesigning, it’s time to look at the actual changes.  
 
[h2]What are the Steam Community Shop and Community Tokens?[/h2] 
 
The [b]Steam Community Shop[/b] is a new addition to the game. Here, you can choose your own rewards and purchase them for [b]Community Tokens[/b].  
 
Previously, all Community events had a [b]pre-determined reward[/b] that all participants received at the end of the event. It was a good and simple system, but it lacked flexibility. For example, our monthly reward for following us on Steam was a bunch of Personal Reserves. Of course, if a player already has plenty of Personal Reserves on their account, they’d rather get something else instead. The introduction of Community Tokens and the Steam Community Shop lets you do exactly that! 
 
[b]From March 6, 2023[/b], all regular Community activities will have universal rewards: a certain amount of [b]Community Tokens[/b]. You can spend these Tokens in the Community Shop to get the reward that you need most. You can save up your Tokens throughout the month to purchase better rewards, or you can spend them as soon as you get them: the choice is yours! 
 
The Steam Community Shop will work in [b]stages[/b]. Each stage will last approximately [b]2 months[/b], and then we will refresh the available rewards. Please note that we will carefully monitor your feedback and adjust the Steam Community Shop mechanics if needed (e.g., the length of stages might change in the future, etc.).   
 
[quote=][b]NOTE:[/b] Earned Community Tokens [b]DO NOT transfer[/b] between stages. When a stage ends, all unused Tokens will disappear, so make sure to spend all your Tokens in time![/quote] 
You can expect various useful rewards in the Steam Community Shop, including [b]consumables, Personal Reserves, credits, WoT Premium Account, Garage slots, and customization elements[/b]. Some rewards can be claimed an unlimited number of times, while others are limited to 1-2 times per account.

notes.title: Oyster Bay Enters Random Battles!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0c2dd99e7a48debbfbc45e28c915b35be686d698.jpg[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]

Oyster Bay was the second most popular location of Recon Mission 2021, and now, it’s hitting Random Battles several months after the first-place map, Outpost. Oyster Bay offers a drastically different setting: a tropical island with a lush jungle and scenic beaches. Sadly, this once tranquil paradise has strategic value, and two mighty countries are fighting for control of it.

[previewyoutube=6POCg9c1_7I;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Enjoy the Views (And History)[/h2]

For decades, the island was held by one of the adversaries, who had constructed an airbase on the land. However, several years ago, the other side drove their troops out and entrenched, building multiple coastal bunkers. Now, the first power is back for revenge. The locals to whom the island rightfully belongs haven’t benefited from the presence of either occupying force: the landscape is littered with various military structures, and it is not easy to find a place to grow food or set up an oyster farm. Adding to their woes, a massive volcano is about to erupt, sending billowing smoke into the beautiful blue sky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2b057eb9b8e2d777016560642fbacf1de3d7f91b.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0693eb44fc1b963072075ee2892dff64411be193.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4fae4636cb8af9996720bc35da0426a1c2771091.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6ca566fcd5e1f2aa829eb8085fa8a5168d94eaa3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6de1eda67c418dc58eda251127e269a0d85c2efc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4cef13c343b2ba23c81d8d65ff5e2614e7d68f9a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bb9039575d0fc78f704b107a94a9ffe362ed1aef.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a6fa66e281ba5b9b2cbbd4a6d0315d1679a305f6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/67abe984802ad26e3149f69b3f8e66f830fb8288.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/081261ecfb835d5444ff1dee38605144e3bd446c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7785cc61dd6bae76f5256bde3107e7bd4e9c1d6c.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]Play in Various Ways[/h2]

Oyster Bay is the first map set on a tropical island, and the battlefield is completely surrounded by water. However, that’s not the only feature that makes this map special. It is also very large: At 1,300x1,300 meters, it is [b]69% more spacious[/b] than a standard 1 km² map. In fact, the extra size was one of the most requested features by players. There are also additional bypass routes behind the bases and in the middle of the map, prompting you to be mobile and tactically aware. Here, smart maneuvering pays off even more than usual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/533c44e3905fee11f04dd7b0c774f48a80d58335.png[/img]

[i]Let’s play on a new fan-favorite location, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Update 1.20: Check Out What’s New!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/744840bf298ceb2047264f8c217bc116b1968a94.jpg[/img]

[b]Update 1.20 is coming, Commanders! [/b]

It introduces the sunny Oyster Bay Random Battles map and a series of balance improvements to three other locations. We’re also adding the new Tournaments tab to the main menu of the Garage to help you find and join the tournaments and challenges you’re most interested in. On top of that, this update features rebalancing changes to a large batch of vehicles (including seven Tier X tanks) and brings cool new goodies to the Items for Bonds section in the in-game Store. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/23db4a44ed3b166bfb0e6a234bb0e6c240994c0d.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Map: Oyster Bay![/h2]

The second-place winner of Recon Mission 2021—Oyster Bay—hits Random Battles! This is a picturesque 1,300x1,300 m summer map in a tropical setting full of sunshine and vivid colors. In addition to the heavenly landscapes, you will find here spacious battle zones for all vehicle classes. Put on your sunglasses, grab your sunscreen, and go explore Oyster Bay!

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/updates/1-20-CT-1/#header-id-0 style=button][b]MORE INFO[/b][/url]

[h2]Tournaments and Challenges in Your Garage[/h2]

To make it easier for you to find and join tournaments and challenges you want to participate in, we're adding a new Tournaments tab to the main menu of the Garage. If you want to join a tournament, click the corresponding button to open its web page and choose a team or create your own.

Also in this new section, you will find another tab for ongoing challenges. If you want to prove yourself and take part in the challenge you like, join it by clicking the respective button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/180c19b41fb132aea823972c643402d087cc5a54.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3673285123522425080
[h2]Vehicle Rebalancing: A New Iteration[/h2]

We're updating the characteristics of 27 vehicles from different nations, tiers, and types, including seven Tier X tanks—the Centurion Action X, the Т57 Heavy, the Rinoceronte, among others. We’re also adjusting the parameters of the surrounding vehicles in their branches and updating the performance of seven Tier VI⁠ and VII tanks. Depending on whether they perform beyond the scope of their tier performance, we’ll improve or reduce their effectiveness in battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5ec5267ad43ac5f33f98c006a5e3b31a8b264a23.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3664278558804919800
[h2]Map Balance Improvements[/h2]

We’re continuing to work on improving Random Battles maps and adjusting three battlefields: Airfield, Steppes, and Mines. They received a series of balance tweaks to make gameplay more comfortable for both teams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d77b27a5df0a64d526f122c1ce870fc3c4f21ecf.jpg[/img]

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/updates/1-20-CT-1/#header-id-1 style=button][b]FIND OUT MORE[/b][/url]

[h2]New Items for Bonds[/h2]

We’ve added more cool tanks, unique customizations, and a piece of Improved Equipment to the Bond Shop, Commanders! Head to the Items for Bonds section in the in-game Store to get your hands on the following: the 113 Beijing Opera; the Lorraine 40 t; the T23E3; Increased Shell Resistance; and spectacular 3D styles for the 60TP Lewandowskiego, STB-1, and E 100.

Take advantage of the expanded selection!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1a9dc666a38d8cf1462630eaf5a87465a21c25b6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Battle Pass: New Season, New Rewards![/h2]

Battle Pass is back in 2023 with Season X and rewards galore! As always, you can complete Progression Stages and earn rewards, including Battle Pass Tokens. Exchange them for various items and rare vehicles in a special section of the in-game Store. There will be two formidable new tanks for 2023, so don't miss out!
