notes.title: Holiday Ops 2023: Event Guide
notes.content:
[b]The holidays are just around the corner, which means it’s time for Holiday Ops in World of Tanks. It’s the most anticipated event, featuring tons of rewards and wonderful surprises![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b27fa97a6b343877a0c57c4d9e19273907f580d8.png[/img]

Instead of your classic Garage, we’ve prepared for you a festive [b]Village [/b]filled with joy and a magical atmosphere. Here, you will instantly find a pleasant gift from us: [b]the brand-new M16/43 Sahariano, a Tier III Premium Italian medium tank[/b]. It’s a fast and maneuverable medium for fun and dynamic gameplay. This is also where you’ll meet our guest stars, Arnie and Milla! They will host the event and provide you with special quests and combat missions and make Holiday Ops even more exciting! Join us, and let’s celebrate together!

[h3][b]Holiday Ops 2023[/b][/h3]
[b]EU:[/b] December 1, 2022 at 07:00 CET through January 9, 2023 at 07:00 CET (UTC+1)
[b]NA: [/b] December 1 at 03:20 PT | 05:20 CT | 06:20 ET through January 9 at 03:20 PT | 05:20 CT | 06:20 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] December 1, 2022 at 11:00 through January 9, 2023 at 11:00 (UTC+8)

[previewyoutube=qZZO8_-uHkU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Event Summary[/h2]
[list]
[*] Holiday Ops 2023 [b]kicks off on December 1, 2022, at 07:00 CET[/b] and [b]runs until January 9, 2023, at 07:00 CET (UTC+1) (EU server)[/b].
[*] The day the event starts, your Garage will turn into a festive [b]Village [/b]with new landmarks: Headquarters with two guest stars, three Decorative Objects, zones to collect Holiday Ops resources, etc.
[*] Holiday Ops 2023 features a special event currency called [b]Resources[/b]. There are four types of resources in the event: [b]Rock Crystal, Pure Emerald, Warm Amber[/b], and [b]Meteoric Iron[/b]. All your festive activities will be based on collecting and investing these resources. You can get Holiday Ops resources in the following ways:

[olist]
[*] Collect them [b]manually in your own Village[/b] up to twice a day
[*] As rewards for completing [b]Daily Missions[/b]
[*] In your [b]Best Friends’ Villages[/b] once a day
[*] When petting your dog friend [b]Chaffee[/b]
[*] As a bonus from [b]Large Boxes[/b]
[/olist]
[*] There are [b]10 levels of Festive Atmosphere[/b], marking your progress in the event and providing you with rewards. To improve the Festive Atmosphere, upgrade decorative objects from Level 1 to 5 by collecting and investing [b]Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald[/b].
[*] By improving your Festive Atmosphere and reaching each new Level, you will earn [b]rewards[/b], such as new female crew members, a brand-new festive 2D style with unique Marks of Excellence, and much more.
[*] The day Holiday Ops 2023 starts, you can assign the status of "Best Friend" [b]to up to two players from your friends list[/b]. You can visit their Villages and collect some extra resources [b]once a day[/b] to boost your progress in the event. Remember that you [b]don't take any resources from them[/b]—you just get additional resources for free! By collecting resources from your Best Friends, you will have the opportunity to receive special friendship-themed customizations.
[*] [b]Arnold Schwarzenegger[/b] is back from last year, but he isn't alone this time: international star [b]Milla Jovovich[/b] makes her Holiday Ops debut! She and Arnie will greet you at Headquarters in your Village. Our celebrities will provide you with [b]Assignments[/b], which are special quests that can be completed by collecting a certain amount of [b]Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron[/b].
[*] Upon completing a certain number of Assignments, you will receive exclusive [b]decals [/b]and [b]2D styles with unique Marks of Excellence[/b]. On top of that, each completed Assignment increases [b]economic bonuses to credits and all types of experience in Random Battles[/b] (including Grand Battles).

[quote=]If getting rewards for improving the Festive Atmosphere is the highest priority for you, focus on upgrading decorative objects by investing Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald.

If you're more interested in customization rewards from our celebrities and economic bonuses, focus on fulfilling their Assignments using Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron.[/quote]
[*] You can also complete a [b]Holiday Ops Challenge[/b] consisting of [b]28 Combat Missions From Milla[/b], all in Random and Grand Battles, and all in [b]Tier IV vehicles and higher[/b].
[*] All missions are cumulative and can be performed at the same time. Upon completing a certain number of missions, you will receive rewards, including credit discounts on researchable vehicles, a brand-new 2D style with unique Marks of Excellence, [b]Milla Jovovich[/b] herself as a tank commander, and much more.
[*] Upon completing all 28 Missions From Milla, you may unlock up to four additional missions, with each mission rewarding one of [b]Arnie’s rewards that you didn't receive[/b] in last year's Holiday Ops Challenge.
[*] When you reach [b]Festive Atmosphere Level X[/b], you can start shopping in the [b]Holiday Ops Shop[/b] using any of the four resources. Here, you will find customization rewards for assembling Collections from previous years (from 2018 through 2022) and Holiday Post 2022 that you [b]did not receive[/b]. Depending on how complete your Collections were and how many Holiday Post rewards you received in previous years, you will get [b]discounts[/b].
[*] There will also be a [b]Gift Terminal[/b] in your Village where you can spend [b]Tokens[/b]. Tokens are another in-game currency that you can get in several ways. For each Token spent, you will receive [b]one surprise gift from the list below[/b]:

[list]
[*] Consumables
[*] Personal Reserves
[*] A Training Guide
[*] Other in-game items

[quote=]But in some special cases, you may even get the [b]Object 283, a brand-new Tier IX Special Soviet medium tank[/b]. You may get it for several rental battles, or it may be given to you permanently.[/quote][/list]
[*] We support [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3360267192919523807]transfer opportunities for players from CIS to the EU realm[/url] throughout the [b]Holiday Ops 2023 event[/b].
[/list][h2]Discover Your New Festive Village![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f06e069de040efb7b24f7c601ca9f3905d7c6a2c.png[/img]

With the start of Holiday Ops 2023 on [b]December 1[/b], your Garage will turn into a snowy Village full of festive magic and fairy lights. It will certainly look charming, but you can improve it even further! This is where your free festive gift—[b]the brand-new M16/43 Sahariano, a Tier III Premium Italian medium tank[/b] with a 100% trained crew and a Garage slot—will be waiting for you!

[quote=]When you first log in to the game client, you’ll be able to choose a fun name for your festive Village from the suggested combinations of words. Once confirmed, your Village will keep this name until the end of the event.[/quote]
You will also find [b]Headquarters [/b]here, which is where you can receive special combat missions and [b]Assignments [/b]from our incredible celebrities. There will also be three magnificent decorative objects in your Village—the [b]Christmas Tree, Fair[/b], and [b]Installation[/b]—that you can adorn with amazing Decorations!

[h2]Decorative Objects and Decorations[/h2]

Each of the three decorative objects has [b]five levels[/b]. To boost their level and customize your Village to your liking, you need to spend a certain amount of two [b]Holiday Ops resources: Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald[/b]. Decorative objects levels are improved incrementally, meaning one after another.

Each time you reach a new level, you will receive several [b]random Standard Decorations[/b] from four festive settings:
[list]
[*] New Year
[*] Christmas
[*] Lunar
[*] Magic
[/list]Upon reaching the first level, you will unlock the slots and will be able to place Standard Decorations in them. Improve the levels of your decorative objects, obtain new Decorations, and create your own unique atmosphere!

Additionally, you can outfit your Village with [b]Large Decorations[/b], and each one will be automatically put in its proper place. You will earn Large Decorations both for completing Assignments from our celebrities and for upgrading your decorative objects to Level 5.

[quote=]Standard and Large Decorations [b]do not affect your progress in the event[/b], but they serve as festive and fancy customization items for your Village.[/quote]
[h2]Holiday Ops Resources[/h2]

These are the four types of Holiday Ops resources, a special in-game currency:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7c4be346a85727b69b660c2578319a6467cf24d2.png[/img]

[quote=]Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald are used to improve the Festive Atmosphere, while Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron are needed to complete the Guests’ Assignments.[/quote]
[b]Collect resources and use them to do the following:[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgrade decorative objects
[*] Complete Guests’ Assignments
[*] Purchase customization rewards for assembling Collections from previous years (from 2018 through 2022) and Holiday Post 2022 feature rewards
[*] Purchase Tokens (another in-game currency that can be used in the Gift Terminal)
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/40add46c5786d2ebe294805955db29dbc5a1b85f.jpg[/img]

You can get resources in different ways, and the first way is to collect them manually right in your Village. You can collect resources in your Village up to twice a day.

[quote=]After collecting resources for the first time in your Village, a 55-minute cooldown occurs. After the second collection, the cooldown lasts until the start of the next game day (05:00 CET).[/quote]
If you plan to be away from the game for several days, make sure to activate the Resource Autocollector feature in advance. It allows you to automatically collect all the resources in your Village at the same time without logging in. Each time resources are collected in this way, you will be charged 150,000 credits. Automatic collection occurs at the end of each cooldown.

[quote=]You need to manually deactivate the [b]Resource Autocollector[/b]. If you don’t, it will deactivate at the end of Holiday Ops or when there are not enough credits on your account.

If you activate the Resource Autocollector and don't log into the game before the end of the event, it will deactivate along with the end of Holiday Ops. Resources for this period won't be collected, and you won't be charged any credits.[/quote]
[b]You can also get resources in the following ways:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/03e5060cbed2cfbb603cffea3f690c9b0eb2e130.jpg[/img]

[h2]Resource Converter[/h2]

If you have a lot of certain resources but fewer of other types, use the Resource Converter. It will allow you to exchange a chosen resource for any other type at the rate of 50:40.

[h2]Level Up Your Festive Atmosphere![/h2]

There are 10 levels of Festive Atmosphere, which define your progress in the event and provide you with rewards. At the start of Holiday Ops 2023, you’ll be at Festive Atmosphere Level I.

To improve the Festive Atmosphere, upgrade decorative objects from Level 1 to 5 by investing [b]Rock Crystal [/b]and [b]Pure Emerald[/b]. Each time you level up decorative objects, you earn special Festive Atmosphere Points that improve your Festive Atmosphere.

[h2]Visit Your Best Friends to Grab Extra Resources and Unique Customizations![/h2]

During Holiday Ops 2023, you can visit the [b]Villages of all your friends in World of Tanks[/b] to see who has the most creative and festive one of all!

Moreover, from the day the event starts, you can assign the status of "Best Friend" [b]to up to two players from your friends list[/b]. You can visit their festive Garages and collect some extra resources once a day to boost your progress in the event.

[quote=]Collecting resources in your Best Friends' Villages does not affect the number of resources that they themselves will gather. You don't take anything from them, don’t worry—you just get additional resources for free![/quote]
Every time you collect resources in your Best Friend's Villages, you add one point to a special counter. After earning a certain number of these points, you will have the opportunity to get the following unique friendship-themed customizations:
[list]
[*] A set of 6 cool inscriptions (6 points required)
[*] A set of 6 stunning decals (12 points required)
[*] An amazing 2D style featuring unique Marks of Excellence (24 points required)
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0c25ce5c3eb17be588a0873241b15eb8d7ecd597.jpg[/img]

[h2]Guest Stars and Festive Bonuses[/h2]

This year, two incredible celebrities will help us make this event even cooler and more exciting! They will host Holiday Ops and greet you at [b]Headquarters[/b], an interactive 3D zone in your Village.

The first guest of honor is already familiar to you: the legendary [b]Arnold Schwarzenegger[/b]! He enjoyed celebrating with us last year so much that he didn't hesitate when we invited him to our festive party again. But this year, Arnie will share the event with the amazing [b]Milla Jovovich[/b], and she has prepared something truly special for you—keep reading to find out more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a856671ad38be6ce48418f5305f86ca68cd4e346.jpg[/img]

Our celebrities will provide you with [b]Assignments[/b], which are special quests that can be completed by spending a certain amount of [b]Warm Amber and Meteoric Iro[/b]n. Each of the celebs has their own line of unique Assignments, as well as with their own progression and rewards. There are 10 quests from each host, making 20 in total. To complete an Assignment, you need to bring a [b]specific item[/b] to the guest star.

Assignments from each celebrity are fulfilled sequentially, meaning one by one. If you haven’t completed your current active Assignment, you won’t be able to move on to the next one. Upon completing a certain number of quests, you will receive exclusive customization items from our celebrities, such as [b]decals and 2D styles with unique Marks of Excellence[/b]. Additionally, our guest stars will tell you amazing stories and even help you decorate your Village!

[h3][b]New 2D Style from Milla[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/32f517ba50c131b0217ac1dcf1ca01aded2291ea.png[/img]

[h3][b]New 2D Style from Arnie[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d0531ba6d371e55548ae6cb1aa71f510bfb49d90.png[/img]

Each completed Assignment from Arnie or Milla simultaneously increases all economic bonuses in the game. When you finish an Assignment, you'll slightly increase the bonus to credits and bonuses to all types of XP—Free, Combat, and Crew—in Random Battles (including Grand Battles).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/36d6ecddbd808673e8b7b2ba045f8591cf901d71.png[/img]

[quote=]The bonus to credits applies to all vehicles in the game, including Premium and rental ones, [b]until the end of Holiday Ops on January 9, 2023, at 07:00 CET (UTC+1) (EU server)[/b].

Bonuses to XP will also apply until the end of the event, but only one bonus of your choice can be active. By default, the bonus to Combat XP will be selected. You can change the type of active bonus to XP at any time in your Village. Active bonuses to XP apply to all vehicles in the game except Premium and rental ones.[/quote]
In the event guide, you already learned how to get resources during Holiday Ops and what to spend them on. Let us note once again that you can use them to improve the Festive Atmosphere, as well as to complete Assignments from our super guests, Milla and Arnie.

[quote=]If getting rewards for improving the Festive Atmosphere is the highest priority for you, you’d better focus on [b]upgrading decorative objects by investing Rock Crystal and Pure Emerald[/b].

If you're more interested in customization rewards and economic bonuses from our celebrities, then give your primary attention to [b]fulfilling their Assignments using Warm Amber and Meteoric Iron[/b].[/quote]
[h2]Take On the Holiday Ops Challenge![/h2]

Get ready to take on the [b]Holiday Ops Challenge[/b] and prove that you can become real heroes, too!

The Challenge includes [b]28 Combat Missions From Milla[/b] to complete in Random and Grand Battles in Tier IV vehicles and higher. Every day, one new mission will be available for you. All missions are cumulative and can be performed at the same time. If you skip several missions, you can complete them all in one go. Upon completing a certain number of missions, you will receive rewards, including a unique medal, cool inscriptions, an amazing decal, and other great stuff.

Plus, completing Missions From Milla will grant you [b]credit discounts on researchable vehicles[/b]. You’ll unlock these discounts gradually as you complete missions. The first discount on purchasing a Tier II vehicle will become available after completing two missions. As you progress, the tier of vehicles discounted will also increase. To earn a discount on purchasing a researchable Tier X vehicle, you need to complete all 28 missions.

[quote=]Each credit discount [b]can only be applied once[/b] when purchasing one vehicle of the respective tier.[/quote]
Once you have completed 23 missions, you'll get an incredible 2D style featuring Milla Jovovich herself and unique Marks of Excellence. Take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2056a831ff81db1d316369e4e55ef197d75f9319.png[/img]

Once you have completed 27 missions, Milla Jovovich will become the commander of one of your vehicles! She comes fully prepared with Repair and Firefighting skills, as well as Brothers in Arms as a zero perk—plus enough experience to learn a fourth skill or perk of your choice. And no matter what happens on the battlefield, Milla will always energize you to win with her instantly recognizable voice!

[h2]Condition Replacements[/h2]

Don’t like a particular mission condition? No problem! Every day until the end of Holiday Ops (including the first day of the event), you’ll receive [b]one Condition Replacement[/b]. It allows you to change the condition of any current or missed mission.

Unused Condition Replacements are cumulative. You can change the condition of any mission (including additional Missions From Arnie, described below) as many times as you have Replacements. Or you might want to change the conditions of each mission only once—it's entirely up to you!

[quote=]The number of Condition Replacements you will obtain during the event is limited, so use them wisely![/quote]
[h2]Additional Challenge Missions From Arnie[/h2]

Didn't manage to complete last year’s Missions From Arnie during Holiday Ops 2022? Here's your second chance to collect them! After you complete all 28 Missions From Milla, you will have the opportunity to unlock [b]additional Missions From Arnie[/b]. You can unlock up to four missions in total, and completing each one will earn you one of the cool Arnie-themed rewards below:
[list]
[*] [b]Arnold Schwarzenegger himself as a tank commander[/b]
[*] 3 striking inscriptions (6 of each)
[*] An exclusive decal
[*] A spectacular 2D style with unique Marks of Excellence

You have the Arnie inscriptions and decal, but you didn’t get the 2D style and Arnie himself as a tank commander. Accordingly, once you complete all 28 missions of this year’s Holiday Ops Challenge, you will unlock two additional missions to earn these two prizes.
And don't forget about the Condition Replacements you’ve accumulated—they're good to use for these Missions From Arnie, as well![/quote]
[h2]The Holiday Ops Shop[/h2]

During the Holiday Ops event, when you reach Festive Atmosphere Level X, you can start shopping in the [b]Holiday Ops Shop[/b], which will become available in the game client.

In this Shop, you can purchase customization rewards for assembling Collections from previous years (from 2018 through 2022) and Holiday Post 2022.

[quote=]You will only be able to get the customizations that you did not receive in previous years.[/quote]
Rewards for Collections from previous years and Holiday Post 2022 are purchased with any of the four types of resources. Depending on how complete your Collections were, you will receive discounts. And if you already have some Holiday Post customizations, you will also receive discounts on the remaining items.

Among the many wonderful objects that you will find in your Village, there will also be a [b]Gift Terminal[/b], in which you can spend special Tokens that you can get in the following ways:
[list]
[*] For improving your Festive Atmosphere levels

If you have a lot of certain resources but fewer of other types, use the Resource Converter.
It will allow you to exchange a chosen resource for any other type at the rate of 50:40.
There are 10 levels of Festive Atmosphere, which define your progress in the event and provide you with rewards.
To improve the Festive Atmosphere, upgrade decorative objects from Level 1 to 5 by investing [b]Rock Crystal [/b]and [b]Pure Emerald[/b].
Each time you level up decorative objects, you earn special Festive Atmosphere Points that improve your Festive Atmosphere.

By improving your Festive Atmosphere and reaching each new level, you will earn in-game rewards, such as Personal Reserves, national and universal fragments, new female crew members, a brand-new festive 2D style with unique Marks of Excellence*, and much more.
Upon reaching Festive Atmosphere Level II, you will find a true friend in your Village: a cute and cheerful dog named Chaffee!
If you pet [b]Chaffee [/b]once a day, you will get a certain number of additional random resources.
During Holiday Ops 2023, you can visit the [b]Villages of all your friends in World of Tanks[/b] to see who has the most creative and festive one of all!
Moreover, from the day the event starts, you can assign the status of "Best Friend" [b]to up to two players from your friends list[/b].
You can visit their festive Garages and collect some extra resources once a day to boost your progress in the event.
Every time you collect resources in your Best Friend's Villages, you add one point to a special counter.
After earning a certain number of these points, you will have the opportunity to get the following unique friendship-themed customizations:
This year, two incredible celebrities will help us make this event even cooler and more exciting!
They will host Holiday Ops and greet you at [b]Headquarters[/b], an interactive 3D zone in your Village.
The first guest of honor is already familiar to you: the legendary [b]Arnold Schwarzenegger[/b]!
He enjoyed celebrating with us last year so much that he didn't hesitate when we invited him to our festive party again.
But this year, Arnie will share the event with the amazing [b]Milla Jovovich[/b], and she has prepared something truly special for you—keep reading to find out more!
Our celebrities will provide you with [b]Assignments[/b], which are special quests that can be completed by spending a certain amount of [b]Warm Amber and Meteoric Iro[/b]n.
Each of the celebs has their own line of unique Assignments, as well as with their own progression and rewards.
There are 10 quests from each host, making 20 in total.
Upon completing a certain number of quests, you will receive exclusive customization items from our celebrities, such as [b]decals and 2D styles with unique Marks of Excellence[/b].
Additionally, our guest stars will tell you amazing stories and even help you decorate your Village!
Each completed Assignment from Arnie or Milla simultaneously increases all economic bonuses in the game.
When you finish an Assignment, you'll slightly increase the bonus to credits and bonuses to all types of XP—Free, Combat, and Crew—in Random Battles (including Grand Battles).
Get ready to take on the [b]Holiday Ops Challenge[/b] and prove that you can become real heroes, too!
The Challenge includes [b]28 Combat Missions From Milla[/b] to complete in Random and Grand Battles in Tier IV vehicles and higher.
Every day, one new mission will be available for you.
Upon completing a certain number of missions, you will receive rewards, including a unique medal, cool inscriptions, an amazing decal, and other great stuff.
Plus, completing Missions From Milla will grant you [b]credit discounts on researchable vehicles[/b].
You’ll unlock these discounts gradually as you complete missions.
The first discount on purchasing a Tier II vehicle will become available after completing two missions.
As you progress, the tier of vehicles discounted will also increase.
To earn a discount on purchasing a researchable Tier X vehicle, you need to complete all 28 missions.
Once you have completed 23 missions, you'll get an incredible 2D style featuring Milla Jovovich herself and unique Marks of Excellence.
Once you have completed 27 missions, Milla Jovovich will become the commander of one of your vehicles!
She comes fully prepared with Repair and Firefighting skills, as well as Brothers in Arms as a zero perk—plus enough experience to learn a fourth skill or perk of your choice.
And no matter what happens on the battlefield, Milla will always energize you to win with her instantly recognizable voice!
Every day until the end of Holiday Ops (including the first day of the event), you’ll receive [b]one Condition Replacement[/b].
It allows you to change the condition of any current or missed mission.
After you complete all 28 Missions From Milla, you will have the opportunity to unlock [b]additional Missions From Arnie[/b].
You can unlock up to four missions in total, and completing each one will earn you one of the cool Arnie-themed rewards below:
During the Holiday Ops event, when you reach Festive Atmosphere Level X, you can start shopping in the [b]Holiday Ops Shop[/b], which will become available in the game client.
In this Shop, you can purchase customization rewards for assembling Collections from previous years (from 2018 through 2022) and Holiday Post 2022.
Among the many wonderful objects that you will find in your Village, there will also be a [b]Gift Terminal[/b], in which you can spend special Tokens that you can get in the following ways:
For each Token spent, you will receive one gift.
In some special cases, you may even receive [b]the Object 283*, a brand-new Tier IX Special Soviet medium tank[/b] — either for several rental battles or permanently!

notes.title: Frontline Is Back for Its Final 7-Day Run in 2022!
notes.content:
[quote=]Dear players, in case your internet connection is slow, you may experience problems with the UI when respawning in battle: some of the necessary elements may be missing or extra ones may be present, and/or the vehicle chosen by you may be wrongly displayed as destroyed. We have done our best to minimize the number of such issues, but sadly, we haven‘t been able to eliminate them entirely. If you encounter one, relaunching the game client may help.[/quote]
[b]Commanders![/b]

Epic 30v30 battles are here to rock vast battlefields again! [b]From November 21 through November 28[/b], Frontline will return to World of Tanks for its final launch in 2022. Soon, you’ll be attacking pillboxes and defending them while using a whole array of Combat Reserves to give your side a tactical edge. Barring a few minor changes, the rules, mechanics, and rewards will be the same as in the second Frontline launch, so you’ll feel at home!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/89d09bba28f913bea084c1df84364fbafc817fa0.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Frontline 2022: Third Launch[/b][/h3]
[b]EU:[/b] November 21, 2022, at 05:00 CET through November 28, 2022, at 03:00 CET (UTC+1)
[b]NA:[/b] November 21, 2022, at 03:00 PT | 05:00 CT | 06:00 ET through November 28, 2022, at 01:00 PT | 03:00 CT | 04:00 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] November 21, 2022, at 07:00 UTC+8 through November 28, 2022, at 04:00 UTC+8

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/content/guide/general/frontline/ style=button][b]TO GUIDE[/b][/url]

[h2]Battle Format[/h2]

There will only be [b]single-tier battles[/b] during the third launch of Frontline in 2022. Get your favorite Tier VIII vehicles ready!

[h2]Changes to Combat Reserves[/h2]

During the third launch of Frontline, you will have the tried-and-tested Combat Reserves at your disposal. Their parameters are the same as the last time, except for one change: After you respawn, you will have to wait a bit for the Combat Reserves to be ready for use—for 30% of their nominal cooldown time.

[h2]Rental Vehicles[/h2]

Rental vehicles are the same as those used during the second launch—all “clones” of their respective researchable Tier VIII counterparts with the best modules installed. Crews from vehicles of the same nation and type can be transferred on and off them for free and without penalty. Rental vehicles will be available for the entire duration of Frontline, which is seven days, and they can only be used in this mode.
[list]
[*] Tiger II FL  
[*] T-44 FL  
[*] AMX AC mle. 48 FL  
[*] M41 Walker Bulldog FL  
[/list]At the start, you will be able to obtain Frontline rental vehicles for 250,000 each in the Frontline section of the in-game Store. This price will go down as the event progresses.

notes.title: It’s Pumpkin Bash Time!
notes.content:
Are you ready for some light-hearted but very intense and fun engagements filled with sorcery? [b]From October 20 through November 4[/b], the Pumpkin Bash event will boil and bubble like a magical cauldron. Come one, come all—for heated PvP revelry and some nice prizes, among which is the loyalty of the first crew of coven members in World of Tanks!

[h3][b]Pumpkin Bash[/b][/h3]

[b]EU:[/b] From October 20 at 7:30 CEST (UTC+2) through November 4 at 4:00 CET (UTC+1)
[b]NA:[/b] From October 19 at 04:30 PT | 06:30 CT | 07:30 ET through November 3 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] From October 20 at 07:30 UTC+8 through November 4 at 05:00 UTC+8

[previewyoutube=6MwJD0a3xYg;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/83664da83a0f9478346710c1d16927d7f47ce690.jpg[/img]

[h2]Battle Mechanics[/h2]

[h3][b]Eligible Vehicles[/b][/h3]

You can participate in Pumpkin Bash battles in any [b]Tier VI–VIII vehicle[/b]. The matchmaker will try to set up a single-tier, 15v15 battle. If that isn’t possible, the matchmaker will consider other options: first, multi-tiered battles, and then the 10v10 and 7v7 formats.

[b]Wheeled vehicles will have separate battles[/b] in the Pumpkin Bash mode with the same matchmaker logic. On some occasions, you may have to wait in a queue for your battle to start.

For those who don’t have wheeled vehicles, the following rental ones will be available for the duration of Pumpkin Bash:
[list]
[*] Panhard AMD 178B  
[*] Hotchkiss EBR  
[*] Panhard EBR 75 (FL 10)  
[/list][h3][b]Victory Conditions[/b][/h3]

Unabashed Halloween PvP fun shows in very special victory conditions. In Pumpkin Bash engagements, you can win in either of the following ways:
[list]
[*] Capturing both (yes—BOTH) bases
[*] Helping your team do more overall damage than the other side before the battle ends
[/list][h3][b]Resurrection[/b][/h3]

Relentless foe-bashing is more than welcome because, should your vehicle get destroyed, you [b]respawn [/b]again in the same vehicle in designated Resurrection Points, with no limits for resurrections. You come back into battle with full ammo, regular consumables, and special consumables (Combat Abilities) that you had at the battle’s start. By the way, repairs and ammo are free and unlimited in Pumpkin Bash. It should be noted that you receive neither credits nor XP in Pumpkin Bash battles, but the prizes more than make up for that!

[h3][b]Combat Abilities[/b][/h3]

Pumpkin Bash magical Combat Abilities come [b]in addition to regular consumables in event battles[/b]. Passive Combat Abilities give your vehicle some juicy bonuses, and Active Combat Abilities bestow some quirky beneficial effects upon your ride. They cost just 3,000 credits each in the in-game Store. Before a Pumpkin Bash battle, you can outfit your tank with up to three different Combat Abilities, mixing and matching them as you wish. It doesn’t matter how many of them are Active or Passive. You can even go all Active or all Passive.

[quote=]Combat Abilities are activated with the 1, 2, and 3 buttons, and the shell types are instead mapped to the 7, 8, and 9 buttons. This is for your convenience, as you most likely will use Combat Abilities more often than you will change your shell type in Pumpkin Bash battles. The regular consumables stay in their place (buttons 4, 5, and 6).[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3e20ed6a8092372c86706fdfad669bed74a96a23.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/145fd778075b036fc4220a88025962a0f1ca098c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Jack-o’-Lantern[/b][/h3]

The Jack-o’-Lantern is an arcane source of various super buffs you may pick up during the battle, some of which can potentially alter the battle’s course. Cast a glance at the minimap often (as you always do), and you’ll know when this epically magical drop appears. Keep in mind that the Jack-o’-Lantern bonus is random, so you won’t see what you’ll pick up until you do! Once you have it, you keep the buff until your vehicle is destroyed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8305e9c82516ecc68457fee625640bbc2f6a0dc1.png[/img]

[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3]

Pumpkin Bash battles take place on four maps. These locations will seem vaguely familiar because they have been “Halloweenified,” becoming mysterious and even mystical. While the maps are darker than usual, a full moon is shining brightly over each of them, so you’ll see where to drive to and what to aim at.

[/tr]

[h2]Progression[/h2]

[h3][b]Stages[/b][/h3]

The Pumpkin Bash progression consists of five Stages. For every Stage, there’s a three-day period to complete its Quests and claim the rewards. After that, the Stage gets locked and the next one starts. Make sure not to miss any of the Stages—some of the prizes’ features work only in a team (more on that in the Rewards section below). And make sure to log in daily for a helping of Combat Abilities!

[h3][b]Halloween Points[/b][/h3]

Sorcery-infused armored combat gives you Halloween Points after each battle you win. The number of Halloween Points you receive is calculated according to the same rules as the amount of XP in Random Battles.

[h3][b]Stage Missions [/b][/h3]

Every Stage has two Stage Missions for you. To complete the first one, you need to earn Halloween Points. You will receive bonds and regular consumables. The second Mission of every Stage requires you to use a specific Combat Ability in multiple Pumpkin Bash battles. The reward is a fabulous female crew member or a sarcastic feline crew member, plus a special personalized 2D style of theirs and some decals.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]

[h3][b]Witch Crew[/b][/h3]

Bonds and consumables are good, but we dare say the first-ever witch crew is even better! Especially considering it’s a fully voiced crew of sorceress tankers and their token cat. And by “fully voiced,” we mean every crew member has custom lines and reactions to what is happening in a given moment.

To have them all talking (and to make your battles feel like something between a road trip movie and a magic carpet ride), you need to put all five magical crew members into the same vehicle. That’s why it’s important to complete all five Stages of the Pumpkin Bash event! However, if you do miss some Stages, don’t worry—you’ll still be able to unlock supernatural crew members, 2D styles, and decals for gold later.

When only the commander, Cordelia Astra, is present in a tank of yours, the limited second-option soundtrack will activate, which features the lead witch’s vocals.

Also, all five members of the team have the Coven zero perk. It works exactly like Brothers in Arms but has a special arcane flair. On top of that, each witch—and the cat—has enough experience to fully train a second perk or skill right off the bat (pun intended).

[h3][b]2D Styles[/b][/h3]

Each Pumpkin Bash heroine and their hero cat comes with a fit-all 2D style. Their patterns are the same, but the coloring is different. Along with the reward ones, there are two more 2D styles to remember Halloween 2022: “Iron Jack” and “Boo”. They are both obtainable in special packages in the in-game Store.

[*] If a player disconnects while in battle with Combat Abilities activated and then reconnects, the activated abilities may not be highlighted in the UI.
[*] Battle replays are not officially supported for Pumpkin Bash battles, but you can still record them. Minor graphics glitches (mostly UI-related) are possible.
[*] If you enter the Pumpkin Bash event screen (the one with the progression Stages shown) and then go to the Exterior screen, the in-game Store (via Daily Mission or Extend WoT Premium), or Missions screen (via Daily Mission), and then go back to your Garage, you have to click on the Pumpkin Bash window to get on the event screen again. (For example: when you go back to your Garage, you find yourself where you are always at when you launch the game.)
[/list][/expand]
[i]Feel the night wind and drive on for Pumpkin Bash adventures, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Update 1.18.1 Is Here!
notes.content:
[b]Time to check out Update 1.18.1, Commanders![/b] 

This update includes a ton of great features that will boost your game experience and add to the fun. Get ready for the brand-new Onslaught mode, the free Sixth Sense perk for your vehicle crews, modified Personal Reserves, balancing changes to four maps, and more. Dive into the game and check it all out!

[previewyoutube=s6wFsfZWa84;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Onslaught Mode[/h2]

What if you could play in teams of seven, with everyone rolling out to the battlefield in Researchable and Collectors’ Tier X vehicles? What if you could use upgradable skills based on your vehicle’s role, capture Points of Interest to get extra Tactical Skills, and band together in Super Platoons of seven players? Well, enough what-ifs! Join Onslaught mode to find out for yourself, and enjoy the new rating-based matchmaking. The rewards include “Wing and Claw,” the first-ever progressive 2D style. Find out more about Onslaught in the dedicated article for the new mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cc658fc3e3ecddab1bfcb572b12b105fa2374131.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3398551594417802749
[h2]Free Sixth Sense[/h2]

The Sixth Sense perk is now free for every existing vehicle commander, as well as those you obtain in the future. If any of your crew members already have the perk, all of the XP you invested into Sixth Sense will be refunded. This XP will first be used to completely train their major qualification to 100%, and then on the last skill or perk that was being trained, and finally, on Crew XP that can be spent on a new skill or perk. If you have questions, refer to the dedicated article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/41b6f8bab49de9a9cf5b7d80668541db3855088e.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3301726014492689801
[h2]Improved Personal Reserves[/h2]

Personal Reserves have been streamlined. Now, there are just three types of Reserves (one per slot) and two levels of bonuses. Plus, all Personal Reserves will have a duration of 1 hour. This means no more complicated calculations. The modified UI allows you to activate Personal Reserves on the fly, even during battle. Your old Personal Reserves have been converted into the new ones using a conversion rate that works in your favor. Check out the dedicated article for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e18334c9105db12a83df705dcf95255c7b7d840e.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/4649425839616028933
[h2]Map Balance Adjustments[/h2]

We have refreshed four more locations: Malinovka, Sand River, Fisherman’s Bay, and Himmelsdorf. While playing on these maps, you can now enjoy the fresh smell of new tactical opportunities, and more balanced and fair team competition. If you would like to familiarize yourself with all of the changes to the locations mentioned above, see the Common Test article, which features a bunch of “before and after” screenshots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/460e4d9aa829382e36808f8bb7d8d844c2828b1c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Sixth Sense: A Special Commander Feature
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Commanders![/b]

When Update 1.18.1 goes live, [b]the Sixth Sense perk will become a special commander feature[/b]. This means that it will always be available for all crew commanders in the game, and you will no longer need to train it. We are sure that this change will make battles more enjoyable for all players, especially new ones. Let’s see how it works and what will happen to your newly available perk slot.

[h2]Crew 2.0 Sandbox Test: A Look Back[/h2]

In 2021, we tested [b]Crew 2.0[/b] in Sandbox. From the very beginning of testing, the Sixth Sense perk was made available as a default perk for all crew commanders. We received a huge number of questions, feedback, and comments. Clearly, players were very interested in these major proposed changes. After completing the tests, we took a break and carefully analyzed the statistics and feedback we obtained with your help. It was obvious that Crew 2.0 required further improvements, and its main changes could not be released in this form. However, we decided to first develop the solutions you would find most useful, including the Sixth Sense perk as a [b]special commander feature[/b].

Since then, we have been gradually moving forward, refining and improving some of the ideas shown on the Sandbox server. The Sixth Sense perk will be the first Crew improvements from these ideas introduced to the game. In the future, other changes to the Crew concept will follow. However, we will get into more detail about that at a later date.

[h2]Free Sixth Sense: General Rules and Compensation[/h2]

Sixth Sense will become a special feature for [b]all current and future crew commanders[/b] that you recruit, receive, or retrain. It will be available automatically starting from the crew commander’s first battle, regardless of the major qualification level. The mechanics of the Sixth Sense perk will work [b]the same as before[/b].

If any of your commanders already possess the Sixth Sense perk, the XP you spent to train the perk will be fully compensated upon the release of Update 1.18.1, and then automatically re-distributed in the following order of priority:
[olist]
[*] To reach 100% of your commander’s major qualification (if it was below 100%).
[*] To train the last skill of the commander to 100% (if there was any skill that was not fully trained).
[*] The remaining experience will go to the commander experience pool and can be spent on a new skill/perk of your choice.
[/olist][b]Example:[/b]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]UPDATE 1.18[/th]
[th]UPDATE 1.18.1[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Major qualification — [b]100%[/b]

Sixth Sense — [b]100%[/b][/td]
[td]Major qualification — [b]100%[/b]

Sixth Sense — [b]special commander feature[/b]

New skill/perk of your choice — [b]100%[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
If the Sixth Sense perk has not been trained to 100%, then the experience spent on it will go towards reaching 100% of your commander's major qualification. The remaining XP will go back to the commander experience pool, so you can select and start training a new skill/perk of your choice. This new skill/perk will automatically be upgraded to the same level as the original Sixth Sense perk (e.g., 70% for 70%).

[b]Example:[/b]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]UPDATE 1.18[/th]
[th]UPDATE 1.18.1[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Major qualification — [b]90%[/b]

Sixth Sense — [b]70%[/b][/td]
[td]Major qualification — [b]100%[/b]

Sixth Sense — [b]special commander feature[/b]

New skill/perk of your choice — [b]41%*[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[i]*Training the first perk from 0% to 70% requires 51,172 XP. To reach 100% of your commander’s major qualification with 90%, you need 39,153 XP. The remaining 12,019 XP is only enough for 41% of the new skill/perk.[/i]

[quote=]After the release of Update 1.18.1, the Increased Focus directive will no longer be available for purchase. Already purchased/received directives of this type will remain in your Depot, and you can continue to use them to strengthen the effect of the Sixth Sense feature until they are all used up.[/quote]
[h2]Interface Improvements[/h2]

We have also slightly redesigned the crew interface, making it clearer and easier to navigate. Special commander features and zero skills/perks will now be displayed separately. In the screenshots below, you will find these changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2507147def08d3d0eff59b7528a85845c965e5e7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d6bffc06d7227b70d05d0336c75795f73902bf50.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/810c0b3d0cedb0351b71460c2e040a955fe0837c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6bd60368320df7b8286ad7c5f24761b20adbdf63.jpg[/img]

[h2]Sixth Sense as a Zero Perk[/h2]

If your commander possesses Sixth Sense as the zero perk, you will be able to choose any of the 4 basic perks and skills (Repair, Firefighting, Concealment, Brothers in Arms), or any of the major qualification perks in its place as a zero perk (this rule also applies to each crew member who possessed Sixth Sense).

If Sixth Sense was a zero perk and you managed to train some other perks, you can still [b]make them the new zero perk[/b].

[b]Example:[/b]

You have trained 5 perks, including Sound Detection. You will now be able to set Sound Detection as the zero perk. This perk will no longer be on your list of trained perks, and the XP you spent to train it will be compensated and automatically re-distributed in the same order as the fully trained Sixth Sense perk.

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]UPDATE 1.18[/th]
[th]UPDATE 1.18.1[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Sound Detection — [b]40%[/b]

Sixth Sense — [b]zero perk[/b]

Major qualification — [b]100%[/b]

Brothers in Arms— [b]100%[/b]

Firefighting — [b]100%[/b]
[/td]
[td]Sound Detection — [b]zero perk[/b]

Sixth Sense — [b]special commander feature[/b]

Major qualification — [b]100%[/b]

Brothers in Arms — [b]100%[/b]

Firefighting — [b]100%[/b]

New skill/perk of your choice — [b]40%[/b]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Instead of the Sixth Sense zero perk, you can choose any basic skill/perk (Repair, Firefighting, Concealment, Brothers in Arms), or any skill/perk from your crew member's major qualification. For example, for the Commander (other than the basic skills/perks), you can choose from:
[olist]
[*] Jack of All Trades
[*] Mentor
[*] Recon
[*] Eagle Eye
[/olist]Accordingly, if you retrain your Commander to Loader, you’ll be able to choose from:
[olist]
[*] Safe Stowage
[*] Intuition
[*] Adrenaline Rush
[/olist][quote=]Remember, you can only choose a new zero perk once and you won’t be able to change it later.[/quote]
[i]Roll out and stay tuned, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: The Waffenträger: Legacy. Event Guide
notes.content:
[b]The legendary Blitzträger auf E 110 returns to World of Tanks, Commanders![/b]

[b]From September 26 through October 10[/b], The Waffenträger: Legacy will take place, and you'll once again face the extremely powerful [b]Blitzträger auf E 110[/b], the formidable "wonder weapon" of the von Krieger family. But this time, things are a bit different. Instead of the Engineer, his daughter Ermelinda will meet the intruders and show them how hospitable their family can be. Ermelinda will be opposed by the forces of the Alliance, represented by a team of six Harriers.

As always, there are no good or bad sides in this epic conflict. Join the event and earn the right to fight in Random Battles in the legendary Waffenträger auf E 100!

[h3][b]The Waffenträger: Legacy[/b][/h3]
[b]EU:[/b] September 26 at 11:00 CEST through October 10* at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] September 26 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET through October 10* at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] September 26 at 17:00 (UTC+8) through October 10* at 17:00 (UTC+8)

[h3][b]Prime Times (First Event Day)[/b][/h3]
EU1, EU2, EU3: 14:00–00:00 CEST (UTC+2)
EU4: 14:00–20:00 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: 06:00–23:00 PT | 08:00–01:00 CT | 09:00–02:00 ET
HK: 18:00–00:00  (UTC+8)
ANZ: 21:00–03:00  (UTC+11)

[h3][b]Prime Times (All Other Event Days)[/b][/h3]
EU1, EU2, EU3: 12:00–00:00 CEST (UTC+2)
EU4: 14:00–20:00 CEST (UTC+2)
NA: 11:00–23:00 PT | 13:00–01:00 CT | 14:00–02:00 ET
HK: 14:00–00:00  (UTC+8)
ANZ: 17:00–03:00   (UTC+11)

[i]*Please note: The last day of battles will take place on October 9.[/i]

[previewyoutube=tlFGxDIAcLE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Key Changes From the Previous Event[/h2]
[list]
[*] Instead of facing Max von Krieger, the Harriers will be opposed by his daughter, [b]Ermelinda[/b].
[*] The Harrier Squad consists of a team of [b]six random players[/b]—a Platoon of up to three players is allowed. They have unlimited respawns in a single battle, but each subsequent respawn will take more and more time.
[*] If a Harrier vehicle has a load of Plasma on board and is moving [b]faster than 50 km/h[/b], the Plasma counter will slow down, meaning it will disappear later, giving you more time to deliver it to the Generators.
[*] The event progression is now [b]more linear and visually understandable[/b]. You will always know which rewards you can earn and how soon you will achieve the next Progression Stage.
[*] The Waffenträger: Legacy features a ton of cool rewards, including the Engineer's and Harriers' Starters to activate the Gates containing valuable loot, new customizations, bonds, and even rental battles in the Waffenträger auf E 100! The Engineer's Starters will also be available as gifts in bundles in the in-game Store.
[*] The Engineer’s and Harriers’ Gates feature a reward replacement mechanic: You can replace their contents up to three times using a few credits (the Harriers’ Gate) or up to five times using gold (the Engineer’s Gate).
[*] You will have the opportunity to rent the legendary Waffenträger auf E 100 to fight in Random Battles when activating the Engineer's Gate (with a certain drop chance), or it will be a guaranteed reward for completing the event's progression.
[/list][h2]The Waffenträger: Legacy Event Summary[/h2]
[quote=]If you choose to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3360267192919523807][b]transfer your account[/b][/url] to a different region, your event progress and any in-game items received or purchased will be transferred along with your account. You’ll be able to continue your progress from the Stage at which you left off.[/quote][list]
[*] Battles take place [b]in the 6v1 format[/b] on one of three lightly redesigned maps: [b]Murovanka, Siegfried Line, and Steppes[/b].
[*] Before entering battle, you can choose one of the sides in the conflict.
[*] The Harrier Squad—as either a team of six random players or a Platoon of up to three players (Dynamic Platoons are allowed)—will rush into battle in extensively modified special vehicles: the [b]Foudre (Bat.-Châtillon 25 t), Resistor (Object 140), and Thunderbolt (M48A5 Patton)[/b].
[*] Ermelinda will face them in the [b]Blitzträger auf E 110[/b], an incredibly powerful tank destroyer manned by a single player. It will be flanked by AI-controlled guards called [b]Sentinels[/b].
[*] Each team has its own objective: The Harrier Squad must disable the Blitzträger auf E 110’s protective energy shield and [b]destroy this vehicle[/b] within the allotted time, and the Blitzträger auf E 110 must hold out until time expires.
[*] To enter battle in the Blitzträger auf E 110, you need to have a [b]Key[/b]. You can earn it while playing the game mode or receive it as a part of special bundles in the in-game Store. Keep reading to find out about one more way to get a Key for the Blitzträger auf E 110!
[*] Complete special combat missions in the event to get [b]Tokens [/b]that will gradually fill the progression meter. The event’s progression consists of [b]20 Stages[/b]. Upon reaching each Stage, you will receive rewards, including cool customization items, Waffenträger auf E 100 rentals to enter Random Battles, bonds, the Engineer’s and Harriers’ Starters, etc.
[*] In addition to the rewards that you will receive for completing the Progression Stages, you can also get valuable loot through [b]the Gates[/b]. The most coveted prizes are Premium vehicles, including two brand-new ones:

[list]
[*] [b]FV4201 Chieftain Proto[/b], a Tier IX Premium British heavy tank
[*] [b]KV-4 KTTS[/b], a Tier VIII Premium Soviet tank destroyer
[/list][/list]These and 10 other Premium vehicles can only be obtained from the Engineer's Gate with a certain drop rate. Plus, you can rent the legendary [b]Waffenträger auf E 100[/b] to fight in Random Battles!
[list]
[*] The Engineer's Starters are special in-game items you can earn during the event to activate the Engineer’s Gate, which contains cool Premium vehicles and other valuable loot.
[*] There are also the Harriers' Starters for activating the Harriers’ Gate, which has a chance of dropping useful in-game goodies, such as cool 2D styles and other customizations, Personal Reserves, days of WoT Premium Account, etc.
[/list][quote=][b]Mod Performance During the Event[/b]

Popular mods may cause performance issues during The Waffenträger: Legacy. To prevent this from happening, please play without mods or update them.[/quote]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/wargaming/sale/waffentrager2022][h2]The Free DLC[/h2][/url]  
During the event, you can claim the [b]special time-limited DLC “High Voltage Pack”[/b] for free to get a bunch of spectacular event-themed decals, as well as an [b]“Inductor Coil” 2D style[/b]. Transform your favorite vehicle’s appearance into a cool-looking steampunk-style beast! 
 
Moreover, you will get an additional gift of [b]3 Harriers’ Starters[/b] if you claim this DLC and log in to the game [b]until October 9, 2022, 17:00 UTC[/b]. Use them to activate the Harriers’ Gate and get guaranteed useful rewards!   
 
To get the bundle, just click on the link below and add it to your account for free. Please note that it is available only [b]until October 9, 2022, 17:00 UTC[/b] and will disappear from the Store page after that date! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144720/World_of_Tanks__High_Voltage_Pack/
[h2]How to Start Playing[/h2]
[olist]
[*] In your Garage, choose the “The Waffenträger: Legacy” mode in the drop-down menu to the right of the “Battle!” button.
[*] Click the event banner in the lower-right corner of the screen.
[*] Click the interactive 3D portal in your Garage.
[/olist][h2]The Harriers[/h2]

The Alliance once again went on the trail of the von Krieger family and found the coordinates of this base, where the Harrier Squad was immediately sent. But something unexpected happened… Instead of von Krieger, they had to deal with his daughter, Ermelinda. But this doesn’t mean that it will now be easier to triumph in this conflict!

The Harrier Squad consists of [b]six battle Harriers[/b] who will have to take on the extremely powerful Blitzträger auf E 110. You will have the following three special vehicles to choose from in the event Garage:
[list]
[*] [b]Resistor[/b], a versatile multi-role tank
[*] [b]Thunderbolt[/b], a slow tank with decent turret and frontal armor and a formidable gun
[*] [b]Foudre[/b], a speedy tank with an autoloader that sacrifices armor and survivability for greater dynamics
[/list]Choose one of them and click the “Battle!” button to take on Ermelinda’s incredibly powerful combat monster!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ad30b8bfc0eb09d1dfb5715fea5e9cfa28e580fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e8ba70cdecf68d5023282f6ad93b78b662876e15.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4cd555d1238e405d11406441b4907ddd2fc9b040.png[/img]

The Harriers can respawn an unlimited number of times in a single battle, but each subsequent respawn will take more and more time. If your vehicle has a load of Plasma on board and is driving [b]faster than 50 km/h[/b], the Plasma counter will slow down. Take advantage of this to deliver Plasma faster and increase your chances of winning!

[h2]The Harriers’ Missions[/h2]

Completing the Harriers’ missions will reward you with Tokens to fill the event progression meter, as well as Keys that allow you to play in the Blitzträger auf E 110. Some of these missions will also reward you with the Harriers' Starters to activate the Harriers’ Gate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/940166927b372f1ef9039c7c54b0f8faa627f7cf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/18ae1c1f95be4c91e617865d1556c3ca749399f8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/189253f9f6cb7d34ee29547438174501934440a2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/edea25793c6224f2d1040829f25aff1b3ab76c32.png[/img]

[h2]The Blitzträger auf E 110[/h2]

To ride in the mighty Blitzträger auf E 110, you need a special Key. There are several ways to get them, as follows:
[olist]
[*] Complete a special mission in Random Battles (available once per account) to earn one Key. The mission will be available on September 26 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2) and will remain active until October 6 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2). You need to win five Random Battles in Tier IV–X vehicles and be among the top 10 on your team by XP earned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/053e0ac69b4708ec950dbbf7d8255d21ec1e7b36.png[/img]

[*] Complete Harriers’ missions.
[*] Reach certain milestones of the event’s main progression meter.
[/olist]Keys will also be available as free gifts in bundles in the in-game Store during the event.

[quote=]If the queue time to enter battle is too long, or if the number of players in the Blitzträger is insufficient, the matchmaker may allow you to play in the Blitzträger auf E 110 even if you don’t have Keys.

There will be no compensation for unused Keys when the event ends on October 10 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2).[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/71ce69b9e91b342a6dfe924d3f65c40042bd74ae.png[/img]

[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] [b]Gungnir [/b]- A shot that causes considerable damage to enemy vehicles.
[*] [b]EMP Arrow[/b] - A shot with a high-voltage charge that slows down and stuns enemies. Resets Generator Overload points of damaged vehicles.
[*] [b]EMP Burst [/b]- A charge of energy that covers the entire area around the vehicle. Stuns all enemies in the impact area and causes damage to those closest. Passes through all obstacles and resets Generator Overload points of damaged vehicles.
[*] [b]Teleportation[/b] - Allows the vehicle to teleport to a selected point on the map after some delay. Operating the vehicle is impossible during preparation. Cannot be used while the shield is deactivated.
[*] [b]Absorption [/b]- By being near a clump of Plasma on the ground, the vehicle accelerates its evaporation. If, at the moment of evaporation of Plasma, the vehicle is within a 50 m radius of it, it will recover a certain number of hit points and accelerate the Teleportation cooldown.
[/list][/expand]
[h2]The Engineer’s Missions[/h2]

Completing the Engineer’s mission will earn you Tokens and the Engineer’s Starters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/94a5f3190f890362cfdeeb30d33c1dbd0ee73780.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f80ff9af97074030415e0ee7f4cf84509462d81b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7126d1b00ee770fb259956d55c826f652616ad46.png[/img]

[h2]Battle Time Mechanics[/h2]

The initial battle time is five minutes, but this can be increased to up to 15 minutes thanks to the overtime mechanics, which can only trigger once per match. If at least one Harrier vehicle has a load of Plasma on board their vehicle, then the battle time will increase by the time remaining until it disappears, provided that the overtime mechanic has not yet been triggered.

If there are several loads of Plasma in the battle, the load with the most time left will have its time added to the battle timer. If the overtime conditions are met, 60 seconds will be added to the battle time.

So, what happens if a Harrier vehicle has a load of Plasma on board?
[list]
[*] If overtime mechanics have not been triggered, additional battle time will be added according to the above rules.
[*] If overtime mechanics have already been triggered, the timer will remain at zero but the battle will not end.
[*] If the Generator is captured, the battle will increase by the same amount of time as during a normal capture.
[*] If the player leaves the Generator's capture zone and the battle time expires, the Harrier Squad will lose, and the match will end.
[/list][h2]The Blitzträger auf E 220: A Rare-Yet-Coveted Opponent[/h2]

The Blitzträger auf E 220 has the same stats as the E 110, but it features a unique camouflage pattern so you can easily identify it. This is a vehicle that only certain Wargaming employees and famous content creators can unlock. You may encounter it during special days.

If you and your team manage to defeat the E 220, everyone on your team will receive [b]a special medal and one Engineer’s Starter[/b]. Check out the dedicated article for additional information about the big E 220 hunt, including a list of participating content creators and prime hunting times!

[h2]Rush Into Random Battles in the Iconic Waffenträger auf E 100![/h2]

[quote=]To complete the event progression meter and grab all rewards available in the event, you should play [b]for both the Harrier Squad and Ermelinda[/b]. If you skip several missions or only start playing in the middle of the event, it will be hard to catch up and rent the legendary Waffenträger auf E 100.[/quote]
Complete special missions in the event battles to earn Tokens that will gradually fill the progression meter. The progression system consists of 20 Stages, and you need 20 Tokens to complete each Progression Stage. On the progression screen, you will see how many Tokens you still have to earn to complete the Stage and grab the reward.

Reaching each new Stage awards you valuable in-game items, including the following:
[list]
[*] Two unique female crew members with exclusive voiceovers (upon completion of the 10th and 17th Progression Stages)
[*] Imposing event-themed customizations (an emblem, decals, inscriptions, and camos)
[*] The Engineer’s and Harriers’ Starters
[*] Bonds
[*] Days of WoT Premium Account
[/list]But most importantly, upon completion of the final 20th Stage, you will have the opportunity to rent the legendary Waffenträger auf E 100 for five Random Battles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9d2b3a971735675493f762882e45a3f9498a0d6c.jpg[/img]

You will receive the very iconic, incredibly powerful Waffle, a Tier X German tank destroyer that was removed from the game in 2016. If you have previously played in this formidable predator, your daily statistics for this vehicle will be recorded in all Random Battles. You can also obtain additional Waffle battles as loot from the Engineer's Gate with a certain drop rate.

Platoons with the Waffenträger auf E 100 are [b]not allowed[/b].

[quote=]You will be able to play your battles in the rented Waffenträger auf E 100 even after the end of the event, until October 18 at 06:00 CEST (UTC+2). After that, this living legend will be removed from your account, and all unplayed battles will disappear with no compensation.[/quote]
[h2]Gates and Rewards[/h2]

For completing event missions and certain Progression Stages, as well as for defeating the rare Blitzträger auf E 220, you will receive two types of Starters, which are needed for activating the Gates. Through activated Gates, you’ll be able to get valuable loot.

You can earn the Harriers' Starters for completing event missions and progression milestones while playing in Harrier Squad vehicles. These Starters will allow you to activate the Harriers' Gate. It will drop a guaranteed prize from the list below:
[list]
[*] Credits
[*] Personal Reserves
[*] Days of WoT Premium Account
[*] Consumables
[*] Demounting Kits
[*] Garage slots
[/list]Plus, you have a chance to get customization items from previous Waffenträger events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4b7e364e004d713fabb39435aea3526289a0774c.jpg[/img]

By completing the missions while playing in the Blitzträger auf E 110, you earn the Engineer’s Starters. These Starters are used to activate the Engineer's Gate.

You can also get the Engineer's Starters upon completing certain progression milestones, as well as for free with each special bundle in the in-game Store.

[quote=]You’re guaranteed to receive [b]100 gold[/b] each time you activate the Engineer’s Gates for the first time, which can also be used to replace your reward (more on this below). It will be added to your account each time you activate the Engineer's Gate and won’t apply if you replace your reward.[/quote]
Upon each activation, the Engineer's Gate may bring you in-game items from four different categories, each of which has its own drop rate. First, you will receive a guaranteed item from the following list:
[list]
[*] Credits
[*] Personal Reserves
[*] Days of WoT Premium Account
[*] Crew Books
[*] Demounting Kits
[*] Special 2D "Network Meltdown," "Lightning Hunter," and "Breadboard" styles
[/list][h3][b]2D "Network Meltdown" Style[/b][/h3]

If Lady Luck's on your side, you also have a 5% chance to get an imposing Harrier-themed 3D style for the [b]Object 140, Bat.-Châtillon 25 t, or M48A5 Patton[/b]. Each 3D style can only drop once.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]

[/tr]
[/table]
But the most coveted rewards are the rare Tier VIII and IX Premium vehicles, including the brand-new [b]FV4201 Chieftain Proto[/b] and [b]KV-4 KTTS[/b].
[list]
[*] [b]NEW! FV4201 Chieftain Proto[/b]: A multi-role Tier IX Premium British heavy tank with an incredibly tough turret and decent frontal armor, great gun depression angles of –10 degrees, and a respectable 400 HP of damage per shot. Like its brother in arms sitting at Tier X, this heavy boasts an overall good mix of characteristics, allowing it to dominate in positional battles or win one-on-one duels. Depending on the situation on the battlefield, it can lead the attack and carry the team, absorbing enemy shells, or it can perform as a powerful support vehicle, assisting medium tanks.
[*] [b]NEW! KV-4 KTTS[/b]: A Tier VIII Premium Soviet tank destroyer. A rear-mounted turret and its similarity to the KV-4 heavy tank leave a mark on the vehicle's gameplay. Low maneuverability and mediocre mobility are counterbalanced by well-sloped frontal armor, so hitting it will not be easy. The KV-4 KTTS is armed with a 107 mm high-penetrating gun that causes 360 HP of damage per shot and has a reload time of under nine seconds. With its rear-mounted turret and 90-degree gun traverse limits (45 degrees to either side), it can successfully use side-scraping tactics at the most effective angles from both cover and open terrain.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f6c2b2c03d072db590cefd57722f36ee136cfef2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4b05ff8748d6507ff82eedaf8f06e3bb9cb54961.png[/img]

Apart from these menacing hunters, you may receive a Premium vehicle—one that you do not have in your Garage yet—with a Garage slot from the following list with a 2.4% drop rate:
[list]
[*] [b]Chieftain/T95[/b] : A Tier VIII Premium British medium tank. The well-angled upper glacis plate and strong turret armor make it perfect for frontal assaults. It may confidently follow the mediums path on almost any map, and with your armor, you can bully same-tier medium and even heavy tanks.
[*] [b]M-IV-Y[/b] : A Tier VIII American heavy tank from the Yoh branch featuring the reserve track mechanics. This well-armored tank has good mobility for a heavy and is armed with a menacing 105 mm gun that causes 360 HP of damage per shot.
[*] [b]EMIL 1951[/b] : An outstanding support Tier VIII Swedish Premium heavy with a strong turret that features a powerful autoloader. It can easily switch roles between a mighty frontline brawler and a menacing flanker thanks to its good mobility.
[*] [b]ASTRON Rex 105 mm [/b]: A Tier VIII American medium tank. A universal soldier with a five-round autoloader and 1,600 HP of potential damage!
[*] [b]VK 75.01 (K)[/b] : A Tier VIII German heavy tank with solid armor and a powerful gun.
[*] [b]M54 Renegade[/b] : A Tier VIII American heavy tank and a true all-rounder, featuring an easily penetrating sharpshooting gun with 360 HP of damage per shot.
[*] [b]Škoda T 27[/b] : A Tier VIII Czechoslovakian medium tank with a fast autoloader gun and great dynamics.
[*] [b]Kampfpanzer 07 RH[/b] : A Tier VIII German medium tank that sits at the junction of medium and light vehicles. Its 9 cm gun features good stabilization, rapid loading time, and a high rate of fire
[*] [b]AltProto AMX 30[/b] : A Tier VIII French medium tank that features the second-highest armor penetration value with a standard shell (232 mm) among all Tier VIII medium tanks.
[*] [b]M48A2 Räumpanzer[/b] : A Tier VIII German medium tank. It is equipped with a real bulldozer blade that serves as a screen, as well as a fast-firing gun that lets you fire every 7.6 seconds!
[/list]Finally, the Engineer's Gate has a chance of dropping [b]10 Random Battles in the legendary Waffenträger auf E 100[/b]*!

[i]*10 rental battles in the Waffenträger auf E 100 may drop no more than five times per account.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/75f5871dfaad362f888c42b021f523833b58955d.jpg[/img]

[quote=]There will be a special guaranteed vehicle counter in the game client. Each time you get a Premium tank, the counter is reset, and the countdown to the next vehicle drop starts over. After you receive all the vehicles, this counter will become unavailable.[/quote]
[h2]The Engineer's Gate: How It Works[/h2]
[list]
[*] When a vehicle drops from the Engineer’s Gate, a slot in the Garage is credited first, and information about it will be displayed in the in-game notification center.
[*] If you receive a vehicle that is already in your Garage, it will be replaced by any vehicle from the above list that you don’t already have in your Garage.
[*] If you already have all the vehicles from the list, the cost of the dropped tank will be compensated with gold.
[*] If you have sold a Premium vehicle from the list above and it can be restored using the in-game Vehicle Restoration tool, it may drop from the Engineer's Gate at the standard drop rate. However, it will be compensated with gold instead.
[/list][h2]Guaranteed Vehicle Mechanics[/h2]

If you spent [b]49 Engineer's Starters[/b] but still did not receive a Premium vehicle, then with the 50th activation of the Engineer's Gate, you are guaranteed to receive a random Premium tank that you don’t have already from the list above, as well as a Garage.

If you already have all the vehicles from the list in the Garage, then the guaranteed vehicle mechanics will be disabled.

[h2]The Reward Replacement Mechanic[/h2]

The Waffenträger: Legacy event features a [b]reward replacement mechanic[/b], meaning you can replace your current prize. Each reward replacement counts towards a guaranteed vehicle and takes you one step closer to getting a Premium tank.

The Harriers’ Gates can be reactivated up to three times for [b]credits[/b].
[list]
[*] The first replacement costs 25,000 credits, the second 50,000 credits, and the third 100,000 credits.
[/list]The Engineer’s Gates can be reactivated up to five times for [b]gold[/b].
[list]
[*] The first three replacements cost 250 gold each, and the rest are 500 gold each.
[/list]You cannot replace your reward if the Engineer’s Gates drops a Premium vehicle or compensation in gold.

[h2]Exclusive Crew Members[/h2]

Ermelinda Jung and her Alliance antagonist, Villanelle Rapière, are ready to join the ranks of your commanders! Upon completion of certain event milestones, you’ll be able to recruit these unique characters with exclusive voiceovers. They come with 100%-trained Brother in Arms as a zero perk and enough XP to learn three additional skills or perks of your choice.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/efa8ceec1bf2362b14aef79a3ca757a977a4fe77.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6c423ffd0dd9f311301eb9c17abe377a078585fe.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]            [b]Ermelinda Jung[/b][/td]
[td]          [b]Villanelle Rapière[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Neither crew member is affiliated with any nation, so you can assign them to any vehicle in your Garage. Initially, they can only be recruited as commanders, but you can change their major qualifications using gold.

[quote=]If you retrain them to any qualification other than commander, their unique voiceovers will no longer be available. But if you retrain them as commanders, their voiceovers will become available again.[/quote]
[h2]The Medals[/h2]

Achieve at least one victory over the Blitzträger auf E 110 or the Harrier Squad, and you will be decorated with the corresponding medal. There’s a third one, but getting it requires a bit of luck, as you need to defeat the Blitzträger auf E 220.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d0d4345853f6f41f0648fdda9334a93f5f9100ab.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bda70751884cbd764b43b145e84ca1c2266eac28.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4ca48bc435367616cbcc74435da41e79504fb2a7.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]           [b]Semiconductor[/b][/td]
[td]         [b]Too Old to Die Jung[/b][/td]
[td]             [b]Free Electron[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h2]Special Bundles[/h2]

There are four special bundles available during the event. These bundles include free Keys that are required to play in the Blitzträger auf E 110. Plus, each bundle contains a set of exclusive event-themed decals to customize your vehicles, as well as the Engineer’s Starters to activate the Engineer’s Gate as gifts.

[h2]What Will Happen to the Keys and Starters After the Event Ends?[/h2]

After the end of the event on October 10 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2), all unused Keys to play in the Blitzträger auf E 110 will disappear, and the corresponding number of Gates will be activated automatically. All items from them will be automatically credited to your account. All event vehicles will be deducted and all XP earned in them will be moved to the MS-1. All Collection Items, rewards, and loot from the Gates remain with you permanently. You will be able to play your battles in the rented Waffenträger auf E 100 until October 18 at 06:00 CEST (UTC+2).

[h2]Tune in for the Event Streams![/h2] 
 
During the event, the streams on the World of Tanks Steam Store page will show you exciting gameplay from the event, so make sure to check them out while you’re taking a break from the action-packed battles between the Harriers and Ermelinda!  

[i]Join the Harrier Squad or drive the Blitzträger itself, and earn the right to rock out with the legendary Waffle in Random Battles![/i]

notes.title: Onslaught: A New Competitive Mode Is Coming to World of Tanks!
notes.content:
[b]Get ready to test your battle mastery against your fellow commanders in a brand-new game mode with fresh mechanics![/b]

[b]From October 12 through November 20[/b], you will have the opportunity to face players of equal rating and find out who’s the strongest. Battles in Onslaught will take place in the 7v7 format in Tier X vehicles only, and will take place during the [b]Season of the Griffin[/b]. The mode features many new gameplay mechanics, and among the large number of rewards you will find unique progressive 2D styles that will highlight your achievements. Read on for more details!

[h2]Onslaught: A New Mode to Test Your Skills[/h2]
[list]
[*] In this exciting new mode, battles take place with collectible and researchable [b]Tier X vehicles only and in the 7v7 format[/b]. You must have at least one Tier X tank in your Garage to participate in the Onslaught mode.
[*] The matchmaker will be selecting both allies and opponents for teams based on the [b]mode’s Ranked System[/b]. It will take your position into account and find opponents with a similar rating to yours.
[*] During the countdown before entering battle, you will be able to select [b]a different Tier X vehicle in the pre-battle lobby[/b] or switch to a different set of equipment, shells, and consumables.
[*] All vehicles in this mode feature their own [b]combat roles[/b]. Depending on your role, you will have a unique Role Skill with three levels of charge. The higher the charge level, the stronger the effect of the skill will be. To upgrade your Role Skill level, earn Prestige Points in battles for performing any useful action. You will earn more Prestige Points for actions that are most relevant to your combat role.
[*] By capturing Points of Interest on the map, you can activate [b]Tactical Skills[/b] and help your teammates gain an advantage over your opponents.
[*] Instead of the classic three-player Platoons, Onslaught features two-player squads. You can also create a [b]team of seven[/b] Commanders and fight against an opposing Super Platoon.
[*] Onslaught offers [b]two lines of rewards[/b]. The first line features a unique progressive 2D style, Dog Tag elements, and more, and is based on your Rank. The second features more traditional, valuable rewards, such as bonds and pieces of equipment, and is based on the number of victories. You'll also be able to earn Battle Pass Points while playing Onslaught.
[/list]To make the new mode the perfect place for the best of the best to compete on an equal playing field, we're introducing many new gameplay mechanics. All of them are designed to further enhance Onslaught's competitiveness. Let’s take a look at them individually.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png[/img]
[h2]Pre-Battle Lobby[/h2]

In the pre-battle lobby during the countdown before battle, you can change your selected vehicle. Be sure to prepare it for battle, though—it must be repaired and have a full crew and ammo loaded. You can also select an alternative set of equipment, shells, and consumables. You will also see your vehicle and your allies at the starting positions on the map.

[h2]Prestige Points and Vehicle Role Skills[/h2]

All vehicles in Onslaught have special roles depending on their conduct on the battlefield. During the course of each battle, you earn [b]Prestige Points[/b] according to your role and combat performance.

Depending on its role, each vehicle type features a special [b]Role Skill[/b] with three levels of charge. All vehicles of the same combat role have the same skills. For example, assault heavy tanks have Field Repairs at their disposal, which, after activation, creates a zone that gradually restores the vehicle's and its teammates' HP within a certain radius. Assault medium tanks can use the Fury skill, which reduces reload time by a few seconds. There are many other Role Skills in the mode, so every vehicle will have the opportunity to better fulfill its purposes on the battlefield.

At the start of a battle, all Role Skills are unavailable. To activate a Role Skill, you need to have at least one level of charge. Perform your best in battles and earn Prestige Points to unlock and improve your Role Skill from level 1 to 3. The higher the charge level, the more powerful the effect of your Role Skill. Upon activation, you spend all accumulated charge. You can reuse your Role Skill after a cooldown.

Prestige Points also affect how many [b]Rating Points[/b] you gain or lose, which are needed to advance through the mode's progression.

[h2]Maps and Points of Interest[/h2]

Battles in Onslaught will unfold on the following select set of Random Battle maps:

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
