Some of these maps have been slightly reworked specifically for Onslaught to make the battles more engaging and competitive. We’ve added additional firing and cover positions, passes, etc.

Each map in Onslaught has special Points of Interest called [b]Artillery Headquarters[/b] and [b]Communication (Comms) Center[/b]. Having captured a Point of Interest, you'll be able to activate a unique Tactical Skill to gain an advantage over your opponents.
[list]
[*] If you capture the [b]Artillery Headquarters[/b], you can command an [b]Artillery Strike[/b] on the selected area, stunning and causing damage to enemy vehicles.
[*] Capturing the [b]Comms Center[/b] allows you to use [b]Divisional Radar[/b]. Upon its activation, all enemy vehicles remain spotted for three seconds.
[*] Depending on the map, the location and number of Points of Interest may vary.
[*] The Point of Interest capture time is [b]15 seconds[/b] for the Artillery Headquarters and[b] seven seconds[/b] for the Comms Center. Only one vehicle can capture a Point of Interest.
[*] To reset a Points of Interest’s capture progress, cause HP damage or critical damage to the capturing enemy vehicle. Accordingly, you will lose all capture progress each time you get damaged, and you won’t be able to capture this Point of Interest again for five seconds. However, your allies and opponents can capture this Point of Interest without restriction.
[*] If you don’t activate your Tactical Skill, you won’t be able to re-capture the Point of Interest it belongs to.
[/list][h2]Fog of War[/h2]

To make battles even more unpredictable, Onslaught features the Fog of War mechanic. At the beginning of a battle, teams won’t know the location and strength (i.e., vehicle types and models) of the enemy forces until they’re spotted.

[h2]Get Ready to Fight in Super Platoons![/h2]

Choose to fight solo or create a two-player Platoon with your friend. You can also join a Super Platoon of seven teammates of equal rating and fight against an opposing Super Platoon.

[quote=]To create a Platoon with your teammate, the difference between the highest and lowest Rating Points value of both players should not exceed 350 Points. If you want to fight as a seven-player Super Platoon, the difference between the highest and lowest Rating Points value among all players should not exceed 490 Points.[/quote]
[h2]Battle Communication[/h2]

In Onslaught, you will be able to communicate with your teammates and coordinate your tactics [b]via voice chat[/b]. This will be disabled by default, but you can enable it with one touch using the "H" key (default) or directly in the mode interface. All players who are in voice chat will be marked with a special icon.

[quote=]The Platoon/Super Platoon voice chat turns into a team chat upon entering the pre-battle lobby.

If you have not turned off voice communication while in a Platoon, you will be automatically connected to the team chat at the start of the battle.[/quote]
[h2]Compete With Equal-Rating Rivals![/h2]

Throughout the Season of the Griffin, your experience and individual mastery will be your main advantages. In Onslaught, the matchmaker will take your position in the mode’s Ranked System into account and automatically find opponents close to your rating. It will assemble teams of [b]equal strength[/b] based on their rating gained in Onslaught. As a result, players will clash with each other in intense battles, fighting on an equal playing field to discover who is best.

[quote=]In Onslaught, the matchmaker evenly distributes players of different Ranks and Divisions. Players who differ by 7 Divisions cannot be matched in the same battle.[/quote]
[h2]Ranked System: Watch Your Mastery Grow![/h2]

Set yourself apart from the crowd with the progression system [b]with a rating[/b] that shows your performance and reflects the growth of your mastery. The higher it is, the greater your status—and reward!—will be.

The mode’s progression is called [b]Ranked System[/b] and consists of [b]Ranks and Divisions[/b]. To reach new Ranks and Divisions, you need to win battles and earn Rating Points. Your rating directly depends on your results: The more effectively you battle, the more Rating Points you get for each victory.

You can also lose your earned Rating Points for defeats, draws, abandoning the battle before it ends, or long inactivity in the mode (more on that below).

In total, there are seven Ranks in the mode:
[list]
[*] Debutant
[*] Iron
[*] Bronze
[*] Silver
[*] Gold
[*] Champion
[*] Legend
[/list]The first five Ranks comprise four Divisions—D, C, B, and A—while the two remaining top Ranks—[b]Champion and Legend[/b]—have only one Division.

But the most prestigious and honorable is the [b]Legend Rank[/b]. Only 10% of the most skilled and persistent Commanders who manage to enter the mode's Leaderboard will be able to reach this elite ranking.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/onslaught-announcement-2022/#head-id-8 style=button][b]Learn more[/b][/url]

[h2]Leaderboard and Rank Inactivity[/h2]

Onslaught will feature its own dynamic Leaderboard in the game client. It will only display players who have reached the two top Ranks, Champion and Legend. The player's position on the Leaderboard depends on the number of Rating Points they have earned. If several players have the same number of Rating Points, the player who has played more battles in Onslaught will take the higher position.

If you are not active in the mode for a certain period, the number of Rating Points you've earned will gradually decrease. This mechanic will only apply to Silver, Gold, Champion and Legend Rank players.

In addition, each battle played in these four Ranks rewards you with a certain number of activity charges. These charges gradually fill your activity bar and cannot exceed 14 charges. Activity charges can also be obtained by reaching a Rank for which the rank inactivity mechanics apply (i.e., Silver, Gold, Champion and Legend). If you don't have any activity charges, you will lose a certain number of Rating Points, depending on your Rank.

[h2]Season Rewards[/h2]

Now, to the most tantalizing topic: rewards! The Season of the Griffin brings two lines of rewards.

The first reward line includes unique status customization items that will spark envy in other commanders. To get your hands on these rewards, you need to advance through the progression.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/onslaught-announcement-2022/#head-id-10 style=button][b]Learn more[/b][/url]

After you play your first battle in the mode, you will get a unique progressive 2D style that can be applied (and then re-applied, if you wish) to any Tier X vehicle. You will immediately receive Level I of this style. As you reach new Ranks or significant achievements in a specific battle or series of battles, your style will gain new 2D elements, such as emblems, inscriptions (after completing special missions available in Onslaught), and camos.

The maximum Level VII style with the most imposing camo is awarded when you make it to the Legend Rank. In total, you can earn up to five copies of the style during the Season of the Griffin.

Reaching new Ranks will also earn you extra exclusive customizations, including the following:
[list]
[*] [b]Unique Dog Tag elements[/b], such as Engravings and Backgrounds

notes.title: 2022 Fall Plans: Waffenträger, a Brand-New Mode, and Spooky Surprises
notes.content:
[b]The heat of the summer season has ended, but even more fun awaits you this fall, Commanders![/b]

Get ready to take part in a whole series of exciting activities and try out some long-awaited game modes! Mark your calendars and stick around, because this fall will be full of specials and surprises. Here’s what you can expect in World of Tanks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/65662210ea930cf9797dbd23caac699943bb7584.jpg[/img]

[h2]Battle Pass 2022: Season IX[/h2]

Battle Pass Season IX kicked off on September 8, and it’s chock-full of valuable rewards, including 3D styles, unique crew members, Bounty Equipment, and more! This Season features three new Core Vehicles: [b]AMX 13 105, Progetto M40 mod. 65, and 60TP Lewandowskiego[/b]. You can complete Chapters in any order or pause one Chapter to switch over to another. Roll out, earn Points and Tokens before they reset, and receive rewards. It's going to be an exciting Season!

[h2]Global Map Season 19[/h2]

An exciting new journey on the Global Map is about to begin! Season 19 will kick off on September 19, promising you thrilling battles and tactical challenges. It will follow the same rules as the previous Season but with an updated list of rewards. Clan warriors—it’s your time to shine!

[h2]The Waffenträger: Legacy[/h2]

What is September without the Waffenträger? This fall, one of the most anticipated game modes is making a comeback, featuring adrenaline-fueled battles with familiar rules. The formidable Blitzträger auf E 110 and the Harriers are ready for a new round of epic confrontations. Which side will you choose?

Participate in the event to earn useful rewards such as bonds, unique crew members, days of WoT Premium account and more. Apart from the rewards for completing event Progression Stages, you can receive lots of valuable loot from Dimension Gates, including two brand-new Premium vehicles: [b]FV4201 Chieftain Proto, a Tier IX Premium British heavy tank[/b], and [b]KV-4 KTTS, a Tier VIII Premium Soviet tank destroyer[/b]!  

And, of course, don’t forget about the [b]special time-limited DLC[/b] that is available for free [b]until October 9, 2022, 17:00 UTC[/b]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144720/World_of_Tanks__High_Voltage_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/4649425839615993654
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/wargaming/sale/waffentrager2022 style=button][h3][b]Visit the Sales page[/b][/h3][/url]

[h2]Onslaught: A New Competitive Mode Is Coming![/h2]

A brand-new thrilling mode called Onslaught is coming to World of Tanks! Prepare your Tier X vehicles to fight for glory and honor. Exciting battles and a host of fresh gameplay mechanics await! Onslaught will feature the following:
[list]
[*] Intense 7v7 clashes in Tier X vehicles only
[*] A pre-battle lobby where you can select a different tank from your Garage and prepare your vehicle during the countdown ahead of battle
[*] Special Tactical Skills you can activate after capturing certain key positions on the map
[*] Unique vehicle Role Skills that can be upgraded over the course of the battle
[*] 2-player squads and Super Platoons of 7 players—handpick your Platoon members and play to your strengths
[*] A rating system that takes your progression position into account and finds opponents with similar ratings
[*] And much more!
[/list]Get ready to face your fellow commanders and find out who’s the strongest!

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3398551594417802749
[h2]Halloween 2022[/h2]

The upcoming spooky season will be perfect for cozy fall evenings. If you're on the hunt for a light-hearted, dynamic, and exciting Halloween, don’t miss our friendly party this October! It’s your chance to enjoy an intense PvP mode with a fascinating story that features a team of colorful witches and a bad-tempered cat.

[i]Stay tuned and get ready for a fun-filled fall, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: New Personal Reserves: Simple, Efficient, and Easy to Use
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Commanders![/b]

Update 1.18.1 will bring a fresh batch of upgrades to World of Tanks. One of these upgrades will be the introduction of reworked Personal Reserves, which are easier to use, simpler, and more efficient than ever before. However, since this change will affect a number of valuable in-game items, we want to share all of the details with you in advance.

[previewyoutube=UAMDkws6KlM;full][/previewyoutube]

Personal Reserves are great assets, but, at the moment, they also have some drawbacks:
[list]
[*] They are hard to locate and navigate through
[*] There are too many types of them, way too many unusual durations (like 4 or 6 hours), and miniscule bonus values (like +10% or +15%)
[/list]For these reasons, Personal Reserves too often gather dust in players’ Depots. Instead, we want you to get the most value possible from Personal Reserves with minimum extra effort.

Let’s see what will improve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png[/img]
[h2]Easy to Use[/h2]

Personal Reserves will have a new access point in your Garage that will indicate which Reserves are currently activated and how much time you have left for each.

The old way of activating Personal Reserves was a bit complicated. You’ll now be able to do it in just a couple of clicks.

The new Personal Reserves activation and management screen will be accessible via the top bar in the Garage. On the screen, you will also see the following:
[list]
[*] All Reserve types available in the game: Personal Reserves (for Combat XP, credits, Crew and Free XP), Event Reserves, and Clan Reserves
[*] The number of Reserves on your account
[*] The time remaining for each activated Reserve
[/list]You will also be able to purchase Personal Reserves directly from this screen, saving you valuable playtime.

Moreover, [b]you will even be able to activate Personal Reserves when in battle[/b]. Just press Tab (or hit the B key) and select a Reserve.

Some might say, “What’s so special about activating Personal Reserves mid-fight? Under the current rules, if the bonus expires while I’m in battle, it will still be applied to the results.” Well, just imagine you roll out with no Personal Reserves activated—just as a warmup—and then the battle goes exceptionally well for you. With the current system, you wouldn’t be able to capitalize on your performance. However, this will change with Update 1.18.1, and you’ll be able to activate Personal Reserves before the fight is over! The bonus will apply to the results of the entire battle, not just what you earned after activation.

On top of that, once the effect of an activated Personal Reserve ends, you’ll get a notification showing the amount of extra credits / Combat XP / Crew and Free XP gained. The notification will also feature a button leading to the Personal Reserves activation screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png[/img]
[h2]Simple and Efficient[/h2]

To complement the reworked UI, we reviewed and improved the basic mechanics of Personal Reserves by streamlining them and increasing their efficiency.
[list]
[*] [b]All Personal Reserves will have the same duration: 1 hour[/b]. Your questionnaire answers revealed that most players preferred 1‑hour Personal Reserves, so we hope this change will be well received.
[*] [b]There will only be three categories of Personal Reserves: for extra credits, for extra Combat XP, and the combined one for Crew and Free XP[/b]. The reasoning is simple: There are only three Personal Reserve slots, and you shouldn’t have to choose which type to leave out when you’re filling in all the slots.
[*] [b]There will only be two types of Personal Reserve bonus values: Standard and Improved[/b]. Once again, this is for simplicity and transparency. We believe that playing World of Tanks should be about having fun on the battlefield, not about estimating comparative values of various Reserves in the Depot.
In the table below, you can see the entire range of new Personal Reserves:

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]PERSONAL RESERVE TYPE[/th]
[th]FOR COMBAT XP[/th]
[th]FOR CREW + FREE XP[/th]
[th]FOR CREDITS[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Standard[/td]
[td]+50%[/td]
[td]+200%[/td]
[td]+50%[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Improved[/td]
[td]+100%[/td]
[td]+300%[/td]
[td]+100%[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[*] Standard Reserves will be awarded for taking part in in-game events and activities. Improved Reserves will come from in-game purchases or as part of in-game Store packages.
[*] [b]With Update 1.18.1, it will be technically possible for Standard Personal Reserves to have an expiration date[/b] (after which they disappear from the player’s account). Please note that we will not be using this functionality in the foreseeable future. Here’s what it means for players:  

[list]
[*] [b]Improved Personal Reserves will not have expiration date[/b].
[*] [b]Converted Personal Reserves will not have expiration date[/b]. This applies to both Standard and Improved Personal Reserves.
[*] Battle Pass, Well-Deserved Reward, Holiday Ops, or any other current and upcoming activities will NOT distribute Personal Reserves with an expiration date anytime soon. 
[/list][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8d04cab72b9d4891686699528f2d3a1684ce3077.png[/img]
[h2]The Principles of Personal Reserve Conversion[/h2]

As the new Personal Reserves all have a duration of 1 hour, and given that there will only be two bonus values per type (Standard and Improved), we will have to convert all existing Personal Reserves. With this conversion, [b]the combined value of new Personal Reserves on your account will be greater than or equal to the combined value of old Personal Reserves on your account[/b].

The value of an old Personal Reserve can be defined as its bonus (in %) multiplied by its duration in hours. The value of a new Personal Reserve is simply its bonus (in %) since the new Personal Reserves all have a duration of 1 hour.

Therefore, during this conversion, the value of your Personal Reserves will stay the same or grow. The quantity of new Personal Reserves will always be rounded up, and you will not lose any value during the conversion.

Personal Reserves with a numeric value that exists in the new system but a long duration (e.g., 2 hours) will be converted into the respective number of 1-hour Reserves.
[quote=][b]EXAMPLE:[/b]

You have seven 2-hour Personal Reserves for +50% to Combat XP. After the conversion, you will get fourteen 1-hour Standard Personal Reserves for +50% to Combat XP.
[/quote]
Personal Reserves with numeric values that do not exist in the new system (e.g., +15% to credits) will have their bonuses “compressed” so that the total value for the player remains the same or increases.

[quote=][b]EXAMPLE:[/b]

You have two 4-hour Personal Reserves for +15% to credits. After the conversion, you will get three 1-hour Personal Reserves for +50% to credits. Why? One 4-hour Personal Reserve with a bonus of 15% has a value of 60% (15% × 4). As the closest new Personal Reserve bonus value is 50%, you should get 2.4 of the new Reserves (1.2 × 2). This rounds up in your favor to three. With the new Reserve, in 1 hour, you will earn approximately the same number of extra credits that you would earn in 4 hours with the old Reserve.[/quote]
Personal Reserves for Crew XP and Free XP on your account will be converted into the new combined Personal Reserves for Crew and Free XP as follows. First, the converter will assess the quantity, bonuses, and duration of the Reserves (separately for Reserves with Standard and Improved bonuses). Then, the converter will calculate the number of new combined Personal Reserves that would appear after the conversion of Personal Reserves for Crew XP and Personal Reserves for Free XP. After that, the converter will choose the greater value and add the resulting number of new combined Personal Reserves on your account.

[quote=][b]EXAMPLE:[/b]

You have eight 2-hour Personal Reserves for +300% to Crew XP and eleven 2-hour Personal Reserves for +300% to Free XP. After the conversion, you will get twenty-two 1-hour combined Personal Reserves for +300% to Crew and Free XP. Why? One 2-hour Personal Reserve with a bonus of 300% has a value of 600% (300% × 2). The total value of eight 2-hour Personal Reserves is 4,800%, and in case with eleven 2-hour Personal Reserves is 6,600%, which is the greater of the two. By dividing 6,600% by 300%, we get 22.[/quote]
[i]Commanders, we hope you enjoy the reworked Personal Reserves system and UI. Game on![/i]

tags.feature: Update 1.18.1 will bring a fresh batch of upgrades to World of Tanks. One of these upgrades will be the introduction of reworked Personal Reserves, which are easier to use, simpler, and more efficient than ever before.
Personal Reserves will have a new access point in your Garage that will indicate which Reserves are currently activated and how much time you have left for each.
The new Personal Reserves activation and management screen will be accessible via the top bar in the Garage.
Moreover, you will even be able to activate Personal Reserves when in battle.
On top of that, once the effect of an activated Personal Reserve ends, you’ll get a notification showing the amount of extra credits / Combat XP / Crew and Free XP gained.

tags.balance_change: All Personal Reserves will have the same duration: 1 hour.
There will only be three categories of Personal Reserves: for extra credits, for extra Combat XP, and the combined one for Crew and Free XP.
There will only be two types of Personal Reserve bonus values: Standard and Improved.

notes.title: [UPDATED] Battle Pass Season IX: Event Guide
notes.content:
[b]Commanders! [/b]

Welcome to [b]Battle Pass Season IX[/b], taking place from September 8th through November 30th.

Start off with a Chapter of your choosing, then complete the Stages one by one to enter a world of excellent rewards. This Season, these include progressive 3D styles for the Season IX Core Vehicles: [b]the 60TP Lewandowskiego, the Progetto M40 mod. 65, and the AMX 13 105[/b] (the first-ever light tank in a Battle Pass lineup). Keep in mind that this will be the last season of Battle Pass in 2022, which means you have to spend all your Battle Pass Tokens before they are reset. Luckily, there are plenty of valuable rewards on offer. Do you have a Cobra yet? Want some more rare Tier IX vehicles for your Garage? Well, this is your chance!

[h3][b]Battle Pass Season IX[/b][/h3]

[b]EU[/b]: September 8 at 07:00 CEST (UTC+2) through November 30 at 01:30 CET (UTC+1)
[b]NA[/b]: September 8 at 03:00 PT | 05:00 CT | 06:00 ET through November 29 at 23:30 PT | November 30 at 01:30 CT | 02:30 ET.
[b]ASIA[/b]: September 8 at 03:00 UTC+8 through November 29 at 02:00 UTC+8

[previewyoutube=qo90_SV3sKA;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote=][b][UPDATED] 07/09/2022[/b]
 
Taking the discussion on the matter into consideration, we’ve decided NOT to make Personal Reserves from Season IX Base rewards time-limited after Update 1.18.1. Therefore, ALL Personal Reserves you obtain as Battle Pass Season IX rewards will have no expiration date, whether you collect them before or after 1.18.1 hits.
 
Regarding time-limited Personal Reserves in general, we will introduce them as an in-game entity with Update 1.18.1. Yet we have no plans to use them in in-game activities in foreseeable future.
 
Once the new mechanics are introduced, all Personal Reserves on your account will be converted into the new reserves at no loss of value. Expect a dedicated article on the new Personal Reserves in the coming days.[/quote]
[h2]The Rewards[/h2]

If you played the previous two Battle Pass Seasons of 2022, you know the drill: Earn Battle Pass Points and complete Stages to receive rewards. Start with any Chapter and switch between Chapters as often as you wish without losing your progress. If you would like more comprehensive instructions or just want to know every single detail about Season IX, check out the full guide.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/content/guide/general/battle_pass/ style=button][b]TO THE FULL GUIDE[/b][/url]

The mountain of Battle Pass Season IX prizes is already towering high, but you can make it even taller by obtaining an[b] Improved Pass[/b]. 

Soon, we will announce all of the improvements we’re going to make to the mechanics and UI of Personal Reserves. But for now, here are the key changes:
[list]
[*] All Personal Reserves will have a duration of [b]one hour[/b].
[*] Personal Reserves for [b]Crew XP[/b] and [b]Free XP[/b] will be merged into a single combined type. (This also applies to Season IX progression rewards.)
[*] Along with the three types of Personal Reserves, there will be [b]two grades of bonuses[/b]: [b]Standard [/b](+50% to XP / +50% to credits / +200% to Crew and Free XP) and [b]Improved [/b](+100% to XP / +100% to credits / +300% to Crew and Free XP).
[*] [strike]Newly-issued Standard Personal Reserves, including those from Season IX Base Rewards, [b]will have an expiration date[/b] (one month after Season IX ends), but Improved Personal Reserves will not.[/strike]
[/list]Once the new mechanics are introduced, all Personal Reserves on your account will be converted into the new reserves at no loss of value. Personal Reserves that are collected as Season IX Base Rewards before the implementation of the new mechanics will not have expiration dates after being converted. Moreover, Personal Reserves that come as Improved Rewards will never have expiration dates.

You can expect a dedicated article on the new Personal Reserves mechanics in the coming days.

[h2]The 3D Styles[/h2]

The Season IX 3D styles give the Core Vehicles a cutting-edge appearance, bristling with innovation.
[list]
[*] [b]The Bernard 3D style[/b] for the 60TP Lewandowskiego  turns this tough tank into a truly stylish moving stronghold.
[*] [b]The Cesare 3D style[/b] for the Progetto M40 mod. 65  makes this sharpshooter look even sharper.
[*] [b]The Le Vizir 3D style[/b] for the AMX 13 105  gives this nimble-yet-dangerous reconnaissance vehicle a hi-tech visual upgrade.

notes.title: The Outpost Hits Random Battles!
notes.content:
The [b]Outpost [/b]is the latest location to appear in the game. Although this map is brand new, it may already be familiar to many curious tankers who took part in Recon Mission 2021, in which Outpost became a fan favorite. Now it's here to stay with improved visuals, fine-tuned gameplay, and a powerful soundtrack. Let’s look, learn, and listen!

[previewyoutube=1exxFQVwhKA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Enjoy the Views[/h2]

During Recon Mission 2021, the focus was mainly on the gameplay of Outpost. However, over this last year, our art team has done their best to scale up the appearance of the map and give it more character. Thanks to all of the new special details, we were able to give Outpost a look that fits more closely with its approximate location in Central Europe (with maybe a slight turn to the East). Check out the map’s vistas below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4fad5c0ebf099580bac0ae84554686187e4c6cf5.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/22ae8b41e62a7a7a7a880af1d20d3329706e5a96.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3cb6f6f871bd74b541f799fd1788353acfa23000.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a65108fdeb4898a68150bd77379973db8842e5ee.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/95e5a6adb622ab91786ee9e4484a4894806b26dc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/238826d9d9faf65c0aa585747b95744e595f2e6a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ef23837e26d4cf831600fd4025f057d76b364e2a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/77ce87536335379b0f43c73aa24fa62a67f543ba.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0d2a39acb41be58506c1d30e50401ad7efc08307.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a21671b2e6da302504e06ce7769cd34e0fa94a2e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d29952d11f551fc576e0666cc5a2518f4d427f1e.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]Play in Various Ways[/h2]

Outpost is a summer map with lots of open space. It has multiple gameplay zones, allowing every vehicle type to shine and every tactical approach to be tried out. Each zone has its own unique landscape and special objects so you always know where you are on the map. The main landmark is the castle on a hill, which dominates the entire location. 

[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]                     [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3b0f06d9c883cca85416210a8df7cc585f024879.png[/img]                                                [/td]
[td]      [/td]
[td][b]I would suggest you play carefully and avoid doing risky rushes, as your teammates might not be ready to support such ventures on an unfamiliar map. Besides, it has a lot of open space where you can attract some unwanted attention of the enemy TDs. Start out defensive, secure the urban area with your heavies and make sure you are working as a team![/b]

[i]PeacefulSoldier, WoT Steam Community Manager[/i]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][h2]Hear the Story[/h2]

The Outpost soundtrack really highlights its location somewhere in “Central-to-Eastern” Europe. The theme is based on a traditional song called “Ederlezi” and it starts with solo vocals—in our vision, those of a young girl who holds an old music box and reminisces about her grandmother. The symphonic orchestra (especially the percussion section) and the folk choir spin this story into a powerful and moving tale.

[i]Go check out everything this new map has to offer, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Check Out the Biggest Update of 2022!
notes.content:
[b]Commanders! [/b]

Update 1.18 for World of Tanks is here, and it is our biggest update of 2022. This update introduces brand-new Italian tank destroyers with a non-standard autoloader and a fresh Random Battles map called Outpost. We have also updated the vehicle performance of a number of tanks and improved a large pool of locations for Random Battles. But that's not all! Get ready for important matchmaking changes for light vehicles and SPGs, reworked visuals for destroyed vehicle tracks, and other cool features. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2d5c45fc9c0ef13b39258bec003afd20e213c706.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Branch: Here Come the Italian Tank Destroyers![/h2]

The Italian tank destroyers are ready to storm World of Tanks! This new branch will consist of six researchable vehicles, from Tier V to Tier X. All of these vehicles feature decent frontal armor and great gun depression angles, perfect for mid-range or close combat. Most importantly, the Tier VII–X vehicles are equipped with a rather unusual autoloader. These unpredictable warriors are sure to spice up your gameplay, so check them out below!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3254434504246136799 style=button][b]READ ARTICLE[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/444343f07d18d4da8682a60a2637261ef5f20a4b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Massive Vehicle Rebalancing[/h2]

We have updated the characteristics of a number of vehicles from different nations, tiers, and types, including two Tier X tanks: the Kranvagn and the AMX M4 mle. 54. We have also adjusted the battle characteristics of the Emil II, AMX 65 t, T29, M44, TVP VTU Koncept, CS-44, and many other vehicles. Depending on how these vehicles were performing against other vehicles in their tier, we have improved or reduced their effectiveness in battle.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/updates/1-18-CT1/#head-id-1 style=button][b]LEARN MORE[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/50441ea2ceb8d77c84e468b087814e2eddd29814.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Map: Outpost[/h2]

A new map is making its debut in Random Battles. This is Outpost! Take a look at this picturesque summer map, which combines open green areas with city ruins and trenches, as well as an impressive fortress with an outpost of its own. This winning location of the first Season of Recon Mission boasts diverse visuals and exciting gameplay. Enjoy the views from this new location and explore its battle directions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4fad5c0ebf099580bac0ae84554686187e4c6cf5.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]

[/expand]
[h2]Map Balance Improvements[/h2]

We are continuing to work on improving Random Battles maps and adjusting a total of 14 locations. The most extensive changes have been made to the following six maps: Berlin, Himmelsdorf, Pearl River, Murovanka, Redshire, and Glacier. In addition, we have made minor improvements to 8 other maps. Learn more about the gameplay changes in our dedicated article!

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/updates/1-18-CT1-map-balance-improvements/ style=button][b]DETAILS[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8a9fd7edbfdf8f8223150966424d4dd742872efb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Matchmaking Changes[/h2]

To improve your battle experience, we have decided to introduce new rules for balancing light and wheeled tanks. The matchmaker will now be stricter when assigning light tanks to teams and will always try to ensure that both teams have an identical number of light tanks in each battle. There will also be a limit of 1 wheeled tank per team. To help enforce these changes, we are also introducing a limit of no more than one Tier VII–X light/wheeled tank in a Platoon.

There are also important changes regarding the number of SPGs per team. Now, the majority of battles will have between 0–2 SPGs on each team. With that, the matchmaker will keep the number of battles with 3 SPGs per team to an absolute minimum.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/updates/1-18-CT1/#head-id-4 style=button][b]MORE INFO[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fbce0ff6f6d9d540a9bdcad2172a3b35aaef804a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improved Visuals for Destroyed Vehicle Tracks[/h2]

We have also improved the visuals for destroyed tracks on every vehicle in the game. Tracks will now interact with objects as an independent physics model. To get an idea of how this will work, just picture how the tracks of American Yoh tanks look when they get knocked down. This setting does affect the performance of your device, however, so it will only be enabled by default if your graphics quality is set to high or better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/20ec7f4f022c3a26c21339bbdf1acd77672b7705.jpg[/img]

[h2]Battle Pass Season IX Is Coming![/h2]

Commanders! Battle Pass Season IX is coming back soon with tons of useful Base Rewards and even more valuable Improved Rewards! As always, you will also receive Battle Pass Tokens for completing certain Progression Stages. You can exchange these Tokens for various items and rare vehicles in the Items for Tokens section of the in-game Store. A total of seven rare Tier IX vehicles will be available for purchase, including the Cobra and the Lorraine 50 t.

It's going to be a hot Season, so get ready to showcase your skills and earn tons of cool rewards!

notes.title: Veni, Vidi, Vici: Italian Tank Destroyers Are Coming!
notes.content:
[b]We’re ready to add an entire Italian tank destroyer branch to the game, Commanders! [/b]

This branch will consist of six researchable vehicles, from Tier V through Tier X. Starting from Tier VII, all new TDs will have strong frontal armor, excellent gun depression angles, and an autoloader with unusual implementation as a unique gameplay feature. Read on to find out more!

[h2]Italian Tank Destroyers: Well-Armored, Dangerous, and Unusual   [/h2]

Researching the new branch of Italian tank destroyers starts from the [b]Tier IV P26/40 medium tank[/b]. You will need approximately [b]12,650 XP[/b] to unlock the branch-opening vehicle, the [b]Semovente M41[/b]. Almost all of these Italian TDs existed as design projects, and some of them even had physical prototypes. Thanks to surviving blueprints and archive materials, we've taken these forgotten concepts to the next level and recreated six historical in-game machines as they might have existed in real life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bfcd3f53af9c5d3428b32a53f83ddd39d243e451.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bf954146957a22d75cb1627f2b2f489a5de6cdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4555646e8a3695d62775dbf57a08c39e8dcf9bef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4da5c03b3108943d1d9eb5892ccbe0fff2bb66d4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a02f1b19b53e11518ccbc316690192cd11f2bd26.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0a308a946cc925204750db23f242591f22018639.png[/img]

This new branch features decent frontal armor and excellent gun depression angles. You would probably expect these vehicles to be equipped with an autoreloading system, as well, like Italian medium or heavy tanks. But here’s the big surprise: High-tier Italian tank destroyers come with a [b]magazine loading system[/b] that offers up a completely new playstyle! We’ll give you more information about this mechanic using a Tier X vehicle as an example. But let's first take a look at the lineup!

[h2]The Semovente M41 and the Semovente M43 Bassotto[/h2]

The new branch kicks off with the [b]Semovente M41[/b], which is a Tier V transitional vehicle. It is equipped with a non-rotating cabin instead of a turret, as well as a 75 mm gun. With a 350 m view range and great concealment values, this vehicle is a born Tier V master of camouflage and offers exciting stealthy gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7fa9b6f56c473e86640ead291b6c03f0e9d737da.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/55c659d1dab3c03bed63f714e784198fdee449ae.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7f762d4cf03aea7e48064166ec0294b89807055d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0d31ebca1d1b6e6a826a964844639fe6d4bc9d67.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fcd93323a7a71be5c90869711603ee819fe60acb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/842d05a265f36ce846f604036103143b9b553df8.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
Sitting at Tier VI, the [b]Semovente M43 Bassotto[/b] is somewhat of an improved version of the previous vehicle. It can brag about a more powerful 102 mm gun with good accuracy and penetration values. Alternatively, you can equip the 105 mm Tier VII gun with HE gameplay. The vehicle’s frontal armor is also more solid. Both vehicles are rather slow and rely on a stealthy playstyle using their great concealment values.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5f0fb088de407347fae619ebf6f04df9b800aa2d.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f7695979f824f28d781cde5071e2e337f44fb717.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/945dfb8454b3acbaa2f20f11a8b67a48eedced5d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/57d201b0bd66943d7ccf04a6856d756bd5e976f6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/df18970bf462c3cd300a5e7552e5abb51ecb42f8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4b6d7ecb3bc08b78d89cb850b8e028e8742cdeb2.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]The SMV CC-56[/h2]

The next Italian newcomer is the [b]SMV CC-56[/b], which is noticeably different from its predecessors. Starting with this TD, the branch begins to take on its main features, offering you an idea of what the gameplay of the high-tier vehicles will be.

The SMV CC-56 is equipped with a rotating turret but limited turret traverse angles (30 degrees to either side, 60 degrees in total). The turret and frontal armor are quite solid, so you can rely on them in close-range combat. However, what makes this vehicle so dangerous is its 105 mm gun that features an autoloader with a non-standard configuration (more on that below), as well as good depression and elevation angles (–10/+20 degrees).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/339aaba3da94c641e591e6c5ac4e069ad4894fca.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/652c3cec0918d34808f2faa0dd24e2da5d744c61.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/607275e224a3627db98610e13db2b3e9391a37a3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b2f0e418afd48247e959b12b0a5ab3ad00cff287.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/20515b1ef82a87090d111cecac2ca0a3ef187c75.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/141ac637fa5c7e32cdf06c9b943353fc7343172d.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]The SMV CC-67[/h2]

Now for the high-tier tanks! Let’s start with the menacing [b]SMV CC-67[/b], which embodies all the finest qualities of Italian tank destroyers. This vehicle also has a rotating turret, but its turret traverse angles is an impressive 70 degrees (35 degrees to either side).

The vehicle’s other characteristics are also evolving. The frontal hull and turret armor is even stronger, and the vehicle’s mobility is increasing, as well. The Tier VIII vehicle has a higher top speed, reverse speed, engine power, power-to-weight, and even traverse values. Although the SMV CC-67 can move from one flank to another, it will take you some time, so you’ll need to choose the right direction in battle. Its 120 mm gun with an autoloader and –10 degrees of gun depression make it easier to go hull-down, take a shot, and withdraw into cover for a few seconds so that enemies can’t hit your weak spots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b3e7680e4153990ea01157d3a7b2b46ee6f57bf4.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/31efc1f795ce3306fb318c86899348cf156c209a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/38b45669da70bfbece74766ebaabb1bcb15ee7e7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bd6329e58387558c3cec5ee306a657b459269de6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/795dec66f293374c7c31dafa62861478267b8676.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ae39fc5d6ec4bc13700f4af71b38a5dd2420f298.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]The Controcarro 1 Mk. 2[/h2]

All of the above-mentioned gameplay features continue to evolve, making the [b]Controcarro 1 Mk. 2[/b] an incredibly dangerous opponent in close- and mid-range combat. The vehicle’s partial turret traverse and average mobility are counterbalanced by its excellent frontal armor and good gun handling. Its menacing and high-DPM 127 mm gun boasts 80 degrees of turret traverse angles (40 degrees to either side) and an autoloader that causes 490 HP of alpha damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d66f9610296320d400795f331f6ff1eaeed6a7f0.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c314991c930451f7982fedac0d1db513a0415d42.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b180891d78c94b4651639e70d759c1edb9bffd80.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9782f70ba15f79f8c589984876978871f40317bd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4e8f78d91aecc2c14a248a062d510b934357515c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bb0b57ebe76fada159540db476097510abf5ce7d.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]The Controcarro 3 Minotauro[/h2]

As the crown jewel of the new line, this Italian minotaur has key battle parameters similar to those of other high-tier TDs, but this is where they reach their maximum. Like its brothers-in-arms, this vehicle has excellent frontal hull armor and few weak spots, meaning that it can easily repel enemy shells and save your precious HP in a one-on-one duel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/457c6a66d9fea6741f97cb7ae120747c28f74d2e.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cf24a2e108c14959277105dd31b6fdfcd4d4df60.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7a8d1ae6467b2e5fe3c6e03033c66a2c9cc9bfbe.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3d8ae926f213f74a152fb4888301ad48440deb64.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3fc6c6822c4c2a83001c87960b222d12f6ee0cbd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c8c6bed2d3c536b468918bbc7ae299070a08c440.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
The rotating turret tops out at 90 degrees of total turret traverse angles, with 45 degrees to either side! The gun depression angles of –10 degrees are also good. The accuracy of the 130 mm gun is not too impressive, but its aiming time is very decent for this caliber, especially compared to other heavy tanks and tank destroyers with comparable guns. The penetration values are also more similar to those of heavy tanks rather than tank destroyers. This does not make firing from a long distance very comfortable, so the Minotauro will feel right at home on the front line as a powerful breakthrough vehicle. With its respectable [b]530 HP of alpha damage[/b], it will perform brilliantly in both frontal assaults and positional hull-down duels, assisting heavies and putting pressure on the enemy in close combat.

The vehicle’s top speed of 30 km/h and its acceleration remain competitive compared to heavy tanks. It can confidently follow other allies to support them on the flanks.

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the Commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks, and skills, as well as special in-game items.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f0ee1a1173e934d161e6ca16652fd91a82cc9de2.png[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/57d5ed1589cf80b3731e0ff8a592c14a47dc07ea.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8b4dddb8096c0415a0b25aac778be4da64ccd585.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/657da52d0abb3192c6acb2d9384898c3eff5b0f3.png[/img]
[/expand]
And now, meet the branch’s real superpower: its unique autoloader!

[h2]Not Your Classic Autoloader: How It Works[/h2]

Unlike high-tier medium and heavy Italian tanks, Tier VII–X tank destroyers are equipped with a [b]drum-type autoloader[/b]. However, this is not the classic autoloader that you might play on some popular French vehicles. Let's see how it works using the Controcarro 3 Minotauro as an example.

The autoloader has five shells with [b]530 HP of alpha damage[/b]. The full reload time is [b]24 seconds[/b], and between shots—surprise! — a whopping [b]eight seconds[/b]! This may seem strange on paper, but in practice, an autoloader with these unique parameters is perfect for trying out new tactics and keeping your opponents on their toes.

Always remember that you should treat this vehicle like a [b]standard tank with a normal cyclic gun[/b]. Its alpha damage is equal to that of alpha heavies, but with a reload time of eight seconds, it’s faster than many brawlers, such as the IS-7 or the 60TP Lewandowskiego. This means that you can jump into a 1v1 duel and come out victorious, thanks to your huge in-clip DPM—up to 2650 HP!—and excellent frontal armor. One drum is enough to outshoot most of your opponents, even those with large HP pools.

Of course, you will have to pay for all of those shots with a reload that takes [b]24 seconds[/b]. Consider it a kind of delayed penalty for unleashing your devastating in-clip DPM. On the other hand, 24 seconds isn’t that bad. After all, the cooldown won’t take you out of the game for a very long time. Also, don’t forget that you have excellent frontal armor. While reloading, try to face your opponents frontally while hiding your lower plate so they have a harder time punishing you.

If you have a few shells left and the combat situation is favorable (meaning you can potentially do more damage), simply skip your drum to fully reload it. In just 24 seconds, you will have five shells with nice alpha at your disposal. Your rate of fire will probably be higher than that of your opponents, and they won't even know how many shots you have left! Whether or not to reload your full clip will be an easier decision in this vehicle than it would be in other autoloaders, so you will be perfectly capable of quickly adapting as the battle progresses.

This autoloader concept makes the Controcarro 3 Minotauro a unique and versatile vehicle that is sure to challenge its commander. You’ll need to get used to the Minotauro’s temper, but if you succeed, you will have a real king of the hill on any map.

[i]If you are ready to take on this challenge, go ahead! It all depends on you![/i]

The accuracy of the 130 mm gun is not too impressive, but its aiming time is very decent for this caliber, especially compared to other heavy tanks and tank destroyers with comparable guns.
The penetration values are also more similar to those of heavy tanks rather than tank destroyers.

notes.title: Transfer Opportunities for Players from CIS to the EU Realm
notes.content:
[b]Dear players! [/b]

On April 4, we announced that Wargaming projects including World of Tanks, will be operated by Lesta Games in Russia and Belarus. This was the first step, followed by months of hard work. The result is the complete structural and financial division of the two companies. Today, World of Tanks and other products are operated by two independent companies: by Lesta Games in Russia and Belarus, and by Wargaming in all other countries.  

The next big step is [b]to launch a special CIS → EU transfer campaign for CIS players who wish to stay with Wargaming and continue playing on Steam. [/b]

Transfer is a crucial activity where every player from CIS realm will need to decide on how to continue playing the game. Below you can find the key points about this procedure: 
[olist]
[*] [b]In September[/b], CIS servers will be turned off for Steam players. Additionally, [b]new players from Russia and Belarus[/b] will not be able to register a new World of Tanks account via Steam. 
[*] New CIS players from outside Russia and Belarus will still be able to install World of Tanks in Steam and create an account. Such players will be automatically redirected to EU region during registration. 
[*] If you already have an account on CIS region, you will have an opportunity to transfer your CIS account to EU region and continue playing on Steam. 
[*] If you don’t want to transfer your account to EU region, unfortunately, you will not be able to continue playing on Steam. 
[/olist]Providing high quality service and ensuring the comfort of our players will always remain our priority. We will keep your account progress and all applicable terms and conditions, including pricing principles, as well as the core set of services you are used to, no matter where you continue playing. 

We understand that this is a big and serious decision for our players, and we will do our best to make it a smooth and easy experience for everyone.  

[h3][b]Additional Questions [/b][/h3]

[expand type=details]
[olist]
[*] [b]Q: Do I need to perform any actions now? [/b]
A: If you wish to transfer your account, make sure that you have [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3413183219972726055][b]completed your registration[/b][/url] by adding an email and a password. Other than that, you do not have to do anything now, this is just an announcement to make sure you stay up to date with our latest plans. We will make an additional publication when the transfer is ready with all details about the procedure. 

[*] [b]Q: How long will the transfer option be available?  [/b]
A: The transfer campaign doesn’t have any planned end date. We want to make sure that all our players get a chance to move to EU region, including those who decided to take a break from the game at the moment. If this changes sometime in the future, we will let you know in advance. 

[*] [b]Q: Will my progress, stats, purchases and resources be transferred as well? [/b]
A: Yes, of course. Your progress, stats, purchases, resources etc. will be transferred to a new account on EU region with only a couple of exceptions. We will give you all the details closer to the transfer start. 

[*] [b]Q: I play from Belarus or Russia and I want to transfer my account to EU region. Will I be able to make purchases in the game after the transfer? [/b]
A: You will not be able to pay directly to Wargaming. In order to know if you are able to make purchases directly to Steam please look at the payment methods that are available in your country on Steam or contact Steam Support. 

[*] [b]Q: Will the prices in the in-game Store become higher after the transfer? [/b]
A: For the transferred players, the pricing principles on EU region will remain at the same level with CIS region. 

[*] [b]Q: Will my ping become worse after the transfer?  [/b]
A: This is a very specific question which depends on a variety of factors, mainly on your service provider and your location. In some cases it might become lower, in other cases it might become higher.  
 
To ensure a comfortable gaming experience for transferred players we will add two new servers to the EU realm: [b]EU 3 and EU 4[/b].  
EU 3 will be in Luxembourg and is recommended for players located in Ukraine and Western Europe. The ping values on EU3 will be similar to the current RU3 server. 
EU 4 will be in Kazakhstan and is recommended for players located in Central Asia. The ping values on EU4 will be similar to the current RU10 server. 

[*] [b]Q: Can I transfer my EU, NA, ASIA account to another server during this transfer campaign? [/b]
A: No, this transfer campaign will be aimed specifically at CIS-region players. Other regions remain without any changes.  

[*] [b]Q: What if I don’t want to transfer my account to EU region? [/b]
A: Unfortunately, in that case you will not be able to play World of Tanks via Steam on your CIS-region account.  

[*] [b]Q: Will you add Russian, Ukrainian etc. localizations in the game for the EU server? [/b]
A: We will add Russian, Ukrainian and Kazakh localizations to the EU game client.  
[/olist][/expand]
We understand that you might have more questions about the transfer procedure. We will share the full transfer conditions and technical details for Steam players closer to the transfer launch which is currently planned for the middle of September. Stay tuned!

notes.title: New Launch of Frontline 2022: Back for 9 Days!
notes.content:
[b]Commanders![/b]

Once again, the time has come for massive battles on giant maps, featuring respawns, artillery strikes, smoke screens, and a good dose of strategizing. Of course, we’re talking about the upcoming second launch of Frontline 2022. We have extended the mode [b]from August 20 through 29[/b] meaning it will be available for nine days instead of the usual seven. Let’s see what's in store this time around!

[h3][b]Frontline 2022: Second Launch[/b][/h3]
[b]EU:[/b] August 20, 2022, at 06:00 CEST through August 29, 2022, at 03:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] August 20, 2022, at 04:00 PT | 06:00 CT | 07:00 ET through August 29, 2022, at at 01:00 PT | 03:00 CT | 04:00 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] August 20, 2022, at 07:00 UTC+8 through August 29, 2022, at 04:00 UTC+8

[h2]Single-Tier Battles[/h2]

Last time, a lot of players enjoyed playing Frontline exclusively in Tier VIII vehicles. In this second launch, we are keeping the good old formula of single-tiered battles, so get your favorite Tier VIIIs ready! If you do not have one of your own, try a rental Tier VIII vehicle. You can even get your hands on the Tiger II FL and M41 Bulldog FL, now available for rent.

[h2]More Rewards, Including Unique Ones[/h2]

After the first launch of Frontline 2022, we realized that we should up the rewards for the epic 30v30 battles on extra-large maps. We’ve reworked the Frontline rewards, tied them to the mode progression, increased their number, and even added some unique ones.
[list]
[*] The progression itself now consists of 20 Stages (instead of 15). Upon reaching every Stage, you will earn valuable goodies.
[*] You can earn bonds (up to 975 in total) for completing certain progression Stages.
[*] When receiving directives as a reward, you will be able to choose your favorite type from an expanded list that now includes Pre-Battle Maintenance, Optical Calibration, and Aim Tuning.
[*] A Training Manual (the Crew Book providing 250K Crew XP) has been added to the reward pool.
[*] [b]Retraining Orders[/b] are a new in-game item that can only be obtained as a Frontline mode reward. Use yours to change the skills and/or perks of a crew without a penalty.
[/list][h2]Quick Combat Reserves[/h2]

For the second launch of Frontline 2022, we have decided to make Combat Reserves easier to use. We are curious to try this out and see how it affects the gameplay!
[list]
[*] Once the battle starts, the time before you can use a Combat Reserve has been halved.
[*] Combat Reserves can be used immediately after you respawn (the minimum time before the respawn is 5 seconds).
[*] Combat Reserves can be used immediately after you unlock them for reaching a new rank.
[/list]We are excited for your feedback on quick Combat Reserves!

[h2]Revised Rental Vehicle Roster[/h2]

As usual, rental vehicles will be available for the duration of Frontline (which is now 9 days) and they can only be used in this mode. These vehicles are all “clones” of their respective researchable Tier VIII counterparts and come with the best modules installed. Crews from vehicles of the same nation and type can be transferred on and off them for free and without penalty.
[list]
[*] Tiger II FL  
[*] T-44 FL  
[*] AMX AC mle. 48 FL  
[*] M41 Walker Bulldog FL  
[/list]At the beginning of the mode launch, you will be able to obtain Frontline rental vehicles for 250,000 credits each in the Frontline section of the in-game Store. This price will go down as the event progresses.

[h2]But Wait, There’s More…[/h2]

We have implemented a score of minor changes to Frontline, including brand-new voice messages about various events on the battlefield, an upgrade to the Frontline widget to display your progress and the rewards you still have to collect, and some interface improvements for your convenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2c16bf45b7653f19652315681d7f4beba857e35b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Arcade Cabinet: Try Out an Experimental Mode With Unusual Rules!
notes.content:
[b]Commanders![/b]

Let's imagine for a moment that the battle characteristics of every vehicle in the game were changed beyond recognition. Now, we’re not just talking about Field Modification with some 3–5% fluctuation up or down—we’re talking about a truly impressive transformation!

For example, [b]what if we doubled the Leopard 1's aiming speed[/b]? Or suddenly increased the proximity spotting distance of all vehicles in battle [b]to 445 meters[/b]? What would it be like to play with a damage spread of +/–75% of the standard value?

Sound crazy? We know! This is your opportunity to try out something unusual and extraordinary—something that’s never been seen before in regular Random Battles.

Get ready to experience the classic game mechanics from a different perspective with no risk, no pressure, and no strings attached! Starting[b] July 15[/b], we’re launching [b]Arcade Cabinet[/b], a new experimental platform. Battles will take place according to the standard rules but with unusual battle modifiers that change the classic technical characteristics. There will be a total of three launches taking place over the course of several weeks, each with its own unique theme and gameplay.

Read on to find out more!

[previewyoutube=knBcPWPchI4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How to Find Arcade Cabinet[/h2]

In the Garage, select the Arcade Cabinet mode from the menu to the right of the “Battle!” button. When hovering over the mode button, you’ll see the combat modifiers that will be applied in battle. Check them out and prepare to be surprised!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/92f854e81200f60d5d16d680bc750ae3d27cefb9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Launch One: Railgun[/h2]

[quote=][b]EU:[/b] From July 15 at 06:00 CEST through July 17 at 05:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] From July 15 at 07:00 PT | 09:00 CT | 10:00 ET through July 17 at 21:59 PT | 23:59 CT | July 18 at 00:59 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] From July 15 at 13:00 (UTC+8) through July 18 at 04:00 (UTC+8)[/quote]
The time has come to grab a railgun and show your opponents who's truly the boss as you battle it out in an exciting railgun match! The aiming time, gun dispersion, engine power, and other characteristics of your vehicles will be immediately improved [b]by 50–100%[/b]. Even players who are new to the game may suddenly demonstrate impressive skills and Robin Hood-like accuracy!

Moreover, proximity spotting distance will increase [b]to 445 meters[/b]. Your opponents will be in plain sight, meaning that all you’ll have to do is track them down and cause accurate damage from afar! This is your opportunity to feel like a sniper.

[h3]Battle Modifiers[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fc8d91c2f1a74cd4ddb40def50f24f9ab264c891.png[/img]

[h2]Launch Two: Element of Surprise[/h2]

[quote=][b]EU:[/b] From July 29 at 06:00 CEST through July 31 at 05:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] From July 29 at 07:00 PT | 09:00 CT | 10:00 ET through July 31 at 21:59 PT | 23:59 CT | August 1 at 00:59 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] From July 29 at 13:00 (UTC+8) through August 1 at 04:00 (UTC+8)[/quote]
This is your chance to find out just how random our Random Battles can get and discover the power of the element of surprise! In this launch, expect plenty of jaw-dropping twists and turns. You may get lucky and destroy an IS-7 with Improved Hardening with a single shot, while someone else may cause pitifully low damage and crawl back to their Garage, hoping to be more fortunate next time. As World of Tanks players like to say, "Skill is skill, but RNG is RNG!"

[quote=]We will announce the exact combat modifiers for this mode shortly before its launch.[/quote]
[h2]Launch Three: Tranquility[/h2]

[quote=][b]EU:[/b] From August 12 at 06:00 CEST through August 14 at 05:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] From August 12 at 07:00 PT | 09:00 CT | 10:00 ET through August 14 at 21:59 PT | 23:59 CT | August 15 at 00:59 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] From August 12 at 13:00 (UTC+8) through August 15 at 04:00 (UTC+8)[/quote]
Once again, a total change in combat modifiers means a total change in gameplay! In the third launch, you’ll immerse yourself in calm and peaceful tranquility. There’s no need to hurry, so take your time when loading shells, and treat non-penetrating shots as a worldly vanity. In a sense, this launch will feel like a return to “the good old WoT” of leisurely-paced gameplay and unhurried battles. Enjoy this little dash of nostalgia!

[quote=]We will share more detailed information about the modifiers for this mode before its launch.[/quote]
[h2]Standard Rules for All Launches[/h2]

All launches in Arcade Cabinet will be played according to the standard rules of Random Battles:
[list]
[*] [b]Same-tier battles will be in the 15v15 format[/b].* Only Tier VIII and X vehicles are allowed.
[*] [b]Matchmaking [/b]is by vehicle type.
[*] [b]Objective[/b]: Capture the base or destroy all enemy vehicles.
[*] [b]Platoons [/b]are allowed.
[*] Battle results in this mode [b]do not count towards your statistics[/b]. You have nothing to prove, so just play and enjoy!
[*] Credits and Combat XP earning rates, as well as the costs of repairs and consumables, [b]are the same as in Random Battles[/b].
[*] Bonds and Battle Pass Points [b]cannot be earned in this mode[/b].
[*] [b]Combat missions for credits[/b] will be available in Tier X battles.
[*] The principles of fair play ([url=https://worldoftanks.eu/content/guide/fair_play/]EU[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.com/news/general-news/forbidden-mods/]NA[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/en/content/guide/fair_play/]ASIA[/url]) should be followed in all battles.

*[i]Each of the Arcade Cabinet submodes will have separate queues for Tier VIII and X vehicles. If there is an insufficient number of players in the queue, the matchmaker may launch a battle with fewer participants.[/i]
[/list]Battles in the Arcade Cabinet submodes will be fought on the following maps:

notes.title: 2022 Summer Plans: Update 1.17.1, Events, and Surprises!
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.17.1 is coming your way, Commanders![/b]

Frontline, our most epic game mode, is returning to World of Tanks with an updated progression and other balance adjustments. We'll be sharing a separate article with you in the coming months that will go into more detail about all the exciting changes we’ve made to your favorite mode, so stay tuned!

You can find the full Update 1.17.1 patch notes via this link:

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/content/docs/release_notes/release-notes-1-17-1/ style=button][h3][b]FULL PATCHNOTES[/b][/h3][/url]

[h2]A Feast of Great Events Awaits![/h2]

A host of great activities with exciting gameplay and cool rewards are yet to come, Commanders! Here's what awaits you this summer:
[list]
[*][h3][b]SUMMER GLOBAL MAP EVENT [/b][/h3]
Iron Age, a new Global Map event, is coming to World of Tanks! Once again, the most powerful clans will lock horns to prove their superiority and earn a bunch of valuable rewards, including mighty Tier X vehicles. Get ready for heated battles, and may the strongest win! 

[*][h3][b]WOT 7 TOURNAMENT (EU servers)[/b][/h3]
The next iteration of our WoT7 tournament series will take place in August, featuring exciting matches with Tier X vehicles, magnificent tank commanders, and fantastic rewards. Gather your friends and compete against others, or sit back, relax, and follow the action during our livestream. 

[*][h3][b]FIRST MAN ON THE MOON (NA servers)[/b][/h3]
Come celebrate the first man on the moon! On July 15th, we will celebrate this historic moment with in-game missions and space-themed rewards. 

[*][h3][b]CLAN SHOWDOWN (ASIA servers)[/b][/h3]
Call your clanmates, because Clan Showdown is coming around in August! Take part in this exciting tournament and fight it out to earn gold, bonds, and special customizations. May the best clan win! 

[*][h3][b]THE 12TH ANNIVERSARY OF WORLD OF TANKS [/b][/h3]
This August, World of Tanks will celebrate its 12th anniversary. And to get you in the festive mood, we've prepared an awesome celebration with a beach party, gifts, and exciting adventures! We invite all players, old and new, to come join us! 

[*][h3][b]FRONTLINE [/b][/h3]
The second launch of Frontline 2022 will take place in August. All in all, this epic mode will keep its main principles from the first launch. However, to make things even more exciting, we've adjusted the progression system and changed some of the balance parameters. And most importantly, we've added more rewards, including new ones that you've never seen before! 

[*][h3][b]BATTLE PASS SEASON VIII [/b][/h3]
Battle Pass Season VIII is here for the entire summer! As always, there's a whole bunch of valuable Base and Improved Rewards up for grabs, including unique Warhammer 40,000-themed 3D styles. Don't miss this opportunity to get your hands on them while you still can! 

[*][h3][b]UPDATE 1.18 [/b][/h3]
After a hot summer full of events, Update 1.18 will land in World of Tanks! This update will introduce some exciting new content, so stay tuned for more details! 
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/86641d96bef119ff8ec6d3a932e6f08addce7aa8.png[/img]

[i]Get ready for these upcoming summer events, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Assembly Shop: Craft a Brand-New Tier X Heavy!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Commanders! From June 16 through July 12, the Assembly Shop will be available in World of Tanks.[/b]

During this time, you’ll be able to assemble the [b]Object 780[/b], a brand-new Tier X Soviet heavy tank. Combine and spend in-game resources for the vehicle’s assembly at your discretion, change their ratio—it’s all up to you! The number of vehicles available for assembly is limited:[b] 50,000 (EU) / 17,000 (NA) / 15,000 (ASIA)[/b], and the [b]first 15,000 (EU) / 7,000 (NA) / 5,000 (ASIA) tanks[/b] will receive the spectacular[b] Varanus 3D style[/b] with an individual style number! Let's dig into the details.

[h3][b]Assembly Shop[/b][/h3]
[b]EU[/b]: From June 16 at 07:00 CEST through July 11 at 02:00 CEST (UTC+2)*
[b]NA[/b]: From June 16 at 03:00 PT | 05:00 CT | 06:00 ET through July 11 at 03:00 PT | 05:00 CT | 06:00 ET*
[b]ASIA[/b]: From June 16 at 04:00 UTC+8 through July 10 at 23:59 UTC+8*

[i]*The event may finish early if the allotted number of vehicles is sold out sooner.[/i]

[previewyoutube=2BN7NB4CsLE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How to Access the Assembly Shop[/h2]

Go to the special section using the widget below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0583d64f0e8ce84b93cf6f7eb738b15c2ffba26b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Get a New Tier X Tank Without Researching Its Vehicle Branch![/h2]

The Assembly Shop is a new way to receive a limited-edition Tier X tank without having to research another vehicle branch! Like in a real assembly shop, you’ll spend various game resources to craft the brand-new [b]Object 780[/b], including blueprint fragments, Free XP, credits, gold, and bonds. Their ratio can be determined at your discretion.

The number of vehicles available for assembly is limited—[b]EU: 50,000 / NA: 17,000 / ASIA: 15,000 tanks[/b]. At the same time, [b]the first 15,000 (EU) / 7,000 (NA) / 5,000 (ASIA) players[/b] will receive not only the vehicle itself but also the spectacular [b]Varanus 3D style[/b] for it that includes an individual style number. It will be displayed on the gun and in eye-catching red lights at the rear of the turret. The style also includes three unique camouflage patterns for each map type. They will change automatically, depending on the season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/16a5fbe7d0e94e7adcd2ff31c0614f74199e32d2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/904bc0890b204107d49be3f1fd36323dae326742.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/aa1fa9bb60f3cd56f827e8a335cf8724989a1674.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
Upon their complete assembly, individual style numbers will be assigned to vehicles sequentially, from 1 to 15,000. You won’t be able to choose your style number or know which number you’ll get. One thing is sure, though: The sooner you unlock it, the lower it will be.

Varanus is a truly exclusive style. No one else will have the same unique number in your region, and you have a chance to get an incredible customization item. Don't wait for the last days of the event if you want to extend your vehicle collection with a unique and limited-edition Tier X tank! Currently, the Assembly Shop is the only way to obtain the Object 780 and a 3D style for it.

Once all the 15,000 (EU) / 7,000 (NA) / 5,000 (ASIA) numbered styles and accompanying vehicles have been purchased, [b]another 35,000 (EU) / 13,000 (NA) / 10,000 (ASIA) tanks[/b] will still be available. They will come in their standard configuration—without the 3D style and individual style number—and will be available for assembly until the end of the event or until they run out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4e403b33c207d8955c6687d73560b25837ef6a32.jpg[/img]

[h2]Use Resources as You See Fit![/h2]

Any of the following five game resources can be used to assemble the Object 780:
[list]
[*] Free XP
[*] National and universal blueprint fragments*
[*] Credits
[*] Gold
[*] Bonds
[/list][i]*Blueprint fragments can be used to complete up to 36% of the total vehicle assembly progress: 22% with national fragments, and 14% with universal. You’ll be able to spend up to 50 national blueprint fragments of each nation.[/i]

The value of the resources varies, so each of them has a different effect on the assembly progress. You can use one or several resources at once. You’ll be able to freely combine and spend them in different ratios throughout the event. Also, you don’t need to wait and can spend everything at once if you have enough of one or more resources. You get to decide how to make the best use of your resources to efficiently assemble the Object 780!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6d234d8cf90c9f314513819aa2ee233d9880b1d4.png[/img]

Resources for the assembly are deducted from your account each time you decide to add them to the Assembly. You can track your progress on a special bar in the game event section of the Store. Once its progress reaches 100%, the vehicle will be credited to your account. See what happens to your resources if you don't finish the Assembly in the section below.

With a well-weighed approach, the set of resources that can be used to fill the progression allows for decreasing the cost of Free XP or gold by almost half. We encourage you to go through the examples so you spend your resources wisely!

[h3][b]Example[/b][/h3]
[expand type=details]
To make the most out of your available resources, we recommend adding them in the following order:
[olist]
[*] [b]Blueprint fragments[/b]. Use everything you don’t mind using. In total, you can fill the progression up to 36% (14% with universal, 22% with national blueprint fragments).
[*] [b]Free XP[/b] is the most efficient resource. We suggest mainly focusing on it to complete the progression.
[*] [b]Gold [/b]is the most convenient resource. But if you have Combat XP, consider converting it to Free XP using gold.
[*] [b]Bonds [/b]are a valuable resource for assembling the vehicle but are quite rare.
[*] [b]Credits[/b]. Compared to the other resources, the efficiency of credits is much lower. It then makes sense to use them in two cases only: if you have A LOT of credits, or if you have reduced the vehicle cost (filled the progression) as much as possible but want to get an even greater discount on its assembly.
[/olist][/expand]
[h2]Object 780: Special-Purpose Combat Vehicle[/h2]

Now let’s talk about what exactly you will be assembling. The Object 780 is a powerful and maneuverable assault heavy tank that stands out among other same-tier heavies.

The first thing that attracts attention is its [b]excellent frontal armor[/b]. The lower and upper glacis plates are quite small and well-sloped, making it hard for opponents to penetrate them. Trading shells with this monster—even at a short distance—is a bad idea. Moreover, the unique shape of the hull protects the vehicle quite well from taking damage through the tracks, which is only possible in very rare cases and most likely due to a mistake by the commander rather than the hull’s shape. This will make you more confident in assaults and save the vehicle’s precious HP pool.

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the Commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks, and skills, as well as special in-game items.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/aea4bb00769a9b6ef416ec4c965ed29ff7d75c7d.png[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f5ff38c48e757d2f37d8a226ad6c212fa34999aa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/26a9c76024e4caa24abb474cc504fe73fb8be22e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/74f8949d2c422ecceb3dac610a3cdacc157785c0.png[/img]
[/expand]
Despite its strong armor, the Object 780 accelerates quickly and maintains its top speed well. However, the vehicle's top speed is 45 km/h, which is not very fast. The Object 780 can move from one flank to another, but this will take time, so you’ll need to choose the right direction in battle. But the vehicle can confidently follow its allies to support them with armor and fire at the right time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/788c5c5541ecc5d88e120cb483ddbb1d98d22abd.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e369c247cc8b84a1bb6732c3b41b81589c04036e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/754b73d5c1fdf8ab215671c00c1d15d0447c7128.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e4bde622e4af7e798dcbe8858212a4b4a24e7628.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d81b833f6ce98c2294961e8f9c0e89e4f876abdd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/dc1fdc981ef7e73866b203be8c4605cfda25257b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/181fc450c76c31410355ad37443cd4bf8ea59fff.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fe2a804d78a7a3a5adf4dd747fec46685e503517.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/237a6c06a84536b49d55ab3fc3bd42559c2b48b8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5d97d4049e121ad4096c1cd5885ef5be96fbbf58.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
The main strength of the Object 780 is its good [b]gun-handling parameters for a heavy tank[/b], including a high damage per shot of 530 HP. In addition, its aiming time, dispersion, and accuracy are top-notch, so the Object 780 is suitable not only as a first-line brawler but also for positional medium- and long-range combat. Good gun depression/elevation angles also contribute to such gameplay: The vehicle can take advantage of terrain irregularities and safely fire from cover.

Remember that the tank is very compact, so its modules are located close to one another. This makes it easy to receive critical damage, so it’s good to equip it with Modified Configuration or try to play carefully.

The Object 780 is well armored, but its HP pool is not very impressive. You should use armor correctly in combat and take advantage of the good gun depression angles—you’ll then have a better chance of surviving. Also, its rate of fire is not the highest compared to other heavies. Together with your limited HP pool, this makes you vulnerable in close combat, so don’t get into duels unless you’re sure that you can come out victorious.

In a nutshell, the Object 780 can easily play both as a brawler and mighty support vehicle. This is a versatile and effective vehicle that you can rely on in any situation.

[h2]Risk-Free Resources Returns[/h2]

If you’re unable to collect the required amount of resources by the end of the event, there are no risks for the spent resources. They will automatically return to the account in full.

If you change your mind and want to get everything back, click the [b]Return Resources button[/b]. The assembly progress will be reset, and you’ll be able to re-distribute and spend resources at your discretion or stop the assembly progress entirely. You’ll have time to decide, but don’t delay it—tanks with individual style numbers won’t be available forever!

[i]The Assembly Shop is your opportunity to craft a limited-edition Tier X tank right in your Garage. Spend and combine resources—everything depends on you![/i]

notes.title: Recon Mission Is Coming Back With Six Maps!
notes.content:
[b]Commanders![/b]

The last time we offered the Recon Mission mode, we saw how many of you joined in and became actively involved. In fact, more than two million tankers played the mode, and well over one million of you completed the questionnaire. We’re very grateful for your input, and, to show our appreciation, we have some good news: Recon Mission will be returning soon for two whole weeks.

[h3][b]Recon Mission 2022[/b][/h3]
[b]EU[/b]: June 13, 2022, at 14:00 CEST through June 27, 2022, at 01:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA[/b]: June 13 at 10:00 PT | 12:00 CT | 13:00 ET through June 25 at 23:00 PT | June 26 at 01:00 CT | 02:00 ET
[b]SA[/b]: June 13 at 10:00 PT | 12:00 CT | 13:00 ET through June 25 at 20:00 PT | 22:00 CT | 23:00 ET
[b]ASIA[/b]: June 13, 2022, at 18:00 UTC+8 through June 26, 2022, at 23:59 UTC+8

[h3][b]Cease-Fire Periods (Daily):[/b][/h3]
[b]NA[/b]: 23:00-10:00 PT | 01:00-12:00 CT | 02:00-13:00 ET
[b]SA[/b]: 20:00-10:00 PT | 22:00-12:00 CT | 23:00-13:00 ET
[b]ASIA[/b]: 00:00 - 18:00 UTC+8

[previewyoutube=cc_OEbU4Cks;full][/previewyoutube]
More time means more opportunities to try out all SIX map prototypes, which will each be available from the very start. Based on your feedback, we’ve included three improved prototypes of the maps from the previous iteration ([b]Canyon[/b], [b]Airshipyard[/b], and [b]Far East[/b]). The other three ([b]Anykeyyevka[/b], [b]Aquila[/b], and [b]Klostertal[/b]) are entirely new.

Your favorite map from the previous round (based on player votes), the [b]Outpost [/b]map, has officially “graduated” Recon Mission and is almost completely ready, gameplay-wise. We just need to add some finishing touches to its visuals before it enters Random Battles in September 2022. Here’s how the release version of Outpost will look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2c2536e13819197b3736b1326ef7282eb408c9bc.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
