[/expand]
The second most liked map, [b]Oyster Bay[/b], will be the next in our pipeline. It should hit Random Battles around the beginning of 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/413b7a87f0458dec6dbf9f6fd9b2f194f470dab8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Recon Mission: The Basics[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Getting there[/b]: You can access the Recon Mission mode via the mode selector, a special window in your Garage, and the Missions interface.
[*] [b]The rules[/b]: Recon Mission is played 15v15 in Tier VIII–X vehicles by Standard Battle rules only. The map is randomly chosen from the pool of six prototypes.
[*] [b]The questionnaire[/b]: This will become available for each new map once you’ve entered the top 12 by base XP in six battles played on that map. Make sure to complete as many Recon Mission map questionnaires as you can to help shape the game’s future!
[*] [b]Participation pays off[/b]: Getting into the top 12 by base XP in a Recon Mission battle will add to your progression bar. To win all of the available rewards, you’ll need to get into top 12 by base XP in 50 Recon Mission battles.
[*] You can also complete [b]Daily Missions[/b] to earn Battle Pass Points and bonds in the mode. The results of Recon Mission battles will not contribute to your Personal Missions but will count towards your overall personal statistics.
[/list][quote=]You cannot complete clan missions in the mode but you can use Clan Reserves in it.[/quote]
[h2]Map Candidates: Preview[/h2]

Take a look at what we’ve improved in the prototypes from the previous Recon Mission:
[list]
[*] [b]Canyon[/b], a 1,000x1,000 m map set in a rocky desert with a rugged landscape
[*] [b]Airshipyard[/b], a snow-covered and mostly open 1,000x1,000 m location
[*] [b]Far East[/b], a fairly open 1,000x1,000 m summer map with some buildings and an airfield
[/list][h3][b]Canyon[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5e494d1accdaa89895b6d3e344fd1dd79b554561.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Far East[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/132b05237740cebd472501cf6e3f59822fc53172.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Airshipyard[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bda7a47cd88e0b8599778bb108e70f080fd07c36.jpg[/img]

Take a leap into the unknown! These three map candidates are our latest creations:
[list]
[*] [b]Anykeyyevka[/b], a 1,000x1,000 m map with a Soviet setting, featuring diagonal symmetry, varied elevation, and a combination of cityscape and wilderness
[*] [b]Aquila[/b], an extra-large 1,200x1,200 m location based on Southern Europe, featuring mostly countryside with a small town
[*] [b]Klostertal[/b], a 1,000x1,000 m map set in Central Europe and consisting largely of city blocks with a spacious park in the middle
[/list][h3][b]Anykeyyevka[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/501e2047e20cf358b4b36dde487bd15c684a016e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Aquila[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a07ba13f8d931cdb346ee56791c88a3ef797b7f1.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Klostertal[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/83f5972d784a23d02a398be8ff35d72992b875e7.jpg[/img]

Please take note that the maps in Recon Mission are prototypes designed for Random Battles. While their gameplay experience is almost finalized (to be fine-tuned with your help), the visuals may undergo more significant changes before the official release.

[h2]Questionnaire: Reworked[/h2]

Your thoughts about the proposed World of Tanks maps have been very insightful, so we’ve decided to give you more ways to share your opinion in the questionnaire. Our new upgraded questionnaire is more user-friendly and responsive. Most importantly, it allows you to point out problematic points on a minimap if you mention that the positions of the teams are unbalanced. You can also provide detailed descriptions for up to three positions and explain what exactly is out of order. We’re sure this will help make your feedback more valuable than ever. If you change your mind about any Recon Mission map, you can fill out its questionnaire again at any point before the end of Recon Mission.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9a54c74db1935903bba44b465226ec019a370269.jpg[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0e63d6baad231207fbaa19b7fecf390046702538.jpg[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8038d896616a17db3388a2f82089a27924c88cef.jpg[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h2]Rewards: Doubled[/h2]

Making it into the top 12 by base XP (for both teams) in Recon Mission battles contributes to your progression bar. You’ll need to meet these conditions in 50 Recon Mission battles to complete the progression bar. Among the rewards (given when you reach certain thresholds as shown below) there are Personal Reserves, directives, days of WoT Premium Account, medals, and a unique 2D style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/97c3d7a310c5523092393b4b680a67c5ae843271.jpg[/img]

However, note that the progression will be reset after the first week, so you can try to earn the entire set of Recon Mission prizes twice!

Remember that participating in Recon Mission, providing feedback, and voting for your favorite map prototypes are the best ways to directly influence the future of World of Tanks.

[i]Don’t miss out on this opportunity to make World of Tanks the best it can be![/i]

notes.title: Update 1.17 in World of Tanks: Check Out What's New
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.17 is coming your way, Commanders! [/b]

The long-awaited Steel Hunter mode is returning to World of Tanks with the largest series of complex changes since its release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cfea0c5c58e14d1767d1e390be1cfb3b686ee862.jpg[/img]

[h2]Steel Hunter Returns![/h2]

One of your favorite game modes is returning to World of Tanks! This time, Steel Hunter has received a massive revamp, making it more enjoyable than ever. In addition to the two existing maps—Dreamland and Arzagir 4.04—we added a third atmospheric locale in a Scandinavian setting. You’ll also be able to play in three brand-new vehicles with unique new abilities. Many other changes await—we’re sure you’ll enjoy them!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1407200/view/3297210455220228799 style=button][b]MORE DETAILS[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/793538b34c9df74022f26302087776ff974af0b0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Recon Mission Relaunch[/h2]

This June, Recon Mission will return to the game in the familiar format but with slight adjustments. It will feature three brand-new and three reworked maps from the previous launch for you to try out and cast your vote on. Get ready to explore new maps and share your impressions!

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/content/1-17-recon-mission/ style=button][b]FIND OUT MORE[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2ce0a6a30f8cc4b16c5b9614bd743b159652aeb6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Battle Pass 2022: Season VIII[/h2]

Battle Pass is back again, tankers! Season VIII is here for the entire summer, from June 1, 2022, at 03:30 UTC through August 31, 2022. It's going to be a hot Season—and also a memorable one. The backstory will take you into the Warhammer 40,000 universe, with an epic confrontation between three commanders from the grimdark future. These mighty champions will become your recruits after you complete their respective Season VIII Chapters. Other rewards include three imposing progressive 3D styles inspired by the commanders’ specific factions, Battle Pass Tokens to be exchanged for rare Tier IX vehicles (including the empowered Cobra), 2D styles, and much more. After you complete all the three Chapters, you'll be able to get your hands on some of the rewards from the Seasons that came before.

notes.title: Steel Hunter 2022 Regulations
notes.content:
[b]Are you ready to prove that you are the best of the best, Commanders?[/b]

Steel Hunter, one of the most exciting modes in World of Tanks, is returning to the game with a series of important changes. Instead of several separate Stages, Steel Hunter will run for a whole month and kick off immediately after the release of Update 1.17. A fresh map, three brand-new tanks with unique abilities, and a completely reworked economy—but still only one winner! Welcome to Steel Hunter 2022!

[h3][b]Steel Hunter 2022[/b][/h3]
[b]EU:[/b] June 1, 2022, at 03:00 CEST through June 30, 2022, at 03:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA: [/b] May 31, 2022, at 04:00 PT | 06:00 CT | 07:00 ET through June 30, 2022, at 03:00 PT | 05:00 CT | 06:00 ET
[b]ASIA: [/b] 31 May, 2022, at 05:00 (UTC+8) through June 30, 2022, at 05:00 (UTC+8)

[h3][b]Prime Times:[/b][/h3]
[b]EU 1–2 server:[/b] 08:00–06:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA servers:[/b] 05:00-02:00 PT | 07:00-04:00 CT | 08:00-05:00 ET

[h3][b]Ceasefire Periods:[/b][/h3]
[b]EU 1–2 server:[/b] 06:00–08:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA servers:[/b] 02:00-05:00 PT | 04:00-07:00 CT | 05:00-08:00 ET
[b]HK server: [/b]04:00–07:00 (UTC+8)
[b]ANZ Server:[/b] 02:00–16:00 AEST (UTC+10)

[previewyoutube=AzulGUItvG8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Steel Hunter: Event Summary[/h2]
[list]
[*] You are [b]one of 20 players[/b] fighting for victory. It’s every Steel Hunter for themselves!
[*] Choose to fight solo or join one of 10 two-player Platoons.
[*] Your main goal is to [b]survive at all costs[/b] and become the last Steel Hunter standing.
[*] Collect special objects (loot) that randomly spawn on the map. These objects contain resources, Combat XP, and combat ability charges. You can also pick up loot from destroyed vehicles (Spoils of War), which are now depicted on the minimap.
[*] The most valuable loot type is the Airdrop. Many players will want to get their hands on Airdrops, so you'll have to push yourself to the limit to get to them first.
[*] You'll be able to upgrade your vehicles while in battle and get stronger with each new tier.
[*] Battles will unfold on three huge maps (including a fresh one), the playable areas of which will shrink with time. Escape the Destruction Zones that will gradually cause damage until your vehicle is destroyed.
[*] The total battle time is 15 minutes. Before each battle, you can choose from several spawn points on the map.
[*] You’ll also be able to earn Battle Pass Points when playing Steel Hunter.
[*] Steel Hunter will have its own in-game currency—Steel Seals—for renting mighty event vehicles. You can also earn credits and bonds for completing special daily missions available in the mode.
[*] You will receive [b]Steel Hunter Tokens[/b] for completing certain daily missions. Use them to redeem [b]three stunning 2D styles[/b] exclusive to Steel Hunter.
[/list][h2]How to Start Playing[/h2]

1. In your Garage, choose “Steel Hunter” in the mode selection menu to the right of the “Battle!” button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/516438086263feb3f67f848ccf680c2abfd8fd0a.jpg[/img]

2. You can also enter battles as a two-player Platoon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/895362fda735d10c193022f029aac82206c605aa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Maps and Reworked Danger Zone Mechanics[/h2]

In addition to the two existing maps, [b]Dreamland [/b]and [b]Arzagir 4.04[/b], we’re adding a new map called [b]Firnulfir [/b]with a different setting and unique game atmosphere. This unforgiving yet picturesque Scandinavian tundra will enchant you with its northern landscapes, frozen ponds, and small abandoned settlements. Despite the cold, you’re sure to stay warm while driving nonstop to avoid strikes from other Steel Hunters. Firnulfir will offer players a fresh gameplay experience and many opportunities to experiment with all kinds of tactics.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/542a150d07b205d66f376c755d942fba86940685.jpg[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bbdaaccead39c421d1dce1b96a8a71b9f3c06626.jpg[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7a01915e890383897f6637d84e5f0848e081be7d.jpg[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][b]Dreamland minimap[/b][/td]
[td][b]Arzagir 4.04 minimap[/b][/td]
[td][b]Firnulfir minimap[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
We’ve also reworked the [b]Danger Zone mechanics[/b]. These zones will now close faster, depending on the number of players on the battlefield. So, the fewer the players, the quicker you’ll have to move to escape the Danger Zones. All three maps shrink with time, leaving less space to play and survive. If you’re in an area that turns orange, that means it is about to become a Danger Zone and you need to leave it as soon as possible. When a Danger Zone turns red, it becomes a Destruction Zone. You will have very little time to escape from it, as shown in a countdown. Once the countdown ends, your vehicle will receive continuous damage until it is destroyed or until you have left the Destruction Zone.

[h2]Special Vehicles and Their Upgrade System[/h2]

In addition to the five vehicles from last year, three brand-new tanks with unique abilities (more on them below) will also join the hunt in 2022:
[list]
[*] [b]The Huragan[/b], a versatile Polish tank
[*] [b]The Bái Láng[/b], a speedy Chinese tank
[*] [b]The Beowulf[/b], a menacing Swedish tank
[/list][table noborder=1 equalcells=1]

All eight special vehicles available in Steel Hunter have different tactics, gameplay, and Abilities. Each of them can be upgraded from Tier I to Tier VII while in the heat of battle. Three of the vehicles will be available from the start, and the remaining ones will be available for rent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/79d2439409f91d93a0f1749c04727847c5136621.gif[/img]

To earn XP for these upgrades, you’ll need to [b]collect loot and damage enemies[/b]. There are different modules available for each vehicle, and players can choose from two options at each tier.

[b]Learn more:[/b] [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/steel-hunter-regulations-2022/#head-id-3]EU[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.com/en/news/game-modes/steel-hunter-2022-regulations/#head-id-3]NA[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/en/news/general-news/steel-hunter-regulations-2022/#head-id-3]ASIA[/url]. 

[h2]Vehicle Combat Abilities[/h2]

There are two Combat Abilities that are common for all vehicles:

[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fce12966d65d0ba6dc84422d99db9270301ed9d7.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Recovery[/b]: Gradually recovers a fixed percentage of the vehicle’s HP, but stops working if you take damage.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7488256ad340f02cd805ee7929bbc833a0663fdf.png[/img][/td]
[td][b]Repair Kit[/b]: Repairs vehicle modules (analogous to Large Repair Kits) and reduces stun duration.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Each vehicle also has one regular and one ultimate Combat Ability unique to it:

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c8eca6b039df6c364246f628f9f6352e375b8fe0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e3a23521d1748010797060e7f512ef316fd754d7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/295e33771cd3dbcd475309bdd583e1b3ea3f1914.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ca4fc112987c93c62c363e3a2ebb69f83bbdb558.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e7dffdf085d91edcb78a8b79bc88915809d86743.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/21924b982ddf94110203d0c04c2db1a7df99e129.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fedb20ec2882cb65ee1e062eec9cab5eef64c355.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e2376d85035e0193bacee6d5d164b63a83e57ac3.png[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]Vision/Aiming Mechanics[/h2]

The vision system uses [b]Vision Cones[/b]. Here’s how it works:
[list]
[*] Enemy vehicles only become visible when they appear inside your Vision Cone, which is depicted on the minimap. This does not change when activating the Sixth Sense perk, as you will still only be able to see enemies inside of your Vision Cone.
[*] If enemies are within 50 meters of you, they will automatically become visible.
[*] When enemies are within sight, their markers and HP bars are displayed.
[*] When aiming at an enemy, the vehicle’s silhouette is also displayed.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b4083bcfd51f5e0760a6bb3cae50b9f77dab68d5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Radio Detection Mechanics[/h2]

All vehicles in Steel Hunter are equipped with Radio Detection, which displays loot points (Consumables and Supplies), enemy tanks, and loot from destroyed vehicles (Spoils of War) on the minimap within its coverage area. To activate it, press the X key. Remember that when you activate Radio Detection, your current position will be revealed on the minimap to all players within Radar range of your position.

[quote=]You can only be detected if you are within the area of another player's Radio Detection. The detection radius of a specific vehicle depends on the characteristics of the modules installed.[/quote]
[h2]Looting[/h2]

To upgrade your vehicle, you need to search for special loot points on the map. Once you reach these points, you will be able to collect loot that may contain Battle XP, shells, and charges for your Abilities.

There are four types of loot available:

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1d178b4c992f7c7aa3190f86c0c514f54729d5c8.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f6f134c6b96add9c4d1703e51786f8f6778ce980.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/260ca1d1ef7c9681be467602c051675b69b33960.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b7f6f9b4380f338a5333604fc8f58aaee4e5b3ed.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][b]Ammunition[/b][/td]
[td][b]Airdrops[/b][/td]
[td][b]Spoils of War[/b][/td]
[td][b]Consumables[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Loot from destroyed vehicles (Spoils of War) is now depicted on the minimap. Collecting this loot will be riskier than before, but you'll also be able to take someone else's loot a lot faster (in two seconds) and more often. You can also collect two or more pieces of loot at the same time.

[h2]Crew[/h2]

Crew members are exclusive to the vehicle they come in and can’t be dismissed, injured, or sent to the Barracks. They do not earn Crew XP, and they each have Sixth Sense as a zero perk. In addition, the following perks will be fixed for the Commanders of each vehicle:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e2cb00583633b8a2e110ef8fdb696da43311d828.png[/img]

[h2]Economy in Steel Hunter[/h2]

We have completely reworked the mode's economy. In 2022, Steel Hunter will have its own in-game currency: Steel Seals . These can be earned based on your position in the post-battle ranking or for completing special daily missions. In this launch of Steel Hunter, you can only use Steel Seals to rent mighty event vehicles. The higher you place, the more Steel Seals, credits, and Combat XP you earn. And don’t forget that you can convert Combat XP into Free XP!

Steel Hunter will also have a [b]permanent bonus to credits and Combat XP from WoT Premium Account[/b] and allow you to earn 50% more Steel Seals. Additionally, you can now take advantage of the following:
[list]
[*] Personal and Clan Reserves for extra Combat XP and credits
[*] A 15% bonus to credits and XP when playing in a Platoon
[/list]Three of the eight event vehicles—the Varyag, the Raven, and the Arlequin—will always be available in your Steel Hunter Garage. The remaining five special tanks will be available for rent. You can rent each of these tanks for a free test drive, but each subsequent rental will cost you a certain number of Steel Seals. The rental time is seven days.

[h2]Complete Special Missions to Get Unique Styles![/h2]

In 2022, Steel Hunter will still be closely connected to Battle Pass, and the Battle Pass Points you earn will depend on your position in the post-battle ranking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ea608fa758b4e9bed0a242d15becfae6fd215fbb.jpg[/img]

[b]Special daily missions[/b] will also be available in Steel Hunter. These missions can only be completed in Steel Hunter once per day, and successful missions will reward you with credits and Steel Seals. You can also complete additional daily missions for mastery and be rewarded with bonds.

[b]Learn more:[/b] [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/steel-hunter-regulations-2022/#head-id-10]EU[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.com/en/news/game-modes/steel-hunter-2022-regulations/#head-id-10]NA[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/en/news/general-news/steel-hunter-regulations-2022/#head-id-10]ASIA[/url]. 

You will also receive Steel Hunter Tokens for completing certain daily missions in the mode. Collect them to redeem three cool 2D styles available exclusively in Steel Hunter.

[h3][b]Steel Hunter[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/88da2740028a8f597ebae90fb6ede68fdb4144de.jpg[/img]

[/expand]
[h2]Steel Hunter Statistics[/h2]

In the new Season, you’ll be able to track your battle effectiveness in Steel Hunter via the [b]Service Record → Statistics tab in your Garage[/b]. Select “Steel Hunter” from the dropdown menu of available game modes to see the number of vehicles you’ve destroyed, as well as your average damage per battle, number of wins, and other stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/63a651811b418335de64e8c1b83999c3300f982c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Performance in Steel Hunter[/h2]

Steel Hunter will require more system resources than regular Random Battles. This is due to several key factors that are specifically related to Steel Hunter, including the large map sizes and the significant number of objects on them. Players with 32-bit operating systems and low RAM may experience some performance issues while running this mode. To avoid any problems and ensure you play with maximum comfort, change the graphics settings of your game client in accordance with the capabilities of your CPU and graphics card.

[i]Good hunting, Commanders! Platoon up with your friends or go solo, and be the last hero standing![/i]

notes.title: Battle Pass Season VIII: Event Guide
notes.content:
[quote=][b]PLEASE NOTE:[/b] The content described in this article will be available only on the servers of the following regions: [b]EU[/b], [b]NA[/b], [b]ASIA[/b]. 

To learn more about the content available on [b]RU [/b]servers, please check [url=https://worldoftanks.ru/ru/news/game-events/battle-pass-season-VIII/]this article[/url].[/quote]
Commanders! Welcome to Battle Pass Season VIII, running [b]from June 1st, 05:30 CEST (UTC+2)  through August 31st[/b]!

The new Season is the result of a creative collaboration by World of Tanks and Warhammer 40,000, a rich universe based on tabletop miniature wargames and also comprising countless books and video games.

The backstory of Battle Pass Season VIII is set in the grimdark future where humanity is engaged in an endless conflict, threatened by heretics, mutants, and aliens on a million worlds. The three commanders who join your side once you complete the respective Chapters are the main characters of this story. The reward progressive 3D styles for the three Core Vehicles are inspired by their adventures and by the factions they represent: the [b]Ultramarines[/b], the [b]Death Guard[/b], and the [b]Evil Sunz Orks[/b].

[previewyoutube=grkcvJP99zQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]The Rewards[/h2]

While the narrative of Season VIII takes a new and exciting turn, its mechanics remain the same as the previous Season, from earning Battle Pass Points to the possibility of starting with any Chapter and switching to another on your whim.

The prizes are lucrative, as usual, and even more so with an Improved Pass.

Learn more: [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/battle-pass-season-8/#rewards]EU[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.com/en/news/game-events/battle-pass-season-8-event-guide/#rewards]NA[/url].

[h2]The 3D Styles[/h2]

There’s plenty of great stuff to be earned in battle during Battle Pass Season VIII, but some spoils of WAAAGH! really stand out. Like, for example, the brand-new Warhammer 40,000-themed progressive 3D styles for the Season VIII Core Vehicles.
[list]
[*] Your [b]E 100[/b] can proudly wear Ultramarine colors (which is mainly the namesake one).

[h2]The Cobra[/h2]

We would also like to draw your attention to the [b]Cobra[/b], one of the vehicles available for Battle Pass Tokens. There are two reasons for that. First, Season VIII is the first time you can obtain enough Tokens to claim this powerful medium tank. Second, the Cobra’s stats are currently being finalized (see the preliminary ones below) so that it’s ready to burst into the game in full power. This Tier IX Brit offers a bombastic combination of HESH shells and an autoloader, which is pure Waaagh!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2acd76c0d40e39ded4769eca41fdcc555b36afaa.png[/img]

[quote=][b]Reminder[/b]
Select a Chapter once the Season starts so you can complete Stages and claim the rewards. Remember that you can pause the current Chapter and switch to another at any time, without losing the progress you’ve made. Keep an eye on the number of Battle Pass Tokens you’ve accumulated. During this Season, the most dedicated will be able to obtain the Cobra, this year’s key prize. Once you’ve completed all three Chapters, you’ll become able to get crew members, 3D styles, and great goodies (such as bonds) for excess Battle Pass Points. Don’t forget to spend them all before August 31, when Season VIII ends.[/quote]
[h2]Earning Battle Pass Points[/h2]

As it always goes, you need Battle Pass Points to claim the goodies. During Season VIII, you can earn them in Random Battles and by completing Daily Missions. (Keep in mind that Points awarded for Daily Missions are given even after you reach a vehicle’s Point Limit.) The Core Vehicles of Season VIII—the  			E 100, the Object 430U, and the STB-1 — have extended Limits for maximum Points. 

Learn more: [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/battle-pass-season-8/#earning]EU[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.com/en/news/game-events/battle-pass-season-8-event-guide/#earning]NA[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/en/news/general-news/battle-pass-season-8/#earning]ASIA[/url].

[h2]The Story[/h2]

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/general-news/battle-pass-season-8-wh40k/]THE ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER[/url] of Battle Pass Season VIII left our main characters as they were preparing to battle for the Standard Template Construct on the desolate world of Tahnicus Mundi in the light of the twin suns of the Hursprari system. To be most precise, the millennia-old relic containing long-lost advanced technology is coveted by the Ultramarines and their former brothers from the Death Guard. The Orks are in for a fight—and for some scrap.

So what happened to the commanders after the battle? Who ultimately prevailed? And what is the true Ork way of opening reinforced blast doors?

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9909747b1a002d89c92ad36e3af82ca3f099a43a.png[/img]

[b]Upon entering the atmosphere of Tahnicus Mundi, we came under heavy Xenos fire but were able to land. No losses were reported.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4c2c43e017d39dd644a2bf474f0a94838d56ce0c.png[/img]

[b]We swiftly moved towards the projected location of the STC in a Spearhead formation, meeting some resistance from the Orks.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e4b132b420065f2a0092fe69153a70929e782476.png[/img]

[b]Our task was eased: The Xenos had already engaged the traitorous Space Marines, who arrived to claim the STC for their own nefarious purposes.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/314afdac14cad098bbe9e4d3d35a272c87baa940.png[/img]

[b]Driven by either madness or mere spite, the traitors’ commander challenged us over the comms. This allowed us to spot their main forces and avoid falling into the trap set by the Death Guard.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e8c53ed9e50f3bcbdbc217b86861512fa0585e25.png[/img]

[b]A surprise attack by the Xenos was also a factor, turning our confrontation into a three-way battle. Its course was quite… disorderly.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f8c50c852327feb25321dea1635f982de4d8434d.png[/img]

[b]The entire engagement turned out to be a gauntlet of sorts. But we are the Ultramarines, and we are prepared to overcome.[/b]
[/expand]
[h2]The Bundles[/h2]

Over the course of Battle Pass Season VIII, numerous themed bundles will be available in the in-game Store. Among these, we would like to highlight one featuring the devout Natalestra Aspais of Adepta Sororitas as a crew member and the awesome-looking [b]Ignis Purgatio[/b] 3D style for the Bat.-Châtillon 25 t .

[i]Join the fray and fight like the Ultramarines, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Frontline Returns for Its First Launch in 2022!
notes.content:
[b]One of the most exciting modes in World of Tanks is back, Commanders![/b]

In 2022, Frontline will no longer be tied to events or Stages. Instead, it will be launched at the end of each Battle Pass Season, so you can earn even more credits and Progression Points. The first week-long launch awaits you [b]from May 23 through 30[/b]. Let's see what it brings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/89d09bba28f913bea084c1df84364fbafc817fa0.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Frontline 2022: First Launch[/b][/h3]
[b]EU:[/b] May 23, 2022, at 06:00 CEST through May 30, 2022, at 03:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] May 23, 2022, at 04:00 PT | 06:00 CT | 07:00 ET through Monday, May 30, 2022 at 01:00 PT | 03:00 CT | 04:00 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] May 23, 2022, at 07:00 UTC+8 through May 30, 2022, at 04:00 UTC+8
[b]Australia Server Prime Time:[/b] 18:00-22:00 UTC+10

[h2]Balance Improvements[/h2]

In the first Frontline 2022 launch, we return to the comfortable [b]same-tier battles[/b]. Pick up your favorite Tier VIII vehicles and get ready for epic clashes in a familiar format!

Other core rules won’t change, but we’ve made the following balance adjustments to improve your gameplay experience:
[list]
[*] The order of Combat Reserves upgrades for SPGs has been changed. Now, they will unlock as follows:
[list]
[*] Attack Reserves
[*] Recon Reserves
[*] Tactical Reserves
[/list][*] The Engineering Combat Reserve was moved from Tactical to Recon Reserves, and Smoke Screen was moved from Recon to Tactical Reserves.
[*] Smoke Screen now not only conceals all allied and enemy vehicles in and behind the smoke, but additionally provides penalties to the skills of enemy crew (by 15%) and the view range value (by 30%) within the screen.
[*] We also improved the effectiveness of Artillery Strike. Depending on its level, this Combat Reserve will have 20/24/28 shells instead of 16/18/20.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d2deeaea4195c09c31b543dc666991f0673e0d0c.jpg[/img]

Finally, Combat Reserves [b]are now assigned to the same hotkeys[/b], so they will be more convenient for you to use during battle.

[h2]Kraftwerk Map Rebalancing[/h2]

The Kraftwerk map has received a large series of balance fixes that will make gameplay more comfortable for attackers. We changed several firing positions, added additional cover, made the path to the pillboxes more accessible, etc.

[h2]Changes to the Vehicle Rental System[/h2]

We’ve also updated the vehicle rental system in the mode. Instead of the weekend offer, daily discounts will appear on all days (except for the first day) that Frontline is available. You’ll be able to rent four popular vehicles with a cumulative 14% discount. All rental tanks come with 100% trained crews as an enjoyable bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a3a2639c9e22069a4c5af3549182cb58d0ddbdcb.png[/img]

[h2]Battle Pass Connection[/h2]

In 2022, Frontline will still be closely connected to Battle Pass. Don’t forget that you’ll be able to earn [b]Battle Pass Progression Points[/b] for both:
[list]
[*] Performance in battles
[*] Reaching new Frontline Tiers
[/list]The number of Points you can earn will depend on your position in the post-battle ranking by Frontline Experience earned and whether your team won or lost.

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]POSITION IN THE POST-BATTLE RANKING[/th]
[th]VICTORY[/th]
[th]DEFEAT[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]1–5[/td]
[td]25[/td]
[td]10[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]6–20[/td]
[td]10[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]21–30[/td]
[td]-[/td]
[td]-[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Upon reaching each Frontline Tier (except for the first), you will receive [b]20 Battle Pass Points[/b], as well as a bonus reward of directives.

Since Frontline will kick off at the end of each Battle Pass Season, you'll have a good chance to earn the maximum amount of Progression Points, and catch up and reap lucrative rewards you haven't received yet.

[h2]Frontline Daily Missions[/h2]

After reaching the maximum Frontline Tier (15), you will be able to complete [b]special daily missions[/b]. There will be 3 missions in total, all of which can be completed only once a day, in Frontline. Each completed mission will reward you with bonds and a Personal Reserve.

[expand type=details]
[h3][b]Do...[/b][/h3]

[b]Condition[/b]
[list]
[*] Play 3 battles and cause at least 5,000 damage to enemy vehicles in each battle by shooting, ramming, or using Combat Reserves.
[/list]
[b]Restrictions[/b]
[list]
[*] Once a day
[*] Only in Frontline
[*] Only for players who have the maximum Frontline Tier
[*] Progress resets daily
[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b]
[list]
[*] 25 bonds 
[*] x1 Personal Reserve +300% to Crew Experience for 1 hour 
[/list][h3][b]...or do not,...[/b][/h3]

[b]Condition[/b]
[list]
[*] Get the Rank of Captain 3 times.
[/list]
[b]Restrictions[/b]
[list]
[*] Once a day
[*] Only in Frontline
[*] Only for players who have the maximum Frontline Tier
[*] Progress resets daily
[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b]
[list]
[*] 25 bonds 
[*] x1 Personal Reserve +300% to Free Experience for 1 hour 
[/list][h3][b]...there is no try.[/b][/h3]

[b]Condition[/b]
[list]
[*] Play 3 battles and block at least 2,000 damage in each battle. Ricochets and non-penetrating hits are included.
[/list]
[b]Restrictions[/b]
[list]
[*] Once a day
[*] Only in Frontline
[*] Only for players who have the maximum Frontline Tier
[*] Progress resets daily
[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b]
[list]
[*] 25 bonds 
[*] x1 Personal Reserve +50% to combat experience for 1 hour 
[/list][/expand]
[i]Good luck in Frontline, Commanders! We’re sure that all these changes will make the mode even more exciting![/i]

notes.title: "Queen of the Night" Chapter: Get the New Czechoslovakian Tank Destroyer!
notes.content:
Want to get the first-ever Czechoslovakian tank destroyer for free, Commanders? Complete an additional Battle Pass Chapter—"Queen of the Night"—and add this brand-new vehicle to your collection!

This time-limited Chapter will be available [b]from May 12 through the morning of May 23[/b]. If you complete it within the given timeframe, you will get the [b]ShPTK-TVP 100[/b], a Tier VIII Premium Czechoslovakian tank destroyer.

But that's not all! If you get the Improved Pass for the "Queen of the Night" Chapter and complete the [b]Improved Rewards Track[/b], you will grab a striking 3D style for this new vehicle. Read up on all the details and get ready to win!

[h3][b]Battle Pass: Time-Limited "Queen of the Night" Chapter[/b][/h3]

[b]EU:[/b] May 12, 2022, at 06:50 CEST through May 23, 2022, at 06:20 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] May 12 at 02:50 PT | 04:50 CT | 05:50 ET through May 23 at 02:20 PT | 04:20 CT | 05:20 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] May 12, 2022, at 05:50 UTC+8 through May 23, 2022, at 05:20 UTC+8

[previewyoutube=4iWSWTlSutM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Time-Limited "Queen of the Night" Chapter: Let’s Refresh the Challenge Format![/h2]

We’re offering you a fresh and experimental take on your favorite opportunity to get a Premium vehicle for free. This time-limited Chapter will be available for 10 days as part of Battle Pass Season VII. If you complete it, you can [b]get the first-ever Czechoslovakian tank destroyer in the game for free![/b]

[quote=]During the launch of an additional Chapter, we're testing several new mechanics, one of which is the complexity of the progression system for players.

The Chapter's progression value was calculated based on [b]all sources of earning Battle Pass Points[/b]. It is important for us that you use all these sources to earn Points and advance through the progression, especially Daily Missions—they can earn you a significant number of Points. Another important source is the increased number of Points that Battle Pass Core Vehicles earn.

After the Chapter has finished, we will evaluate this new format to see if it is worth continuing in the future.[/quote]
[h2]How It Works[/h2]

As with the three main Chapters, this additional Chapter needs to be manually selected and confirmed in order to start earning rewards for your progress. Considering the Chapter is limited in time, it is better to activate it and start completing it as soon as it becomes available.

The progression system works in the same way as in the main Chapters but for a limited period of time. Upon completing it, you will receive a brand-new Premium vehicle for free. Now let’s see what the Chapter's main differences are and dig into the details.
[list]
[*] You earn [b]Battle Pass Progression Points[/b] according to the standard rules, based on the results of the battle. Battle Pass Core Vehicles—the Leopard 1 , the Kranvagn , and the T110E4 —still have increased Point Limits and can earn more Points in battles, assuming you haven't reached their Point Limits.
[*] You also earn Points for completing [b]Daily Missions and the Bonus Mission[/b].
[*] You will be rewarded with [b]additional Battle Pass Points[/b] when the Point Limit for a vehicle has been reached, even if you started filling the Limit before the start of this Chapter.
[/list][quote=]All Point Limits that apply throughout the Season also apply to the additional Chapter.[/quote]
[b]Daily Missions[/b] will be an important source of progression completion. To get the most out of these Missions, you will need to complete them on a regular basis. However, Daily Missions are quite doable and don't take much time to complete. And remember that if you don't like the conditions of a particular Mission, you can re-roll it!

[quote=]You cannot invest Progression Points previously earned in Battle Pass into your progress in this time-limited Chapter.[/quote]
Compared to the familiar challenge format, the additional Chapter offers more options and flexibility. Now, the whole process will be more manageable, and it will be easier for you to estimate how much effort it will take to complete the Chapter and get the main prize for free.

[h2]Reward Tracks[/h2]

The Chapter involves completing 40 consecutive Stages instead of 10. With the increase in Stages, it will now be easier for you to plan your time. The Chapter has one progression system but two Reward Tracks: Base Rewards and Improved Rewards. Each Stage completed in the Base Rewards Track will bring you useful prizes, including:
[list]
[*] Days of WoT Premium Account
[*] Bonds
[*] Credits
[*] And much more!
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ab39f906aa9136e4aea30c570d05d2593eb2f53c.jpg[/img]

When all 40 Stages in the Base Rewards Track are completed within the given timeframe, you will get the ShPTK-TVP 100 for free. This vehicle comes with a 100% trained crew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cad1f5cfd95041460b0d19ce425110ef583ed5aa.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/25a91db56c1dee38da832e9d7c56c3ef9e1f596a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1304262c305e28ebaf056fd039534326461ab911.jpg[/img]

[/expand]
Want to receive even more rewards, such as Personal Reserves and Crew Books? Get the Improved Pass for this additional Chapter to unlock the [b]Improved Rewards Track[/b]. After that, you will receive all Improved Rewards for the Stages you have already completed in the first Track. The main prize for this Improved Reward Track is a spectacular 3D style for the ShPTK-TVP 100.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f84f0368b3e4def6c30ac6564cfe5b554986a0c0.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/39fb0c9dbdebe6103e9aa0c2bc30736022e94f4b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/38437e3b96d90db707369a1d5e881fbbd668addf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4adf3d681fe3a43c5599870339ed2d576babd9fb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/aa33d755dba6011fec36cf66a288eb7aa4bc6adb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c35f96ac82b7971c3d1a73ecc080473c8dab3b2d.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
As before, you determine the final cost of the vehicle. It will depend on the [b]number of Battle Pass Stages you have completed[/b], just like in the main Chapters. Purchasing an Improved Pass allows you to purchase any number of Progression Stages. It is up to you to decide how many Stages to complete while playing World of Tanks, and how many to buy for gold.

[quote=]There will be no “last call” period for making a purchase. Don’t miss the deadline, and make your decision before [b]the morning of May 23[/b] when the extra Chapter ends.[/quote]
[h2]Meet the ShPTK-TVP 100![/h2]

This Tier VIII Premium vehicle is [b]the first Czechoslovakian tank destroyer in the game[/b]. This vehicle has exactly the characteristics that you would expect from a lightly armored support TD, so its gameplay requires you to be prudent and see opportunities on the battlefield.

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the Commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks, and skills, as well as special in-game items.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d5c444479e95090b140b80183f0e85aac4b3f91e.png[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/89ff5754debbbd7cb5dbdce4f149a8bde9f1d89e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/19a6000fa628881aafca305cd91f3c261675a9d8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3cdbb8553374f8fd8c1d47d23c2dee2222ec4ada.png[/img]
[/expand]
One of its main advantages is its [b]high 270 mm penetration with standard AP shells[/b]. You'll be able to penetrate even well-armored targets and cause damage in battles with vehicles of all tiers. But in battles with Tier X opponents, you'll have to aim more carefully. You will also need to get used to the shell velocity of standard AP shells. On the other hand, they lose less armor penetration at a distance and have better normalization after hitting the armor.

The vehicle’s [b]mobility and high top speed of 55 km/h[/b] are excellent compared to other Tier VIII vehicles, so you can quickly reach positions you want, depending on the current combat situation. This is very important for good performance in battles, but you need to create opportunities to get the most out of this vehicle's DPM.

Its accurate , sharp-shooting gun has excellent aiming and reload time (5.4 seconds) and delivers an [b]incredible DPM of 2,778 HP[/b]. It is achieved thanks to the high rate of fire, while the alpha damage is rather modest. Therefore, you need to learn how to make the most of the opportunities that the vehicle provides. You need to choose the right positions and play carefully from behind your allies.

[b]A fully rotating turret[/b] is another trick up your sleeve. It allows you to control wider areas of the battlefield , staying in position and using all its advantages.

Always remember your [b]concealment values[/b], use all the bushes, and don't forget to roll back after a shot. Given your low HP and high DPM, it's better to avoid a possible enemy shot than to take an extra shot yourself. A high rate of fire will allow you to catch up and seek revenge against your opponents, but the low HP will require you to use rather prudent tactics.

[b]Field Modification[/b] will be especially useful for this vehicle. For example, it will allow you to reduce the unmasking effect after a shot, which is very important for the ShPTK-TVP 100.

[i]Roll out and get the brand-new ShPTK-TVP 100, Commanders![/i]

notes.title: Art of Strategy: Event Guide
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

[b]From April 21 through May 4[/b], World of Tanks will host the new Art of Strategy event. Get ready for intense clashes on familiar maps and familiar vehicles…but with new tactical opportunities! Smash through four consecutive Progression Stages and complete daily missions to earn high-value rewards!

[h3][b]Art of Strategy[/b][/h3]
[b]EU:[/b] April 21, 2022, at 13:00 CEST through May 4, 2022, at 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] April 21, 2022, at 06:00 PT | 08:00 CT | 09:00 ET through May 4, 2022, at 23:00 PT | May 5 at 01:00 CT | 02:00 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] April 21, 2022, at 18:00 UTC+8 through May 5, 2022, at 00:00 (UTC+8)

[h3][b]Prime Times[/b][/h3]
[b]EU SERVERS:[/b] 13:00–23:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA SERVERS:[/b] 01:00-23:00 PT | 03:00-01:00 CT | 04:00-02:00 ET
[b]HK SERVER:[/b] 18:00–00:00 (UTC+8)
[b]ANZ SERVER:[/b] 20:00–02:00 (UTC+10)

[previewyoutube=vxpTDnTpC-U;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How to Start Playing[/h2]

Click the special 3D object to enter the main screen of the Art of Strategy event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0c0b1d2d699b43ccf97a156f3684105f00351063.jpg[/img]

[h2]Set Up Your Strategy![/h2]

[quote=]Art of Strategy is an event that features many brand-new and unique mechanics for World of Tanks. During the event, to make the gameplay experience more enjoyable for both Tankers and Strategists, some balance changes and tweaks may be made, including significant ones.[/quote]
Art of Strategy battles take place in two formats for [b]Tier X vehicles only[/b].
[list]
[*] [b]1v7 format[/b]. Seven Tankers fight against one Strategist who commands seven AI-controlled vehicles in real time. For combat, the Strategist also selects three (out of six) types of defenses.
[*] [b]1v1 format[/b]. In this duel, two Strategists will fight for supremacy. Both players start on an equal footing with seven AI-controlled vehicles each. Before battle, both Strategists can deploy three types of defenses to pre-arranged positions.
[/list][b]From April 21 through 24, only 1v1 battles will be available in the event[/b]. Use this time to learn the specifics of playing as a Strategist and to master the variety of available tools. Try different squad compositions, choose various defenses, and use a variety of tactics. This will help you oppose the Tankers more effectively in the 1v7 format once it is unlocked.

[b]Starting from April 25[/b], you will need special event currency—[b]Intel [/b]and [b]Orders[/b]—to play as the Strategist in the 1v7 and 1v1 formats. You can earn them by playing as a Tanker, as well as by completing a special daily mission (more about that below). [b]Intel [/b]and [b]Orders [/b]are credited depending on the result of battles within the event and are distributed among players on the Tanker team.  

You will also receive [b]300 Orders[/b] as a starting bonus when you first log in to the game [b]after April 25[/b]. 
[list]
[*] To play as a Strategist against the Tankers in the 1v7 format, you need 100 Intel. 
[*] To fight against another Strategist in the 1v1 format, 100 Orders are required.
[/list][quote=]If the queue time to enter battle is too long, or the number of Strategists is insufficient, the matchmaker may allow you to [b]play as a Strategist[/b] even if you do not have the required quantity of Intel and Orders.[/quote]
To make sure that you always have enough event currency to play in the event, we have designed a special daily mission that will be available in-game [b]from April 25 through May 4[/b]. You can find it in the “MISSIONS” tab of your Garage.  

[h3][b]Help Is on the Way[/b][/h3]

[b]Conditions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Play 5 battles and be among the top 10 players on your team by Combat XP earned
[/list]
[b]Rewards:[/b]
[list]
[*] 300 Intel
[*] 300 Orders
[/list]
[b]Restrictions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Random and Grand Battles only
[*] Once per day
[*] Only in Tier VI–X vehicles
[/list]Completing this mission will give you the opportunity to play [b]six more battles as the Strategist[/b]: three in the 1v1 format, and three in the 1v7 format. It’s the perfect way to enjoy the event for longer!

Now let’s take a detailed look at the event itself.

[h2]General Rules[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Strategist has a squad of [b]seven AI-controlled Tier X vehicles under their command[/b]. They can fight without directly controlling each vehicle, but if they do not set Stances or issue the appropriate commands (e.g., attack, withdraw, capture the base, etc.), they will not be victorious. The Strategist also sets routes for their vehicles, watching the battlefield from a bird's-eye view and moving freely over the map.
[*] Additionally, the Strategist has auxiliary defenses at their disposal. These cannot be controlled directly. Their positions are fixed, and they act as independent combat units.
[*] During the countdown before battle (60 seconds), the Strategist should deploy their vehicles and defenses at the pre-arranged key positions on the map or use the auto-deploy function. If you run out of time for deployment, the system will deploy the remaining units automatically.
[*] At any time, the Strategist can assume control of any vehicle in their squad and command it individually.
[*] In each battle, the Tanker team and the Strategist will earn credits, depending on the battle outcome and their personal performance:

[expand type=details]
[h3][b]1v7 Format[/b][/h3]

[b]Tanker[/b]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
	[th]POSITION IN THE POST-BATTLE RANKING BY XP EARNED[/th]

	[th]DEFEAT / DRAW[/th]
[/tr]

[/tr]
[/table][/expand]
[*] Battle duration: 15 minutes
[*] Battles will be fought on the following maps:

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
	[th]In the 1v7 format[/th]
	[th]In the 1v1 format[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][list]
[*] Airfield
[*] Ghost Town
[*] Siegfried Line
[*] Mannerheim Line
[*] Abbey
[*] Cliff
[*] Steppes
[/list][/td]
	[td][list]
[*] Airfield
[*] Ghost Town
[*] Siegfried Line
[*] Paris
[*] Mines
[*] Cliff
[*] Steppes
[/list][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][/list][h2]Objectives of the Teams[/h2]

Each team in the Art of Strategy event has the same objective: [b]destroy all enemy vehicles or capture the base[/b].

[quote=]The base capture time is 60 seconds for both the Tankers and the Strategist, regardless of the number of vehicles participating in the capture.[/quote]
If neither team completes its objective within the allotted time, the battle ends in a [b]draw[/b].

[h2]Playing as a Tanker[/h2]

Playing as a Tanker should feel familiar to you as it is similar to what you are used to in Random Battles.

During the countdown before battle, the Tankers can decide on their tactics and distribute the roles in the squad, taking into account the vehicles they have selected. Act as a team—this is the key to success. Breaking the defense of the Strategist and repelling their counterattacks alone will be extremely difficult.

Always be aware of the defenses that the Strategist has at their disposal. Concealed Watchtowers will warn the Strategist of your approach. At the same time, Flamethrowers, MRLs (Multiple Rocket Launchers), and other defenses can repel even the most rapid attack and provide support if the Strategist starts an offensive.

Depending on the battle results, the Tankers will receive [b]Intel and Orders[/b]—in-game currencies that are distributed among all commanders. The better your performance and the more base experience you earn, the more Intel and Orders you will receive.

[h2]Playing as a Strategist: Stances and Commands[/h2]

When playing as a Strategist, you will have a squad of seven vehicles at your disposal. Each of them is a full-fledged AI-controlled combat unit. Watching the battle from a strategic view and assessing the combat situation, you can set routes and one of three Stances for the vehicles. Stances are certain patterns of behavior on the battlefield that the vehicles follow when under AI control:

[h3][b]Adapt  [/b][/h3]

Default Stance for all the Strategist's vehicles. Vehicles will seek cover within a certain radius of the designated position and will defend the area by firing at attacking opponents.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5b026674ebb01a5738fcf8c2a1169c215536f546.png[/img]
[h3][b]Recon [/b][/h3]

Vehicles seek cover and transmit scouting data to their allies, trying to stay concealed. When spotted, the vehicles will try to withdraw to cover. If no cover can be found, they will engage the opponent.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/688dcd56d51e80bc136ec930cd9d969e2636e06f.png[/img]
[h3][b]Hold[/b][/h3]

Vehicles hold the designated position and engage targets when possible. Vehicles will change their positions only after receiving a command to attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0cfec21c7e12defc6b5f14c601fa774ce00f80cd.png[/img]
[expand type=details]
[quote=]When executing this Stance, vehicles with a limited horizontal gun or turret arc (e.g., the Badger, K-91, etc.) will seek targets and rotate their hull to cover a 90° sector of fire set by the Strategist.[/quote]
[/expand]
You can set Stances for vehicles not only in battle but also before it starts (both on the Squad Panel and during the countdown).

In addition to setting Stances, the Strategist can give [b]commands [/b]to attack, withdraw, defend the base, etc. There are seven commands in total. Here's how the vehicles respond to them:

[h3][b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3065784b39dced8100a3eeaf63402a89e9b294dd.png[/img]Attack [/b][/h3]

The vehicle opens fire at the selected target if it is able to do so.

[h3][b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a7fd2adccdf1adf76e891b00836e3a2b9287d8d5.png[/img]Charge [/b][/h3]

The vehicle will try to get as close as possible to the selected target and engage it in close combat, trying to attack it from the side or rear. It continues until the target is destroyed or the command is canceled.

[h3][b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e204c4be8adfb83cc579610c5e4d5b7ce2d492c7.png[/img]Move [/b][/h3]

The vehicle moves to the specified point without stopping. If, on the way, it encounters an enemy that can be damaged or destroyed, it will stop to attack. Having reached the specified position, the vehicle will continue executing the set Stance.

[h3][b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d0b23401eaf6e0478ccb4322ffec750539637d71.png[/img]Rush [/b][/h3]

The vehicle will move to the specified point via the shortest path possible. It will fire on the move, but it won't stop to fire. Once in position, it will continue to execute the set Stance.

[h3][b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6c8fa3cb3d2b1b60fb685c12445a3c3c9388f9da.png[/img]Withdraw [/b][/h3]

The vehicle will withdraw along the shortest path to the specified point, keeping its frontal armor to the enemy. Once in position, it will continue to execute the set Stance.

[h3][b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d0a451197526d5d3c97ad3d540802790a540885a.png[/img]Capture Base [/b][/h3]

A variation of the Move command. The vehicle will stay within the enemy base.

[h3][b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/25f3c10d0975d57fe83a63e9889285c8e22d5b2e.png[/img]Defend Base[/b][/h3]

Another variation of the Move command. The vehicle will move to its base and try to prevent base capturing.

[quote=]The Strategist can give a [b]series of commands[/b]. To do this, add several commands to the queue while holding Shift. The vehicle will execute them sequentially in the order they were added to the queue. If you have given a command or series of commands, pressing the Spacebar will cancel them.[/quote]
In battle, each vehicle from the Strategist's squad will be marked with a special commander icon and a sequence number. You can quickly switch between them by using the corresponding number keys. You can also command several vehicles at once by adding them to groups.

[h2]Manual Control of Vehicles by the Strategist[/h2]

Are you ready to finish the enemy off and ensure a spectacular victory? Or maybe the situation on the battlefield is becoming critical and it is necessary to repel an attack by the Tankers at all costs? Assume control of any vehicle in your squad and command it individually. This way, you can show your skills and turn the tide of battle at the right time.

[quote=]To assume control of a vehicle, select it and press [b]Q[/b]. Please note that assuming control of a vehicle stops all orders given to that vehicle. Press Q again to stop controlling the vehicle.[/quote]
[h2]Defenses[/h2]

The Strategist has defenses at their disposal. They will automatically assist the Strategist in battle. The Strategist cannot give commands to defenses but can deploy them to key positions on the map during the countdown before battle. Each defense has its own range and parameters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1ca1772f434c534e6cfe315353c4a479d613f81c.png[/img]

[h2]Preparing Squads[/h2]

Vehicles for the Strategist's squad are selected in the event Garage. Click the squad composition button and fill all seven slots with Tier X vehicles. You will be able to select any researchable and collectible Tier X vehicles that exist in the game, with the following exceptions:
[list]
[*] Vehicles earned for various in-game activities (e.g., T95/FV4201 Chieftain, Object 279 early, etc.)
[*] Panhard EBR 105  
[*] ST-II  
[*] Strv 103B  
[*] M-V-Y  
[*] CS-63  
[/list][quote=]All vehicles selected by the Strategist will have equipment, consumables, and a crew trained to 100%, regardless of the availability and condition of such vehicles in the player's Garage.[/quote]
Slots for the Strategist's vehicles have restrictions on the vehicle type. Additionally, you cannot have two identical vehicles in a squad. Experiment and choose a squad composition that best suits your playstyle. This will allow you to fend off the Tankers more effectively and increase your chances of victory. The Strategist can also select defenses on the Squad Panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7216f938181adc887b18678b880bbbbd4e96d810.jpg[/img]

Once the squad is ready, click the "Battle!" button to start the battle.

To enter battle, the Tankers need to select a Tier X vehicle in their Garage. It should be repaired and have a full crew and ammo loaded. The Tankers cannot join battle in a wheeled vehicle or in vehicles earned for activities on the Global Map and for Personal Missions.

[h2]Build the Event Collection and Get Rewards![/h2]

The Art of Strategy progression consists of four consecutive Stages and involves assembling the event Collection with different customization elements. To fill the progression meter and complete the Stages, you need to fulfill special missions in the event.

Each day, you will have access to two daily missions for both the Strategist and the Tankers. For completing two missions for the Strategist, you will receive two random Collection items. The same goes for completing two missions for the Tankers. Every customization item is unique—each one will drop just once. They include styles, medals, inscriptions, decals, badges, and five unique and fully trained crew members with Brothers in Arms as a zero perk, plus enough experience to learn an additional perk of your choice.

[h3][b]Battlefield[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.16.1 is Here!
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.16.1 is coming, Commanders! [/b]

Try out the new features in the aiming interface, fight as Strategists and Tankers in the newest Art of Strategy event, and get ready for the return of Frontline, featuring game and balance adjustments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/25952b82006cb20a59802fa9efe1fe16ce6c9bf2.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Vehicle Outlining[/h2]

We’re introducing two new features to the aiming interface to help you hit opponents with greater accuracy.

The rendering of various obstacles that are inside the vehicle collision model will be useful when aiming at enemy vehicles that are obstructed by bushes, fences, etc. When you see an opponent in the crosshair, obstacles inside its collision model will be highlighted with two types of special rendering, depending on whether the shell can penetrate them or not.

Vehicle outlining by collision model will help you identify all the external "through" elements on a potential target that it makes no sense to aim at. The hull and turret of all vehicles will be highlighted by the collision model, while the suspension will still be outlined by the visual model.

By default, these new features will be disabled in the game client. You can enable them manually in the Reticle tab in the game settings.

[quote=][b]Important:[/b] Enabling these settings may cause performance issues, especially on low-spec PCs.[/quote]
The new vehicle outlining is an experimental solution that significantly affects the aiming process and your gameplay experience. We're getting mixed feedback on these changes and will continue to monitor them closely to see what impact they may have on key game parameters. With your help, we will see what the future holds for this feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fa9249f8db86cf21f8c277e1b27d7db8c9ca224a.gif[/img]

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/content/docs/release_notes/1-16-1-map-vehicle-outlining/ style=button][b]DETAILS[/b][/url]

[h2]Showcase Your Strategy[/h2]

Want to command not just one tank but a whole squadron of Tier X vehicles? Brace yourselves for the new Art of Strategy event, which is just around the corner! You’ll have the opportunity to take on the role of a real-time Strategist who has seven AI-controlled allies at their disposal, or you can be one of the seven brave Tankers on opposition. Which side will you choose in this showdown?

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/news/updates/1-16-1-CT1-the-art-of-strategy/ style=button][b]MORE DETAILS[/b][/url]

[previewyoutube=zv8fjhM_Pfw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Frontline Returns[/h2]

The most epic mode in World of Tanks is back! There will be several launches of this mode in 2022, the first of which kicks off in May. Frontline's core gameplay remains unchanged, but we’re back to the comfortable format of single-tier battles. Select your favorite Tier VIII vehicles, and get ready to hone personal and team tactics in your favorite mode!

notes.title: Ranked Battles: Take the Final Step Toward Your Annual Reward!
notes.content:
[b]The year-long epic is coming to an end with a bang, Commanders![/b]

Ahead of you is the third and final Season of Ranked Battles 2021–2022. It will complete a whole cycle of three competitive Seasons and promises you a reward worthy of all the battles you’ve endured along this long journey!

The final Season will take place [b]from March 7 through March 20[/b]. After it ends, you will receive your Annual Reward, depending on how many Rank Tokens you earned during all three Seasons. Brace yourselves for the fiercest of battles—this is your last chance to make the final push for the formidable [b]114 SP2 and a host of other cool prizes![/b]

[h2]The Brand-New Milton Pact 3D Style for the Concept 1B[/h2]

This Season, we'll update the list of exclusive Ranked Battles goodies available for bonds. This time, we’ve added the [b]brand-new Milton Pact 3D style for the Concept 1B[/b]. You can get it for 5,000 bonds once you reach the Second Division.

The imposing and eye-catching Milton Pact custom look continues the visual concept of the [b]Garmr 3D style for the Kampfpanzer 50 t[/b], which was introduced in Season 2. It will turn your Concept 1B into a formidable hunk of steel and granite, within which a bright flame burns. The style has an unusual effect—you can see drops of burning lava falling from the vehicle's hull. Just looking at it will leave your opponents in awe and make your allies jealous, so if you have the Concept 1B in your Garage, this style is a must!

We also improved the reward selection screen, so now it will be even easier to redeem the pieces of improved equipment you will receive as part of the Annual Reward. This year, you’ll be able to grab up to three different items of improved equipment of your choice from all existing equipment in this category, including Improved Compressor and Increased Shell Resistance, which are currently exclusive to Ranked Battles and unavailable for bonds. Think carefully before selecting!

[h2]Progression System: A Quick Recap[/h2]

The final Season has the same basic rules. We're sure you remember them, but here’s a small summary just in case:
[list]
[*] Battles take place in the 10v10 format in Tier X vehicles.
[*] No more than one SPG and two light tanks per team will be allowed in battles.
[*] To ascend in rank in order to qualify for Leagues, you need to earn the following amount of chevrons: 
[list]
[*] [b]EU: 94 chevrons[/b] 
[*] [b]CIS: 94 chevrons [/b]
[*] [b]NA: 70 chevrons[/b] 
[*] [b]APAC: 70 chevrons [/b]
[/list][/list]When you qualify for a League, you’ll be able to complete special daily missions. There will be three missions in total, and each one can be completed in vehicles of four different roles. In total, missions for 12 different vehicle roles will be available. They will reward you with bonds and Daily Bonus Battles.

Want to compare your battle performance with other tank aces fighting in Ranked Battles? This ranking will be determined by your effectiveness throughout all three Seasons. Only the best 200 players will be listed on the Leaderboard, so try your hardest to get to the top and lead the ranked elite!

If you make it to the Leaderboard, you’ll receive the unique Ranked Battles Champion badge that you can apply as a symbol of glory and tank mastery.

[h2]Make the Final Push and Grab Your Annual Reward![/h2]

Based on the results of the three Seasons of Ranked Battles 2021–2022, the bravest and most skilled players will get the long-awaited Annual Reward. Depending on the number of Rank Tokens you have earned, you will receive one of the four rewards. This Season is your last chance to [b]earn up to five Rank Tokens[/b], so do your best to get a better Annual Reward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c32f333960854ae44b9732136f3b31699a97ed88.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c9754b76bf0d99875ae2eba3ee0dac1e7ca2cb68.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d1cb5269f6eb053d4454780afbe51a50db84a5a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4f45d11486aa110e746f8f49ce6685a3a4b95cc3.png[/img]

[quote=]Each item of equipment is available for selection only once. If you don't make a selection by September 2022, improved equipment will be automatically credited according to the following priority:
[list]
[*] [b]Increased Shell Resistance[/b]
[*] [b]Improved Compressor[/b]
[*] [b]Innovative Loading System[/b]
[/list][b]EXAMPLES[/b]
[olist]
[*] If you have already redeemed Increased Shell Resistance as part of your Annual Reward and, after that, you still have one more piece of equipment to choose from, then you will be credited with Improved Compressor.
[*] If you have redeemed Experimental Optics (for example) as part of your Annual Reward and, after that, you still have one more piece of equipment to choose from, then you will be credited with Increased Shell Resistance according to the list of equipment priority mentioned above.
[/olist][/quote]
[h2]The 114 SP2: Everything You Need for Good Hunting[/h2]

The main reward in Ranked Battles 2021–2022 is [b]the 114 SP2, a Tier X Chinese tank destroyer[/b]. This mighty predator features a fully rotating turret and has everything you need for good hunting. Despite its light armor, the 114 SP2 is extremely dangerous in duels at any distance thanks to its powerful and accurate gun that causes 650 HP of alpha damage.

High concealment values, great armor penetration, and short aiming time make this vehicle perfect for ambushing enemies, leaving them no chance of escape. The 114 SP2 is worth fighting for, so make the final push to add it to your tank collection!

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks and skills, as well as special in-game items.[/quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/34c91dd6eab5b234b76308a5d5c759125257ce20.png[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9ee6ff7718110a49041f10931ed3d5d854266255.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/086f4cd3cebab775151a632e591ed6fe70e7d801.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2349821b3f321e30cb2f2da637515069da562826.png[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]When Can I Get My Annual Reward?[/h2]

Your Annual Reward and all the prizes it contains will be credited to your account within two weeks of the end of the Season—you’ll just need to log in to the game to grab it! Any remaining Rank Tokens will be converted to bonds at the following rate:

[b]1 Rank Token = 500 bonds[/b]

Compensation will also occur automatically within two weeks of the end of Season 3.

[i]Get ready to fight to the last and grab your Annual Reward, Commanders![/i]

tags.feature: This Season, we'll update the list of exclusive Ranked Battles goodies available for bonds. This time, we’ve added the [b]brand-new Milton Pact 3D style for the Concept 1B[/b].
We also improved the reward selection screen, so now it will be even easier to redeem the pieces of improved equipment you will receive as part of the Annual Reward.

notes.title: Update 1.16 Rolls Out!
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.16 is here, Commanders! [/b]

Get ready to advance through Progression Stages of the revamped Battle Pass kicking off in March. You can also experience battles on three improved Random Battle maps, as well as the addition of the Assault mode to several other Random Battles locales. Finally, the closing Season of Ranked Battles 2021–2022 is around the corner, so gather your strength to make the final push for Rank Tokens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0e633d709e5463176120aefbb5b3fc554d4542ad.jpg[/img]

[h2]Map Balance Improvements[/h2]

We improved three Random Battle maps ([b]Siegfried Line, Ghost Town, and Erlenberg[/b]) to address several minor issues and balance the gameplay possibilities for both teams. We’re sure that these changes will make your battles more enjoyable and your experience more comfortable. Plus, the following maps now support Assault Battles: Redshire, Steppes, Mannerheim Line, Tundra, Overlord, and Safe Haven.

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/content/guide/general/1-16-map-rebalance/ style=button][b]Learn more...[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5abe23bcd010e5bd482bd3801bafa77b8e55522a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ranked Battles 2021–2022: Get Your Annual Rewards![/h2]

Your year-long battle journey in one of the most competitive modes is finally coming to an end. The closing Season of Ranked Battles 2021–2022 will take place [b]from March 7 through March 21[/b], so this is your last chance to display your mastery and make the final push for Rank Tokens for a better Annual Reward! Get ready for the fiercest of battles and join the race for the exclusive 114 SP2 and a load of other cool rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c84212c0ac8af0be32231e79c2a6ad00556b3670.jpg[/img]

[h2]Battle Pass: Season VII Is Coming![/h2]

In early March, the seventh Season of Battle Pass kicks off. It will run for almost three months and introduces several important changes.

The new Season will consist of three main Chapters, but now you can complete them in any order. You can also pause the completion of a Chapter and switch to a different one to grab the rewards you need the most.

This is the opening Season of 2022 and the first of the year in which you can earn Battle Pass Tokens—a special in-game currency. They will accumulate throughout the year in all Seasons of Battle Pass in which you participate in 2022. Use Battle Pass Tokens to redeem cool Tier IX reward vehicles, including two formidable brand-new tanks, [b]the Cobra and the Lorraine 50 t[/b].

A new Reward section of the in-game Store will be introduced where you’ll be able to redeem bonds and the following rewards:
[list]
[*] 3D styles for all Battle Pass Core Vehicles from the previous six Seasons
[*] Unique crew members from Season IV onwards
[/list]It will become available once you complete all three main Chapters. Plus, an additional time-limited Chapter with a special challenge will become available at the end of the Season.

And of course, the seventh Season will feature three new (and iconic!) Battle Pass Core Vehicles, each with its own unique progressive style: [b]the Kranvagn, the Leopard 1, and the T110E4[/b].

[url=https://worldoftanks.eu/news/general-news/battle-pass-season-7/ style=button][b]BATTLE PASS GUIDE[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ba400902299eaede6679d9d7f046c401f19596e0.jpg[/img]

[i]Enjoy the revamped Battle Pass, try out map improvements, and brace yourselves for the final Season of Ranked Battles 2021–2022![/i]

notes.title: Celebrate the Lunar New Year and Hunt Down the Hidden Tiger!
notes.content:
The Holiday Ops event is over, but we’re happy to celebrate once again, Commanders!

With the Lunar New Year approaching fast, we invite you to celebrate the Year of the Water Tiger and prolong the joyful mood! Jump into the special Hidden Tiger event, running [b]from January 28 at 09:00 CET through February 7 at 10:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b], and earn a host of cool prizes!

The Hidden Tiger Challenge will award you with a smashing 2D style, essential equipment items, and many other in-game rewards. But the main prize is [b]the powerful WZ-114, a brand-new Tier IX Premium Chinese heavy tank[/b] with a mind-blowing 3D style that features two states! In addition, the WZ-114 [b]can earn bonds[/b] and will be regularly filling your vault with this valuable in-game currency.

[h3][b]The Hidden Tiger[/b][/h3]
[b]EU:[/b] January 28, 2022, at 09:00 CET through February 7, 2022, at 10:00 CET (UTC+1)
[b]NA:[/b] January 28, 2022, at 06:00 PT | 08:00 CT | 09:00 ET through February 7, 2022, at 06:00 PT | 08:00 CT | 09:00 ET
[b]ASIA:[/b] January 28, 2022, at 09:00 UTC+8 through February 7, 2022, at 09:00 UTC+8

[quote=]The event consists of two Chapters: [b]Shadow of the Predator (Chapter I) and Tiger Leap (Chapter II)[/b]. Unlocking and completing Chapter II missions will grant you even more rewards, including the formidable [b]Tiger Claw 3D style[/b].[/quote]
[previewyoutube=KYsg127-gLc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Check Your Steam Inventory For More Surprises! [/h2]

Of course, we can’t leave you without some additional treats. To progress faster in Hidden Tiger event you have an opportunity to ride some interesting vehicles. Just log in to the game [b]from January 28, 2022 through February 6, 2022[/b] and you will receive a special gift to celebrate the coming of the Year of the Tiger. The gift will contain a set of special missions (more details on them below), and one of four Tier VI Premium tanks with 100% trained crew and commander with Sixth Sense perk for 10 rental days. 

That’s right – you decide which tank to pick as a gift! You can choose between the following vehicles: 
[list]
[*] Tier VI Premium Chinese Type 64 light tank 
[*] Tier VI Premium Japanese Heavy Tank No. VI heavy tank 
[*] Tier VI Premium German Dicker Max tank destroyer 
[*] Tier VI Premium British Sherman VC Firefly medium tank 
[/list]To park one of these tanks in your Garage for 10 days, just head to the [b]“DEPOT”[/b] tab and choose the [b]“HOMEFRONT SUPPLIES”[/b] section. They will be waiting for you there, ready for battle! 

And if you really enjoy the tank you’ve picked and wish to leave it in your Garage for good – go for it! You can purchase it on any moment, what’s even better, [b]you can get a discount on the tank’s price[/b] in Gold if you play more than 10 battles in it! The discount is calculated in the following way: 

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]Number of battles played in the rental tank [/th]
[th]Discount amount [/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]10[/td]
[td]10%[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]20[/td]
[td]20%[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]30[/td]
[td]30% (maximum discount)[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
The tank will be available for purchase with the any discount you’ve earned for 10 days after it happens.  

For example, if you played 10 battles you get 10% discount for 10 days, and on next day you play 10 more battles you will have 20% discount for another 10 days. 

Apart from the tank, the gift includes 5 special missions that can be completed [b]from January 28, 2022 through February 9, 2022[/b]. If you finish all missions, you will get the following useful rewards: 
[list]
[*] 200,000 Credits  
[*] Gun Rammer Class 2  
[*] Improved Aiming Class 2  
[*] x5 Battle Reserves +100% bonus to Combat XP for 1 hour  
[*] x5 Crew Reserves +200% bonus to Crew XP for 1 hour  
[*] x5 Battle Reserves +300% bonus to Free XP for 1 hour 
[/list]Use the tank of your choice from this gift to progress faster In the Hidden Tiger event, or just to have fun completing the missions. 

[h2]Hunt Down the Mighty WZ-114![/h2]

The day the Hidden Tiger event starts, you will see that everything in your Garage is ready for the celebration! Each Lunar Year is named after one of twelve animals, and 2022 will be held under the patronage of the Water Tiger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1fb2c445ceebc64534981e94e53f1ade4be442cb.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2e546152b428be50dbe98b0e74fd6b50030ae83e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2954db4e7d8ef673f2be86c40555986a43fe834d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/63c82aa46ec22bc4791765fcd0ebe68de6a180d6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8de7218a7cc983d52a56a16cbea930f61d4d6875.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/75831dc21fc73225ac9e2d309977ee69c68f1dee.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/828bee6eddd0e7a434f7a889fccd1340adaa927b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5d903245ef1765cc427cf424cfd5232e8ac671b7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bf8d5306cc8502c5d7949ca95beed423ad792905.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/10746dcb386a5d52228b9ac139247a942dca5a4a.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
The main prize of the challenge, the brand-new WZ-114, was chosen with this powerful predator in mind. This is the second Tier IX Premium tank in the game, which means it will earn more credits and Combat and Crew XP per battle. On top of that, the WZ-114 will allow you to earn bonds in battle, as a Tier X vehicle does, and swap the crew without penalty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/79a216521acca0ba6b70e193cb479d1209a80e65.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/39aed5fa67eadf5a0e34e049823e95cab3c4244d.jpg[/img]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/822c21609dcffdd975e08ca707616ab7a138abbc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0481e5c4340e8c9e179c46ce72eb22fb833386e1.jpg[/img]
