[/tr]
[/table][/expand]
[h2]Mechanics and Details [/h2]

To help you understand exactly how the Achievements feature will work in different possible scenarios, we’ve prepared answers to the most important questions. 

[b]Q: Is all my progress before the Achievements release considered? [/b]

[b]A:[/b] When we were developing the Achievements, our main concept was to make sure that they all can be completed by every single player. Most of the achievements are really easy to get, but there are some that will require some time to obtain. The captivating process of unlocking achievements, tracking your progress, hunting down “that last one” can be an extremely interesting experience. We feel that taking it all away from you by just giving them out based on your previous progress will mean robbing you of that sense of exploration and accomplishment. That’s why previous game progress will not be taken into account after the Achievements release. 

However, our players already have outstanding results which we simply cannot leave without recognition, so we would like to reward your efforts and skills regarding some particular achievements. Thus, with the feature release, everybody who managed to complete the required conditions will receive the following achievements: 

[table]
[tr]
[th]Icon[/th]
[th]Name[/th]
[th]Description[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2be2c15f39579885b91bb9bf7d4e4f80e6978634.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/5d4b685955b3a7550edb97be22b8dddd14d9e1dd.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][b]You Must Be New Here[/b][/td]
[td]Complete the Bootcamp.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/67f81fa4165da6734ad6ce1dcb43a2f27b2de3d5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/45dcaf9a59dfa6ef55a38fcb44fa3c12b989d494.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][b]...And That's How You Do It[/b][/td]
[td]Complete all Briefing missions.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/94c07b1b3db21226aea5745bec81a08c94c842aa.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fd0f3d5479ba0ef60748d84fa6c163c76602f63c.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][b]Smooth Operation[/b][/td]
[td]Complete all Personal Missions in the same operation.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[b]Q: Is the Achievement progress shared between all regions? [/b]

[b]A:[/b] No. If you have two accounts on different regions, they will have separate achievements progress. However, Steam will display only [b]the highest achievement progress for all regions.[/b] To help you understand this better, let’s look at an example: 

A player has two accounts – an EU account and an NA account. On each account he has different progress on a certain Achievement, but on his EU account the progress is bigger than on his NA one. In this case, the EU progress bar will be shown [b]for both accounts:[/b] 

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]Account [/th]
[th]Achievement Progress  [/th]
[th]Displayed in Steam? [/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]EU  [/td]
[td]500 / 1000 [/td]
[td]YES [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]NA [/td]
[td]450 / 1000  [/td]
[td]NO [/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
If the player stops playing on his EU account and starts grinding this achievement on his NA account, he will not see any progress in the achievement progress bar until the progress [b]surpasses that of his EU account[/b]. As soon as the progress on the NA account is bigger, it will be displayed in Steam instead: 

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]Account [/th]
[th]Achievement Progress  [/th]
[th]Displayed in Steam? [/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]EU  [/td]
[td]500 / 1000 [/td]
[td]NO[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]NA [/td]
[td]501 / 1000  [/td]
[td]YES  [/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[b]Q: Will there be more achievements added in the future? [/b]

[b]A:[/b] Achievements have just been released: explore them and rise to the challenge! The future of achievements is in your hands. After all, if you like them and want even more, feel free to let us know and share your ideas and suggestions.  

[b]Q: Will there be an achievement for unlocking all the achievements? [/b]

[b]A:[/b] Right now, we do not have such an achievement for one simple reason: what if our players would like to see more achievements? We do not want to limit ourselves by adding a “final” achievement and will be paying a lot of attention to your reaction to this feature and your thoughts and ideas about its future.  

[b]Q: Do I get any prizes in the game when I unlock an achievement? [/b]

[b]A:[/b] No. The achievements are designed to allow you to showcase your mastery in World of Tanks and share high results with friends and gaming communities in Steam, as well as guide you in your journey to becoming a skillful player. 

[b]Q: How much time do I need to get all the achievements? [/b]

[b]A:[/b] We would like to emphasize again that we designed the achievements in such a way that every player is able to get them all. Of course, there are the easier ones and ones that will require a bit of extra effort, but we wanted to make the feature enjoyable and fun, so let’s just say that you won’t need to grind them for thousands of hours. 

[h2]Let the Great Achievement Hunt Begin! [/h2]

Achievements will bring a whole new perspective to playing World of Tanks, adding a new level of competitiveness between you and your friends and setting some goals for your future in the game.  

In the upcoming article we will tell you more about the Community Events and Activities that will launch soon to support the release of the Achievements, so stay tuned! 

[i]Roll out onto the battlefield and let the hunt begin!  [/i]

notes.title: Update 1.14.1 in World of Tanks
notes.content:
The August Heat may have subsided, but that doesn't mean we're taking a break! The rebalance of several Chinese vehicles and the arrival of the third Stage of Frontline are the highlights of the upcoming update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6e6b9524f40a7a506033c83d3ff0101d92a5e631.jpg[/img]

[h2]Chinese Vehicles Rebalance[/h2]

Seven Chinese Tech Tree vehicles and one Premium counterpart have had some of their stats tweaked to improve their battle performance and enhance your gameplay experience. Learn more: [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/content/1-14-1-cn-tanks-rebalancing/]EU[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.com/en/news/updates/update-1-14-1-chinese-vehicles/]NA[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/en/news/general-news/1-14-1-cn-tanks-rebalancing/]ASIA[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7b77cd72b42cc10042e3bdb8c64c2f80364e4c70.jpg[/img]

[h2]Frontline: Stage 3[/h2]

The third stage of Frontline is fast-approaching, so it’s the perfect time to ready your vehicles, refine your trusty tactics, and test out new strategies in preparation for its return. After all, this could be the difference between victory and defeat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ada977cd1926ca1739a6095aeafac5410bb16054.jpg[/img]

[h2]To Battle, Commanders![/h2]

Update 1.14.1 is here. Try out the revamped Chinese vehicles and get ready for a new stage of 30v30 battles in Frontline!

Learn more: [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/1.14.1/]EU[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.com/en/1.14.1/]NA[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/en/1.14.1/]ASIA[/url]

notes.title: Return of the Waffenträger: Event Guide
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

[b]From September 27 through October 11[/b], World of Tanks will host the Return of the Waffenträger event. Battles will be fought in the 7-vs-1 format on a select of maps. The Harriers will face the extremely powerful Blitzträger auf E 110, the creation of the formidable Max von Krieger. Let’s dig into the details.

[h3]Event Dates[/h3]
[b]EU:[/b] September 27 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2) through October 11 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] September 27 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET through October 11 at 02:00 PT | 04:00 CT | 05:00 ET
[b]SEA:[/b] September 27 at 17:00 (UTC+8) through October 11 at 17:00 (UTC+8)

[h3]Prime Times (First Event Day)[/h3]
[b]EU: [/b]from 14:00 CEST (UTC+2) to 00:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] 06:00-23:00 PT | 08:00-01:00 CT | 09:00-02:00 ET
[b]SEA:[/b] from 18:00 (UTC+8) to 00:00 (UTC+8)

[h3]Prime Times (All Other Event Days)[/h3]
[b]EU:[/b] from 12:00 CEST (UTC+2) to 00:00 CEST (UTC+2)
[b]NA:[/b] 11:00-23:00 PT | 13:00-01:00 CT | 14:00-02:00 ET 
[b]SEA:[/b] from 14:00 (UTC+8) to 00:00 (UTC+8)

[previewyoutube=7CC33l-LDSE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Return of the Waffenträger: Event Summary[/h2]
[list]
[*] Battles take place in the 7v1 format on one of three lightly redesigned maps: Murovanka, Siegfried Line, and Steppes.

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6f035f1681a24274665b049ebf55431e8d5cd167.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/fe6b3b82594bc3ed43c45c97c5558dcfd758aca6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8bd99a6f7c5b92edd7c3027ed7adeee5ffe927eb.png[/img]
[/expand][*] Before the battle starts, you can choose one of the sides in the conflict.
[list]
[*] The Harrier Squad (either a team of seven random players or a Platoon of up to three players—Dynamic Platoons are allowed) will rush into battle in extensively modified special vehicles: the Object 140, Bat.-Châtillon 25 t, and M48A5 Patton.
[*] The Engineer faces them in the Blitzträger auf E 110, an incredibly powerful tank destroyer manned by a single player. He will be flanked by AI-controlled guards called Sentinels, which will be the third type of vehicle you will spot in the mode.
[/list][*] Each team has its own objective. The Harrier Squad must disable the Blitzträger auf E 110’s protective energy shield and destroy this menacing vehicle within the allotted time. The Blitzträger auf E 110 must eliminate the Harrier Squad or hold out until time expires.
[*] To enter the battle in the Blitzträger auf E 110, you need to have a Key. You can earn it in battles while playing the game mode or receive it as a part of special bundles in the in-game Store. Keep reading to find out about one more way to get one Key for the Blitzträger auf E 110! 
[*] The Return of the Waffenträger progression involves assembling the Harriers' Collection and the Engineer's Collection with different elements and consists of four Stages. Upon collecting a certain number of elements and reaching each Stage, you will receive valuable rewards. To fill the event progression meter and grab all rewards available in the event, you need to complete both Collections.
[*] The event’s main reward is the ASTRON Rex 105 mm, a brand-new Tier VIII Premium American medium tank, which can be obtained from the Vehicle Gate (more about this below) with a certain drop chance.
[*] You can also purchase it with the Engineer's Starters, special in-game keys you can earn during the event to activate the Engineer’s Gate which contains valuable loot. The Engineer's Starters will also be available as part of bundles in the in-game Store. 
[*] You can also use the Harriers' Starters to activate the Harriers’ Gate, which might drop useful in-game items—sometimes even the Engineer's Starters!
[/list][h2]How to Start Playing[/h2]

1. In your Garage, choose the “Return of the Waffenträger” mode in the drop-down menu to the right of the “Battle!” button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/a1233435315f3139370c961ff7926341224fb05f.jpg[/img]

2. Click the event banner in the lower-right corner of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/bb3d2f0eb1e687d90bdfa7903a16cb5fb75c1f5e.jpg[/img]

3. Click the interactive 3D portal in your Garage.

[h2]The Harriers[/h2]

On September 27, you will find three special vehicles to choose from in the event Garage - the Resistor, Thunderbolt, and Foudre. Choose one of the tanks and click the “Battle!” button to take on von Krieger's empowered vehicle!

Each Harrier Squad's battle hounds features its own battle role and general and several combat abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ad30b8bfc0eb09d1dfb5715fea5e9cfa28e580fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e8ba70cdecf68d5023282f6ad93b78b662876e15.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4cd555d1238e405d11406441b4907ddd2fc9b040.png[/img]

The Harriers [b]have three Lives[/b] (including the starting one), which means they can respawn just twice in a single battle.

[h2]How to Play[/h2]

When the battle starts, the Blitzträger auf E 110 will be protected by an almost impenetrable energy shield, so it doesn’t make sense to shoot at it while this shield is active. From time to time, AI-controlled vehicles called Sentinels will spawn at certain points on the battlefield to assist the Engineer. When destroyed, Sentinels leave a load of Plasma that you need to pick up and deliver to Generators, indestructible power structures that appear in different parts of the map, changing location each time. They also create a protective shield for the Engineer.

The Harriers collect and use Plasma to overload Generators, thereby disabling the Engineer's shield for some time. Overloading a Generator with the Harriers works just like capturing the base in Random Battles. The more tanks in the cap circle, the faster it happens.

[quote=]Generators have two states: active and inactive. When Generators spawn on the map, they are always inactive and have one common activation time. The Harriers can only overload a Generator when it becomes active.[/quote]
When you first pick up a load of Plasma, a certain amount of HP is restored for the entire team. Plus, having Plasma on board your vehicles increases the damage caused to von Krieger, so try not to miss any loads.

Once the Blitzträger auf E 110 is temporarily left without its protective shield, you have some time to deal full damage to it—don't forget to use your unique combat abilities! After that, the shield will be restored, and you’ll need to overload and destroy the next Generator. The damage you cause through the shield is greatly reduced, but it increases with each destroyed Generator.

After overloading and destroying the fourth and last Generator, the shield on von Krieger's machine will be permanently disabled, so take this opportunity to finish it off. But if the timer runs out with the Blitzträger still operational, von Krieger will win, so push yourself to the limit in the final stage of the battle!

Keep in mind that the Blitzträger auf E 110 has a new ability: [b]Teleportation[/b]. It allows the Engineer to teleport to a selected point on the map with some delay. But when the protective shield disappears, Teleportation becomes unavailable, and after the destruction of the fourth Generator, this ability is blocked.

To succeed, the Harriers’ battle hounds must work together and act as a close-knit team. Fight in packs of three or four vehicles, destroy the Sentinels assisting the Blitzträger auf E 110, collect Plasma, and pay attention to the timer. Coordinate your efforts, as the chances of a single Harrier vehicle defeating the Engineer are close to nonexistent!

[h2]The Harriers’ Mission[/h2]

Completing the Harriers’ mission will reward you with Keys that allow you to play as the Blitzträger auf E 110. Some of them will also reward you with Harriers' Starters (more on them below).

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2994b7ec2d26931ef2e29d8b8efd2ea2db62cf60.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7d5704b16c303cfbf37d8ac3af4922e1c4b2bb41.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c8dc21bd0260742ae8514546aa1fa0438184a3a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3adc0b61bc372b61dbbb14250b8178e22b074ea6.png[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]The Blitzträger auf E 110[/h2]

To fight in the mighty and powerful Blitzträger auf E 110, you need a Key. There are four ways to get it:

1. Complete a special mission in Random Battles to earn one Key. The mission will be available on [b]September 27 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b] and will remain active until [b]October 4 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]. You need to win five Random Battles in Tier IV–X vehicles and be among the top 10 on your team by experience earned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cdf0e989974acf569f3d626a41eebeef2e6bf03d.png[/img]

2. You can also earn Keys by completing special Harriers’ missions in the event.

3. Keys will also be available as a part of bundles starting from [b]September 27 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b] in the in-game Store during the event.

There will be no compensation for unused Keys when the event ends on [b]October 11 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2).[/b]

The Blitzträger auf E 110 is a formidable tank destroyer with overwhelming firepower. Designed by Max von Krieger, this incredible feat of engineering is equipped with a gun with an autoloading mechanism. One penetrating shot can easily take away well over half of a Harrier vehicle’s entire HP pool. Plus, the Blitzträger auf E 110 features four additional (three active and one passive) combat abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/71ce69b9e91b342a6dfe924d3f65c40042bd74ae.png[/img]

[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] [b]Gungnir [/b]- A shot that causes considerable damage to enemy vehicles.
[*] [b]EMP Arrow[/b] - A shot with a high-voltage charge that slows down and stuns enemies. Resets Generator Overload points of damaged vehicles.
[*] [b]EMP Burst [/b]- A charge of energy that covers the entire area around the vehicle. Stuns all enemies in the impact area and causes damage to those closest. Passes through all obstacles and resets Generator Overload points of damaged vehicles.
[*] [b]Teleportation[/b] - Allows the vehicle to teleport to a selected point on the map after some delay. Operating the vehicle is impossible during preparation. Cannot be used while the shield is deactivated.
[*] [b]Absorption [/b]- By being near a clump of Plasma on the ground, the vehicle accelerates its evaporation. If, at the moment of evaporation of Plasma, the vehicle is within a 50 m radius of it, it will recover a certain number of hit points and accelerate the Teleportation cooldown.
[/list][/expand]
AI-controlled [b]Sentinels[/b] are autonomous guards that spawn across the map. Their role is to deal damage to the Harriers and act as spotters for the Blitzträger.

[h2]How to Play[/h2]

Although the Blitzträger auf E 110 is incredibly powerful and your shield reflects most of the damage you take, always keep in mind that you will be facing seven dangerous Harriers at once. If, at the end of the battle, the opposing team remains at full strength, you’ll be in trouble.

Try to confuse enemies, pick off stragglers, and support your Sentinels—don't let opponents collect loads of Plasma that can disable the Generators. Make full use of your combat abilities, constantly move around the battlefield, and take advantage of the new Teleportation ability. Protect the Generators at all costs, because if the Harriers destroy all four of them, the shield will disappear permanently and you will become vulnerable.

[quote=]Time is on your side, so it’s not necessary to destroy all the Harriers to win. If they fail to destroy you within the allotted time, you will triumph![/quote]
[h2]The Engineer’s Mission[/h2]

Completing the Engineer’s mission will earn you Engineer’s Starters and the Engineer’s Collection Items (more on them below), including the von Krieger crew member.

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3c339f11433d33e541f3d47d4f896497f1a95bd1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ae6610b8ae95102eb7951c9cffca32541a1096dc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d59a52aa3cefb1a23d5ad7ab337bbfedb3e9162f.png[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]Overtime Mechanics[/h2]

The initial battle time is [b]6 minutes[/b], but this can be increased to [b]up to 15 minutes[/b], thanks to the overtime mechanics, which can only trigger once per match. If at least one Harrier vehicle has a load of Plasma on board their vehicle, then the battle time will increase by the time remaining until it disappears (provided that the overtime mechanic has not yet been triggered).

If there are several loads of Plasma in the battle, then the load with the most time left will have its time added to the battle timer. The minimum amount of time that will be added to the battle timer when any of the Harrier vehicles is carrying Plasma is 30 seconds.

What happens if a Harrier vehicle with Plasma on board is within the Generator's capture radius?
[list]
[*] If overtime mechanics have not been triggered, then additional battle time will be added according to the rules above.
[*] If overtime mechanics have already been triggered, then the timer will remain at zero, but the battle will not end.
[*] If the Generator is captured, the battle will increase by the same amount of time as during a normal capture.
[*] If the player leaves the Generator's capture zone and the battle time expires, the Harrier Squad will lose and the match will end.
[/list][h2]The Blitzträger auf E 220[/h2]

If Lady Luck is on your side, you may encounter a special version of the Blitzträger in some battles: [b]the E 220[/b]. This is a vehicle that only certain Wargaming employees and famous content creators can unlock. It features a unique camouflage pattern so you can easily identify it, should you meet it during the special Prime Times.

The Blitzträger auf E 220 has the same stats as the E 110. If you and your team manage to destroy the E 220, everyone on your team will receive a special medal and one Engineer’s Starter. Check out the dedicated article for additional information about the big E 220 hunt, including a list of participating content creators and prime hunting times!

[h2]The Medals[/h2]

Achieve at least one victory over the Blitzträger auf E 110 or the Harrier Squad, and you will be decorated with the corresponding medal. There’s a third one, but getting it requires a bit of luck, as you need to defeat the Blitzträger auf E 220.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/33ed6e4cba813565a3631fbda17424830ac46279.png[/img]

[b]Lightning Rod[/b]

Defeat the Blitzträger auf E 110
when fighting in the Harrier Squad.[/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d5b8b8cfc0075cc6b7c79dc05d9e0655f46d7f33.png[/img]

[b]Voltage Surge[/b]

Defeat the Harrier Squad when
fighting in the Blitzträger auf E 110/220.[/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d57a28431a1b393cd263e744090485ce6ffca161.png[/img]

[b]Power Outage[/b]

Defeat the Blitzträger auf E 220
when fighting in the Harrier Squad.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h2]The Collections[/h2]

The Return of the Waffenträger progression consists of four Stages and involves assembling the Harriers' Collection and the Engineer's Collection with different elements. Upon collecting a certain number of elements and reaching each Stage, you will receive valuable rewards. Join the event and gather event-themed vehicle customization elements from both the Harriers' and Engineer's Collections! To fill the event progression meter and grab all the event rewards, you need to complete both Collections.

Every customization Item in both Collections is unique—each one will drop just once. The Collections include styles, camos, emblems, inscriptions, decals, and, of course, the Harriers and Max von Krieger himself. These characters will become your crew members and come with exclusive voiceovers and 100% trained Sixth Sense as a zero perk. 

[quote=]All crew members have a predetermined nation affiliation. You can only assign Max von Krieger to German vehicles, while the Harriers are affiliated with the nation to which their special tank prototypes belong—either France, U.S.A., or U.S.S.R.[/quote]
Each Harriers’ or Engineer’s Collection Item adds 1 Point to the event’s main progression meter. Completing each Stage of the main progression will yield you prizes, with the final reward being [b]3,000 Bonds.[/b]

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ffb373dbcc24111f9d365d16697ad462e6681f5b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c486f194fe08e1860bf11fc1cc433bddd9fa3a76.png[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]Dimension Gates and Rewards[/h2]

For completing event missions, as well as for defeating the rare Blitzträger auf E 220, you will receive Starters, which are special keys for activating Dimension Gates. Through activated Dimension Gates, you’ll be able to get valuable loot, including Collection Items.

You can earn the Harriers' Starters for completing event missions while playing in Harrier Squad vehicles. These keys will allow you to activate [b]the Harriers' Gate.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/79704341105a4dd11066290c63fb2df9d3f51f89.jpg[/img]

It will drop a unique Harriers’ Collection Item or a guaranteed prize from the list below:
[list]
[*] Credits
[*] Personal Reserves
[*] Days of WoT Premium Account
[*] Consumables
[*] Demounting Kits
[*] Garage slots
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2ed4b8459011160fc877425be777e0bd562c259a.jpg[/img]

By completing the missions, you earn Engineer’s Starters. These keys are used to activate [b]the Engineer's Gate.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/035ecadf12a0e650c555f32f0d6a9dce5eb6e300.jpg[/img]

You can also get Engineer's Starters upon completing certain progression milestones, as well as from special bundles in the in-game Store or when activating the Engineer's Gate (with a 5% drop rate) or the Harriers' Gate (a 1% drop rate).

Upon each activation, the Engineer's Gate may bring you in-game items from four different categories, each of which has its own drop rate. First, you will receive a guaranteed item from the following list:
[list]
[*] Gold
[*] Credits
[*] Personal Reserves
[*] Days of WoT Premium Account
[*] Crew Books
[*] Demounting Kits
[*] Special custom looks and decals not included in either the Harriers’ or Engineer’s Collections
[/list]But if the stars align for you, you have a 5% chance to get an Engineer’s Starter or a striking Harrier-themed 3D style for the Object 140, Bat.-Châtillon 25 t, or M48A5 Patton. Each 3D style can only drop once.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1abf1c7f3793d5152c04b9380f045e146ae3a99c.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b734561c039a7fd11f2c3f8d33a1cbf39be0d00f.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/c0eaf5e2eb7b9093ac33753daa2b5fdc130c2530.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
But the sweetest prizes are the menacing Tier VIII Premium tanks, including the brand-new ASTRON Rex 105 mm. Apart from this predator, you may receive a Premium vehicle with a Garage slot from the following list with a 2.4% drop rate:
[list]
[*] T77
[*] Lansen C
[*] ISU-152K
[*] Turtle Mk. I
[*] EMIL 1951
[*] M41D
[*] Centurion Mk. 5/1 RAAC
[*] Е 75 TS
[*] T26E4 SuperPershing
[*] LT-432
[*] CS-52 LIS
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1136ce4e31f5d3953fb46e59769d0cd0aa88299b.jpg[/img]

If you spent 49 Engineer's Starters but still did not receive a Premium vehicle, then with the 50th activation of the Engineer's Gate, you are guaranteed to receive a random Premium tank with a Garage slot from the list above that you don't have yet.

If you receive a vehicle that is already in your Garage (or that was previously sold with the possibility of restoration), then it will be replaced by any vehicle from the above list, and a Garage slot will also be added. If you already have all the vehicles from the list, then the cost of the dropped tank will be compensated with Gold. These rules also work with Premium tanks (guaranteed reward) if you spent 49 Engineer’s Starters.

[h3][b]Compensation[/b][/h3]

[expand type=details]
[table equalcells=1]

[h2]ASTRON Rex Gate[/h2]

There’s also a special ASTRON Rex Gate that requires an Engineer's Starter to activate.

                   [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f63104bc7cc8884a09221cc6eedae725a7e61c7c.jpg[/img]

From it, you can receive a particular reward: [b]the ASTRON Rex 105 mm, a brand-new Tier VIII Premium American medium tank.[/b]

[quote=]The parameters displayed are valid for the vehicle with each crew member trained to 100% major qualification level. Some vehicle characteristics can be further improved with the Commander's bonus to major qualification level, crew perks, and skills, as well as special in-game items.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/17f5647ea4d6799fff2d3e16d9d2ed08dd1398dc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/29016f7c54967995cdbcbe02cfa77c48242222c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1f7097444d619fcb370112ab0b4641313316b6a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/aa808831cdadfb3d9c93bdb4f002ce027f9f6f52.png[/img]

To activate the ASTRON Rex Gate and get this menacing hunter, you need to collect 60 Engineer’s Starters. But if you get this tank from the Engineer's Gate before that, the Vehicle Gate will become inactive.

After the end of the event on [b]October 11 at 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b], all unused Keys to play in the Blitzträger auf E 110 will disappear, and the corresponding number of Dimension Gates will be activated automatically. All items from them will be automatically credited to your account. All event vehicles will be deducted and XP earned in them will be moved to the MS-1. All Collection Items, rewards, and loot from Dimension Gates remain with you permanently.

[quote=]When the event is over (October 11 at 11:00 CEST), all remaining Starters will automatically activate the Harriers' and Engineer's Gates. The Engineer's Starters, which might drop with a certain chance, will no longer drop after 3 Gates activations.[/quote]
[h2]Special Bundles[/h2]

These bundles include Keys that are required to play as the Blitzträger auf E 110. Plus, each bundle contains a certain number of event-themed decals to customize your vehicles, as well as Engineer’s Starters to activate the Engineer’s Gate for valuable loot. Additionally, three of the four available bundles include days of WoT Premium Account.

[b]Large Engineer's Bundle[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/7ab0ccc73931462bb1a677dd88a93b043c22e96f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e00cff584b8948972eaa46c21811bbd5800af074.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/326b500fbe7838f8b1409d6fc35d95834da0fde1.png[/img]

[b]Taster Engineer's Bundle[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b3320c5f592aa8b7cf89d17c40dee76c9e95216a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]

[expand type=showmore]

In the Return of the Waffenträger event, heap memory consumption is higher than in Random Battles, which may lead to various issues caused by the lack of memory for players using a 32-bit game client. You may experience some visual glitches and sudden game client crashes during the start / course / end of the battle. Players who may potentially encounter these issues will see an appropriate warning.

Sometimes, when using the Engineer's EMP Arrow ability, the animation may not be displayed.

In some cases, the remaining time to overload the Generator, displayed on the capture bar and on the player's timer with a load of Plasma may differ by 1 second.
[/expand]
[i]Get ready to take on an empowered monstrosity of a vehicle and earn the right to command the Blitzträger auf E 110—and fight like the final boss![/i]

[h2]Matchmaking in the Mode [/h2]

Much of your feedback on Recon Mission concerned matchmaking, and we’ve taken measures to improve it. This new mode features separate matchmaking which is slightly different from Random Battles. Check out its basic rules:  
[list]
[*] There are three types of battles in Recon Mission: one-, two- and three-tier. 
[*] For two-tier battles, the number of higher tier vehicles is between 5 and 7. 
[*] For three-tier battles, the number of Tier X tanks is from 3 to 5, and the number of Tier IX vehicles is equal to or exceeds the number of Tier X tanks. The number of Tier VIII vehicles is equal to or exceeds the number of Tier IX tanks. 
[*] For three-tier battles with several SPGs there will be no more than 1 Tier X SPG. 
[*] The number of light tanks, wheeled vehicles, and SPGs in both teams is always the same, but their tiers may be different.   
[*] Premium Tier VIII tanks with preferential matchmaking will be sent into battles with adversaries of the same tier or one tier higher. 
[/list][h2]Reserve Stock and Clan Reserves  [/h2]

Reserve Stock, an exclusive option for WoT Premium Account, is now available in Recon Mission. Players with a WoT Premium Account will get an additional 10% bonus to Credits on top of what they earn in battles. For example, if you earned 10,000 credits in a battle, your vault will receive 1,000 thanks to the 10% bonus. Every 7 days, regardless of whether your WoT PA has expired that week, the vault will open, and all credits accumulated in it will be automatically moved to your account. 

Clan Reserves can now be used in battles.  

[h2]3 Stages, 9 New Maps  [/h2]

To enter the mode, select Recon Mission via the mode selector in your Garage and click the Battle! button.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9b3895ca3238a0d10ece9317602ef9465c73a931.jpg[/img]

This year, we will launch three Recon Mission Stages, each lasting 7 days. In each Stage, you can explore 3 maps in the late stages of development. After playing 20 battles in Recon Mission (your result will only count if you finish in the top 12 by XP earned), you’ll be able to vote for the map you like the most and the least in each Stage.   

You can leave detailed feedback about each map in the special questionnaire shown below, and this will greatly help us improve and finalize these locales. Before you can share your opinions in the questionnaire about a specific map, you’ll need to play at least 6 battles on it and reach the top 12 by XP earned. You can only give feedback about the maps of the current Stage, but you’ll have the opportunity to change your mind and share a different opinion in the questionnaire before the end of each Stage.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cc0ba6821c3fc68d2111e55eee2865f3345c59e6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Your Feedback Is Crucial!   [/h2]

All maps in Recon Mission are pre-release prototypes designed for Random Battles. The gameplay experience on these maps is almost finalized, but the visuals may undergo further changes before release. Your feedback and the statistics we obtain will help us understand what balance adjustments and other final refinements are needed. The maps that are the most popular with the community will be prioritized for addition to the Random Battles map pool in future updates. 

[h2]General Rules [/h2]  

Battles in Recon Mission will follow the rules of Standard Battles with several changes.   
[list]
[*] Battles will take place in Tier VIII–X vehicles.   
[*] Personal and clan missions will not be available, but you can complete other battle missions, including Daily Missions.  
[*] The battle economy will be the same as in Random Battles.   
[*] You will be able to earn bonds, progressive customization decals, Mastery Badges, and Marks of Excellence.  
[*] The statistics of all Recon Mission battles will be counted in the statistics of Random Battles. Session statistics will not include Recon Mission battles.   
[/list]You will be able to earn Battle Pass Points in the following ways:

[tr]

[th]Defeat/Draw[/th]

[/tr]

[/tr]
[/table] 
[h2]Progression System and Rewards[/h2]  

Each Recon Mission Stage will have a separate progression system, consisting of 50 battles and its own set of rewards. After playing a certain number of battles, you will receive in-game goodies such as a cool all-season camo, Personal Reserves, and other prizes. After completing a series of 50 battles, you will also earn a special medal.

Each Stage will feature a unique medal and a new camo that you can apply to any vehicle in your Garage.

notes.title: The New Ranked Battles 2021–2022 Season Begins!
notes.content:
[b]Thanks for your feedback on Season X, Commanders! This experiment has proven to be very useful and informative, so we decided to keep the 10v10 Ranked Battles format!  [/b]

One of the most competitive modes in which the most skillful players decide who’s the strongest returns to World of Tanks with three new Seasons and some important changes. It brings with it heaps of rewards for good performance in combat, including fresh 2D styles, bonds, gold, and more! But the ultimate prize for all three Seasons is the brand-new Tier X Chinese 114 SP2 tank destroyer, which is exclusive to Ranked Battles. Read up on all the latest features and changes for the upcoming Season!  

Learn more about Ranked Battles on a separate page in the game client with information about the core rules and rewards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0776e5c690824df9260da57ba1bb5d758f593eab.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=7XJxm-8wfwE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Season Dates [/h3]

[b]September 6, 2021 at 10:00 CEST (UTC+2) through September 20, 2021 at 10:00 CEST (UTC+2) [/b]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
	[th]Prime Times[/th]
	[th]EU[/th]
	[th]NA[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][b]Weekdays[/b][/td]
	[td]14:00–02:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/td]
	[td]16:00–23:00 PT | 18:00–01:00 CT | 19:00–02:00 ET[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][b]Weekends[/b][/td]
	[td]10:00–02:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/td]
	[td]16:00–00:00 PT | 18:00–02:00 CT | 19:00–03:00 ET [/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h3]Daily Prime-Times APAC: [/h3]

[b]HK server: 18:00–01:00 UTC+8
ANZ server: 18:00–22:00 UTC+10[/b]

[h2]General Overview and Progression System  [/h2]

Thanks to all the active Commanders who participated in Season X and shared their feedback, we are now ready to move forward with the new 10v10 format in the coming year.  

The first Season of Ranked Battles 2021–2022 will run for two weeks: from September 6 through September 20. You can earn Battle Pass Points when fighting in Ranked Battles, and their number will depend on your position in your team’s post-battle ranking by XP earned. Even if your team lost or drew, you will still receive points. 

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]POSITION IN THE POST-BATTLE RANKING [/th]
[th]VICTORY [/th]
[th]DEFEAT/DRAW [/th]
[/tr]

[td]Top 3 by XP earned[/td]
[td]7[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Top 7 by XP earned [/td]
[td]5[/td]
[td]3[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]  
No more than one SPG and two light tanks per team will be allowed in battles.  

To ascend in rank in order to qualify for Leagues, you need to earn the following amount of chevrons: 
[list]
[*] [b]EU: 94 chevrons[/b] 
[*] [b]CIS: 94 chevrons [/b]
[*] [b]NA: 70 chevrons[/b] 
[*] [b]APAC: 70 chevrons [/b]
[/list]Chevrons will be credited according to the following rules:  

[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/b81aa6884305fdfdcbad8053d6d29b62663eae20.jpg[/img]
[/expand]
[h2]Daily Missions for Different Vehicle Roles  [/h2]

As soon as you qualify for a League, you’ll be able to complete special daily missions. There will be three missions in total, and each one can be completed in vehicles of four different roles. This means that missions for 12 different vehicle roles will be available. These missions will reward you with bonds and Daily Bonus Battles. 

*Role Experience has been introduced to Ranked Battles to refine the way you play in your favorite vehicles. It is earned after every battle based on your performance on the battlefield (damage dealt, enemies destroyed, damage assisted). Learn more about different vehicle roles and how to get as much Role XP as possible, below.

[h2]Fight to the Last to Earn a Heap of Rewards!  [/h2]

The opening Season of Ranked Battles features tons of valuable rewards for good performance in battle. Meet your worthy Tier X opponents and fight to the last to earn:  
[list]
[*] Bonds 
[*] Days of WoT Premium Account 
[*] Gold 
[*] Directives 
[*] Striking 2D custom looks 
[*] Additional rewards! 
[/list]Now, for every battle in the Qualification, you will be rewarded with directives and credits. We’ve also redistributed the prizes and increased the number of credits you can earn in the higher Divisions to make the game more enjoyable.

[h2]The 114 SP2: Meet the Chinese Predator! [/h2]

The ultimate reward for all three Seasons is the brand-new 114 SP2, a Tier X Chinese tank destroyer. It features a fully rotating turret mounted to the center of the hull, just like classic tanks. notes.title: Recon Mission: Explore New Maps and Earn Rewards!
notes.content:
[b]It's going to get even hotter in World of Tanks, Commanders! August Heat is bringing back Recon Mission, our new experimental mode where we’ll work together with you to refine new maps that may be added to Random Battles. [/b]

In response to your feedback, we improved the mode’s matchmaking and some other aspects to make Recon Mission more enjoyable. This experimental mode introduced in Update 1.13 will be relaunched in three separate Stages and with the same maps, with the first Stage kicking off on August 20. Your game progress during the previous Recon Mission launch will be saved, so you can continue from where you left off. Check out all the new improvements Recon Mission has received! 

[previewyoutube=dnBD07D9D4Q;full]VIDEO [/previewyoutube]
[h3]Recon Mission Stage 1  [/h3]
[h3]August 20 at 11:00 UTC through August 26 at 23:59 UTC  [/h3]

[h2]Matchmaking in the Mode [/h2]

Much of your feedback on Recon Mission concerned matchmaking, and we’ve taken measures to improve it. This new mode features separate matchmaking which is slightly different from Random Battles. Check out its basic rules:  
[list]
[*] There are three types of battles in Recon Mission: one-, two- and three-tier. 
[*] For two-tier battles, the number of higher tier vehicles is between 5 and 7. 
[*] For three-tier battles, the number of Tier X tanks is from 3 to 5, and the number of Tier IX vehicles is equal to or exceeds the number of Tier X tanks. The number of Tier VIII vehicles is equal to or exceeds the number of Tier IX tanks. 
[*] For three-tier battles with several SPGs there will be no more than 1 Tier X SPG. 
[*] The number of light tanks, wheeled vehicles, and SPGs in both teams is always the same, but their tiers may be different.   
[*] Premium Tier VIII tanks with preferential matchmaking will be sent into battles with adversaries of the same tier or one tier higher. 
[/list][h2]Reserve Stock and Clan Reserves  [/h2]

Reserve Stock, an exclusive option for WoT Premium Account, is now available in Recon Mission. Players with a WoT Premium Account will get an additional 10% bonus to Credits on top of what they earn in battles. For example, if you earned 10,000 credits in a battle, your vault will receive 1,000 thanks to the 10% bonus. Every 7 days, regardless of whether your WoT PA has expired that week, the vault will open, and all credits accumulated in it will be automatically moved to your account. 

Clan Reserves can now be used in battles.  

[h2]3 Stages, 9 New Maps  [/h2]

To enter the mode, select Recon Mission via the mode selector in your Garage and click the Battle! button.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9b3895ca3238a0d10ece9317602ef9465c73a931.jpg[/img]

This year, we will launch three Recon Mission Stages, each lasting 7 days. In each Stage, you can explore 3 maps in the late stages of development. After playing 20 battles in Recon Mission (your result will only count if you finish in the top 12 by XP earned), you’ll be able to vote for the map you like the most and the least in each Stage.   

You can leave detailed feedback about each map in the special questionnaire shown below, and this will greatly help us improve and finalize these locales. Before you can share your opinions in the questionnaire about a specific map, you’ll need to play at least 6 battles on it and reach the top 12 by XP earned. You can only give feedback about the maps of the current Stage, but you’ll have the opportunity to change your mind and share a different opinion in the questionnaire before the end of each Stage.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/cc0ba6821c3fc68d2111e55eee2865f3345c59e6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Your Feedback Is Crucial!   [/h2]

All maps in Recon Mission are pre-release prototypes designed for Random Battles. The gameplay experience on these maps is almost finalized, but the visuals may undergo further changes before release. Your feedback and the statistics we obtain will help us understand what balance adjustments and other final refinements are needed. The maps that are the most popular with the community will be prioritized for addition to the Random Battles map pool in future updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2ac10ebcee7a2736967591389d1a0de8f23364c1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3773684f10af0d8748d892a2fb9d2d7997ddd5e2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/1fd194b9ebaf98edbcb90bc8054b1acf8f456c95.png[/img]

[h2]General Rules [/h2]  

Battles in Recon Mission will follow the rules of Standard Battles with several changes.   
[list]
[*] Battles will take place in Tier VIII–X vehicles.   
[*] Personal and clan missions will not be available, but you can complete other battle missions, including Daily Missions.  
[*] The battle economy will be the same as in Random Battles.   
[*] You will be able to earn bonds, progressive customization decals, Mastery Badges, and Marks of Excellence.  
[*] The statistics of all Recon Mission battles will be counted in the statistics of Random Battles. Session statistics will not include Recon Mission battles.   
[/list]You will be able to earn Battle Pass Points in the following ways:     

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[th]Position in the Post-Battle Ranking[/th]
[th]Victory[/th]
[th]Defeat/Draw[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Top 3 by XP earned[/td]
[td]7[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]Top 10 by XP earned[/td]
[td]5[/td]
[td]3[/td]
[/tr]
[/table] 
[h2]Progression System and Rewards[/h2]  

Each Recon Mission Stage will have a separate progression system, consisting of 50 battles and its own set of rewards. After playing a certain number of battles, you will receive in-game goodies such as a cool all-season camo, Personal Reserves, and other prizes. After completing a series of 50 battles, you will also earn a special medal.

Each Stage will feature a unique medal and a new camo that you can apply to any vehicle in your Garage.

notes.title: Referral Program: A New Season With Fresh Rewards!
notes.content:
[b]August is heating up and we’re turning up the gas for the grill! Get ready to recruit your friends and earn a Premium vehicle in the upcoming season of the Referral Program, Commanders!  [/b]

August Heat is full of surprises as it brings Season 8 of the Referral Program, which kicks off on August 26 and runs until December. Before the new season launches, we updated the recruit reward pool to make it more valuable for both novices and returning veterans. We also reworked the "Receive a Medal" missions and replaced some medals with more achievable ones, so that you'll be able to earn them with less effort. Get the lowdown on the changes below! 

[h2]Referral Program: Recruit Reward Rebalancing [/h2]

In the new Season of Referral Program, we will replace Bonds in the Recruit reward pool with different valuable prizes more useful for beginners and helping them boost their progress in the game: Personal Reserves, Demounting Kits, days of WoT Premium Account, Crew Books, and Credits. These prizes are also coveted by veterans returning to World of Tanks and willing to continue researching vehicle branches. The full reward breakdown can be found below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2c1589c1cf7f9ff1f4f80eda5810d703c1603264.jpg[/img]

[quote=]In Season 7, you can still receive bonds as a reward for completing Stages. But for completing all subsequent Stages of the upcoming season, you will receive prizes from the updated recruit reward pool.[/quote]   
[h2]Reworking the "Receive a Medal" Missions [/h2]

We also reworked some of the most challenging "Receive a Medal" missions in order to make them more accessible. Now, there will be less time and effort required to complete these tasks. This resulted in the replacement of some Epic Medals and Battle Heroes achievements with other awards, in accordance with the simplified conditions. Check it out.

[h2]New Season, New Premium Tanks[/h2]  

We added two new Premium vehicles to the pool of available rewards, bringing the total to 24 (12 for recruits and 12 for Commanders) to choose from! This season, you’ll have a chance to get your hands on: 

[list]
[*] Recruits: the [b]Pudel[/b], a variant of the Pz.Kpfw. V Panther Ausf. G, the most mass-produced modification of the German Panther tank. This decently armored Polish medium tank features good gun depression, high mobility, and a large health pool, which makes it an excellent support vehicle.

[h2]About Referral Program 2.0 [/h2]

Any player who has played 600 or more Random Battles in the game is eligible to become a Commander and invite Recruits. 

It is worth noting that a Commander can: 
[list]
[*] “Adopt” a novice who has played fewer than 200 battles overall 
[*] Invite World of Tanks veterans who stopped playing, back to the game

notes.title: August Heat: Update 1.14, New Heavies, and More!
notes.content:
August is the hot season, and it brings with it a feast of specials and surprises! Join our birthday bash as we celebrate our 11th anniversary, and take part in a host of exciting activities! Plus, Update 1.14 introduces brand-new Czechoslovakian heavy tanks with unusual gameplay and a fresh Random Battle map called Safe Haven. We're also updating the combat parameters of some iconic vehicles and introducing Field Modification, a totally new feature for fine-tuning your favorite tanks. Finally, we’re adding a new training mode, Topography, and changing some Personal Missions for artillery.

[previewyoutube=tkls15kStYQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Czechoslovakian Heavy Tanks Have Arrived![/h2]

Brand-new Czechoslovakian brawlers are ready to storm the battlefield, Commanders! The new branch consists of four researchable heavies from Tier VII to Tier X. Starting from Tier VIII, all Czechoslovakian warriors will give you the possibility to choose from two top guns to match your preferred gameplay style. One gun fires in regular mode, while the other is a two-shell autoloader with a short reload time between shells. Pick the one you like the most and annihilate your enemies!

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/5526463837488116356
[h2]Recon Mission: Stay Tuned for Updates! [/h2]

Recon Mission, our new game mode, is about to hit the live servers! We are currently working on improving it and will share more details as soon as we can.

[h2]Premium Vehicle Rebalancing [/h2]

We’re continuing to work on rebalancing popular Premium and reward tanks and updating their combat effectiveness. This time, we're improving the characteristics of some your favorite tanks from different nations, including: T34 and T34 B, AMX Chasseur de chars, KV-5, IS-6 and IS-6B, 112, WZ-111 and WZ-111 Alpine Tiger, T-34-3, M48A2 Räumpanzer, M46 Patton KR, T95E2, 59-Patton.

We’re enhancing their strengths to emphasize their gameplay and make them more competitive on the battlefield.

Learn more: [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/content/1-14-features/#vehicle-rebalancing]EU[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.com/en/news/updates/update-1-14-features/#premium-vehicle-rebalancing]NA[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/en/news/general-news/1-14-features/#rebalance]ASIA[/url]

[h2]Changes to Personal Missions for Artillery [/h2]

We're updating some Personal Missions for artillery to make them more achievable. We tried to rework the missions for a certain amount of stun and damage because these parameters were affected in Update 1.13. The rest of the less complex missions remain unchanged. The missions' changes are not very significant, because SPGs can still effectively stun enemy vehicles with the first HE shell and deal damage with the second one.

Learn more: [url=https://worldoftanks.eu/en/content/1-14-features/#pm-arty]EU[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.com/en/news/updates/update-1-14-features/#spg-changes]NA[/url], [url=https://worldoftanks.asia/en/news/general-news/1-14-features/#pm-arty]ASIA[/url]

[h2]Field Modification [/h2]

Want to fine-tune your favorite vehicles to make them better suit your needs and personal playstyle? Take advantage of Field Modification, a brand-new feature for tweaking specific characteristics of Tier VI–X tanks (including Collectors', special, and Premium vehicles). Field Modification consists of three types of special adjustments you can make to a vehicle's parameters or setup. Try it out and take a fresh look at the strengths of your favorite tanks!

[previewyoutube=dFfIzhcIm1w;full][/previewyoutube]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/2999944978195372253
[h2]Welcome to Safe Haven! [/h2]

A brand-new Random Battles map is here! Welcome to Safe Haven, a spacious 1000x1000-meter summer map set in 1960s Japan. It is designed as a demilitarized civilian port adjacent to a traditional fishing village.

Safe Haven is divided into two large gameplay zones. The first is the harbor area with plenty of cover and a huge bunker where heavily armored vehicles will feel right at home. The second is a picturesque green zone, which is good for faster and less-armored tanks. Ambush TDs and SPGs will also find some advantageous positions here. Explore Safe Haven and get ready for intense clashes on a new battlefield!

[previewyoutube=7u5KgPeP4N0;full][/previewyoutube]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/2999944978196112674
[h2]Improve Your Map Knowledge in Topography!  [/h2]

To help newcomers better navigate maps in World of Tanks, we're introducing a new training mode: Topography. The training in this mode takes place in a single-player mission format, where you’ll be able to master the basics of playing on maps of different difficulties. Completing missions and exploring maps will improve your navigation skills and help increase your survivability. Plus, you will get rewards, including credits, free XP, and consumables.

[previewyoutube=KieKxtYZUv8;full][/previewyoutube]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/2999945883212281072
[h2]Join World of Tanks’ 11th Anniversary! [/h2]

Time to party hearty, Commanders! Join our anniversary bash as we celebrate 11 glorious years of World of Tanks. A feast of fun events, valuable rewards, and cool gifts await, so keep your eyes peeled and get ready to celebrate with us—August Heat is already here!

[h2]Frontline Is Back! [/h2]

The most epic mode in World of Tanks is returning to the game with four intense Stages, the first of which kicks off in August. Frontline 2021 will feature a reworked Combat Reserves system and will be closely integrated with Battle Pass. But most importantly, Tier IX vehicles will be allowed in this mode at a later part of the battle. Learn all the details in our dedicated article below.

[previewyoutube=UelySlQGF0U;full][/previewyoutube]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1407200/announcements/detail/2998818442401035451
[b]To Battle, Commanders! [/b]

Meet the unique new Czechoslovakian heavy tanks with unique features, explore a fresh Random Battles map, and get ready to celebrate our 11th anniversary!

notes.title: Topography: A New Mode to Boost Your Map Knowledge
notes.content:
Commanders! 

Of all the things that contribute to players’ performance in World of Tanks, map knowledge is one of the most indispensable.  

Many a player will recall those fatal situations where taking one wrong direction caused them to return to the Garage before they knew it, spoiling both their mood and statistics. Having observed these struggles from new and veteran players alike when getting to grips with maps, we’ve decided to introduce a new training mode: [b]Topography[/b]. To get a quick idea of what it is and how it will benefit you, check out the overview below.  

[previewyoutube=KieKxtYZUv8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is Topography? [/h2]

Topography is a single-player training mode where commanders are shown the ropes of map navigation in World of Tanks. The idea behind Topography is simple: You’ll play four different scenarios while learning the “traffic patterns” that are typical for certain maps, depending on the base you start at and the vehicle type you play. You’ll be shown the main routes, key places to seek cover, and many other positions to understand how to avoid being destroyed, as well as how (and where) to use your vehicle to the fullest. All scenarios, including suggested routes, firing lines, and enemy behavior, are based on heatmaps from real battles. 

And the best part? For your training achievements, you’ll be generously rewarded!   

[h2]How Does It Work? [/h2]
[list]
[*] Find the mode in the client.  
[*] Choose a map and one of four scenarios. 
[*] Enter the battle.  
[*] Move through the map, following all the hints. 
[*] Destroy AI-controlled opponents.  
[*] Get skilled and rewarded!   
[/list] And now for the details.  

[h2]Scenarios [/h2]

Each map has four scenarios available to explore the locations in detail and from different perspectives. Depending on the chosen scenario, you’ll enter the battle either from Base 1 or Base 2 in either a maneuverable or armored tank. Both vehicles are exclusive to Topography, the former functioning as a support tank and the latter an assault tank. 

Each scenario consists of several missions. Essentially, all missions are about moving in certain directions and destroying certain [b]targets[/b], the AI-controlled opponents representing average vehicles of relevant tiers. They can only move their turrets, but beware—they can shoot!  

All scenarios are time limited. With each completed mission, the time provided for the scenario will be extended. And for playing all four scenarios on a given map, you’ll be granted a special reward.  

[h2]Hints  [/h2]

Throughout your training battles, guidance signs will be popping out along the way to help you through. They are: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/019ab1974bbfa65c2b6fe0bc07d6c04997b61c17.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Base [/b]— the point on the map where you will start the battle, depending on the chosen scenario.  
[*] [b]Navigation markers[/b] — white markers showing the optimal direction to the target. 
[*] [b]Targets[/b] — AI-controlled opponents shown as red dots on the minimap. 
[*] [b]Priority targets[/b] — enemy vehicles with a special icon above them. They should be destroyed to complete local missions. 
[*] [b]Firing lines[/b] — upon entering these special zones, you’ll be assigned a “local mission” to destroy a priority target. For completing the task, you’ll be granted additional time.   
[*] [b]Spotting system[/b] — this forewarns you when you’ve crossed the enemy detection area. In this case, the Sixth Sense icon will be displayed along with the corresponding audio signal, and an eye symbol will appear on the minimap.    
[/list] [h2]Maps  [/h2]

Currently, Topography is available on 15 Standard Battle maps, with the scenarios varying in difficulty.   

Easier scenarios will be available for Tier IV and V vehicles and will be played on:    
[olist]
[*] Mines
[*] Ruinberg
[*] Steppes
[*] Ensk
[*] Mannerheim Line
[*] Lakeville
[/olist] [expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8b66aecb589a771741c1cb82fb05ed602b67fe13.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/85402d0ac3161663bc2db0be7e037057d2eb6b6a.jpg[/img][/expand]
More difficult scenarios will be available for Tier VI and VII vehicles and will be available on:   
[olist]
[*] Karelia
[*] Sand River
[*] Malinovka
[*] Prokhorovka

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/daee6f001a89a126805cc82b4ce8c18159ccd72e.jpg[/img]

In the future, the map pool will be expanded, and one more difficulty level will be added.   

[h2]Who Can Participate? [/h2]

Everyone is welcome! However, since new players need the navigation training the most, preference will be given to them. This means that if too many players are looking to play the Topography mode at the same time, a queue will be activated, and newcomers will be the first to enter.  

[h2]How Will You Benefit from Topography? [/h2]

Apart from boosting your navigation skills and in-game performance, you’ll get rewards, including credits, Free XP, and consumables—the latter on the condition that all missions are completed. Plus, it’s so much fun playing World of Tanks when you know the battlefields like the back of your hand!  

Please note: The traffic pattens you’ll be shown in the Topography mode are just recommendations. A real battlefield will require you to adapt your route to the situation and play according to your team's strategy.

notes.title: August Heat: Things Are Getting Hot!
notes.content:
[b]The hottest season of battles is already here, Commanders!  [/b]

Summer has arrived, but it's going to get even hotter in World of Tanks. Get ready to take part in a whole series of exciting activities, August Heat, which will delight you with cool events, long-awaited game modes, and other specials. Plus, 2021 marks the 11th anniversary of World of Tanks, and we invite all of you to join our birthday bash! Jump in—August will be full of surprises! 

[previewyoutube=0BIhkihzyks;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Czechoslovakian Heavy Tanks Are Coming! [/h2]

Asphalt will melt under the tracks of the brand-new Czechoslovakian heavy tanks storming onto the battlefields of our game. We’re adding an entire branch with four researchable Tier VII–X brawlers, so get ready to Czech it out this August!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d6eaacd41e29651b213c83a8fdbf64f7075685d6.jpg[/img]

[h2]The 11th Anniversary of World of Tanks [/h2]

World of Tanks was born on August 12 in Minsk, the heart of Wargaming. 2021 marks the 11th anniversary of our game, and we're planning a grand celebration to honor this milestone! We've prepared a festive Garage and exciting gifts for all of you as a token of our sincere gratitude and appreciation. Let’s party together! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/83a80dee0a2cb46a038f4cce0aaaa184a44398a8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Field Modification  [/h2]

This brand-new feature allows you to fine-tune your favorite Tier VI–X vehicles to enhance their strengths and adjust them to better suit your personal playstyle. Discover new facets of your gameplay and make your tanks more competitive in battles!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/08491cfa02a1269e943c45a3d756ef32b803815c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Premium Vehicle Rebalancing [/h2]  

We’re continuing to rebalance iconic Premium vehicles and improve the characteristics of some of your favorite tanks from different nations. The T34, IS-6, and other popular tanks will receive their own improvements. Enjoy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/af0409c84de0c61c5a741559557d4860c1e6d3c1.jpg[/img]

[h2]A New Map: Safe Haven  [/h2]

Get ready to experience intense battles on a fresh Random Battles map! Safe Haven, a picturesque 1,000x1,000-meter summer locale, features a demilitarized civilian port with a huge bunker. There is also a spacious green area and traditional Japanese fishing village, so all vehicle types will find plenty of cover and room to maneuver here.

[h2]Improve Your Navigation Skills in Topography [/h2]

A new training mode is coming to World of Tanks: Topography. In this single-player mode, you’ll be able to master the basics of playing on maps of different difficulty levels. Completing special missions and exploring maps will improve your navigation skills and help you survive in the fiercest of battles.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/825e46249fa6d8b3f04206560fd947ac7e19c72d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Frontline 2021 Is Just Around the Corner [/h2]

Frontline, the most epic mode in World of Tanks, will return to the game in August 2021 with a reworked Combat Reserves system. Plus, this Season, Tier IX vehicles are allowed after a certain stage in the battle.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2c16bf45b7653f19652315681d7f4beba857e35b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Try Your Hand at Recon Mission![/h2] 

Recon Mission, our new mode that will give you the first chance to try out possible changes in the game, is about to hit the live servers! We are currently improving it and will share more details soon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6857803e8faa6be0a5c07dfb31e8dfc59da383d2.jpg[/img] 

[h2]Get Ready to Showcase Your Mastery [/h2]

Finally, a surprise activity awaits you, which we’ll keep secret for now. More details are coming soon, so stay tuned and get ready to show off your skills! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4856350094e4f132ea25f147085d3bd6f87595df.jpg[/img]

[b]August is a great time to play tanks, so don't miss out! [/b]

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons, and Backgrounds Are Here!
notes.content:
Commanders!
Today we are adding 12 rare and precious trading cards and 6 badges for World of Tanks. There are also 3 backgrounds to adorn your profile with, and 5 emoticons to help you express yourself.

[h2]Trading Cards[/h2]
11 cards represent 11 nations from the game and the last one symbolizes love of World of Tanks. Each of the 11 tanks shown on the cards is a Tier X vehicle, the apex of its research branch. Before putting a tank like these into your Garage, you need to go through hundreds of battles on Tier I to IX vehicles. 
This long journey is a big part of World of Tanks gameplay. You learn the basics throughout Tiers I to IV, find your favorite vehicles on Tiers V to VII, and refine your playstyle on Tiers VIII to X.

[b]Play World of Tanks and have some Tier X tanks in the game and on the Steam cards![/b]

[h3]Let's take a look at some of the cards.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/12873377381a109cab0333daede19353ef2d9fdf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/2d5beb48d3aadeddd55f5a28be957fcc300c1771.png[/img]

[h2]How to get some cards?[/h2]
For all F2P games on Steam each $9 spent grant one card drop, but it's just a bonus; don't forget you can also craft booster packs using gems, which is cheaper. For turning a pack of cards into a game badge, you'll receive random rewards from a set of game-related items—unique emoticons and backgrounds. If you want a specific item only, you can trade or buy it on the market directly.
NOTE: If you've spent some funds in World of Tanks on Steam, check the inventory notifications—there already might be some cards waiting for you! 

[h2]What else can I do with cards?[/h2]
After receiving one of the trading cards, you can see the full image and use it as a wallpaper.
You can always sell them over to the connoisseurs at the Steam Market.

[h3]More info on:[/h3]
•	[url=https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards?snr=1_2108_9__2107] Steam Trading Cards [/url]
•	[url=https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/faq/?snr=1_2108_9__2107] Steam Trading Cards FAQ [/url]
•	[url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=6088-UDXM-7214] Community Market [/url]
•	[url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=6748-ETSG-5417]Steam trading[/url], [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=2178-QGJV-0708]trade offers[/url] and [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=8912-WEYU-8454]recommended trading practices[/url].

[b]Expand your collection of cards! Collect them all![/b]

notes.title: Coming Along With the 1.14 Update: The Safe Haven Map
notes.content:
Commanders!

Update 1.14 will introduce the Safe Haven map to World of Tanks. This location, set in Japan during a period of immense economic growth, features novelties related both to gameplay (which may become “double-decked” in one spot) and to visual design. Let’s take a closer look at Safe Haven!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4b44f51a90955051bc444c849b6595bad82fef69.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=7u5KgPeP4N0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Look and Feel[/h2]
Basking in the warm sunlight of a summer morning, Safe Haven features many elements that knowledgeable players will easily recognize as Japanese. While there’s no direct real-world prototype for the location, its topography is based on the Chūgoku region in southwestern Honshu—specifically on the area adjacent to the Seto Inland Sea. The area is visibly populated, with countless patches of cultivated land, a fishing village beyond the playable area, and a landmark site atop a hill as an embodiment of the spirit of the entire location. The site is indestructible and cannot be accessed by players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/8b29e02e064ba1478a443aabcd06df5282339776.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9f56103a0aa0f56a4f51502346ecc72cd7537177.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e86dc38b2fcb46f443d4864818ae25dcc2529f37.jpg[/img]
[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/4d87c9e92f8ff00f10b09ade0af81b528f63fbad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/58f1b34fed13a167e4ddaabe12635d5b69f83da8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/edef6dffdbd19d1aec07ac11ad72f28a7f5fa4e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/eb527febff2c250e728562c28d32dc464620b3ce.jpg[/img]
[/expand]

The modern age is represented on the map by the massive structures of the seaport. The vast complex, featuring two covered drydocks and coastal defense bunkers, used to be a navy facility. It’s now demilitarized, with two large barges moored in long deep-water quays, ready to be loaded with goods. A tall crane of a traditionally Japanese design towers over the area, ready to perform the task. Another iconic Japanese industrial-age structure is the truss bridge in the hills.

Smaller unique features designed specifically for Safe Haven include cars, road markings in Japanese, and traditional houses in the old village on the coast beyond the playable area. Alas, there’s no perfect harmony between the old and the new here, as the commercial port infrastructure is encroaching upon this peaceful idyll.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
Safe Haven is a spacious map (1,000x1,000 meters) that is available only for Standard Battles in Tier IV–X vehicles. Gameplay-wise, the location can be divided into two large zones. The concrete-clad harbor suits well-armored heavies and assault TDs, offering them good (and, in some places, nearly complete) protection from artillery fire, plus a number of chokepoints to brawl for. The low hills farther inland form a large and picturesque green area which favors faster and less-armored vehicles. Ambush TDs and SPGs will also find some cozy positions here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/6f8862f09eca9d9b4b42226dfc1ec2c0e30dbcbd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/66746dcb74b2e585988a3b2b91ac42efbb2d88d8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/0dd24104725541af683c2da540dcca45c4d166de.jpg[/img]
[expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/58c8269c76b34cad4f2264b13ab7c16470d92b53.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e99df144e7f784dfcdf2a1cd5b6946037a46910a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/d7b3bcc0fc90adf57b970373e6a87b740871c1b6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/3807cd9ac713abde130371564dcd3c63502224d6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/ae1b343213991d2974ba68718e54ac8349eff742.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/f433d6ff728b45779278ecc507738df4a910a850.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/e2e4b951106aa8933845c116978d35b56a014eb8.jpg[/img]
[/expand]

[h2]Music[/h2]
The soundtrack to the Safe Haven map is the result of collaboration between the World of Tanks audio team and Akira Yamaoka, renowned composer of Silent Hill fame. The interesting twist is that Mr. Yamaoka had delivered a tanks-themed, Japan-flavored suite well before the map took its shape. Therefore, one could say that the spirit of the location was born and, for a time, existed in a purely musical form (like in many a creation myth), only to later unfold completely into a place where you can show your battle prowess against a beautiful backdrop.

[b]Gather your strength, Commanders, and get ready to roll out on a new battlefield![/b]

notes.title: Improved Field Modification: Second Common Test of Update 1.14
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!
After completing the Sandbox server test of Field Modification, we thoroughly analyzed all feedback and data we had obtained. Following the test results, we improved certain aspects of Field Modification that had been widely discussed during the Sandbox testing.  

In the second Common Test of Update 1.14, we’ll offer you the newest version of Field Modification. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/19173d65a80095ba2d9e7a04c1f7be400bf166b9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Field Modification: A Feature to Tweak Your Favorite Tanks[/h2]
Let's take a quick look at the core mechanics of Field Modification and how they can benefit your favorite vehicles.

Field Modification is available for all Tier VI–X vehicles (including Collectors', special, and Premium vehicles but excluding rentals and vehicles from various special game modes, such as Steel Hunter or Mirny-13). In a nutshell, Field Modification is a set of tools for fine-tuning specific technical characteristics of your tanks, which will become available once they acquire Elite status.

Field Modification consists of three types of modifications that players can make to a vehicle's technical parameters or setup:
[list]
[*] Standard. These are unlocked using Combat or Free XP when the Field Modification level is increased. Standard Modifications provide a small boost to one characteristic, depending on the vehicle combat role.
[*] Dual. These are purchased using credits and allow your vehicle's characteristics to be redistributed so that it becomes more effective in one aspect at the cost of another.
[*] Special. The first two of these are available for Tier VI and VII vehicles, and the third for Tier VIII–X vehicles. The first Special Modification enables the Essentials Loadout, an alternative set of shells and consumables. The second Special Modification provides you with the Auxiliary Loadout, an alternative set of equipment and directives. The third Special Modification allows you to assign a category to a second equipment slot.
[/list]
Together, these modifications form the Modification Tree. Upon researching and purchasing modifications, you'll improve your vehicles by slightly increasing their technical characteristics to suit your needs.

Modifications affect vehicle parameters and thus the balance of the game in general. As a result, there may be some changes to numerical values in modifications in the future if we see that they are needed to maintain optimal vehicle balance.

When making decisions about Dual Modifications, pay attention to the values of specific vehicle parameters that change in the Field Modification window rather than the rating and fluctuations of the performance scale in the Garage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39263509/9b7c13683c9e16f8a1dcd917a29db8c619e6ad6f.png[/img]

If a Personal Mission requires your vehicle to have a specific piece of equipment or directive, those should be placed into the Main Configuration.

All Tier VI–X vehicles with access to Field Modification receive a special parameter: role. There is a total of 15 roles, like Assault Heavy Tank, Breakthrough Heavy Tank, and Versatile Medium Tank, to name a few. The Modification Tree is created for each vehicle with regard to its specific combat role, so the technical adjustments that vehicles of different roles receive from modifications may vary, even if they are of the same tank role.

Field Modification is designed to help you discover new facets of your gameplay and take a fresh look at the strengths of your favorite vehicles. It should not be considered a compulsory addition to the main Tech Tree, but it will make playing some of your tanks even more special and enjoyable.

[h2]Field Modification: Balance Improvements[/h2]
Results from the Sandbox survey show us that most of you liked the general concept of Field Modification and were positive about adding this functionality to the game. You generally appreciated the opportunity to fine-tune your favorite vehicles to your personal playstyle, so the core mechanics of Field Modification remain unchanged.

However, some of you had questions about higher bonuses from Standard Modifications for Tier IX and X vehicles and perceived unbalanced choices in some Dual Modifications. There were also some other concerns about improvements to parameters, which were considered excessive for certain vehicles, such as SPGs or wheeled vehicles.

We have carefully examined all these issues and made the necessary balance improvements. Now, Field Modification has a more balanced and consistent progression system for all vehicles. Individual tanks no longer see their performance fall below acceptable levels, regardless of what role they play in battle.

With your feedback, we adjusted the following Dual Modifications and the parameters they affect:

[h3]Light Tanks[/h3]
[list]
[*] All roles: reduced effects in the 3rd Dual Modification
[*] Wheeled light tanks: reduced effects in the 5th Dual Modification
[*] Versatile light tanks: reduced effects in both the 4th and 5th Dual Modifications
[/list]
[h3]Tank Destroyers[/h3]
[list]
[*] All roles: reduced effects in the 3rd Dual Modification
[*] Support tank destroyers: increased HP in both the 4th and 5th Dual Modifications
[*] Sniper tank destroyers: slightly reduced effects in the 5th Dual Modification
[*] Versatile tank destroyers: reduced effects in the 5th Dual Modification
[*] Assault tank destroyers: reduced effects in the 5th Dual Modification
[/list]
[h3]SPGs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced effects in both the 1st and 5th Dual Modifications
[*] Changed the standard concealment bonus for both the 1st and 3rd Dual Modifications
[/list]
[h3]Medium Tanks[/h3]
[list]
[*] All roles: reduced the chassis and turret traverse bonus in the 1st Dual Modification, removed turret stabilization from the 2nd Dual Modification, and reduced the repair speed bonus in the 3rd Dual Modification
[*] Sniper medium tanks: reduced effects in the 5th Dual Modification
[*] Versatile medium tanks: slightly reduced effects in both the 4th and 5th Dual Modifications
[*] Assault medium tanks: slightly reduced effects in the 4th Dual Modification; added turret stabilization and increased the view range bonus in the 5th Dual Modification
[/list]
[h3]Heavy Tanks[/h3]
[list]
[*] All roles: changed the composition of both the 1st and 3rd Dual Modifications by removing excessive mobility
[*] Support heavy tanks: changed the composition of both the 4th and 5th Dual Modifications—removed turret stabilization in the 4th Dual Modification and improved aiming time in the 5th Dual Modification
[*] Breakthrough heavy tanks: reduced the stabilization bonus in the 5th Dual Modification
[*] Versatile heavy tanks: removed forward speed in the 4th Dual Modification; removed turret stabilization and reduced the resistance bonus to HE shells in the 5th Dual Modification
[*] Assault heavy tanks: reduced the resistance bonus to HE shells in the 4th Dual Modification and reduced the repair speed bonus in the 5th Dual Modification
[/list]

[h3]Adjusted Dual Modifications[/h3]
We also reduced the bonuses of all vehicle combat roles at Levels VII and VIII of Field Modification.

Lastly, we listened to your concerns about the costs of increasing Field Modification Levels and purchasing Dual Modifications across various vehicle tiers. Now, depending on the vehicle tier, costs will be different, with the lowest ones for Tier VI tanks.

[h2]Comparison Window Improvement[/h2]
Another very important change to Field Modification is the improved comparison window, which will now support the following functionality: You can add several vehicles (or multiple different configurations of the same vehicle) for comparison and, by entering advanced settings, apply various modifications that include all possible changes to characteristics. This option will help you understand how to best fine-tune your favorite tanks and which modifications best suit your needs and individual playstyle.

[b]See you on the battlefield![/b]
